title: 海岸濕地復育水理
summary: 以Nisqually河口與南灣鹽田復育為背景，逐步理解濕地工程如何連結水位、潮溝、泥砂及棲地。十個原創單元從潮汐容積、淹水歷時和通道延遲，延伸至植生阻力、蒸發濃縮、有效沖洗及前後對照，所有公式都說明適用假設與需補充的觀測。
summaryEn: Using Nisqually estuary and South Bay salt-pond restoration as context, connect water levels, channels, sediment and habitat. Ten original units progress from prism, hydroperiod and tidal lag to vegetation drag, evaporation, effective flushing and controlled before-after comparison, stating assumptions and additional observations for every model.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
subcategoryTitle: 海岸、港灣與水資源韌性

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 教學假設固定儲水面積100000 m²、內部潮差1.0 m，得到每次漲潮容積100000 m³，但不能把它全部當成永久新水替換。另一個固定水量200000 m³的混合模型，每潮有效替換5%，十潮後仍有約59.87%舊水；這說明總交換量和有效沖洗不同。再假設每年淤積5 mm、淺層壓密1.5 mm，地表只升高3.5 mm；若同基準海面升高6 mm，濕地相對海面仍每年下降2.5 mm。請將這些獨立算例分開記帳，逐項改變參數，並用潮位、示蹤與高程資料檢查能否支持模型。
workedExample.textEn: Assume constant storage area 100000 m² and internal tidal range 1.0 m, giving 100000 m³ per flood tide, but not necessarily that amount of permanent new-water replacement. In a separate 200000 m³ mixed-volume model with 5% effective replacement per tide, about 59.87% old water remains after ten tides. Gross exchange and effective flushing differ. Separately, accretion of 5 mm/year and shallow compaction of 1.5 mm/year yield surface gain of 3.5 mm/year; against sea-level rise of 6 mm/year on the same datum, relative elevation declines 2.5 mm/year. Keep these scenarios distinct, vary their parameters and identify tidal, tracer and elevation observations that test each assumption.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「潮汐容積與高程面積曲線」與「淹水歷時與棲地高程」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Tidal prism and elevation-area curves" and "Inundation duration and habitat elevation": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 潮汐容積與高程面積曲線：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Tidal prism and elevation-area curves: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「潮汐容積與高程面積曲線」如何影響海岸濕地復育水理的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Tidal prism and elevation-area curves” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Hydraulics for coastal-wetland restoration”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 濕地恢復潮汐連通後，每個潮週期進出的水量取決於地形、潮差及通道限制，不能只用總土地面積代表實際受淹面積。潮汐容積可由不同水位間的面積積分得到，低灘、高灘和潮溝對體積的貢獻不同。若通道阻力使內部水位追不上外海潮位，外海潮差也不能直接套入濕地儲量曲線。教學先使用固定平面面積建立量綱概念，再要求以高程面積曲線和內外水位資料檢查簡化，避免把理想交換量當成實際淨沖洗量。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「潮汐容積與高程面積曲線」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: After tidal reconnection, exchanged volume depends on topography, tidal range and channel restrictions rather than total land area alone. Integrating inundated area between water levels gives tidal prism, with channels and marsh elevations contributing differently. If resistance prevents internal levels from tracking the sea, offshore tidal range cannot be applied directly to wetland storage. Begin with constant plan area, then examine elevation-area curves and internal levels, keeping gross tidal exchange distinct from net flushing of old water. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Tidal prism and elevation-area curves” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設垂直側壁儲水區、水平面積100000 m²，內部高潮與低潮水位差1.0 m；潮汐容積P=100000 m³。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Assume a vertical-sided storage area of 100000 m² and an internal high-to-low range of 1.0 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「濕地總土地面積乘外海潮差，永遠等於實際潮汐交換量與淨沖洗量。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Total wetland area times offshore tidal range always equals both actual tidal exchange and net flushing." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「潮汐容積與高程面積曲線」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Tidal prism and elevation-area curves”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 潮汐容積與高程面積曲線
knowledge.text: 濕地恢復潮汐連通後，每個潮週期進出的水量取決於地形、潮差及通道限制，不能只用總土地面積代表實際受淹面積。潮汐容積可由不同水位間的面積積分得到，低灘、高灘和潮溝對體積的貢獻不同。
knowledge.textEn: After tidal reconnection, exchanged volume depends on topography, tidal range and channel restrictions rather than total land area alone. Integrating inundated area between water levels gives tidal prism, with channels and marsh elevations contributing differently.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：濕地總土地面積乘外海潮差，永遠等於實際潮汐交換量與淨沖洗量。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Total wetland area times offshore tidal range always equals both actual tidal exchange and net flushing. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「潮汐容積與高程面積曲線」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Tidal prism and elevation-area curves" is correct?
options: 濕地總土地面積乘外海潮差，永遠等於實際潮汐交換量與淨沖洗量。
濕地恢復潮汐連通後，每個潮週期進出的水量取決於地形、潮差及通道限制，不能只用總土地面積代表實際受淹面積。
兩塊平台只要最高淹水深度相同，就一定具有相同的淹水歷時與棲地條件。
optionsEn: Total wetland area times offshore tidal range always equals both actual tidal exchange and net flushing.
After tidal reconnection, exchanged volume depends on topography, tidal range and channel restrictions rather than total land area alone.
Equal maximum inundation depth guarantees equal hydroperiod and habitat conditions.
quiz.explanation: 濕地恢復潮汐連通後，每個潮週期進出的水量取決於地形、潮差及通道限制，不能只用總土地面積代表實際受淹面積。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: After tidal reconnection, exchanged volume depends on topography, tidal range and channel restrictions rather than total land area alone. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 潮汐容積與高程面積曲線：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Tidal prism and elevation-area curves: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「潮汐容積與高程面積曲線」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Tidal prism and elevation-area curves” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設垂直側壁儲水區、水平面積100000 m²，內部高潮與低潮水位差1.0 m；潮汐容積P=100000 m³。這是每次漲潮的體積增量，不是整日淨入流。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Assume a vertical-sided storage area of 100000 m² and an internal high-to-low range of 1.0 m. Tidal prism is 100000 m³ per flood tide, not a daily net inflow. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以共同高程基準整理地形與內部潮位，逐段積分面積曲線並與固定面積近似比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Reconcile terrain and internal tide datums, integrate the area curve and compare with the constant-area approximation.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設垂直側壁儲水區、水平面積100000 m²，內部高潮與低潮水位差1.0 m；潮汐容積P=100000 m³。這是每次漲潮的體積增量，不是整日淨入流。
knowledge.textEn: Assume a vertical-sided storage area of 100000 m² and an internal high-to-low range of 1.0 m. Tidal prism is 100000 m³ per flood tide, not a daily net inflow.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「潮汐容積與高程面積曲線」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Tidal prism and elevation-area curves", which statement holds?
options: 兩側水位相同時，只要開口位於水下，就一定仍有很大的單向淨流量。
只要每年有泥砂沉積，濕地地表相對海面就一定會逐年升高。
教學假設垂直側壁儲水區、水平面積100000 m²，內部高潮與低潮水位差1.0 m；潮汐容積P=100000 m³。
optionsEn: A submerged opening necessarily carries a large one-way net flow even when both water levels are equal.
Any annual sediment deposition guarantees that wetland elevation rises relative to sea level.
Assume a vertical-sided storage area of 100000 m² and an internal high-to-low range of 1.0 m.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設垂直側壁儲水區、水平面積100000 m²，內部高潮與低潮水位差1.0 m；潮汐容積P=100000 m³。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Assume a vertical-sided storage area of 100000 m² and an internal high-to-low range of 1.0 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 潮汐容積與高程面積曲線：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Tidal prism and elevation-area curves: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「潮汐容積與高程面積曲線」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Tidal prism and elevation-area curves” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以共同高程基準整理地形與內部潮位，逐段積分面積曲線並與固定面積近似比較。核對潮溝和高灘是否在該水位範圍真正被淹，另以流量時間積分檢查一個完整潮週期的入出水量，保留降雨與河川流入的影響。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Reconcile terrain and internal tide datums, integrate the area curve and compare with the constant-area approximation. Check which channels and platforms are actually inundated, then compare integrated flow over a complete tidal cycle while accounting separately for rainfall and river inflow. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：建立兩段高程面積曲線，讓低水位時只有潮溝存水，高水位時才淹過平台。用分段積分重算潮汐容積，再降低內部潮差，說明地形與水力限制如何分別改變交換量，並列出需要的觀測資料。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Create a two-part area curve with channel-only storage at low levels and platform inundation higher up. Integrate the prism, reduce internal tidal range separately, and explain how terrain and hydraulic restrictions affect exchange and what observations distinguish them.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：使用總土地面積乘外海潮差，可能把從未淹水的高地算進交換量。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Multiplying total land area by offshore range can include dry high ground. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以共同高程基準整理地形與內部潮位，逐段積分面積曲線並與固定面積近似比較。核對潮溝和高灘是否在該水位範圍真正被淹，另以流量時間積分檢查一個完整潮週期的入出水量，保留降雨與河川流入的影響。
knowledge.textEn: Reconcile terrain and internal tide datums, integrate the area curve and compare with the constant-area approximation. Check which channels and platforms are actually inundated, then compare integrated flow over a complete tidal cycle while accounting separately for rainfall and river inflow.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 建立兩段高程面積曲線，讓低水位時只有潮溝存水，高水位時才淹過平台。用分段積分重算潮汐容積，再降低內部潮差，說明地形與水力限制如何分別改變交換量，並列出需要的觀測資料。
knowledge.textEn: Create a two-part area curve with channel-only storage at low levels and platform inundation higher up. Integrate the prism, reduce internal tidal range separately, and explain how terrain and hydraulic restrictions affect exchange and what observations distinguish them.

quiz.question: 要驗證「潮汐容積與高程面積曲線」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Tidal prism and elevation-area curves"?
options: 以共同高程基準整理地形與內部潮位，逐段積分面積曲線並與固定面積近似比較。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
水中鹽濃度升高，一定代表有新的海水流入，不可能只由蒸發造成。
optionsEn: Reconcile terrain and internal tide datums, integrate the area curve and compare with the constant-area approximation.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Increasing salt concentration necessarily proves new seawater inflow and cannot result from evaporation alone.
quiz.explanation: 以共同高程基準整理地形與內部潮位，逐段積分面積曲線並與固定面積近似比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Reconcile terrain and internal tide datums, integrate the area curve and compare with the constant-area approximation. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 潮汐容積與高程面積曲線：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Tidal prism and elevation-area curves: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「潮汐容積與高程面積曲線」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Tidal prism and elevation-area curves” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 使用總土地面積乘外海潮差，可能把從未淹水的高地算進交換量。把漲潮容積再當成淨淡水補充，則忽略退潮排出與舊水返回，容易高估沖洗和水質改善。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Multiplying total land area by offshore range can include dry high ground. Treating flood-tide prism as net freshwater supply further ignores ebb discharge and returning old water, exaggerating flushing and potential quality improvement. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：教學先使用固定平面面積建立量綱概念，再要求以高程面積曲線和內外水位資料檢查簡化，避免把理想交換量當成實際淨沖洗量。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Begin with constant plan area, then examine elevation-area curves and internal levels, keeping gross tidal exchange distinct from net flushing of old water.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「濕地總土地面積乘外海潮差，永遠等於實際潮汐交換量與淨沖洗量。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Total wetland area times offshore tidal range always equals both actual tidal exchange and net flushing." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 使用總土地面積乘外海潮差，可能把從未淹水的高地算進交換量。把漲潮容積再當成淨淡水補充，則忽略退潮排出與舊水返回，容易高估沖洗和水質改善。
knowledge.textEn: Multiplying total land area by offshore range can include dry high ground. Treating flood-tide prism as net freshwater supply further ignores ebb discharge and returning old water, exaggerating flushing and potential quality improvement.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「潮汐容積與高程面積曲線」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Tidal prism and elevation-area curves" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
使用總土地面積乘外海潮差，可能把從未淹水的高地算進交換量。
兩塊平台只要最高淹水深度相同，就一定具有相同的淹水歷時與棲地條件。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Multiplying total land area by offshore range can include dry high ground.
Equal maximum inundation depth guarantees equal hydroperiod and habitat conditions.
quiz.explanation: 使用總土地面積乘外海潮差，可能把從未淹水的高地算進交換量。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Multiplying total land area by offshore range can include dry high ground. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 淹水歷時與棲地高程：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Inundation duration and habitat elevation: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「淹水歷時與棲地高程」如何影響海岸濕地復育水理的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Inundation duration and habitat elevation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Hydraulics for coastal-wetland restoration”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 濕地植物與土壤環境受到淹水的頻率、深度和持續時間影響，單一最高水位無法描述整個水文條件。理想正弦潮可用來推導某平台高程被淹的時間比例，但真實潮汐包含多個分量、風暴增水及河川作用，不能用一天代表全年。復育評估應讓地形高程和水位使用相同基準，並同時檢查長時間積水及極端乾燥情境。課程算例只描述水理，不把某個淹水比例直接當成所有物種都適合的生態門檻。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「淹水歷時與棲地高程」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Wetland vegetation and soils respond to inundation frequency, depth and duration, which a single maximum level cannot describe. A sinusoidal tide can estimate the time a platform is submerged, but real tides combine multiple constituents, surges and river effects, so one day cannot represent a year. Align terrain and water-level datums and consider both persistent flooding and drying. The teaching calculation describes hydraulics without treating one hydroperiod fraction as a universal ecological suitability threshold. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Inundation duration and habitat elevation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設水位η=1.0 sin(ωt) m、平均水位0 m，平台高程0.50 m，週期12.42 h；淹水比例1/2−asin(0.5)/π=1/3，每週期淹水4.14 h。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For an ideal tide η=1.0 sin(ωt) m, mean zero, platform elevation 0.50 m and period 12.42 hours, inundation fraction is 1/2−asin(0.5)/π=1/3, or 4.14 hours per cycle.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兩塊平台只要最高淹水深度相同，就一定具有相同的淹水歷時與棲地條件。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equal maximum inundation depth guarantees equal hydroperiod and habitat conditions." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「淹水歷時與棲地高程」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Inundation duration and habitat elevation”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 淹水歷時與棲地高程
knowledge.text: 濕地植物與土壤環境受到淹水的頻率、深度和持續時間影響，單一最高水位無法描述整個水文條件。理想正弦潮可用來推導某平台高程被淹的時間比例，但真實潮汐包含多個分量、風暴增水及河川作用，不能用一天代表全年。
knowledge.textEn: Wetland vegetation and soils respond to inundation frequency, depth and duration, which a single maximum level cannot describe. A sinusoidal tide can estimate the time a platform is submerged, but real tides combine multiple constituents, surges and river effects, so one day cannot represent a year.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：兩塊平台只要最高淹水深度相同，就一定具有相同的淹水歷時與棲地條件。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Equal maximum inundation depth guarantees equal hydroperiod and habitat conditions. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「淹水歷時與棲地高程」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Inundation duration and habitat elevation" is correct?
options: 兩塊平台只要最高淹水深度相同，就一定具有相同的淹水歷時與棲地條件。
內部與外部最高水位接近，就表示整個潮週期沒有任何阻力或相位延遲。
濕地植物與土壤環境受到淹水的頻率、深度和持續時間影響，單一最高水位無法描述整個水文條件。
optionsEn: Equal maximum inundation depth guarantees equal hydroperiod and habitat conditions.
Similar internal and external high-water levels prove the full tide has no resistance or phase delay.
Wetland vegetation and soils respond to inundation frequency, depth and duration, which a single maximum level cannot describe.
quiz.explanation: 濕地植物與土壤環境受到淹水的頻率、深度和持續時間影響，單一最高水位無法描述整個水文條件。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Wetland vegetation and soils respond to inundation frequency, depth and duration, which a single maximum level cannot describe. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 淹水歷時與棲地高程：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Inundation duration and habitat elevation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「淹水歷時與棲地高程」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Inundation duration and habitat elevation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設水位η=1.0 sin(ωt) m、平均水位0 m，平台高程0.50 m，週期12.42 h；淹水比例1/2−asin(0.5)/π=1/3，每週期淹水4.14 h。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For an ideal tide η=1.0 sin(ωt) m, mean zero, platform elevation 0.50 m and period 12.42 hours, inundation fraction is 1/2−asin(0.5)/π=1/3, or 4.14 hours per cycle. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：先畫出水位曲線與平台線，確認積分的是高於平台的時段而非低於平台的時段。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Plot tide and platform elevation, checking that counted intervals are above the platform.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設水位η=1.0 sin(ωt) m、平均水位0 m，平台高程0.50 m，週期12.42 h；淹水比例1/2−asin(0.5)/π=1/3，每週期淹水4.14 h。
knowledge.textEn: For an ideal tide η=1.0 sin(ωt) m, mean zero, platform elevation 0.50 m and period 12.42 hours, inundation fraction is 1/2−asin(0.5)/π=1/3, or 4.14 hours per cycle.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「淹水歷時與棲地高程」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Inundation duration and habitat elevation", which statement holds?
options: 教學假設水位η=1.0 sin(ωt) m、平均水位0 m，平台高程0.50 m，週期12.42 h。
漲潮帶入的所有懸浮泥砂都會永久留在濕地，完全不需計算退潮輸出。
植生覆蓋率相同的兩片濕地，在任何水深和流速下都必定產生相同阻力。
optionsEn: For an ideal tide η=1.0 sin(ωt) m, mean zero, platform elevation 0.50 m and period 12.42 hours, inundation fraction is 1/2−asin(0.5)/π=1/3, or 4.14 hours per cycle.
All sediment entering on flood tides remains permanently in the wetland, so ebb export can be ignored.
Equal vegetation cover guarantees equal drag at every depth and velocity.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設水位η=1.0 sin(ωt) m、平均水位0 m，平台高程0.50 m，週期12.42 h；淹水比例1/2−asin(0.5)/π=1/3，每週期淹水4.14 h。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: For an ideal tide η=1.0 sin(ωt) m, mean zero, platform elevation 0.50 m and period 12.42 hours, inundation fraction is 1/2−asin(0.5)/π=1/3, or 4.14 hours per cycle. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 淹水歷時與棲地高程：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Inundation duration and habitat elevation: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「淹水歷時與棲地高程」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Inundation duration and habitat elevation” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 先畫出水位曲線與平台線，確認積分的是高於平台的時段而非低於平台的時段。用實際時序逐點統計淹水時間，檢查取樣間隔及缺值，再將春潮、小潮與季節期間分列，不用理想單一週期取代長期觀測。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Plot tide and platform elevation, checking that counted intervals are above the platform. Calculate duration directly from observed time series, review sampling and missing data, and separate spring, neap and seasonal periods rather than replacing long-term behavior with one idealized cycle. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將平台高程改為0.25 m，重算理想淹水比例和時數。再加入固定增水0.20 m，區分地形下降與平均水位上升造成的相似效果，並說明需要哪些基準量測才能辨別兩種成因。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Lower the platform to 0.25 m and recalculate fraction and duration. Add a separate 0.20 m mean-water increase, distinguish similar effects of terrain lowering and water-level rise, and identify datum observations needed to separate these causes.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：地形與潮位基準差幾十公分，就可能顯著改變淹水比例。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A datum mismatch of tens of centimetres can substantially alter hydroperiod estimates. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 先畫出水位曲線與平台線，確認積分的是高於平台的時段而非低於平台的時段。用實際時序逐點統計淹水時間，檢查取樣間隔及缺值，再將春潮、小潮與季節期間分列，不用理想單一週期取代長期觀測。

Calculate duration directly from observed time series, review sampling and missing data, and separate spring, neap and seasonal periods rather than replacing long-term behavior with one idealized cycle.

knowledge.text: 將平台高程改為0.25 m，重算理想淹水比例和時數。再加入固定增水0.20 m，區分地形下降與平均水位上升造成的相似效果，並說明需要哪些基準量測才能辨別兩種成因。
knowledge.textEn: Lower the platform to 0.25 m and recalculate fraction and duration. Add a separate 0.20 m mean-water increase, distinguish similar effects of terrain lowering and water-level rise, and identify datum observations needed to separate these causes.

quiz.question: 要驗證「淹水歷時與棲地高程」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Inundation duration and habitat elevation"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
先畫出水位曲線與平台線，確認積分的是高於平台的時段而非低於平台的時段。
每次漲潮進入多少水，就一定有同樣體積的舊水被永久替換而不再返回。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Plot tide and platform elevation, checking that counted intervals are above the platform.
Every flood-tide inflow permanently replaces an equal old-water volume that can never return.
quiz.explanation: 先畫出水位曲線與平台線，確認積分的是高於平台的時段而非低於平台的時段。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Plot tide and platform elevation, checking that counted intervals are above the platform. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 淹水歷時與棲地高程：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Inundation duration and habitat elevation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「淹水歷時與棲地高程」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Inundation duration and habitat elevation” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 地形與潮位基準差幾十公分，就可能顯著改變淹水比例。若只量高潮水位而不記錄時間，也無法分辨短暫越淹與長時間積水，可能使棲地判讀失去關鍵資訊。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A datum mismatch of tens of centimetres can substantially alter hydroperiod estimates. Recording only high water cannot distinguish brief inundation from persistent ponding, removing information essential to interpreting habitat conditions and restoration response. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

quiz.question: 在「淹水歷時與棲地高程」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Inundation duration and habitat elevation" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
內部與外部最高水位接近，就表示整個潮週期沒有任何阻力或相位延遲。
地形與潮位基準差幾十公分，就可能顯著改變淹水比例。

stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Channel resistance and tidal lag" and "Connecting openings and differential-head flow": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 通道阻力與潮汐延遲：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Channel resistance and tidal lag: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「通道阻力與潮汐延遲」如何影響海岸濕地復育水理的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Channel resistance and tidal lag” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Hydraulics for coastal-wetland restoration”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 濕地與外海之間的連通通道會限制流量，使內部水位振幅減小並落後外部潮位。線性集總儲水模型把通道流量近似為內外水位差的比例，配合儲量守恆得到一階低通反應。這種模型假設面積與通水能力固定，適合說明時間尺度，卻不能描述閘門切換、乾濕交替或高速非線性流動。判讀復育後的水位時，應同時看振幅和相位，不只以最高水位接近外海就認為整個潮週期交換完全恢復。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「通道阻力與潮汐延遲」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A connecting channel limits flow, attenuating internal tidal amplitude and delaying the wetland response. A linear lumped-storage model makes flow proportional to the external-internal level difference, producing a first-order low-pass response through conservation. Constant area and conductance simplify timescales but cannot describe gate switching, wetting-drying or strongly nonlinear flow. Examine amplitude and phase together rather than assuming full tidal exchange is restored merely because the internal high-water mark approaches the sea level. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Channel resistance and tidal lag” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設線性儲水時間常數τ=2.0 h，外潮週期12.42 h；振幅比R=1/√[1+(2π×2/12.42)²]約0.703，相位落後atan(2π×2/12.42)約0.791 rad。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For linear storage time constant 2.0 hours and tidal period 12.42 hours, amplitude ratio is 1/√[1+(2π×2/12.42)²]≈0.703 and phase lag atan(2π×2/12.42)≈0.791 radians.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「內部與外部最高水位接近，就表示整個潮週期沒有任何阻力或相位延遲。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Similar internal and external high-water levels prove the full tide has no resistance or phase delay." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「通道阻力與潮汐延遲」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Channel resistance and tidal lag”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 通道阻力與潮汐延遲
knowledge.text: 濕地與外海之間的連通通道會限制流量，使內部水位振幅減小並落後外部潮位。線性集總儲水模型把通道流量近似為內外水位差的比例，配合儲量守恆得到一階低通反應。
knowledge.textEn: A connecting channel limits flow, attenuating internal tidal amplitude and delaying the wetland response. A linear lumped-storage model makes flow proportional to the external-internal level difference, producing a first-order low-pass response through conservation.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：內部與外部最高水位接近，就表示整個潮週期沒有任何阻力或相位延遲。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Similar internal and external high-water levels prove the full tide has no resistance or phase delay. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「通道阻力與潮汐延遲」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Channel resistance and tidal lag" is correct?
options: 濕地與外海之間的連通通道會限制流量，使內部水位振幅減小並落後外部潮位。
內部與外部最高水位接近，就表示整個潮週期沒有任何阻力或相位延遲。
兩側水位相同時，只要開口位於水下，就一定仍有很大的單向淨流量。
optionsEn: A connecting channel limits flow, attenuating internal tidal amplitude and delaying the wetland response.
Similar internal and external high-water levels prove the full tide has no resistance or phase delay.
A submerged opening necessarily carries a large one-way net flow even when both water levels are equal.
quiz.explanation: 濕地與外海之間的連通通道會限制流量，使內部水位振幅減小並落後外部潮位。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A connecting channel limits flow, attenuating internal tidal amplitude and delaying the wetland response. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 通道阻力與潮汐延遲：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Channel resistance and tidal lag: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「通道阻力與潮汐延遲」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Channel resistance and tidal lag” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設線性儲水時間常數τ=2.0 h，外潮週期12.42 h；振幅比R=1/√[1+(2π×2/12.42)²]約0.703，相位落後atan(2π×2/12.42)約0.791 rad。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For linear storage time constant 2.0 hours and tidal period 12.42 hours, amplitude ratio is 1/√[1+(2π×2/12.42)²]≈0.703 and phase lag atan(2π×2/12.42)≈0.791 radians. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將內外水位時間戳同步，以同一潮汐分量比較振幅與相位，並確認時間常數和週期單位一致。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Synchronize internal and external level timestamps and compare the same tidal component, checking consistent time units.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設線性儲水時間常數τ=2.0 h，外潮週期12.42 h；振幅比R=1/√[1+(2π×2/12.42)²]約0.703，相位落後atan(2π×2/12.42)約0.791 rad。
knowledge.textEn: For linear storage time constant 2.0 hours and tidal period 12.42 hours, amplitude ratio is 1/√[1+(2π×2/12.42)²]≈0.703 and phase lag atan(2π×2/12.42)≈0.791 radians.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「通道阻力與潮汐延遲」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Channel resistance and tidal lag", which statement holds?
options: 只要每年有泥砂沉積，濕地地表相對海面就一定會逐年升高。
教學假設線性儲水時間常數τ=2.0 h，外潮週期12.42 h。
水中鹽濃度升高，一定代表有新的海水流入，不可能只由蒸發造成。
optionsEn: Any annual sediment deposition guarantees that wetland elevation rises relative to sea level.
For linear storage time constant 2.0 hours and tidal period 12.42 hours, amplitude ratio is 1/√[1+(2π×2/12.42)²]≈0.703 and phase lag atan(2π×2/12.42)≈0.791 radians.
Increasing salt concentration necessarily proves new seawater inflow and cannot result from evaporation alone.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設線性儲水時間常數τ=2.0 h，外潮週期12.42 h；振幅比R=1/√[1+(2π×2/12.42)²]約0.703，相位落後atan(2π×2/12.42)約0.791 rad。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: For linear storage time constant 2.0 hours and tidal period 12.42 hours, amplitude ratio is 1/√[1+(2π×2/12.42)²]≈0.703 and phase lag atan(2π×2/12.42)≈0.791 radians. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 通道阻力與潮汐延遲：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Channel resistance and tidal lag: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「通道阻力與潮汐延遲」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Channel resistance and tidal lag” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將內外水位時間戳同步，以同一潮汐分量比較振幅與相位，並確認時間常數和週期單位一致。檢查不同潮差下的反應是否仍近似線性，若高低潮時殘差系統性改變，應調查面積變化、乾濕邊界或通道非線性。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Synchronize internal and external level timestamps and compare the same tidal component, checking consistent time units. Evaluate whether responses remain linear across ranges; systematic residuals near high or low water should prompt investigation of changing area, wetting-drying or nonlinear channel behavior. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將時間常數減半，重算振幅比與相位，再將週期改成原來兩倍。比較通道改善與潮汐頻率改變的不同情境，並列出需要由觀測支持的固定面積、線性通水能力及時間同步假設。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Halve the time constant and recalculate amplitude and phase, then double tidal period separately. Compare channel improvement with changed forcing frequency and list observations needed to support constant area, linear conductance and synchronized timing assumptions.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只用最高水位校正模型，可能得到錯誤交換時間尺度而仍看似吻合。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Calibrating only high water can conceal an incorrect exchange timescale. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將內外水位時間戳同步，以同一潮汐分量比較振幅與相位，並確認時間常數和週期單位一致。檢查不同潮差下的反應是否仍近似線性，若高低潮時殘差系統性改變，應調查面積變化、乾濕邊界或通道非線性。
knowledge.textEn: Synchronize internal and external level timestamps and compare the same tidal component, checking consistent time units. Evaluate whether responses remain linear across ranges; systematic residuals near high or low water should prompt investigation of changing area, wetting-drying or nonlinear channel behavior.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將時間常數減半，重算振幅比與相位，再將週期改成原來兩倍。比較通道改善與潮汐頻率改變的不同情境，並列出需要由觀測支持的固定面積、線性通水能力及時間同步假設。
knowledge.textEn: Halve the time constant and recalculate amplitude and phase, then double tidal period separately. Compare channel improvement with changed forcing frequency and list observations needed to support constant area, linear conductance and synchronized timing assumptions.

quiz.question: 要驗證「通道阻力與潮汐延遲」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Channel resistance and tidal lag"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
復育區指標變好就足以證明工程造成全部改善，不需要對照、季節或變異資料。
將內外水位時間戳同步，以同一潮汐分量比較振幅與相位，並確認時間常數和週期單位一致。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Improvement at the restoration site alone proves the project caused every change without controls or variability data.
Synchronize internal and external level timestamps and compare the same tidal component, checking consistent time units.
quiz.explanation: 將內外水位時間戳同步，以同一潮汐分量比較振幅與相位，並確認時間常數和週期單位一致。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Synchronize internal and external level timestamps and compare the same tidal component, checking consistent time units. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 通道阻力與潮汐延遲：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Channel resistance and tidal lag: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「通道阻力與潮汐延遲」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Channel resistance and tidal lag” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只用最高水位校正模型，可能得到錯誤交換時間尺度而仍看似吻合。儀器時鐘偏差也會產生假的相位落後；若把兩者混淆，可能錯判通道阻力或復育後的水力連通改善。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Calibrating only high water can conceal an incorrect exchange timescale. Instrument clock offsets also create false phase lag, potentially leading to mistaken conclusions about channel resistance or improved hydraulic connectivity following restoration. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判讀復育後的水位時，應同時看振幅和相位，不只以最高水位接近外海就認為整個潮週期交換完全恢復。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Examine amplitude and phase together rather than assuming full tidal exchange is restored merely because the internal high-water mark approaches the sea level.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「內部與外部最高水位接近，就表示整個潮週期沒有任何阻力或相位延遲。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Similar internal and external high-water levels prove the full tide has no resistance or phase delay." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只用最高水位校正模型，可能得到錯誤交換時間尺度而仍看似吻合。儀器時鐘偏差也會產生假的相位落後；若把兩者混淆，可能錯判通道阻力或復育後的水力連通改善。
knowledge.textEn: Calibrating only high water can conceal an incorrect exchange timescale. Instrument clock offsets also create false phase lag, potentially leading to mistaken conclusions about channel resistance or improved hydraulic connectivity following restoration.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「通道阻力與潮汐延遲」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Channel resistance and tidal lag" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 只用最高水位校正模型，可能得到錯誤交換時間尺度而仍看似吻合。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
兩側水位相同時，只要開口位於水下，就一定仍有很大的單向淨流量。
optionsEn: Calibrating only high water can conceal an incorrect exchange timescale.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
A submerged opening necessarily carries a large one-way net flow even when both water levels are equal.
quiz.explanation: 只用最高水位校正模型，可能得到錯誤交換時間尺度而仍看似吻合。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Calibrating only high water can conceal an incorrect exchange timescale. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 連通開口與差水頭流量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Connecting openings and differential-head flow: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「連通開口與差水頭流量」如何影響海岸濕地復育水理的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Connecting openings and differential-head flow” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Hydraulics for coastal-wetland restoration”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 兩側都淹沒的連通開口可用差水頭孔口式作初步教學估算，流量與開口面積成正比、與差水頭平方根成正比。係數概括收縮與能量損失，不能把任意數值直接當成現地設備的校正值。潮汐會使差水頭方向改變，流量符號也需要跟著變；如果一側露出水面，原先的淹沒孔口條件可能失效。濕地復育還要兼顧泥砂、漂流物與生態通行，單一流量公式不能決定實際開口尺寸或施工方式。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「連通開口與差水頭流量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A submerged connection can be illustrated with a differential-head orifice relation: discharge scales with opening area and the square root of head difference. Its coefficient represents contraction and losses, not an arbitrary field calibration. Tides reverse the head difference and flow direction, while exposure of one side can invalidate submerged-flow assumptions. Sediment, debris and ecological passage also matter, so a single discharge equation cannot determine a restoration opening size or construction approach. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Connecting openings and differential-head flow” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設兩側淹沒、準定常流，Cd=0.62、開口2.0 m²、差水頭0.25 m；Q=0.62×2×√(2×9.81×0.25)=2.746 m³/s，方向由高水頭流向低水頭。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Assume submerged quasi-steady flow, coefficient 0.62, opening area 2.0 m² and head difference 0.25 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兩側水位相同時，只要開口位於水下，就一定仍有很大的單向淨流量。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A submerged opening necessarily carries a large one-way net flow even when both water levels are equal." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「連通開口與差水頭流量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Connecting openings and differential-head flow”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 連通開口與差水頭流量
knowledge.text: 兩側都淹沒的連通開口可用差水頭孔口式作初步教學估算，流量與開口面積成正比、與差水頭平方根成正比。係數概括收縮與能量損失，不能把任意數值直接當成現地設備的校正值。
knowledge.textEn: A submerged connection can be illustrated with a differential-head orifice relation: discharge scales with opening area and the square root of head difference. Its coefficient represents contraction and losses, not an arbitrary field calibration.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：兩側水位相同時，只要開口位於水下，就一定仍有很大的單向淨流量。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A submerged opening necessarily carries a large one-way net flow even when both water levels are equal. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「連通開口與差水頭流量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Connecting openings and differential-head flow" is correct?
options: 兩側水位相同時，只要開口位於水下，就一定仍有很大的單向淨流量。
兩側都淹沒的連通開口可用差水頭孔口式作初步教學估算，流量與開口面積成正比、與差水頭平方根成正比。
漲潮帶入的所有懸浮泥砂都會永久留在濕地，完全不需計算退潮輸出。
optionsEn: A submerged opening necessarily carries a large one-way net flow even when both water levels are equal.
A submerged connection can be illustrated with a differential-head orifice relation: discharge scales with opening area and the square root of head difference.
All sediment entering on flood tides remains permanently in the wetland, so ebb export can be ignored.
quiz.explanation: 兩側都淹沒的連通開口可用差水頭孔口式作初步教學估算，流量與開口面積成正比、與差水頭平方根成正比。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A submerged connection can be illustrated with a differential-head orifice relation: discharge scales with opening area and the square root of head difference. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 連通開口與差水頭流量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Connecting openings and differential-head flow: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「連通開口與差水頭流量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Connecting openings and differential-head flow” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設兩側淹沒、準定常流，Cd=0.62、開口2.0 m²、差水頭0.25 m；Q=0.62×2×√(2×9.81×0.25)=2.746 m³/s，方向由高水頭流向低水頭。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Assume submerged quasi-steady flow, coefficient 0.62, opening area 2.0 m² and head difference 0.25 m. Discharge is 0.62×2×√(2×9.81×0.25)=2.746 m³/s, directed from higher to lower head. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同時記錄兩側水位與開口狀態，確認差水頭而非單側水深進入公式。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record levels on both sides and opening status, confirming that the formula uses differential head rather than one-sided depth.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設兩側淹沒、準定常流，Cd=0.62、開口2.0 m²、差水頭0.25 m；Q=0.62×2×√(2×9.81×0.25)=2.746 m³/s，方向由高水頭流向低水頭。
knowledge.textEn: Assume submerged quasi-steady flow, coefficient 0.62, opening area 2.0 m² and head difference 0.25 m. Discharge is 0.62×2×√(2×9.81×0.25)=2.746 m³/s, directed from higher to lower head.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「連通開口與差水頭流量」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Connecting openings and differential-head flow", which statement holds?
options: 植生覆蓋率相同的兩片濕地，在任何水深和流速下都必定產生相同阻力。
每次漲潮進入多少水，就一定有同樣體積的舊水被永久替換而不再返回。
教學假設兩側淹沒、準定常流，Cd=0.62、開口2.0 m²、差水頭0.25 m。
optionsEn: Equal vegetation cover guarantees equal drag at every depth and velocity.
Every flood-tide inflow permanently replaces an equal old-water volume that can never return.
Assume submerged quasi-steady flow, coefficient 0.62, opening area 2.0 m² and head difference 0.25 m.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設兩側淹沒、準定常流，Cd=0.62、開口2.0 m²、差水頭0.25 m；Q=0.62×2×√(2×9.81×0.25)=2.746 m³/s，方向由高水頭流向低水頭。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Assume submerged quasi-steady flow, coefficient 0.62, opening area 2.0 m² and head difference 0.25 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 連通開口與差水頭流量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Connecting openings and differential-head flow: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「連通開口與差水頭流量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Connecting openings and differential-head flow” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同時記錄兩側水位與開口狀態，確認差水頭而非單側水深進入公式。以正負號表示流向，檢查接近零差水頭與退潮露出的時段，對不符合淹沒條件的資料另行分類，不用同一係數硬套所有流況。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record levels on both sides and opening status, confirming that the formula uses differential head rather than one-sided depth. Track flow sign and classify near-zero or exposed conditions separately instead of forcing one coefficient across regimes that do not meet the submerged-flow assumptions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將差水頭降為原值四分之一，保持面積和係數不變，重算流量並比較比例。再交換兩側水位，標出流向改變，最後說明當一側出露或開口堵塞時，哪些假設需要重新檢查。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Reduce head difference to one quarter at unchanged area and coefficient, then compare discharge ratios. Swap the levels to show reversal and identify assumptions requiring review when one side emerges or the opening becomes partially blocked.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把單側水深當成差水頭，可能在兩側同樣高水位時仍算出巨大流量。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using one-sided depth as differential head can predict large flow when both sides have equal levels. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 同時記錄兩側水位與開口狀態，確認差水頭而非單側水深進入公式。以正負號表示流向，檢查接近零差水頭與退潮露出的時段，對不符合淹沒條件的資料另行分類，不用同一係數硬套所有流況。
knowledge.textEn: Record levels on both sides and opening status, confirming that the formula uses differential head rather than one-sided depth. Track flow sign and classify near-zero or exposed conditions separately instead of forcing one coefficient across regimes that do not meet the submerged-flow assumptions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將差水頭降為原值四分之一，保持面積和係數不變，重算流量並比較比例。再交換兩側水位，標出流向改變，最後說明當一側出露或開口堵塞時，哪些假設需要重新檢查。
knowledge.textEn: Reduce head difference to one quarter at unchanged area and coefficient, then compare discharge ratios. Swap the levels to show reversal and identify assumptions requiring review when one side emerges or the opening becomes partially blocked.

quiz.question: 要驗證「連通開口與差水頭流量」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Connecting openings and differential-head flow"?
options: 同時記錄兩側水位與開口狀態，確認差水頭而非單側水深進入公式。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
濕地總土地面積乘外海潮差，永遠等於實際潮汐交換量與淨沖洗量。
optionsEn: Record levels on both sides and opening status, confirming that the formula uses differential head rather than one-sided depth.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Total wetland area times offshore tidal range always equals both actual tidal exchange and net flushing.
quiz.explanation: 同時記錄兩側水位與開口狀態，確認差水頭而非單側水深進入公式。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Record levels on both sides and opening status, confirming that the formula uses differential head rather than one-sided depth. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 連通開口與差水頭流量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Connecting openings and differential-head flow: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「連通開口與差水頭流量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Connecting openings and differential-head flow” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把單側水深當成差水頭，可能在兩側同樣高水位時仍算出巨大流量。忽略潮汐反向則會把整個週期的往返水量都算成單向淨輸送，破壞水量守恆。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using one-sided depth as differential head can predict large flow when both sides have equal levels. Ignoring reversal counts back-and-forth tidal movement as unidirectional transport and breaks the cycle water balance. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：濕地復育還要兼顧泥砂、漂流物與生態通行，單一流量公式不能決定實際開口尺寸或施工方式。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Sediment, debris and ecological passage also matter, so a single discharge equation cannot determine a restoration opening size or construction approach.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「兩側水位相同時，只要開口位於水下，就一定仍有很大的單向淨流量。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A submerged opening necessarily carries a large one-way net flow even when both water levels are equal." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把單側水深當成差水頭，可能在兩側同樣高水位時仍算出巨大流量。忽略潮汐反向則會把整個週期的往返水量都算成單向淨輸送，破壞水量守恆。
knowledge.textEn: Using one-sided depth as differential head can predict large flow when both sides have equal levels. Ignoring reversal counts back-and-forth tidal movement as unidirectional transport and breaks the cycle water balance.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「連通開口與差水頭流量」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Connecting openings and differential-head flow" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
把單側水深當成差水頭，可能在兩側同樣高水位時仍算出巨大流量。
漲潮帶入的所有懸浮泥砂都會永久留在濕地，完全不需計算退潮輸出。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Using one-sided depth as differential head can predict large flow when both sides have equal levels.
All sediment entering on flood tides remains permanently in the wetland, so ebb export can be ignored.
quiz.explanation: 把單側水深當成差水頭，可能在兩側同樣高水位時仍算出巨大流量。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using one-sided depth as differential head can predict large flow when both sides have equal levels. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「泥砂質量與平台淤積」與「淤積、高程變化與相對海面」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Sediment mass and platform accretion" and "Accretion, elevation change and relative sea level": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 泥砂質量與平台淤積：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Sediment mass and platform accretion: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「泥砂質量與平台淤積」如何影響海岸濕地復育水理的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Sediment mass and platform accretion” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Hydraulics for coastal-wetland restoration”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 進入濕地的懸浮泥砂只有部分會留在平台，其餘可能隨退潮排出或在潮溝重新懸浮。由水量與濃度估算進入質量後，還需要保留比例和乾體積密度才能換算沉積體積與厚度。這個換算不等於地表高程的最終增加，因為壓密、侵蝕與有機物變化也會影響高程。復育監測應同時採集流量、濃度、地形重測與沉積層資料，讓短期泥砂通量與長期平台變化能互相檢驗，而非只依一場濁水事件推論長期成長。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「泥砂質量與平台淤積」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Only part of incoming suspended sediment remains on a wetland platform; the rest can leave on ebb tides or be resuspended. Convert water volume and concentration to incoming mass, then apply a retained fraction and dry bulk density to estimate deposited volume and thickness. Deposition is not identical to final elevation gain because compaction, erosion and organic processes also contribute. Combine flow and concentration observations with repeat surveys and sediment records rather than extrapolating one turbid event into a long-term growth trajectory. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Sediment mass and platform accretion” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設交換水量100000 m³、懸浮濃度0.05 kg/m³、保留30%、乾體積密度600 kg/m³，均勻沉積面積10000 m²；保留1500 kg，沉積2.5 m³，厚度0.25 mm，未扣壓密。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Assume 100000 m³ water exchange, concentration 0.05 kg/m³, retention 30%, dry bulk density 600 kg/m³ and deposition over 10000 m².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「漲潮帶入的所有懸浮泥砂都會永久留在濕地，完全不需計算退潮輸出。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "All sediment entering on flood tides remains permanently in the wetland, so ebb export can be ignored." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「泥砂質量與平台淤積」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Sediment mass and platform accretion”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 泥砂質量與平台淤積
knowledge.text: 進入濕地的懸浮泥砂只有部分會留在平台，其餘可能隨退潮排出或在潮溝重新懸浮。由水量與濃度估算進入質量後，還需要保留比例和乾體積密度才能換算沉積體積與厚度。
knowledge.textEn: Only part of incoming suspended sediment remains on a wetland platform; the rest can leave on ebb tides or be resuspended. Convert water volume and concentration to incoming mass, then apply a retained fraction and dry bulk density to estimate deposited volume and thickness.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：漲潮帶入的所有懸浮泥砂都會永久留在濕地，完全不需計算退潮輸出。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: All sediment entering on flood tides remains permanently in the wetland, so ebb export can be ignored. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「泥砂質量與平台淤積」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Sediment mass and platform accretion" is correct?
options: 漲潮帶入的所有懸浮泥砂都會永久留在濕地，完全不需計算退潮輸出。
只要每年有泥砂沉積，濕地地表相對海面就一定會逐年升高。
進入濕地的懸浮泥砂只有部分會留在平台，其餘可能隨退潮排出或在潮溝重新懸浮。
optionsEn: All sediment entering on flood tides remains permanently in the wetland, so ebb export can be ignored.
Any annual sediment deposition guarantees that wetland elevation rises relative to sea level.
Only part of incoming suspended sediment remains on a wetland platform; the rest can leave on ebb tides or be resuspended.
quiz.explanation: 進入濕地的懸浮泥砂只有部分會留在平台，其餘可能隨退潮排出或在潮溝重新懸浮。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Only part of incoming suspended sediment remains on a wetland platform; the rest can leave on ebb tides or be resuspended. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 泥砂質量與平台淤積：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Sediment mass and platform accretion: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「泥砂質量與平台淤積」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Sediment mass and platform accretion” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設交換水量100000 m³、懸浮濃度0.05 kg/m³、保留30%、乾體積密度600 kg/m³，均勻沉積面積10000 m²；保留1500 kg，沉積2.5 m³，厚度0.25 mm，未扣壓密。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Assume 100000 m³ water exchange, concentration 0.05 kg/m³, retention 30%, dry bulk density 600 kg/m³ and deposition over 10000 m². Retained mass is 1500 kg, volume 2.5 m³ and thickness 0.25 mm before compaction. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：分別積分漲潮與退潮泥砂通量，核對濃度採樣是否能代表垂向與時間變化。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Integrate flood and ebb sediment fluxes separately and examine whether concentration sampling resolves vertical and temporal variation.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設交換水量100000 m³、懸浮濃度0.05 kg/m³、保留30%、乾體積密度600 kg/m³，均勻沉積面積10000 m²；保留1500 kg，沉積2.5 m³，厚度0.25 mm，未扣壓密。
knowledge.textEn: Assume 100000 m³ water exchange, concentration 0.05 kg/m³, retention 30%, dry bulk density 600 kg/m³ and deposition over 10000 m². Retained mass is 1500 kg, volume 2.5 m³ and thickness 0.25 mm before compaction.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「泥砂質量與平台淤積」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Sediment mass and platform accretion", which statement holds?
options: 教學假設交換水量100000 m³、懸浮濃度0.05 kg/m³、保留30%、乾體積密度600 kg/m³，均勻沉積面積10000 m²。
水中鹽濃度升高，一定代表有新的海水流入，不可能只由蒸發造成。
復育區指標變好就足以證明工程造成全部改善，不需要對照、季節或變異資料。
optionsEn: Assume 100000 m³ water exchange, concentration 0.05 kg/m³, retention 30%, dry bulk density 600 kg/m³ and deposition over 10000 m².
Increasing salt concentration necessarily proves new seawater inflow and cannot result from evaporation alone.
Improvement at the restoration site alone proves the project caused every change without controls or variability data.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設交換水量100000 m³、懸浮濃度0.05 kg/m³、保留30%、乾體積密度600 kg/m³，均勻沉積面積10000 m²；保留1500 kg，沉積2.5 m³，厚度0.25 mm，未扣壓密。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Assume 100000 m³ water exchange, concentration 0.05 kg/m³, retention 30%, dry bulk density 600 kg/m³ and deposition over 10000 m². Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 泥砂質量與平台淤積：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Sediment mass and platform accretion: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「泥砂質量與平台淤積」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Sediment mass and platform accretion” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 分別積分漲潮與退潮泥砂通量，核對濃度採樣是否能代表垂向與時間變化。以乾重定義檢查體積密度，再與沉積標誌層和高程重測比較，將沉積厚度與地表高程變化分欄，不以兩者相似就省略壓密檢查。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Integrate flood and ebb sediment fluxes separately and examine whether concentration sampling resolves vertical and temporal variation. Verify dry bulk-density definitions, compare marker horizons with repeat elevations, and retain separate deposition and elevation-change records rather than assuming compaction is negligible because two values appear similar. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將保留率改成10%，重算沉積厚度；再保持質量不變但把乾體積密度加倍，比較結果。說明泥砂供應、保留效率與壓密如何造成不同變化，並設計能區分三者的量測表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Lower retention to 10% and recalculate thickness, then double dry bulk density at fixed mass. Compare sediment supply, retention and compaction as distinct causes of change, and design observations that distinguish their contributions.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：使用顆粒密度代替沉積物乾體積密度，會低估含孔隙沉積層的體積。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using particle density instead of dry bulk density understates porous deposit volume. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 分別積分漲潮與退潮泥砂通量，核對濃度採樣是否能代表垂向與時間變化。以乾重定義檢查體積密度，再與沉積標誌層和高程重測比較，將沉積厚度與地表高程變化分欄，不以兩者相似就省略壓密檢查。
knowledge.textEn: Integrate flood and ebb sediment fluxes separately and examine whether concentration sampling resolves vertical and temporal variation. Verify dry bulk-density definitions, compare marker horizons with repeat elevations, and retain separate deposition and elevation-change records rather than assuming compaction is negligible because two values appear similar.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將保留率改成10%，重算沉積厚度；再保持質量不變但把乾體積密度加倍，比較結果。說明泥砂供應、保留效率與壓密如何造成不同變化，並設計能區分三者的量測表。
knowledge.textEn: Lower retention to 10% and recalculate thickness, then double dry bulk density at fixed mass. Compare sediment supply, retention and compaction as distinct causes of change, and design observations that distinguish their contributions.

quiz.question: 要驗證「泥砂質量與平台淤積」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Sediment mass and platform accretion"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
分別積分漲潮與退潮泥砂通量，核對濃度採樣是否能代表垂向與時間變化。
兩塊平台只要最高淹水深度相同，就一定具有相同的淹水歷時與棲地條件。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Integrate flood and ebb sediment fluxes separately and examine whether concentration sampling resolves vertical and temporal variation.
Equal maximum inundation depth guarantees equal hydroperiod and habitat conditions.
quiz.explanation: 分別積分漲潮與退潮泥砂通量，核對濃度採樣是否能代表垂向與時間變化。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Integrate flood and ebb sediment fluxes separately and examine whether concentration sampling resolves vertical and temporal variation. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 泥砂質量與平台淤積：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Sediment mass and platform accretion: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「泥砂質量與平台淤積」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Sediment mass and platform accretion” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 使用顆粒密度代替沉積物乾體積密度，會低估含孔隙沉積層的體積。若只量漲潮進砂而不量退潮出砂，也會高估保留率，讓平台淤積預測偏高且缺乏閉合的質量證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using particle density instead of dry bulk density understates porous deposit volume. Measuring only incoming flood-tide sediment overstates retention when ebb export is ignored, producing an optimistic accretion estimate without a closed sediment mass balance. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：復育監測應同時採集流量、濃度、地形重測與沉積層資料，讓短期泥砂通量與長期平台變化能互相檢驗，而非只依一場濁水事件推論長期成長。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Combine flow and concentration observations with repeat surveys and sediment records rather than extrapolating one turbid event into a long-term growth trajectory.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「漲潮帶入的所有懸浮泥砂都會永久留在濕地，完全不需計算退潮輸出。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "All sediment entering on flood tides remains permanently in the wetland, so ebb export can be ignored." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 使用顆粒密度代替沉積物乾體積密度，會低估含孔隙沉積層的體積。若只量漲潮進砂而不量退潮出砂，也會高估保留率，讓平台淤積預測偏高且缺乏閉合的質量證據。
knowledge.textEn: Using particle density instead of dry bulk density understates porous deposit volume. Measuring only incoming flood-tide sediment overstates retention when ebb export is ignored, producing an optimistic accretion estimate without a closed sediment mass balance.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「泥砂質量與平台淤積」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Sediment mass and platform accretion" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
只要每年有泥砂沉積，濕地地表相對海面就一定會逐年升高。
使用顆粒密度代替沉積物乾體積密度，會低估含孔隙沉積層的體積。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Any annual sediment deposition guarantees that wetland elevation rises relative to sea level.
Using particle density instead of dry bulk density understates porous deposit volume.
quiz.explanation: 使用顆粒密度代替沉積物乾體積密度，會低估含孔隙沉積層的體積。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using particle density instead of dry bulk density understates porous deposit volume. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 淤積、高程變化與相對海面：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Accretion, elevation change and relative sea level: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「淤積、高程變化與相對海面」如何影響海岸濕地復育水理的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Accretion, elevation change and relative sea level” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Hydraulics for coastal-wetland restoration”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 濕地表面累積沉積物，不代表相對海面的高程一定增加。淺層壓密、根系生長與深部地層移動會使沉積厚度和地表高程變化不同，而海面上升又改變相對位置。比較時必須讓地表與潮位的參考基準一致，避免把深部沉降重複扣除。教學以明確基準下的簡單速率帳說明差異，並強調長期速率可能隨泥砂供應和植生回饋而改變，不能把短期測得的常數延伸成確定的數十年預測。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「淤積、高程變化與相對海面」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Sediment accumulation does not guarantee elevation gain relative to the sea. Shallow compaction, root processes and deeper movement separate accretion from surface elevation change, while rising water alters relative position. Use consistent reference frames and avoid subtracting deep subsidence twice. A clearly defined rate balance illustrates these distinctions, but sediment supply and vegetation feedback can change rates over time, so short-term constants should not be presented as certain multidecade forecasts of wetland persistence. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Accretion, elevation change and relative sea level” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設相對同一深基準的淤積5 mm/year、淺層壓密1.5 mm/year，其他地表項為零；地表升高3.5 mm/year。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Relative to one deep benchmark, assume accretion 5 mm/year, shallow compaction 1.5 mm/year and no other surface terms.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要每年有泥砂沉積，濕地地表相對海面就一定會逐年升高。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Any annual sediment deposition guarantees that wetland elevation rises relative to sea level." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「淤積、高程變化與相對海面」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Accretion, elevation change and relative sea level”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 淤積、高程變化與相對海面
knowledge.titleEn: Accretion, elevation change and relative sea level
knowledge.text: 濕地表面累積沉積物，不代表相對海面的高程一定增加。淺層壓密、根系生長與深部地層移動會使沉積厚度和地表高程變化不同，而海面上升又改變相對位置。
knowledge.textEn: Sediment accumulation does not guarantee elevation gain relative to the sea. Shallow compaction, root processes and deeper movement separate accretion from surface elevation change, while rising water alters relative position.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要每年有泥砂沉積，濕地地表相對海面就一定會逐年升高。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Any annual sediment deposition guarantees that wetland elevation rises relative to sea level. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「淤積、高程變化與相對海面」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Accretion, elevation change and relative sea level" is correct?
options: 濕地表面累積沉積物，不代表相對海面的高程一定增加。
只要每年有泥砂沉積，濕地地表相對海面就一定會逐年升高。
植生覆蓋率相同的兩片濕地，在任何水深和流速下都必定產生相同阻力。
optionsEn: Sediment accumulation does not guarantee elevation gain relative to the sea.
Any annual sediment deposition guarantees that wetland elevation rises relative to sea level.
Equal vegetation cover guarantees equal drag at every depth and velocity.
quiz.explanation: 濕地表面累積沉積物，不代表相對海面的高程一定增加。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Sediment accumulation does not guarantee elevation gain relative to the sea. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Diagram the marker horizon, elevation benchmark and tidal datum, identifying the reference frame of every rate.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: Relative to one deep benchmark, assume accretion 5 mm/year, shallow compaction 1.5 mm/year and no other surface terms. Surface gain is 3.5 mm/year against sea-level rise 6 mm/year, a relative deficit of 2.5 mm/year or 50 mm over a linear 20-year scenario.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「淤積、高程變化與相對海面」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
