quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Accretion, elevation change and relative sea level", which statement holds?
options: 每次漲潮進入多少水，就一定有同樣體積的舊水被永久替換而不再返回。
教學假設相對同一深基準的淤積5 mm/year、淺層壓密1.5 mm/year，其他地表項為零；地表升高3.5 mm/year。
濕地總土地面積乘外海潮差，永遠等於實際潮汐交換量與淨沖洗量。
optionsEn: Every flood-tide inflow permanently replaces an equal old-water volume that can never return.
Relative to one deep benchmark, assume accretion 5 mm/year, shallow compaction 1.5 mm/year and no other surface terms.
Total wetland area times offshore tidal range always equals both actual tidal exchange and net flushing.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設相對同一深基準的淤積5 mm/year、淺層壓密1.5 mm/year，其他地表項為零；地表升高3.5 mm/year。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Relative to one deep benchmark, assume accretion 5 mm/year, shallow compaction 1.5 mm/year and no other surface terms. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 淤積、高程變化與相對海面：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Accretion, elevation change and relative sea level: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「淤積、高程變化與相對海面」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Accretion, elevation change and relative sea level” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 畫出沉積標誌層、地表量測基準與潮位基準之間的關係，確認每項速率描述的是哪個相對位移。比較不同期間的速率與不確定度，將線性情境標成假設而非預報，並檢查是否已在相對海面資料中包含深部地層移動。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Diagram the marker horizon, elevation benchmark and tidal datum, identifying the reference frame of every rate. Compare periods and uncertainties, label linear projections as scenarios, and check whether deep movement is already embedded in the relative sea-level record before applying another correction. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將淤積率提高到7 mm/year，其他條件不變，重算相對高程速率。另設海面加速上升的情境，說明為何固定速率乘年數不再適用，並列出需要持續更新的沉積、壓密與潮位觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Increase accretion to 7 mm/year with other terms unchanged and recalculate relative elevation change. Introduce accelerating sea level separately, explain why rate-times-duration no longer applies, and list the deposition, compaction and tidal observations requiring continued updates.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只看沉積厚度大於零就宣稱濕地能追上海面，會忽略壓密和海面變化。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Positive accretion alone does not show that a marsh keeps pace with the sea when compaction and water-level change are omitted. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 畫出沉積標誌層、地表量測基準與潮位基準之間的關係，確認每項速率描述的是哪個相對位移。比較不同期間的速率與不確定度，將線性情境標成假設而非預報，並檢查是否已在相對海面資料中包含深部地層移動。
knowledge.textEn: Diagram the marker horizon, elevation benchmark and tidal datum, identifying the reference frame of every rate. Compare periods and uncertainties, label linear projections as scenarios, and check whether deep movement is already embedded in the relative sea-level record before applying another correction.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將淤積率提高到7 mm/year，其他條件不變，重算相對高程速率。另設海面加速上升的情境，說明為何固定速率乘年數不再適用，並列出需要持續更新的沉積、壓密與潮位觀測。
knowledge.textEn: Increase accretion to 7 mm/year with other terms unchanged and recalculate relative elevation change. Introduce accelerating sea level separately, explain why rate-times-duration no longer applies, and list the deposition, compaction and tidal observations requiring continued updates.

quiz.question: 要驗證「淤積、高程變化與相對海面」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Accretion, elevation change and relative sea level"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
內部與外部最高水位接近，就表示整個潮週期沒有任何阻力或相位延遲。
畫出沉積標誌層、地表量測基準與潮位基準之間的關係，確認每項速率描述的是哪個相對位移。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
Similar internal and external high-water levels prove the full tide has no resistance or phase delay.
Diagram the marker horizon, elevation benchmark and tidal datum, identifying the reference frame of every rate.
quiz.explanation: 畫出沉積標誌層、地表量測基準與潮位基準之間的關係，確認每項速率描述的是哪個相對位移。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Diagram the marker horizon, elevation benchmark and tidal datum, identifying the reference frame of every rate. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 淤積、高程變化與相對海面：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Accretion, elevation change and relative sea level: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「淤積、高程變化與相對海面」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Accretion, elevation change and relative sea level” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只看沉積厚度大於零就宣稱濕地能追上海面，會忽略壓密和海面變化。把已含沉降的相對海面速率再扣一次沉降，也會誇大高程赤字，使比較失去共同基準。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Positive accretion alone does not show that a marsh keeps pace with the sea when compaction and water-level change are omitted. Subtracting subsidence already included in relative sea level double-counts it and exaggerates the elevation deficit. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：教學以明確基準下的簡單速率帳說明差異，並強調長期速率可能隨泥砂供應和植生回饋而改變，不能把短期測得的常數延伸成確定的數十年預測。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A clearly defined rate balance illustrates these distinctions, but sediment supply and vegetation feedback can change rates over time, so short-term constants should not be presented as certain multidecade forecasts of wetland persistence.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要每年有泥砂沉積，濕地地表相對海面就一定會逐年升高。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Any annual sediment deposition guarantees that wetland elevation rises relative to sea level." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只看沉積厚度大於零就宣稱濕地能追上海面，會忽略壓密和海面變化。把已含沉降的相對海面速率再扣一次沉降，也會誇大高程赤字，使比較失去共同基準。
knowledge.textEn: Positive accretion alone does not show that a marsh keeps pace with the sea when compaction and water-level change are omitted. Subtracting subsidence already included in relative sea level double-counts it and exaggerates the elevation deficit.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「淤積、高程變化與相對海面」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Accretion, elevation change and relative sea level" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 只看沉積厚度大於零就宣稱濕地能追上海面，會忽略壓密和海面變化。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
植生覆蓋率相同的兩片濕地，在任何水深和流速下都必定產生相同阻力。
optionsEn: Positive accretion alone does not show that a marsh keeps pace with the sea when compaction and water-level change are omitted.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Equal vegetation cover guarantees equal drag at every depth and velocity.
quiz.explanation: 只看沉積厚度大於零就宣稱濕地能追上海面，會忽略壓密和海面變化。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Positive accretion alone does not show that a marsh keeps pace with the sea when compaction and water-level change are omitted. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「植生阻力與流速敏感度」與「蒸發濃縮與鹽量守恆」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Vegetation drag and velocity sensitivity" and "Evaporative concentration and salt balance": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 植生阻力與流速敏感度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Vegetation drag and velocity sensitivity: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「植生阻力與流速敏感度」如何影響海岸濕地復育水理的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Vegetation drag and velocity sensitivity” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Hydraulics for coastal-wetland restoration”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 濕地植生會改變水流阻力、沉積與波動，但植株不是固定粗糙度常數。莖徑、密度、高度、彎曲和淹沒程度都會改變有效迎流面積，強流時倒伏又可能降低阻力。理想直立剛性圓柱陣列的阻力式可用來理解流速平方關係，卻不能直接代表真實混合植群或極端風浪。復育分析應區分植生對平均流、波浪與生態條件的作用，並用季節及水深不同的觀測檢查假設，不以種植面積直接保證特定防洪成效。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「植生阻力與流速敏感度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Vegetation modifies flow resistance, deposition and waves, but plants are not fixed roughness constants. Stem dimensions, density, height, bending and submergence change frontal area, while reconfiguration in strong flow can reduce drag. An ideal array of upright rigid stems illustrates quadratic velocity dependence without representing mixed vegetation or extreme waves. Distinguish effects on mean flow, waves and habitat, and examine seasonal and depth-dependent evidence rather than promising a specific flood benefit from planted area alone. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Vegetation drag and velocity sensitivity” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設剛性直立植株、均勻流，水密度1025 kg/m³、Cd=1、迎流面積密度a=2 m⁻¹、淹水深h=0.50 m、速度U=0.30 m/s；每床面積阻力F/A=0.5ρC_dahU²=46.125 Pa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Assume rigid upright vegetation and uniform flow, density 1025 kg/m³, drag coefficient 1, frontal-area density 2 m⁻¹, depth 0.50 m and velocity 0.30 m/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「植生覆蓋率相同的兩片濕地，在任何水深和流速下都必定產生相同阻力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equal vegetation cover guarantees equal drag at every depth and velocity." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「植生阻力與流速敏感度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Vegetation drag and velocity sensitivity”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 植生阻力與流速敏感度
knowledge.text: 濕地植生會改變水流阻力、沉積與波動，但植株不是固定粗糙度常數。莖徑、密度、高度、彎曲和淹沒程度都會改變有效迎流面積，強流時倒伏又可能降低阻力。
knowledge.textEn: Vegetation modifies flow resistance, deposition and waves, but plants are not fixed roughness constants. Stem dimensions, density, height, bending and submergence change frontal area, while reconfiguration in strong flow can reduce drag.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：植生覆蓋率相同的兩片濕地，在任何水深和流速下都必定產生相同阻力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Equal vegetation cover guarantees equal drag at every depth and velocity. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「植生阻力與流速敏感度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Vegetation drag and velocity sensitivity" is correct?
options: 植生覆蓋率相同的兩片濕地，在任何水深和流速下都必定產生相同阻力。
濕地植生會改變水流阻力、沉積與波動，但植株不是固定粗糙度常數。
水中鹽濃度升高，一定代表有新的海水流入，不可能只由蒸發造成。
optionsEn: Equal vegetation cover guarantees equal drag at every depth and velocity.
Vegetation modifies flow resistance, deposition and waves, but plants are not fixed roughness constants.
Increasing salt concentration necessarily proves new seawater inflow and cannot result from evaporation alone.
quiz.explanation: 濕地植生會改變水流阻力、沉積與波動，但植株不是固定粗糙度常數。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Vegetation modifies flow resistance, deposition and waves, but plants are not fixed roughness constants. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 植生阻力與流速敏感度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Vegetation drag and velocity sensitivity: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「植生阻力與流速敏感度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Vegetation drag and velocity sensitivity” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設剛性直立植株、均勻流，水密度1025 kg/m³、Cd=1、迎流面積密度a=2 m⁻¹、淹水深h=0.50 m、速度U=0.30 m/s；每床面積阻力F/A=0.5ρC_dahU²=46.125 Pa。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Assume rigid upright vegetation and uniform flow, density 1025 kg/m³, drag coefficient 1, frontal-area density 2 m⁻¹, depth 0.50 m and velocity 0.30 m/s. Drag per bed area is 0.5ρC_dahU²=46.125 Pa. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：確認迎流面積密度是每單位體積的投影面積，而不是地表覆蓋率。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Confirm that frontal-area density is projected area per volume rather than ground cover.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設剛性直立植株、均勻流，水密度1025 kg/m³、Cd=1、迎流面積密度a=2 m⁻¹、淹水深h=0.50 m、速度U=0.30 m/s；每床面積阻力F/A=0.5ρC_dahU²=46.125 Pa。
knowledge.textEn: Assume rigid upright vegetation and uniform flow, density 1025 kg/m³, drag coefficient 1, frontal-area density 2 m⁻¹, depth 0.50 m and velocity 0.30 m/s. Drag per bed area is 0.5ρC_dahU²=46.125 Pa.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「植生阻力與流速敏感度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Vegetation drag and velocity sensitivity", which statement holds?
options: 復育區指標變好就足以證明工程造成全部改善，不需要對照、季節或變異資料。
兩塊平台只要最高淹水深度相同，就一定具有相同的淹水歷時與棲地條件。
教學假設剛性直立植株、均勻流，水密度1025 kg/m³、Cd=1、迎流面積密度a=2 m⁻¹、淹水深h=0.50 m、速度U=0.30 m/s。
optionsEn: Improvement at the restoration site alone proves the project caused every change without controls or variability data.
Equal maximum inundation depth guarantees equal hydroperiod and habitat conditions.
Assume rigid upright vegetation and uniform flow, density 1025 kg/m³, drag coefficient 1, frontal-area density 2 m⁻¹, depth 0.50 m and velocity 0.30 m/s.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設剛性直立植株、均勻流，水密度1025 kg/m³、Cd=1、迎流面積密度a=2 m⁻¹、淹水深h=0.50 m、速度U=0.30 m/s；每床面積阻力F/A=0.5ρC_dahU²=46.125 Pa。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Assume rigid upright vegetation and uniform flow, density 1025 kg/m³, drag coefficient 1, frontal-area density 2 m⁻¹, depth 0.50 m and velocity 0.30 m/s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 植生阻力與流速敏感度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Vegetation drag and velocity sensitivity: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「植生阻力與流速敏感度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Vegetation drag and velocity sensitivity” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 確認迎流面積密度是每單位體積的投影面積，而不是地表覆蓋率。檢查淹水深是否超過植株高度，並比較不同流速下的姿態和阻力，若植株明顯彎曲，需重新定義有效面積，不能只調整係數來掩蓋幾何改變。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Confirm that frontal-area density is projected area per volume rather than ground cover. Check depth against plant height and compare posture across velocities; substantial bending requires reassessing effective area instead of merely adjusting a coefficient to conceal geometric change. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把流速加倍，在剛性假設下重算阻力，再假設有效迎流面積因彎曲減半，比較兩結果。說明為何流速敏感度與植株形變必須一起考慮，並提出能觀察季節和淹沒程度差異的資料欄位。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Double velocity under rigid assumptions, then halve effective frontal area to represent hypothetical bending. Compare drag, explain the interaction between velocity sensitivity and reconfiguration, and propose observations resolving seasonal and submergence differences.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把植生覆蓋百分比直接代入迎流面積密度，會造成量綱錯誤。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Substituting percentage cover for frontal-area density creates a dimensional error. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 確認迎流面積密度是每單位體積的投影面積，而不是地表覆蓋率。檢查淹水深是否超過植株高度，並比較不同流速下的姿態和阻力，若植株明顯彎曲，需重新定義有效面積，不能只調整係數來掩蓋幾何改變。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm that frontal-area density is projected area per volume rather than ground cover. Check depth against plant height and compare posture across velocities; substantial bending requires reassessing effective area instead of merely adjusting a coefficient to conceal geometric change.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 把流速加倍，在剛性假設下重算阻力，再假設有效迎流面積因彎曲減半，比較兩結果。說明為何流速敏感度與植株形變必須一起考慮，並提出能觀察季節和淹沒程度差異的資料欄位。
knowledge.textEn: Double velocity under rigid assumptions, then halve effective frontal area to represent hypothetical bending. Compare drag, explain the interaction between velocity sensitivity and reconfiguration, and propose observations resolving seasonal and submergence differences.

quiz.question: 要驗證「植生阻力與流速敏感度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Vegetation drag and velocity sensitivity"?
options: 確認迎流面積密度是每單位體積的投影面積，而不是地表覆蓋率。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
兩側水位相同時，只要開口位於水下，就一定仍有很大的單向淨流量。
optionsEn: Confirm that frontal-area density is projected area per volume rather than ground cover.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A submerged opening necessarily carries a large one-way net flow even when both water levels are equal.
quiz.explanation: 確認迎流面積密度是每單位體積的投影面積，而不是地表覆蓋率。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Confirm that frontal-area density is projected area per volume rather than ground cover. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 植生阻力與流速敏感度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Vegetation drag and velocity sensitivity: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「植生阻力與流速敏感度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Vegetation drag and velocity sensitivity” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把植生覆蓋百分比直接代入迎流面積密度，會造成量綱錯誤。假設所有植株在強流中保持直立，也可能高估阻力與衰減作用，讓植生方案看起來比實際更有效。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Substituting percentage cover for frontal-area density creates a dimensional error. Assuming all plants remain upright under strong currents can overstate drag and attenuation, making an intervention appear more effective than the supporting physical evidence warrants. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：復育分析應區分植生對平均流、波浪與生態條件的作用，並用季節及水深不同的觀測檢查假設，不以種植面積直接保證特定防洪成效。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Distinguish effects on mean flow, waves and habitat, and examine seasonal and depth-dependent evidence rather than promising a specific flood benefit from planted area alone.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「植生覆蓋率相同的兩片濕地，在任何水深和流速下都必定產生相同阻力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Equal vegetation cover guarantees equal drag at every depth and velocity." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把植生覆蓋百分比直接代入迎流面積密度，會造成量綱錯誤。假設所有植株在強流中保持直立，也可能高估阻力與衰減作用，讓植生方案看起來比實際更有效。
knowledge.textEn: Substituting percentage cover for frontal-area density creates a dimensional error. Assuming all plants remain upright under strong currents can overstate drag and attenuation, making an intervention appear more effective than the supporting physical evidence warrants.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「植生阻力與流速敏感度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Vegetation drag and velocity sensitivity" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
把植生覆蓋百分比直接代入迎流面積密度，會造成量綱錯誤。
水中鹽濃度升高，一定代表有新的海水流入，不可能只由蒸發造成。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Substituting percentage cover for frontal-area density creates a dimensional error.
Increasing salt concentration necessarily proves new seawater inflow and cannot result from evaporation alone.
quiz.explanation: 把植生覆蓋百分比直接代入迎流面積密度，會造成量綱錯誤。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Substituting percentage cover for frontal-area density creates a dimensional error. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 蒸發濃縮與鹽量守恆：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Evaporative concentration and salt balance: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「蒸發濃縮與鹽量守恆」如何影響海岸濕地復育水理的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Evaporative concentration and salt balance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Hydraulics for coastal-wetland restoration”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 連通受限的濕地或舊鹽田可能在蒸發時失去水分而保留鹽分，使濃度升高。簡化鹽量帳假設鹽不揮發、沒有析出或其他進出流，適合說明水量與鹽量守恆的差別，但真實濕地還有潮汐交換、降雨、地下水和植生作用。用鹽度判讀水力連通時，應同時知道水量變化，因為濃度升高不一定代表新增海水輸入。課程的理想濃縮計算不提供生態適宜濃度，而是訓練學徒列出所有可能的水與鹽路徑。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「蒸發濃縮與鹽量守恆」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A poorly connected wetland or former salt pond can lose water through evaporation while retaining salt, increasing concentration. A simple balance assumes nonvolatile salt, no precipitation and no other flows, illustrating the difference between water and salt conservation. Real wetlands also exchange tidal water, rain and groundwater. Interpret salinity with volume changes because increasing concentration need not indicate additional seawater input. The calculation sets no ecological suitability threshold; it trains learners to identify separate water and salt pathways. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Evaporative concentration and salt balance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設初始水量10000 m³、鹽質量濃度20 kg/m³，蒸發1000 m³純水且鹽不流失、不析出；剩水9000 m³，濃度200000/9000=22.22 kg/m³，採體積可直接相減近似。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Assume 10000 m³ initially at salt mass concentration 20 kg/m³, evaporation of 1000 m³ pure water and no salt loss or precipitation.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「水中鹽濃度升高，一定代表有新的海水流入，不可能只由蒸發造成。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Increasing salt concentration necessarily proves new seawater inflow and cannot result from evaporation alone." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「蒸發濃縮與鹽量守恆」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Evaporative concentration and salt balance”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 蒸發濃縮與鹽量守恆
knowledge.text: 連通受限的濕地或舊鹽田可能在蒸發時失去水分而保留鹽分，使濃度升高。簡化鹽量帳假設鹽不揮發、沒有析出或其他進出流，適合說明水量與鹽量守恆的差別，但真實濕地還有潮汐交換、降雨、地下水和植生作用。
knowledge.textEn: A poorly connected wetland or former salt pond can lose water through evaporation while retaining salt, increasing concentration. A simple balance assumes nonvolatile salt, no precipitation and no other flows, illustrating the difference between water and salt conservation.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：水中鹽濃度升高，一定代表有新的海水流入，不可能只由蒸發造成。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Increasing salt concentration necessarily proves new seawater inflow and cannot result from evaporation alone. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「蒸發濃縮與鹽量守恆」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Evaporative concentration and salt balance" is correct?
options: 水中鹽濃度升高，一定代表有新的海水流入，不可能只由蒸發造成。
每次漲潮進入多少水，就一定有同樣體積的舊水被永久替換而不再返回。
連通受限的濕地或舊鹽田可能在蒸發時失去水分而保留鹽分，使濃度升高。
optionsEn: Increasing salt concentration necessarily proves new seawater inflow and cannot result from evaporation alone.
Every flood-tide inflow permanently replaces an equal old-water volume that can never return.
A poorly connected wetland or former salt pond can lose water through evaporation while retaining salt, increasing concentration.
quiz.explanation: 連通受限的濕地或舊鹽田可能在蒸發時失去水分而保留鹽分，使濃度升高。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A poorly connected wetland or former salt pond can lose water through evaporation while retaining salt, increasing concentration. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 蒸發濃縮與鹽量守恆：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Evaporative concentration and salt balance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「蒸發濃縮與鹽量守恆」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Evaporative concentration and salt balance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設初始水量10000 m³、鹽質量濃度20 kg/m³，蒸發1000 m³純水且鹽不流失、不析出；剩水9000 m³，濃度200000/9000=22.22 kg/m³，採體積可直接相減近似。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Assume 10000 m³ initially at salt mass concentration 20 kg/m³, evaporation of 1000 m³ pure water and no salt loss or precipitation. Remaining volume is 9000 m³ and concentration 22.22 kg/m³ under the stated volume approximation. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：分別建立水量與鹽質量兩張帳，核對濃度單位是質量每體積，不將實用鹽度直接當作同單位數值。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Maintain separate water and salt balances and confirm mass-per-volume units instead of treating practical salinity as numerically identical.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設初始水量10000 m³、鹽質量濃度20 kg/m³，蒸發1000 m³純水且鹽不流失、不析出；剩水9000 m³，濃度200000/9000=22.22 kg/m³，採體積可直接相減近似。
knowledge.textEn: Assume 10000 m³ initially at salt mass concentration 20 kg/m³, evaporation of 1000 m³ pure water and no salt loss or precipitation. Remaining volume is 9000 m³ and concentration 22.22 kg/m³ under the stated volume approximation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「蒸發濃縮與鹽量守恆」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Evaporative concentration and salt balance", which statement holds?
options: 教學假設初始水量10000 m³、鹽質量濃度20 kg/m³，蒸發1000 m³純水且鹽不流失、不析出。
濕地總土地面積乘外海潮差，永遠等於實際潮汐交換量與淨沖洗量。
內部與外部最高水位接近，就表示整個潮週期沒有任何阻力或相位延遲。
optionsEn: Assume 10000 m³ initially at salt mass concentration 20 kg/m³, evaporation of 1000 m³ pure water and no salt loss or precipitation.
Total wetland area times offshore tidal range always equals both actual tidal exchange and net flushing.
Similar internal and external high-water levels prove the full tide has no resistance or phase delay.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設初始水量10000 m³、鹽質量濃度20 kg/m³，蒸發1000 m³純水且鹽不流失、不析出；剩水9000 m³，濃度200000/9000=22.22 kg/m³，採體積可直接相減近似。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Assume 10000 m³ initially at salt mass concentration 20 kg/m³, evaporation of 1000 m³ pure water and no salt loss or precipitation. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 蒸發濃縮與鹽量守恆：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Evaporative concentration and salt balance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「蒸發濃縮與鹽量守恆」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Evaporative concentration and salt balance” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 分別建立水量與鹽質量兩張帳，核對濃度單位是質量每體積，不將實用鹽度直接當作同單位數值。同步記錄降雨、蒸發與潮汐交換，若出現結晶或地下交換，應新增相應項目而非強迫簡式閉合。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Maintain separate water and salt balances and confirm mass-per-volume units instead of treating practical salinity as numerically identical. Track rain, evaporation and tidal exchange concurrently, adding terms for crystallization or groundwater exchange when present rather than forcing the simplified balance to close. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：在蒸發後加入1000 m³無鹽雨水，重算水量與鹽濃度，再與加入同體積含鹽潮水比較。說明相同水位回升為何可能伴隨不同鹽度，並列出辨識來源所需的水量與濃度觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: After evaporation, add 1000 m³ of salt-free rain and recalculate concentration, then compare with the same volume of saline tidal water. Explain why equal level recovery can accompany different salinity and identify the flow and concentration observations needed to distinguish sources.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只看濃度上升就判定海水入侵，可能漏掉蒸發濃縮。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Attributing every concentration increase to seawater input overlooks evaporation. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 分別建立水量與鹽質量兩張帳，核對濃度單位是質量每體積，不將實用鹽度直接當作同單位數值。同步記錄降雨、蒸發與潮汐交換，若出現結晶或地下交換，應新增相應項目而非強迫簡式閉合。
knowledge.textEn: Maintain separate water and salt balances and confirm mass-per-volume units instead of treating practical salinity as numerically identical. Track rain, evaporation and tidal exchange concurrently, adding terms for crystallization or groundwater exchange when present rather than forcing the simplified balance to close.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 在蒸發後加入1000 m³無鹽雨水，重算水量與鹽濃度，再與加入同體積含鹽潮水比較。說明相同水位回升為何可能伴隨不同鹽度，並列出辨識來源所需的水量與濃度觀測。
knowledge.textEn: After evaporation, add 1000 m³ of salt-free rain and recalculate concentration, then compare with the same volume of saline tidal water. Explain why equal level recovery can accompany different salinity and identify the flow and concentration observations needed to distinguish sources.

quiz.question: 要驗證「蒸發濃縮與鹽量守恆」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Evaporative concentration and salt balance"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
分別建立水量與鹽質量兩張帳，核對濃度單位是質量每體積，不將實用鹽度直接當作同單位數值。
漲潮帶入的所有懸浮泥砂都會永久留在濕地，完全不需計算退潮輸出。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Maintain separate water and salt balances and confirm mass-per-volume units instead of treating practical salinity as numerically identical.
All sediment entering on flood tides remains permanently in the wetland, so ebb export can be ignored.
quiz.explanation: 分別建立水量與鹽質量兩張帳，核對濃度單位是質量每體積，不將實用鹽度直接當作同單位數值。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Maintain separate water and salt balances and confirm mass-per-volume units instead of treating practical salinity as numerically identical. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 蒸發濃縮與鹽量守恆：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Evaporative concentration and salt balance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「蒸發濃縮與鹽量守恆」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Evaporative concentration and salt balance” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只看濃度上升就判定海水入侵，可能漏掉蒸發濃縮。反過來，若有鹽析出卻仍假設全部溶解，會高估水中濃度；水量與鹽相態資料必須一起支持解釋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Attributing every concentration increase to seawater input overlooks evaporation. Assuming all salt remains dissolved when precipitation occurs overstates aqueous concentration, so volume and salt-phase evidence must jointly support the interpretation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：課程的理想濃縮計算不提供生態適宜濃度，而是訓練學徒列出所有可能的水與鹽路徑。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The calculation sets no ecological suitability threshold; it trains learners to identify separate water and salt pathways.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「水中鹽濃度升高，一定代表有新的海水流入，不可能只由蒸發造成。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Increasing salt concentration necessarily proves new seawater inflow and cannot result from evaporation alone." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只看濃度上升就判定海水入侵，可能漏掉蒸發濃縮。反過來，若有鹽析出卻仍假設全部溶解，會高估水中濃度；水量與鹽相態資料必須一起支持解釋。
knowledge.textEn: Attributing every concentration increase to seawater input overlooks evaporation. Assuming all salt remains dissolved when precipitation occurs overstates aqueous concentration, so volume and salt-phase evidence must jointly support the interpretation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「蒸發濃縮與鹽量守恆」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Evaporative concentration and salt balance" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
每次漲潮進入多少水，就一定有同樣體積的舊水被永久替換而不再返回。
只看濃度上升就判定海水入侵，可能漏掉蒸發濃縮。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Every flood-tide inflow permanently replaces an equal old-water volume that can never return.
Attributing every concentration increase to seawater input overlooks evaporation.
quiz.explanation: 只看濃度上升就判定海水入侵，可能漏掉蒸發濃縮。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Attributing every concentration increase to seawater input overlooks evaporation. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「往返潮水與有效沖洗」與「復育成效與前後對照」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Returning tidal water and effective flushing" and "Restoration response and before-after controls": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 往返潮水與有效沖洗：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Returning tidal water and effective flushing: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「往返潮水與有效沖洗」如何影響海岸濕地復育水理的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Returning tidal water and effective flushing” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Hydraulics for coastal-wetland restoration”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 潮汐進出的總量不等於每次都換入全新水體，退潮排出的舊水可能在下一次漲潮返回。簡化離散混合模型可用有效替換比例描述每個週期後舊水剩餘量，但需要假設完全混合、固定容積及穩定替換率。潮溝捷徑、死水區和分層都會讓實際停留時間呈現分布，不能用一個平均值保證所有位置都被沖洗。復育後應以示蹤或多點時間序列檢驗交換效率，同時區分水體更新與污染物反應造成的濃度降低。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「往返潮水與有效沖洗」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Gross tidal exchange does not replace the wetland with entirely new water each cycle, because ebb water can return on the next flood. A discrete mixed-volume model uses an effective replacement fraction to track old water, assuming complete mixing, fixed volume and a constant fraction. Short-circuiting, stagnant zones and stratification produce residence-time distributions rather than one universal duration. Test exchange with tracers or multiple time series and distinguish water renewal from concentration changes caused by reactions. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Returning tidal water and effective flushing” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設固定水量200000 m³，每潮有效新水替換10000 m³，即比例0.05；每次完成完全混合替換後，十潮剩餘舊水比例(1−0.05)^10=0.5987。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Assume fixed volume 200000 m³ and effective new-water replacement 10000 m³ per tide, a fraction 0.05.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「每次漲潮進入多少水，就一定有同樣體積的舊水被永久替換而不再返回。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Every flood-tide inflow permanently replaces an equal old-water volume that can never return." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「往返潮水與有效沖洗」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Returning tidal water and effective flushing”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 往返潮水與有效沖洗
knowledge.titleEn: Returning tidal water and effective flushing
knowledge.text: 潮汐進出的總量不等於每次都換入全新水體，退潮排出的舊水可能在下一次漲潮返回。簡化離散混合模型可用有效替換比例描述每個週期後舊水剩餘量，但需要假設完全混合、固定容積及穩定替換率。
knowledge.textEn: Gross tidal exchange does not replace the wetland with entirely new water each cycle, because ebb water can return on the next flood. A discrete mixed-volume model uses an effective replacement fraction to track old water, assuming complete mixing, fixed volume and a constant fraction.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：每次漲潮進入多少水，就一定有同樣體積的舊水被永久替換而不再返回。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Every flood-tide inflow permanently replaces an equal old-water volume that can never return. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「往返潮水與有效沖洗」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Returning tidal water and effective flushing" is correct?
options: 潮汐進出的總量不等於每次都換入全新水體，退潮排出的舊水可能在下一次漲潮返回。
每次漲潮進入多少水，就一定有同樣體積的舊水被永久替換而不再返回。
復育區指標變好就足以證明工程造成全部改善，不需要對照、季節或變異資料。
optionsEn: Gross tidal exchange does not replace the wetland with entirely new water each cycle, because ebb water can return on the next flood.
Every flood-tide inflow permanently replaces an equal old-water volume that can never return.
Improvement at the restoration site alone proves the project caused every change without controls or variability data.
quiz.explanation: 潮汐進出的總量不等於每次都換入全新水體，退潮排出的舊水可能在下一次漲潮返回。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Gross tidal exchange does not replace the wetland with entirely new water each cycle, because ebb water can return on the next flood. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 往返潮水與有效沖洗：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Returning tidal water and effective flushing: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「往返潮水與有效沖洗」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Returning tidal water and effective flushing” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設固定水量200000 m³，每潮有效新水替換10000 m³，即比例0.05；每次完成完全混合替換後，十潮剩餘舊水比例(1−0.05)^10=0.5987。有效替換量不同於總潮汐容積。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Assume fixed volume 200000 m³ and effective new-water replacement 10000 m³ per tide, a fraction 0.05. Under complete discrete mixing, old-water fraction after ten tides is 0.95^10=0.5987; effective replacement differs from gross tidal prism. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：先明確描述每個潮週期的替換與混合順序，檢查新舊水比例加總為一。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Specify replacement and mixing order within each cycle and verify that old and new fractions sum to one.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設固定水量200000 m³，每潮有效新水替換10000 m³，即比例0.05；每次完成完全混合替換後，十潮剩餘舊水比例(1−0.05)^10=0.5987。有效替換量不同於總潮汐容積。
knowledge.textEn: Assume fixed volume 200000 m³ and effective new-water replacement 10000 m³ per tide, a fraction 0.05. Under complete discrete mixing, old-water fraction after ten tides is 0.95^10=0.5987; effective replacement differs from gross tidal prism.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「往返潮水與有效沖洗」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Returning tidal water and effective flushing", which statement holds?
options: 兩塊平台只要最高淹水深度相同，就一定具有相同的淹水歷時與棲地條件。
教學假設固定水量200000 m³，每潮有效新水替換10000 m³，即比例0.05。
兩側水位相同時，只要開口位於水下，就一定仍有很大的單向淨流量。
optionsEn: Equal maximum inundation depth guarantees equal hydroperiod and habitat conditions.
Assume fixed volume 200000 m³ and effective new-water replacement 10000 m³ per tide, a fraction 0.05.
A submerged opening necessarily carries a large one-way net flow even when both water levels are equal.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設固定水量200000 m³，每潮有效新水替換10000 m³，即比例0.05；每次完成完全混合替換後，十潮剩餘舊水比例(1−0.05)^10=0.5987。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Assume fixed volume 200000 m³ and effective new-water replacement 10000 m³ per tide, a fraction 0.05. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 往返潮水與有效沖洗：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Returning tidal water and effective flushing: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「往返潮水與有效沖洗」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Returning tidal water and effective flushing” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 先明確描述每個潮週期的替換與混合順序，檢查新舊水比例加總為一。以多位置示蹤衰減比較同一模型，若尾端衰減很慢或不同位置差異大，應調查死水區與回流，不只用初期快速變化估計整片濕地沖洗能力。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Specify replacement and mixing order within each cycle and verify that old and new fractions sum to one. Compare tracer decay at multiple locations; slow tails or spatial differences should prompt investigation of stagnant zones and return flow rather than extrapolation from rapid initial changes alone. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將有效替換比例提高至0.10，重算十潮後舊水比例，並比較把比例直接乘十的錯誤線性估算。另畫一個不參與交換的死水區，指出完全混合假設如何失效，以及應增加哪些採樣位置。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Increase effective replacement to 0.10 and recalculate the ten-cycle fraction, comparing with the incorrect linear shortcut of multiplying by ten. Add a stagnant compartment, identify the failed mixing assumption and propose additional sampling locations.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把總潮汐容積全部視為有效新水替換，會高估沖洗。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Treating the entire tidal prism as new-water replacement exaggerates flushing. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 先明確描述每個潮週期的替換與混合順序，檢查新舊水比例加總為一。以多位置示蹤衰減比較同一模型，若尾端衰減很慢或不同位置差異大，應調查死水區與回流，不只用初期快速變化估計整片濕地沖洗能力。
knowledge.textEn: Specify replacement and mixing order within each cycle and verify that old and new fractions sum to one. Compare tracer decay at multiple locations; slow tails or spatial differences should prompt investigation of stagnant zones and return flow rather than extrapolation from rapid initial changes alone.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將有效替換比例提高至0.10，重算十潮後舊水比例，並比較把比例直接乘十的錯誤線性估算。另畫一個不參與交換的死水區，指出完全混合假設如何失效，以及應增加哪些採樣位置。
knowledge.textEn: Increase effective replacement to 0.10 and recalculate the ten-cycle fraction, comparing with the incorrect linear shortcut of multiplying by ten. Add a stagnant compartment, identify the failed mixing assumption and propose additional sampling locations.

quiz.question: 要驗證「往返潮水與有效沖洗」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Returning tidal water and effective flushing"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
只要每年有泥砂沉積，濕地地表相對海面就一定會逐年升高。
先明確描述每個潮週期的替換與混合順序，檢查新舊水比例加總為一。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Any annual sediment deposition guarantees that wetland elevation rises relative to sea level.
Specify replacement and mixing order within each cycle and verify that old and new fractions sum to one.
quiz.explanation: 先明確描述每個潮週期的替換與混合順序，檢查新舊水比例加總為一。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Specify replacement and mixing order within each cycle and verify that old and new fractions sum to one. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 往返潮水與有效沖洗：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Returning tidal water and effective flushing: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「往返潮水與有效沖洗」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Returning tidal water and effective flushing” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把總潮汐容積全部視為有效新水替換，會高估沖洗。只在通道附近採樣也可能看到快速更新，卻漏掉平台凹地的長停留水體，使平均模型掩蓋局部問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Treating the entire tidal prism as new-water replacement exaggerates flushing. Sampling only near the channel can detect rapid renewal while missing long-residence water in depressions, allowing a mean model to conceal localized stagnant conditions. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：復育後應以示蹤或多點時間序列檢驗交換效率，同時區分水體更新與污染物反應造成的濃度降低。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Test exchange with tracers or multiple time series and distinguish water renewal from concentration changes caused by reactions.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「每次漲潮進入多少水，就一定有同樣體積的舊水被永久替換而不再返回。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Every flood-tide inflow permanently replaces an equal old-water volume that can never return." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把總潮汐容積全部視為有效新水替換，會高估沖洗。只在通道附近採樣也可能看到快速更新，卻漏掉平台凹地的長停留水體，使平均模型掩蓋局部問題。
knowledge.textEn: Treating the entire tidal prism as new-water replacement exaggerates flushing. Sampling only near the channel can detect rapid renewal while missing long-residence water in depressions, allowing a mean model to conceal localized stagnant conditions.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「往返潮水與有效沖洗」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Returning tidal water and effective flushing" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 把總潮汐容積全部視為有效新水替換，會高估沖洗。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
復育區指標變好就足以證明工程造成全部改善，不需要對照、季節或變異資料。
optionsEn: Treating the entire tidal prism as new-water replacement exaggerates flushing.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Improvement at the restoration site alone proves the project caused every change without controls or variability data.
quiz.explanation: 把總潮汐容積全部視為有效新水替換，會高估沖洗。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Treating the entire tidal prism as new-water replacement exaggerates flushing. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 復育成效與前後對照：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Restoration response and before-after controls: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「復育成效與前後對照」如何影響海岸濕地復育水理的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Restoration response and before-after controls” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Hydraulics for coastal-wetland restoration”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 工程完成後觀察到棲地或水理指標改善，仍需要辨認季節、區域氣候和其他工程同時變化的影響。前後與對照區比較可用來扣除共同背景變化，但對照區必須具有可比較性，且多個獨立樣區和時間點比大量重複量同一點更能支持推論。簡單差中之差只是描述指標變化，不自動證明因果或統計顯著。適應性管理應先定義目標、量測方法與調整條件，再依觀測更新假設，而不是在看到結果後才挑選最有利的指標。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「復育成效與前後對照」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An improved habitat or hydraulic indicator after construction may also reflect seasonality, regional climate or other interventions. Before-after comparison with a control can remove shared background change, but comparability and independent spatial-temporal replication matter. A simple difference-in-differences is descriptive rather than automatic proof of causality or statistical significance. Adaptive management should define objectives, measurements and decision conditions in advance, then revise hypotheses using evidence instead of selecting the most favorable indicator after results are known. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Restoration response and before-after controls” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設復育區植生覆蓋率由30%升至50%，對照區由40%升至45%；差中之差為(50−30)−(45−40)=15個百分點，尚無樣本變異資料，不能宣稱統計顯著。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Assume vegetation cover rises from 30% to 50% at a restoration area and from 40% to 45% at a control.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「復育區指標變好就足以證明工程造成全部改善，不需要對照、季節或變異資料。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Improvement at the restoration site alone proves the project caused every change without controls or variability data." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「復育成效與前後對照」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Restoration response and before-after controls”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 復育成效與前後對照
knowledge.text: 工程完成後觀察到棲地或水理指標改善，仍需要辨認季節、區域氣候和其他工程同時變化的影響。前後與對照區比較可用來扣除共同背景變化，但對照區必須具有可比較性，且多個獨立樣區和時間點比大量重複量同一點更能支持推論。
knowledge.textEn: An improved habitat or hydraulic indicator after construction may also reflect seasonality, regional climate or other interventions. Before-after comparison with a control can remove shared background change, but comparability and independent spatial-temporal replication matter.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：復育區指標變好就足以證明工程造成全部改善，不需要對照、季節或變異資料。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Improvement at the restoration site alone proves the project caused every change without controls or variability data. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「復育成效與前後對照」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Restoration response and before-after controls" is correct?
options: 復育區指標變好就足以證明工程造成全部改善，不需要對照、季節或變異資料。
工程完成後觀察到棲地或水理指標改善，仍需要辨認季節、區域氣候和其他工程同時變化的影響。
濕地總土地面積乘外海潮差，永遠等於實際潮汐交換量與淨沖洗量。
optionsEn: Improvement at the restoration site alone proves the project caused every change without controls or variability data.
An improved habitat or hydraulic indicator after construction may also reflect seasonality, regional climate or other interventions.
Total wetland area times offshore tidal range always equals both actual tidal exchange and net flushing.
quiz.explanation: 工程完成後觀察到棲地或水理指標改善，仍需要辨認季節、區域氣候和其他工程同時變化的影響。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: An improved habitat or hydraulic indicator after construction may also reflect seasonality, regional climate or other interventions. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 復育成效與前後對照：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Restoration response and before-after controls: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「復育成效與前後對照」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Restoration response and before-after controls” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設復育區植生覆蓋率由30%升至50%，對照區由40%升至45%；差中之差為(50−30)−(45−40)=15個百分點，尚無樣本變異資料，不能宣稱統計顯著。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Assume vegetation cover rises from 30% to 50% at a restoration area and from 40% to 45% at a control. Difference-in-differences is 15 percentage points; without sampling variability, statistical significance cannot be claimed. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：確認前後季節、樣區面積和影像判讀方法一致，檢查對照區是否也受到工程影響。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Align seasons, plot areas and classification methods, checking whether the control was also affected by construction.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設復育區植生覆蓋率由30%升至50%，對照區由40%升至45%；差中之差為(50−30)−(45−40)=15個百分點，尚無樣本變異資料，不能宣稱統計顯著。
knowledge.textEn: Assume vegetation cover rises from 30% to 50% at a restoration area and from 40% to 45% at a control. Difference-in-differences is 15 percentage points; without sampling variability, statistical significance cannot be claimed.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「復育成效與前後對照」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Restoration response and before-after controls", which statement holds?
options: 內部與外部最高水位接近，就表示整個潮週期沒有任何阻力或相位延遲。
漲潮帶入的所有懸浮泥砂都會永久留在濕地，完全不需計算退潮輸出。
教學假設復育區植生覆蓋率由30%升至50%，對照區由40%升至45%。
optionsEn: Similar internal and external high-water levels prove the full tide has no resistance or phase delay.
All sediment entering on flood tides remains permanently in the wetland, so ebb export can be ignored.
Assume vegetation cover rises from 30% to 50% at a restoration area and from 40% to 45% at a control.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設復育區植生覆蓋率由30%升至50%，對照區由40%升至45%；差中之差為(50−30)−(45−40)=15個百分點，尚無樣本變異資料，不能宣稱統計顯著。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Assume vegetation cover rises from 30% to 50% at a restoration area and from 40% to 45% at a control. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 復育成效與前後對照：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Restoration response and before-after controls: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「復育成效與前後對照」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Restoration response and before-after controls” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 確認前後季節、樣區面積和影像判讀方法一致，檢查對照區是否也受到工程影響。保留獨立樣區及時間點的原始值，報告變異與缺測，再比較水理、泥砂及生態指標是否支持同一解釋，而非只保留改善最大的數字。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Align seasons, plot areas and classification methods, checking whether the control was also affected by construction. Retain independent plot and time observations, report variability and missingness, and compare hydraulic, sediment and ecological indicators rather than selecting only the largest improvement. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：改成對照區也增加二十個百分點，重算差中之差並說明結論如何改變。再設計兩個獨立樣區與跨季節觀測表，列出可檢查共同趨勢的資料，以及仍不能由簡單差值直接證明的因果問題。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Let the control also improve by twenty percentage points and recompute the contrast. Design independent plots and seasonal observations, identify evidence for common trends, and explain which causal questions remain unresolved by the simple difference alone.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把百分比相減後再稱為百分比增幅，會混淆百分點與相對變化。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Confusing percentage-point differences with relative percentage change distorts results. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 確認前後季節、樣區面積和影像判讀方法一致，檢查對照區是否也受到工程影響。保留獨立樣區及時間點的原始值，報告變異與缺測，再比較水理、泥砂及生態指標是否支持同一解釋，而非只保留改善最大的數字。
knowledge.textEn: Align seasons, plot areas and classification methods, checking whether the control was also affected by construction. Retain independent plot and time observations, report variability and missingness, and compare hydraulic, sediment and ecological indicators rather than selecting only the largest improvement.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 改成對照區也增加二十個百分點，重算差中之差並說明結論如何改變。再設計兩個獨立樣區與跨季節觀測表，列出可檢查共同趨勢的資料，以及仍不能由簡單差值直接證明的因果問題。
knowledge.textEn: Let the control also improve by twenty percentage points and recompute the contrast. Design independent plots and seasonal observations, identify evidence for common trends, and explain which causal questions remain unresolved by the simple difference alone.

quiz.question: 要驗證「復育成效與前後對照」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Restoration response and before-after controls"?
options: 確認前後季節、樣區面積和影像判讀方法一致，檢查對照區是否也受到工程影響。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
植生覆蓋率相同的兩片濕地，在任何水深和流速下都必定產生相同阻力。
optionsEn: Align seasons, plot areas and classification methods, checking whether the control was also affected by construction.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Equal vegetation cover guarantees equal drag at every depth and velocity.
quiz.explanation: 確認前後季節、樣區面積和影像判讀方法一致，檢查對照區是否也受到工程影響。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Align seasons, plot areas and classification methods, checking whether the control was also affected by construction. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 復育成效與前後對照：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Restoration response and before-after controls: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「復育成效與前後對照」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Restoration response and before-after controls” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把百分比相減後再稱為百分比增幅，會混淆百分點與相對變化。沒有對照與變異資料就宣稱工程造成全部改善，也可能把共同氣候因素或觀測方法改變誤當成復育效果。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Confusing percentage-point differences with relative percentage change distorts results. Attributing all improvement to construction without controls or variability can also mistake regional climate or changed observation methods for a restoration effect. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：適應性管理應先定義目標、量測方法與調整條件，再依觀測更新假設，而不是在看到結果後才挑選最有利的指標。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Adaptive management should define objectives, measurements and decision conditions in advance, then revise hypotheses using evidence instead of selecting the most favorable indicator after results are known.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「復育區指標變好就足以證明工程造成全部改善，不需要對照、季節或變異資料。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Improvement at the restoration site alone proves the project caused every change without controls or variability data." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把百分比相減後再稱為百分比增幅，會混淆百分點與相對變化。沒有對照與變異資料就宣稱工程造成全部改善，也可能把共同氣候因素或觀測方法改變誤當成復育效果。
knowledge.textEn: Confusing percentage-point differences with relative percentage change distorts results. Attributing all improvement to construction without controls or variability can also mistake regional climate or changed observation methods for a restoration effect.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「復育成效與前後對照」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Restoration response and before-after controls" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
把百分比相減後再稱為百分比增幅，會混淆百分點與相對變化。
濕地總土地面積乘外海潮差，永遠等於實際潮汐交換量與淨沖洗量。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Confusing percentage-point differences with relative percentage change distorts results.
Total wetland area times offshore tidal range always equals both actual tidal exchange and net flushing.
quiz.explanation: 把百分比相減後再稱為百分比增幅，會混淆百分點與相對變化。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Confusing percentage-point differences with relative percentage change distorts results. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 地下水人工補注設施
summary: 以橘郡地下水補注系統與Sand Hollow研究為背景，從地表入滲一路追蹤到含水層儲存與回收。十個原創單元包含濕潤前緣、限制層、地下水隆起、氣體困陷、入滲衰減、水質質量帳與熱示蹤，要求逐一辨識控制體、時間尺度和模型限制。
summaryEn: Use Orange County recharge and Sand Hollow research as context to follow infiltration into aquifer storage and recovery. Ten original units examine wetting fronts, restrictive layers, mounding, trapped gas, declining infiltration, mass accounting and thermal tracing, making control volumes, timescales and model limitations explicit.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
subcategoryTitle: 海岸、港灣與水資源韌性

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 教學假設一天有1000 m³水穿越補注池底，其中300 m³增加包氣帶儲存、100 m³側向離開控制體，剩600 m³才穿越下方地下水面。第二天即使停止供水，前一天的暫存水仍可能繼續向下移動，所以地表入滲與地下水補注不能逐日直接畫等號。另一個獨立算例以10000 m³注入量、8000 m³總抽回量及6500 m³符合假設條件的水量，得到80%總抽回比與65%條件合格回收效率。請保持指標邊界一致，並以獨立示蹤資料評估來源，而非將水量比例當成水質或分子來源證明。
workedExample.textEn: Assume 1000 m³ crosses a basin floor in one day, with 300 m³ retained in vadose storage and 100 m³ leaving laterally. Only 600 m³ crosses the lower water-table boundary during that interval. Stored moisture may continue draining after supply stops the next day, so daily infiltration and recharge are not interchangeable. In a separate recovery example, 10000 m³ is injected, 8000 m³ pumped and 6500 m³ meets a hypothetical condition, yielding an 80% gross pumping ratio and 65% acceptable recovery efficiency. Keep definitions and periods consistent, and use independent tracers for source attribution rather than interpreting volume ratios as proof of quality or molecular origin.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「入滲量與地下水補注量」與「濕潤前緣與包氣帶儲存」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Infiltration versus aquifer recharge" and "Wetting fronts and vadose storage": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 入滲量與地下水補注量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Infiltration versus aquifer recharge: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「入滲量與地下水補注量」如何影響地下水人工補注設施的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Infiltration versus aquifer recharge” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Managed aquifer-recharge facilities”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 進入補注池底的水不一定立即抵達區域地下水面，因為中間包氣帶可以暫存水分，也可能產生側向流、蒸散或滯留在低滲透層上方。水量帳應先選定控制體，再區分池面收支、包氣帶儲量與真正穿越地下水面的補注。只把池內水位下降全當補注，容易混入蒸發、池體滲漏到其他區域及量測誤差。教學上先以簡單守恆建立概念，再說明需要時間序列與地下觀測，才能把地表入滲事件和後續含水層回應連結起來。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「入滲量與地下水補注量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Water entering a recharge-basin floor does not necessarily reach the regional water table immediately. The unsaturated zone can store moisture, route water laterally or retain it above restrictive layers, while evapotranspiration removes some water. Define the control volume before separating basin balance, vadose storage and flux across the water table. Treating every basin-level decline as recharge mixes evaporation and other pathways into the estimate. Begin with conservation, then use temporal and subsurface observations to connect infiltration events with later aquifer response. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Infiltration versus aquifer recharge” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設一天池底入滲1000 m³，其中包氣帶儲量增加300 m³、側向離開控制體100 m³，其他項為零；跨越底部地下水面的補注量為600 m³。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Assume one day of 1000 m³ basin-floor infiltration, 300 m³ increase in vadose storage and 100 m³ lateral outflow, with other terms zero.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「補注池水位下降的全部水量，都等於同一天已經抵達區域含水層的補注量。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Every basin-level loss equals aquifer recharge completed on the same day." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「入滲量與地下水補注量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Infiltration versus aquifer recharge”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 入滲量與地下水補注量
knowledge.text: 進入補注池底的水不一定立即抵達區域地下水面，因為中間包氣帶可以暫存水分，也可能產生側向流、蒸散或滯留在低滲透層上方。水量帳應先選定控制體，再區分池面收支、包氣帶儲量與真正穿越地下水面的補注。
knowledge.textEn: Water entering a recharge-basin floor does not necessarily reach the regional water table immediately. The unsaturated zone can store moisture, route water laterally or retain it above restrictive layers, while evapotranspiration removes some water.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：補注池水位下降的全部水量，都等於同一天已經抵達區域含水層的補注量。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Every basin-level loss equals aquifer recharge completed on the same day. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「入滲量與地下水補注量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Infiltration versus aquifer recharge" is correct?
options: 補注池水位下降的全部水量，都等於同一天已經抵達區域含水層的補注量。
進入補注池底的水不一定立即抵達區域地下水面，因為中間包氣帶可以暫存水分，也可能產生側向流、蒸散或滯留在低滲透層上方。
相同入滲水量在任何初始含水量下，都會產生完全相同的濕潤前緣深度。
optionsEn: Every basin-level loss equals aquifer recharge completed on the same day.
Water entering a recharge-basin floor does not necessarily reach the regional water table immediately.
Equal infiltrated volume produces the same wetting-front depth regardless of initial moisture.
quiz.explanation: 進入補注池底的水不一定立即抵達區域地下水面，因為中間包氣帶可以暫存水分，也可能產生側向流、蒸散或滯留在低滲透層上方。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Water entering a recharge-basin floor does not necessarily reach the regional water table immediately. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 入滲量與地下水補注量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Infiltration versus aquifer recharge: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「入滲量與地下水補注量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Infiltration versus aquifer recharge” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設一天池底入滲1000 m³，其中包氣帶儲量增加300 m³、側向離開控制體100 m³，其他項為零；跨越底部地下水面的補注量為600 m³。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Assume one day of 1000 m³ basin-floor infiltration, 300 m³ increase in vadose storage and 100 m³ lateral outflow, with other terms zero. Recharge crossing the lower water-table boundary is 600 m³. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在剖面圖上標明每個流量穿越哪個邊界，核對儲量變化的正負號與期間。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Mark which boundary each flux crosses and check the sign and interval of storage change.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設一天池底入滲1000 m³，其中包氣帶儲量增加300 m³、側向離開控制體100 m³，其他項為零；跨越底部地下水面的補注量為600 m³。
knowledge.textEn: Assume one day of 1000 m³ basin-floor infiltration, 300 m³ increase in vadose storage and 100 m³ lateral outflow, with other terms zero. Recharge crossing the lower water-table boundary is 600 m³.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「入滲量與地下水補注量」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Infiltration versus aquifer recharge", which statement holds?
options: 任何一口井測到的水位隆起，都可以直接代表整個補注區域的平均水位變化。
指數曲線擬合良好，就足以證明入滲衰減只有一種已知堵塞機制。
教學假設一天池底入滲1000 m³，其中包氣帶儲量增加300 m³、側向離開控制體100 m³，其他項為零；跨越底部地下水面的補注量為600 m³。
optionsEn: The rise measured at any single well automatically represents the mean rise across the recharge area.
A good exponential fit proves that infiltration decline has one uniquely identified clogging mechanism.
Assume one day of 1000 m³ basin-floor infiltration, 300 m³ increase in vadose storage and 100 m³ lateral outflow, with other terms zero.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設一天池底入滲1000 m³，其中包氣帶儲量增加300 m³、側向離開控制體100 m³，其他項為零；跨越底部地下水面的補注量為600 m³。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Assume one day of 1000 m³ basin-floor infiltration, 300 m³ increase in vadose storage and 100 m³ lateral outflow, with other terms zero. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 入滲量與地下水補注量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Infiltration versus aquifer recharge: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「入滲量與地下水補注量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Infiltration versus aquifer recharge” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在剖面圖上標明每個流量穿越哪個邊界，核對儲量變化的正負號與期間。把池面蒸發、地下側向流和水位反應分開記錄，使用不同深度的含水量資料檢查暫存量，避免以同一個水位數字同時代表兩個控制體。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Mark which boundary each flux crosses and check the sign and interval of storage change. Record evaporation, lateral subsurface flow and groundwater response separately, using moisture observations at multiple depths to assess temporary storage rather than assigning one level measurement to two different control volumes. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
