steps.observation: 現場實務：畫出池體、包氣帶與飽和含水層三個控制體，建立連續兩日水量帳。第二日停止供水但允許包氣帶釋水，說明為何池底入滲為零時地下水補注仍可能持續，並檢查跨日總量是否守恆。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Draw basin, vadose-zone and saturated-aquifer control volumes and prepare a two-day balance. Stop supply on day two while allowing stored moisture to drain, explaining why recharge may continue without new basin infiltration and checking conservation across both days.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若把包氣帶暫存水直接記為已補入含水層，會高估短期補注績效。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Crediting vadose storage as completed aquifer recharge overstates short-term performance. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在剖面圖上標明每個流量穿越哪個邊界，核對儲量變化的正負號與期間。把池面蒸發、地下側向流和水位反應分開記錄，使用不同深度的含水量資料檢查暫存量，避免以同一個水位數字同時代表兩個控制體。
knowledge.textEn: Mark which boundary each flux crosses and check the sign and interval of storage change. Record evaporation, lateral subsurface flow and groundwater response separately, using moisture observations at multiple depths to assess temporary storage rather than assigning one level measurement to two different control volumes.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 畫出池體、包氣帶與飽和含水層三個控制體，建立連續兩日水量帳。第二日停止供水但允許包氣帶釋水，說明為何池底入滲為零時地下水補注仍可能持續，並檢查跨日總量是否守恆。
knowledge.textEn: Draw basin, vadose-zone and saturated-aquifer control volumes and prepare a two-day balance. Stop supply on day two while allowing stored moisture to drain, explaining why recharge may continue without new basin infiltration and checking conservation across both days.

quiz.question: 要驗證「入滲量與地下水補注量」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Infiltration versus aquifer recharge"?
options: 在剖面圖上標明每個流量穿越哪個邊界，核對儲量變化的正負號與期間。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
熱前緣一定與保守溶質以完全相同速度移動，不受土壤固體熱容量影響。
optionsEn: Mark which boundary each flux crosses and check the sign and interval of storage change.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Thermal fronts always move at conservative-solute speed, unaffected by solid heat capacity.
quiz.explanation: 在剖面圖上標明每個流量穿越哪個邊界，核對儲量變化的正負號與期間。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Mark which boundary each flux crosses and check the sign and interval of storage change. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 入滲量與地下水補注量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Infiltration versus aquifer recharge: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「入滲量與地下水補注量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Infiltration versus aquifer recharge” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若把包氣帶暫存水直接記為已補入含水層，會高估短期補注績效。後續暫存水逐漸向下移動時，又可能被重複記帳，造成同一批水在不同月份被算成兩次補注。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Crediting vadose storage as completed aquifer recharge overstates short-term performance. When that stored water later moves downward, it may be counted again, recording the same water twice across different accounting periods. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：教學上先以簡單守恆建立概念，再說明需要時間序列與地下觀測，才能把地表入滲事件和後續含水層回應連結起來。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Begin with conservation, then use temporal and subsurface observations to connect infiltration events with later aquifer response.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「補注池水位下降的全部水量，都等於同一天已經抵達區域含水層的補注量。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Every basin-level loss equals aquifer recharge completed on the same day." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若把包氣帶暫存水直接記為已補入含水層，會高估短期補注績效。後續暫存水逐漸向下移動時，又可能被重複記帳，造成同一批水在不同月份被算成兩次補注。
knowledge.textEn: Crediting vadose storage as completed aquifer recharge overstates short-term performance. When that stored water later moves downward, it may be counted again, recording the same water twice across different accounting periods.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「入滲量與地下水補注量」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Infiltration versus aquifer recharge" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若把包氣帶暫存水直接記為已補入含水層，會高估短期補注績效。
相同入滲水量在任何初始含水量下，都會產生完全相同的濕潤前緣深度。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Crediting vadose storage as completed aquifer recharge overstates short-term performance.
Equal infiltrated volume produces the same wetting-front depth regardless of initial moisture.
quiz.explanation: 若把包氣帶暫存水直接記為已補入含水層，會高估短期補注績效。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Crediting vadose storage as completed aquifer recharge overstates short-term performance. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 濕潤前緣與包氣帶儲存：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Wetting fronts and vadose storage: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「濕潤前緣與包氣帶儲存」如何影響地下水人工補注設施的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Wetting fronts and vadose storage” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Managed aquifer-recharge facilities”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 簡化活塞式濕潤前緣把入滲水視為逐步填補土壤含水量差，前緣前進距離可由累積入滲深度除以體積含水量增量估算。這個模型忽略優勢流、氣體困陷與前緣擴散，不能代表所有地層。初始含水量越高，同一入滲水量需要填補的孔隙儲存越少，理想前緣可能更深；但實際流速仍取決於不飽和傳導特性。應把水量幾何估算與動力學分開，不能由前緣深度公式直接推定精確到達時間。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「濕潤前緣與包氣帶儲存」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A piston-style wetting front treats infiltration as filling a moisture deficit. Cumulative infiltration depth divided by volumetric moisture increase estimates front depth, ignoring preferential flow, trapped gas and diffuse wetting. A wetter initial profile requires less added storage for the same depth, but actual movement also depends on unsaturated conductivity. Separate this geometric storage estimate from flow dynamics: the relation explains how much water is needed under ideal assumptions, not exactly when a front reaches a particular layer. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Wetting fronts and vadose storage” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設均勻初始體積含水量0.10、濕潤後0.30，累積入滲深度0.60 m，無側流或蒸發；理想濕潤深度z=0.60/(0.30−0.10)=3.0 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Assume uniform initial volumetric water content 0.10, wetted content 0.30 and cumulative infiltration depth 0.60 m, with no lateral loss or evaporation.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「相同入滲水量在任何初始含水量下，都會產生完全相同的濕潤前緣深度。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equal infiltrated volume produces the same wetting-front depth regardless of initial moisture." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「濕潤前緣與包氣帶儲存」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Wetting fronts and vadose storage”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 濕潤前緣與包氣帶儲存
knowledge.text: 簡化活塞式濕潤前緣把入滲水視為逐步填補土壤含水量差，前緣前進距離可由累積入滲深度除以體積含水量增量估算。這個模型忽略優勢流、氣體困陷與前緣擴散，不能代表所有地層。
knowledge.textEn: A piston-style wetting front treats infiltration as filling a moisture deficit. Cumulative infiltration depth divided by volumetric moisture increase estimates front depth, ignoring preferential flow, trapped gas and diffuse wetting.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：相同入滲水量在任何初始含水量下，都會產生完全相同的濕潤前緣深度。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Equal infiltrated volume produces the same wetting-front depth regardless of initial moisture. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「濕潤前緣與包氣帶儲存」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Wetting fronts and vadose storage" is correct?
options: 相同入滲水量在任何初始含水量下，都會產生完全相同的濕潤前緣深度。
限制層只要很薄，就不可能控制整個地層剖面的垂直入滲通量。
簡化活塞式濕潤前緣把入滲水視為逐步填補土壤含水量差，前緣前進距離可由累積入滲深度除以體積含水量增量估算。
optionsEn: Equal infiltrated volume produces the same wetting-front depth regardless of initial moisture.
A thin restrictive layer can never control vertical flux through the full profile.
A piston-style wetting front treats infiltration as filling a moisture deficit.
quiz.explanation: 簡化活塞式濕潤前緣把入滲水視為逐步填補土壤含水量差，前緣前進距離可由累積入滲深度除以體積含水量增量估算。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A piston-style wetting front treats infiltration as filling a moisture deficit. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 濕潤前緣與包氣帶儲存：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Wetting fronts and vadose storage: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「濕潤前緣與包氣帶儲存」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Wetting fronts and vadose storage” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設均勻初始體積含水量0.10、濕潤後0.30，累積入滲深度0.60 m，無側流或蒸發；理想濕潤深度z=0.60/(0.30−0.10)=3.0 m。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Assume uniform initial volumetric water content 0.10, wetted content 0.30 and cumulative infiltration depth 0.60 m, with no lateral loss or evaporation. Ideal wetting depth is 0.60/(0.30−0.10)=3.0 m. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將體積含水量以無量綱比例表示，核對入滲深度是每單位地表面積的水量。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Express volumetric contents as dimensionless fractions and verify that infiltration depth is volume per ground area.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設均勻初始體積含水量0.10、濕潤後0.30，累積入滲深度0.60 m，無側流或蒸發；理想濕潤深度z=0.60/(0.30−0.10)=3.0 m。
knowledge.textEn: Assume uniform initial volumetric water content 0.10, wetted content 0.30 and cumulative infiltration depth 0.60 m, with no lateral loss or evaporation. Ideal wetting depth is 0.60/(0.30−0.10)=3.0 m.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「濕潤前緣與包氣帶儲存」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Wetting fronts and vadose storage", which statement holds?
options: 教學假設均勻初始體積含水量0.10、濕潤後0.30，累積入滲深度0.60 m，無側流或蒸發；理想濕潤深度z=0.60/(0.30−0.10)=3.0 m。
孔隙氣體占比降低多少，水力傳導係數就必定以完全相同的百分比提高。
混合後濃度降低，就表示污染物總質量一定已經被去除。
optionsEn: Assume uniform initial volumetric water content 0.10, wetted content 0.30 and cumulative infiltration depth 0.60 m, with no lateral loss or evaporation.
Reducing gas-filled pore fraction always increases conductivity by exactly the same percentage.
A lower concentration after mixing necessarily means pollutant mass has been removed.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設均勻初始體積含水量0.10、濕潤後0.30，累積入滲深度0.60 m，無側流或蒸發；理想濕潤深度z=0.60/(0.30−0.10)=3.0 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Assume uniform initial volumetric water content 0.10, wetted content 0.30 and cumulative infiltration depth 0.60 m, with no lateral loss or evaporation. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 濕潤前緣與包氣帶儲存：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Wetting fronts and vadose storage: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「濕潤前緣與包氣帶儲存」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Wetting fronts and vadose storage” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將體積含水量以無量綱比例表示，核對入滲深度是每單位地表面積的水量。以多深度感測資料觀察前緣是否清楚，若出現先深後淺的到達或不連續反應，應檢查優勢流和感測代表性，不強迫資料符合均勻活塞模型。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Express volumetric contents as dimensionless fractions and verify that infiltration depth is volume per ground area. Examine multiple depths for a distinct front; early deep responses or discontinuities should trigger checks for preferential flow and sensor representativeness rather than forcing observations into a uniform piston model. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將初始含水量改成0.20而保持其餘假設不變，重算前緣深度。再畫出一條快速裂隙路徑，說明為何均勻模型無法預測最早到達，並指出需增加哪種分層或示蹤資料才能檢驗假設。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change initial moisture to 0.20 while retaining other assumptions and recalculate depth. Sketch a fast fracture pathway, explain why the uniform model cannot predict earliest arrival, and identify layered or tracer observations needed to evaluate its assumptions.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把百分比直接代入而未換成比例，會讓估算深度差一百倍。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Entering percentages without conversion produces a hundredfold error. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將體積含水量以無量綱比例表示，核對入滲深度是每單位地表面積的水量。以多深度感測資料觀察前緣是否清楚，若出現先深後淺的到達或不連續反應，應檢查優勢流和感測代表性，不強迫資料符合均勻活塞模型。
knowledge.textEn: Express volumetric contents as dimensionless fractions and verify that infiltration depth is volume per ground area. Examine multiple depths for a distinct front; early deep responses or discontinuities should trigger checks for preferential flow and sensor representativeness rather than forcing observations into a uniform piston model.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將初始含水量改成0.20而保持其餘假設不變，重算前緣深度。再畫出一條快速裂隙路徑，說明為何均勻模型無法預測最早到達，並指出需增加哪種分層或示蹤資料才能檢驗假設。
knowledge.textEn: Change initial moisture to 0.20 while retaining other assumptions and recalculate depth. Sketch a fast fracture pathway, explain why the uniform model cannot predict earliest arrival, and identify layered or tracer observations needed to evaluate its assumptions.

quiz.question: 要驗證「濕潤前緣與包氣帶儲存」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Wetting fronts and vadose storage"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
將體積含水量以無量綱比例表示，核對入滲深度是每單位地表面積的水量。
總抽回量占注入量百分之八十，就代表有百分之八十的注入水已符合所有使用條件。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Express volumetric contents as dimensionless fractions and verify that infiltration depth is volume per ground area.
Pumping eighty percent of injected volume proves eighty percent of injected water meets every use condition.
quiz.explanation: 將體積含水量以無量綱比例表示，核對入滲深度是每單位地表面積的水量。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Express volumetric contents as dimensionless fractions and verify that infiltration depth is volume per ground area. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「濕潤前緣與包氣帶儲存」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Wetting fronts and vadose storage" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
限制層只要很薄，就不可能控制整個地層剖面的垂直入滲通量。
把百分比直接代入而未換成比例，會讓估算深度差一百倍。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A thin restrictive layer can never control vertical flux through the full profile.
Entering percentages without conversion produces a hundredfold error.
quiz.explanation: 把百分比直接代入而未換成比例，會讓估算深度差一百倍。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Entering percentages without conversion produces a hundredfold error. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 水力機制、材料與定量模型
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「限制層與串聯水力阻抗」與「比出水量與地下水位隆起」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Restrictive layers and series hydraulic resistance" and "Specific yield and groundwater mounding": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 限制層與串聯水力阻抗：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Restrictive layers and series hydraulic resistance: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「限制層與串聯水力阻抗」如何影響地下水人工補注設施的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Restrictive layers and series hydraulic resistance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Managed aquifer-recharge facilities”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 垂直流經多層土壤時，各層的水頭損失相加，厚度除以水力傳導係數代表該層在單位面積下的阻抗。很薄但低傳導性的層可能控制整個剖面的通量，因此只取各層傳導係數的算術平均通常不適合串聯流動。此處採飽和、定常、一維及相同截面假設，便於理解限制層；真實補注的包氣帶可能不飽和、形成滯水或側流，需要其他模型。辨識薄弱層的連續性與範圍，往往比只量地表材料更重要。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「限制層與串聯水力阻抗」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: For vertical flow through layers, head losses add, and thickness divided by conductivity represents resistance per unit area. A thin low-conductivity layer can control the total flux, so arithmetic averaging of conductivities generally fails for series flow. The teaching model assumes saturated steady one-dimensional flow through equal areas to isolate this mechanism. Actual vadose recharge may involve unsaturation, perched water and lateral diversion, making the continuity and extent of restrictive layers as important as the properties of surface material. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Restrictive layers and series hydraulic resistance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設飽和定常串聯兩層，厚度1與0.20 m，K分別1與0.01 m/day，總水頭差1 m；通量q=1/(1/1+0.20/0.01)=0.04762 m/day。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For two saturated steady layers in series, thicknesses are 1 and 0.20 m, conductivities 1 and 0.01 m/day and total head difference 1 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「限制層只要很薄，就不可能控制整個地層剖面的垂直入滲通量。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A thin restrictive layer can never control vertical flux through the full profile." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「限制層與串聯水力阻抗」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Restrictive layers and series hydraulic resistance”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 限制層與串聯水力阻抗
knowledge.titleEn: Restrictive layers and series hydraulic resistance
knowledge.text: 垂直流經多層土壤時，各層的水頭損失相加，厚度除以水力傳導係數代表該層在單位面積下的阻抗。很薄但低傳導性的層可能控制整個剖面的通量，因此只取各層傳導係數的算術平均通常不適合串聯流動。
knowledge.textEn: For vertical flow through layers, head losses add, and thickness divided by conductivity represents resistance per unit area. A thin low-conductivity layer can control the total flux, so arithmetic averaging of conductivities generally fails for series flow.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：限制層只要很薄，就不可能控制整個地層剖面的垂直入滲通量。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A thin restrictive layer can never control vertical flux through the full profile. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「限制層與串聯水力阻抗」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Restrictive layers and series hydraulic resistance" is correct?
options: 垂直流經多層土壤時，各層的水頭損失相加，厚度除以水力傳導係數代表該層在單位面積下的阻抗。
限制層只要很薄，就不可能控制整個地層剖面的垂直入滲通量。
任何一口井測到的水位隆起，都可以直接代表整個補注區域的平均水位變化。
optionsEn: For vertical flow through layers, head losses add, and thickness divided by conductivity represents resistance per unit area.
A thin restrictive layer can never control vertical flux through the full profile.
The rise measured at any single well automatically represents the mean rise across the recharge area.

quiz.explanationEn: For vertical flow through layers, head losses add, and thickness divided by conductivity represents resistance per unit area. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 限制層與串聯水力阻抗：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Restrictive layers and series hydraulic resistance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「限制層與串聯水力阻抗」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Restrictive layers and series hydraulic resistance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設飽和定常串聯兩層，厚度1與0.20 m，K分別1與0.01 m/day，總水頭差1 m；通量q=1/(1/1+0.20/0.01)=0.04762 m/day。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For two saturated steady layers in series, thicknesses are 1 and 0.20 m, conductivities 1 and 0.01 m/day and total head difference 1 m. Flux is 1/(1/1+0.20/0.01)=0.04762 m/day. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：逐層計算阻抗與水頭損失，確認相同通量穿越每層且損失總和等於施加差值。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Calculate each resistance and head loss, confirming common flux and closure of the imposed head difference.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設飽和定常串聯兩層，厚度1與0.20 m，K分別1與0.01 m/day，總水頭差1 m；通量q=1/(1/1+0.20/0.01)=0.04762 m/day。
knowledge.textEn: For two saturated steady layers in series, thicknesses are 1 and 0.20 m, conductivities 1 and 0.01 m/day and total head difference 1 m. Flux is 1/(1/1+0.20/0.01)=0.04762 m/day.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「限制層與串聯水力阻抗」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Restrictive layers and series hydraulic resistance", which statement holds?
options: 指數曲線擬合良好，就足以證明入滲衰減只有一種已知堵塞機制。
教學假設飽和定常串聯兩層，厚度1與0.20 m，K分別1與0.01 m/day，總水頭差1 m。
熱前緣一定與保守溶質以完全相同速度移動，不受土壤固體熱容量影響。
optionsEn: A good exponential fit proves that infiltration decline has one uniquely identified clogging mechanism.
For two saturated steady layers in series, thicknesses are 1 and 0.20 m, conductivities 1 and 0.01 m/day and total head difference 1 m.
Thermal fronts always move at conservative-solute speed, unaffected by solid heat capacity.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設飽和定常串聯兩層，厚度1與0.20 m，K分別1與0.01 m/day，總水頭差1 m；通量q=1/(1/1+0.20/0.01)=0.04762 m/day。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: For two saturated steady layers in series, thicknesses are 1 and 0.20 m, conductivities 1 and 0.01 m/day and total head difference 1 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 限制層與串聯水力阻抗：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Restrictive layers and series hydraulic resistance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「限制層與串聯水力阻抗」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Restrictive layers and series hydraulic resistance” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 逐層計算阻抗與水頭損失，確認相同通量穿越每層且損失總和等於施加差值。把薄低滲透層的橫向延續範圍列為調查項，並比較多個鑽孔，避免將單點未見限制層誤判為整個補注池下方都沒有。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Calculate each resistance and head loss, confirming common flux and closure of the imposed head difference. Investigate lateral continuity of the restrictive layer and compare multiple boreholes, rather than treating its absence at one location as evidence that the entire basin footprint is unrestricted. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將限制層厚度減半而保持其他條件不變，重算總通量與各層水頭損失。再把限制層改成不連續透鏡體，說明一維串聯假設哪裡失效，以及為何需要側向流動和空間調查資料補充判讀。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Halve restrictive-layer thickness and recalculate flux and head losses. Replace it conceptually with a discontinuous lens, identify where the one-dimensional series assumption fails, and explain why lateral-flow assessment and spatial investigation become necessary.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把兩層傳導係數平均後直接計算，可能大幅高估通量。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Averaging the two conductivities directly can greatly overstate flux. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 逐層計算阻抗與水頭損失，確認相同通量穿越每層且損失總和等於施加差值。把薄低滲透層的橫向延續範圍列為調查項，並比較多個鑽孔，避免將單點未見限制層誤判為整個補注池下方都沒有。
knowledge.textEn: Calculate each resistance and head loss, confirming common flux and closure of the imposed head difference. Investigate lateral continuity of the restrictive layer and compare multiple boreholes, rather than treating its absence at one location as evidence that the entire basin footprint is unrestricted.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將限制層厚度減半而保持其他條件不變，重算總通量與各層水頭損失。再把限制層改成不連續透鏡體，說明一維串聯假設哪裡失效，以及為何需要側向流動和空間調查資料補充判讀。
knowledge.textEn: Halve restrictive-layer thickness and recalculate flux and head losses. Replace it conceptually with a discontinuous lens, identify where the one-dimensional series assumption fails, and explain why lateral-flow assessment and spatial investigation become necessary.

quiz.question: 要驗證「限制層與串聯水力阻抗」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Restrictive layers and series hydraulic resistance"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
設備額定日容量乘以三百六十五，就一定等於每年實際完成的地下水補注量。
逐層計算阻抗與水頭損失，確認相同通量穿越每層且損失總和等於施加差值。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Rated daily capacity multiplied by 365 always equals actual annual aquifer recharge.
Calculate each resistance and head loss, confirming common flux and closure of the imposed head difference.
quiz.explanation: 逐層計算阻抗與水頭損失，確認相同通量穿越每層且損失總和等於施加差值。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Calculate each resistance and head loss, confirming common flux and closure of the imposed head difference. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 限制層與串聯水力阻抗：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Restrictive layers and series hydraulic resistance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「限制層與串聯水力阻抗」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Restrictive layers and series hydraulic resistance” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把兩層傳導係數平均後直接計算，可能大幅高估通量。即使薄層只占很小厚度，也可能控制水頭分布並造成上方積水，讓表面看似良好的入滲條件無法延續到深層。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Averaging the two conductivities directly can greatly overstate flux. A thin restrictive layer may dominate head loss and create perched storage above it, preventing favorable surface infiltration conditions from extending through the deeper profile. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：辨識薄弱層的連續性與範圍，往往比只量地表材料更重要。

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「限制層只要很薄，就不可能控制整個地層剖面的垂直入滲通量。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A thin restrictive layer can never control vertical flux through the full profile." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把兩層傳導係數平均後直接計算，可能大幅高估通量。即使薄層只占很小厚度，也可能控制水頭分布並造成上方積水，讓表面看似良好的入滲條件無法延續到深層。
knowledge.textEn: Averaging the two conductivities directly can greatly overstate flux. A thin restrictive layer may dominate head loss and create perched storage above it, preventing favorable surface infiltration conditions from extending through the deeper profile.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「限制層與串聯水力阻抗」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Restrictive layers and series hydraulic resistance" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 把兩層傳導係數平均後直接計算，可能大幅高估通量。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
任何一口井測到的水位隆起，都可以直接代表整個補注區域的平均水位變化。
optionsEn: Averaging the two conductivities directly can greatly overstate flux.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
The rise measured at any single well automatically represents the mean rise across the recharge area.
quiz.explanation: 把兩層傳導係數平均後直接計算，可能大幅高估通量。 需以量測區分可能原因。

steps.title: 比出水量與地下水位隆起：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Specific yield and groundwater mounding: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「比出水量與地下水位隆起」如何影響地下水人工補注設施的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Specific yield and groundwater mounding” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Managed aquifer-recharge facilities”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 非受壓含水層水位升高時，新增水量主要填入可排水孔隙，因此可用比出水量連結面積、水位變化與儲量。這種集總水量估算並未計算隆起的空間形狀，也忽略同步側向流出、抽水及延遲排水。若觀測井位於補注池附近，局部隆起可能遠高於整個區域的平均水位增量。課程要求先界定有效面積和時間尺度，再辨認比出水量與總孔隙率的差別，避免把一口井的水位乘上任意區域面積就稱為補注總量。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「比出水量與地下水位隆起」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: In an unconfined aquifer, added storage fills drainable pore space, allowing specific yield to relate area, water-level rise and volume. This lumped estimate does not resolve mound shape and omits simultaneous lateral drainage, pumping and delayed yield. A well near a recharge basin may record much more rise than the regional mean. Define area and timescale, distinguish specific yield from total porosity, and avoid multiplying one local well response by an arbitrary regional area to infer recharge volume. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Specific yield and groundwater mounding” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設均勻非受壓區域面積10000 m²、比出水量0.20，短期淨儲量增加1000 m³且無側向流出；平均水位升高Δh=1000/(10000×0.20)=0.50 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Assume a uniform unconfined area of 10000 m², specific yield 0.20 and net storage addition 1000 m³, with no lateral outflow during the interval.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「任何一口井測到的水位隆起，都可以直接代表整個補注區域的平均水位變化。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The rise measured at any single well automatically represents the mean rise across the recharge area." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「比出水量與地下水位隆起」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Specific yield and groundwater mounding”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 比出水量與地下水位隆起
knowledge.text: 非受壓含水層水位升高時，新增水量主要填入可排水孔隙，因此可用比出水量連結面積、水位變化與儲量。這種集總水量估算並未計算隆起的空間形狀，也忽略同步側向流出、抽水及延遲排水。
knowledge.textEn: In an unconfined aquifer, added storage fills drainable pore space, allowing specific yield to relate area, water-level rise and volume. This lumped estimate does not resolve mound shape and omits simultaneous lateral drainage, pumping and delayed yield.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：任何一口井測到的水位隆起，都可以直接代表整個補注區域的平均水位變化。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The rise measured at any single well automatically represents the mean rise across the recharge area. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「比出水量與地下水位隆起」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Specific yield and groundwater mounding" is correct?
options: 任何一口井測到的水位隆起，都可以直接代表整個補注區域的平均水位變化。
非受壓含水層水位升高時，新增水量主要填入可排水孔隙，因此可用比出水量連結面積、水位變化與儲量。
孔隙氣體占比降低多少，水力傳導係數就必定以完全相同的百分比提高。
optionsEn: The rise measured at any single well automatically represents the mean rise across the recharge area.
In an unconfined aquifer, added storage fills drainable pore space, allowing specific yield to relate area, water-level rise and volume.
Reducing gas-filled pore fraction always increases conductivity by exactly the same percentage.
quiz.explanation: 非受壓含水層水位升高時，新增水量主要填入可排水孔隙，因此可用比出水量連結面積、水位變化與儲量。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: In an unconfined aquifer, added storage fills drainable pore space, allowing specific yield to relate area, water-level rise and volume. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 比出水量與地下水位隆起：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Specific yield and groundwater mounding: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「比出水量與地下水位隆起」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Specific yield and groundwater mounding” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設均勻非受壓區域面積10000 m²、比出水量0.20，短期淨儲量增加1000 m³且無側向流出；平均水位升高Δh=1000/(10000×0.20)=0.50 m。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Assume a uniform unconfined area of 10000 m², specific yield 0.20 and net storage addition 1000 m³, with no lateral outflow during the interval. Mean rise is 1000/(10000×0.20)=0.50 m. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以多口井檢查空間水位變化，將局部隆起與區域平均分開估算。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use multiple wells to distinguish local mounding from regional average rise.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設均勻非受壓區域面積10000 m²、比出水量0.20，短期淨儲量增加1000 m³且無側向流出；平均水位升高Δh=1000/(10000×0.20)=0.50 m。
knowledge.textEn: Assume a uniform unconfined area of 10000 m², specific yield 0.20 and net storage addition 1000 m³, with no lateral outflow during the interval. Mean rise is 1000/(10000×0.20)=0.50 m.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「比出水量與地下水位隆起」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Specific yield and groundwater mounding", which statement holds?
options: 混合後濃度降低，就表示污染物總質量一定已經被去除。
總抽回量占注入量百分之八十，就代表有百分之八十的注入水已符合所有使用條件。
教學假設均勻非受壓區域面積10000 m²、比出水量0.20，短期淨儲量增加1000 m³且無側向流出。
optionsEn: A lower concentration after mixing necessarily means pollutant mass has been removed.
Pumping eighty percent of injected volume proves eighty percent of injected water meets every use condition.
Assume a uniform unconfined area of 10000 m², specific yield 0.20 and net storage addition 1000 m³, with no lateral outflow during the interval.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設均勻非受壓區域面積10000 m²、比出水量0.20，短期淨儲量增加1000 m³且無側向流出；平均水位升高Δh=1000/(10000×0.20)=0.50 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Assume a uniform unconfined area of 10000 m², specific yield 0.20 and net storage addition 1000 m³, with no lateral outflow during the interval. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 比出水量與地下水位隆起：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Specific yield and groundwater mounding: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「比出水量與地下水位隆起」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Specific yield and groundwater mounding” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以多口井檢查空間水位變化，將局部隆起與區域平均分開估算。核對比出水量來源及適用排水時間，並在水量帳中另列抽水與側向排出，確認模型使用的是淨儲量而非未扣損失的總供水量。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use multiple wells to distinguish local mounding from regional average rise. Check the provenance and drainage timescale of specific yield, and account separately for pumping and lateral discharge so the storage calculation uses net retained water rather than gross basin supply. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：保持淨儲量不變，分別將有效面積加倍與比出水量減半，重算平均水位。再畫出中心高、邊緣低的隆起剖面，提出能估算區域平均的觀測配置，並說明哪個參數仍需要獨立證據。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Keep net storage fixed, double effective area and halve specific yield in separate scenarios, then recalculate mean rise. Sketch a mound with a high center and lower edges, proposing observations for regional averaging and identifying parameters that still require independent evidence.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：用總孔隙率取代比出水量，可能把不能在分析期間釋出的水也算入有效儲存。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Substituting total porosity for specific yield includes water that may not drain on the analysis timescale. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以多口井檢查空間水位變化，將局部隆起與區域平均分開估算。核對比出水量來源及適用排水時間，並在水量帳中另列抽水與側向排出，確認模型使用的是淨儲量而非未扣損失的總供水量。
knowledge.textEn: Use multiple wells to distinguish local mounding from regional average rise. Check the provenance and drainage timescale of specific yield, and account separately for pumping and lateral discharge so the storage calculation uses net retained water rather than gross basin supply.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 保持淨儲量不變，分別將有效面積加倍與比出水量減半，重算平均水位。再畫出中心高、邊緣低的隆起剖面，提出能估算區域平均的觀測配置，並說明哪個參數仍需要獨立證據。
knowledge.textEn: Keep net storage fixed, double effective area and halve specific yield in separate scenarios, then recalculate mean rise. Sketch a mound with a high center and lower edges, proposing observations for regional averaging and identifying parameters that still require independent evidence.

quiz.question: 要驗證「比出水量與地下水位隆起」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Specific yield and groundwater mounding"?
options: 以多口井檢查空間水位變化，將局部隆起與區域平均分開估算。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
補注池水位下降的全部水量，都等於同一天已經抵達區域含水層的補注量。
optionsEn: Use multiple wells to distinguish local mounding from regional average rise.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Every basin-level loss equals aquifer recharge completed on the same day.
quiz.explanation: 以多口井檢查空間水位變化，將局部隆起與區域平均分開估算。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Use multiple wells to distinguish local mounding from regional average rise. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 比出水量與地下水位隆起：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Specific yield and groundwater mounding: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「比出水量與地下水位隆起」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Specific yield and groundwater mounding” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 用總孔隙率取代比出水量，可能把不能在分析期間釋出的水也算入有效儲存。把池邊最高水位代表整片含水層，則可能高估區域儲量，兩種誤差需要不同觀測才能分辨。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Substituting total porosity for specific yield includes water that may not drain on the analysis timescale. Extending the highest basin-edge head across the entire aquifer can overstate regional storage; these errors require different observations to resolve. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：課程要求先界定有效面積和時間尺度，再辨認比出水量與總孔隙率的差別，避免把一口井的水位乘上任意區域面積就稱為補注總量。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Define area and timescale, distinguish specific yield from total porosity, and avoid multiplying one local well response by an arbitrary regional area to infer recharge volume.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「任何一口井測到的水位隆起，都可以直接代表整個補注區域的平均水位變化。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The rise measured at any single well automatically represents the mean rise across the recharge area." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 用總孔隙率取代比出水量，可能把不能在分析期間釋出的水也算入有效儲存。把池邊最高水位代表整片含水層，則可能高估區域儲量，兩種誤差需要不同觀測才能分辨。
knowledge.textEn: Substituting total porosity for specific yield includes water that may not drain on the analysis timescale. Extending the highest basin-edge head across the entire aquifer can overstate regional storage; these errors require different observations to resolve.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「比出水量與地下水位隆起」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Specific yield and groundwater mounding" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
用總孔隙率取代比出水量，可能把不能在分析期間釋出的水也算入有效儲存。
孔隙氣體占比降低多少，水力傳導係數就必定以完全相同的百分比提高。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Substituting total porosity for specific yield includes water that may not drain on the analysis timescale.
Reducing gas-filled pore fraction always increases conductivity by exactly the same percentage.
quiz.explanation: 用總孔隙率取代比出水量，可能把不能在分析期間釋出的水也算入有效儲存。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Substituting total porosity for specific yield includes water that may not drain on the analysis timescale. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「氣體困陷與有效導水截面」與「入滲衰減與觀測期間」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Gas entrapment and effective flow area" and "Declining infiltration and observation windows": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 氣體困陷與有效導水截面：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Gas entrapment and effective flow area: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「氣體困陷與有效導水截面」如何影響地下水人工補注設施的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Gas entrapment and effective flow area” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Managed aquifer-recharge facilities”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 補注造成水位上升或濕潤前緣移動時，孔隙內氣體可能被困住，改變可供水流的連通路徑。氣體效應不等同於細粒堵塞，也不能由總孔隙率直接推算，因為氣泡位置、孔喉形狀及溶解過程都會影響導水能力。Sand Hollow研究把水力和水化學資料並用，提供氣體相關機制的實際研究背景；本課的簡化截面模型只用於辨別幾何量與流量的關係，不把假設的氣體比例套用到該水庫或當作現地診斷公式。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「氣體困陷與有效導水截面」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Rising groundwater or a moving wetting front can trap pore gas and alter connected water-flow pathways. Gas effects differ from particle clogging and cannot be inferred from total porosity alone, because bubble location, pore throats and dissolution matter. Sand Hollow research combines hydraulic and hydrochemical evidence as context for this mechanism. The teaching area model isolates geometry and flux without assigning its hypothetical gas fraction to that reservoir or treating it as a field diagnostic law. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Gas entrapment and effective flow area” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學幾何假設總截面10 m²、原可流動孔隙面積比例0.30，其中20%被氣體阻斷；有效流動面積10×0.30×0.80=2.4 m²。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Assume a 10 m² section, connected pore-area fraction 0.30 and 20% blockage of that area by gas.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「孔隙氣體占比降低多少，水力傳導係數就必定以完全相同的百分比提高。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Reducing gas-filled pore fraction always increases conductivity by exactly the same percentage." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「氣體困陷與有效導水截面」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Gas entrapment and effective flow area”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 氣體困陷與有效導水截面
knowledge.titleEn: Gas entrapment and effective flow area
knowledge.text: 補注造成水位上升或濕潤前緣移動時，孔隙內氣體可能被困住，改變可供水流的連通路徑。氣體效應不等同於細粒堵塞，也不能由總孔隙率直接推算，因為氣泡位置、孔喉形狀及溶解過程都會影響導水能力。
knowledge.textEn: Rising groundwater or a moving wetting front can trap pore gas and alter connected water-flow pathways. Gas effects differ from particle clogging and cannot be inferred from total porosity alone, because bubble location, pore throats and dissolution matter.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：孔隙氣體占比降低多少，水力傳導係數就必定以完全相同的百分比提高。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Reducing gas-filled pore fraction always increases conductivity by exactly the same percentage. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「氣體困陷與有效導水截面」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Gas entrapment and effective flow area" is correct?
options: 孔隙氣體占比降低多少，水力傳導係數就必定以完全相同的百分比提高。
指數曲線擬合良好，就足以證明入滲衰減只有一種已知堵塞機制。
補注造成水位上升或濕潤前緣移動時，孔隙內氣體可能被困住，改變可供水流的連通路徑。
optionsEn: Reducing gas-filled pore fraction always increases conductivity by exactly the same percentage.
A good exponential fit proves that infiltration decline has one uniquely identified clogging mechanism.
Rising groundwater or a moving wetting front can trap pore gas and alter connected water-flow pathways.
quiz.explanation: 補注造成水位上升或濕潤前緣移動時，孔隙內氣體可能被困住，改變可供水流的連通路徑。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Rising groundwater or a moving wetting front can trap pore gas and alter connected water-flow pathways. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 氣體困陷與有效導水截面：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Gas entrapment and effective flow area: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「氣體困陷與有效導水截面」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Gas entrapment and effective flow area” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學幾何假設總截面10 m²、原可流動孔隙面積比例0.30，其中20%被氣體阻斷；有效流動面積10×0.30×0.80=2.4 m²。若流量固定0.24 m³/day，該簡式平均速度0.10 m/day，未推算K。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Assume a 10 m² section, connected pore-area fraction 0.30 and 20% blockage of that area by gas. Effective area is 2.4 m². At fixed discharge 0.24 m³/day, geometric mean velocity is 0.10 m/day; conductivity is not inferred. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：把氣體比例明確定義為哪個面積或體積的比例，檢查是否誤與總孔隙率相加。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Define whether gas fraction refers to an area or volume and check that it is not incorrectly added to total porosity.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學幾何假設總截面10 m²、原可流動孔隙面積比例0.30，其中20%被氣體阻斷；有效流動面積10×0.30×0.80=2.4 m²。若流量固定0.24 m³/day，該簡式平均速度0.10 m/day，未推算K。
knowledge.textEn: Assume a 10 m² section, connected pore-area fraction 0.30 and 20% blockage of that area by gas. Effective area is 2.4 m². At fixed discharge 0.24 m³/day, geometric mean velocity is 0.10 m/day; conductivity is not inferred.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「氣體困陷與有效導水截面」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Gas entrapment and effective flow area", which statement holds?
options: 教學幾何假設總截面10 m²、原可流動孔隙面積比例0.30，其中20%被氣體阻斷；有效流動面積10×0.30×0.80=2.4 m²。
熱前緣一定與保守溶質以完全相同速度移動，不受土壤固體熱容量影響。
設備額定日容量乘以三百六十五，就一定等於每年實際完成的地下水補注量。
optionsEn: Assume a 10 m² section, connected pore-area fraction 0.30 and 20% blockage of that area by gas.
Thermal fronts always move at conservative-solute speed, unaffected by solid heat capacity.
Rated daily capacity multiplied by 365 always equals actual annual aquifer recharge.
quiz.explanation: 教學幾何假設總截面10 m²、原可流動孔隙面積比例0.30，其中20%被氣體阻斷；有效流動面積10×0.30×0.80=2.4 m²。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Assume a 10 m² section, connected pore-area fraction 0.30 and 20% blockage of that area by gas. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 氣體困陷與有效導水截面：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Gas entrapment and effective flow area: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「氣體困陷與有效導水截面」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Gas entrapment and effective flow area” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 把氣體比例明確定義為哪個面積或體積的比例，檢查是否誤與總孔隙率相加。比較流量、水頭、溶解氣體及溫度的時間變化，評估不同成因能否解釋同一資料，不用單一水力指標直接宣稱已證實氣體困陷。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Define whether gas fraction refers to an area or volume and check that it is not incorrectly added to total porosity. Compare discharge, head, dissolved-gas and temperature trends, evaluating competing explanations instead of claiming that one hydraulic metric alone proves trapped gas. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把假設阻斷比例改為40%，保持流量不變，重算有效面積與幾何平均速度。再說明若實際流量隨阻抗改變，固定流量假設就不成立，並列出需要量測的壓力、氣體和流量資料以檢驗因果。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change blockage to 40% at fixed discharge and recalculate effective area and geometric velocity. Explain why variable discharge would invalidate that assumption, then list pressure, gas and flow observations needed to evaluate the causal interpretation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把阻斷孔隙比例直接當成水力傳導係數下降比例，會忽略孔喉連通性的非線性影響。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Equating blocked pore fraction with proportional conductivity decline ignores nonlinear connectivity. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 把氣體比例明確定義為哪個面積或體積的比例，檢查是否誤與總孔隙率相加。比較流量、水頭、溶解氣體及溫度的時間變化，評估不同成因能否解釋同一資料，不用單一水力指標直接宣稱已證實氣體困陷。
knowledge.textEn: Define whether gas fraction refers to an area or volume and check that it is not incorrectly added to total porosity. Compare discharge, head, dissolved-gas and temperature trends, evaluating competing explanations instead of claiming that one hydraulic metric alone proves trapped gas.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 把假設阻斷比例改為40%，保持流量不變，重算有效面積與幾何平均速度。再說明若實際流量隨阻抗改變，固定流量假設就不成立，並列出需要量測的壓力、氣體和流量資料以檢驗因果。
knowledge.textEn: Change blockage to 40% at fixed discharge and recalculate effective area and geometric velocity. Explain why variable discharge would invalidate that assumption, then list pressure, gas and flow observations needed to evaluate the causal interpretation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「氣體困陷與有效導水截面」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Gas entrapment and effective flow area"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
把氣體比例明確定義為哪個面積或體積的比例，檢查是否誤與總孔隙率相加。
相同入滲水量在任何初始含水量下，都會產生完全相同的濕潤前緣深度。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Define whether gas fraction refers to an area or volume and check that it is not incorrectly added to total porosity.
Equal infiltrated volume produces the same wetting-front depth regardless of initial moisture.
quiz.explanation: 把氣體比例明確定義為哪個面積或體積的比例，檢查是否誤與總孔隙率相加。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Define whether gas fraction refers to an area or volume and check that it is not incorrectly added to total porosity. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 氣體困陷與有效導水截面：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Gas entrapment and effective flow area: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「氣體困陷與有效導水截面」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Gas entrapment and effective flow area” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把阻斷孔隙比例直接當成水力傳導係數下降比例，會忽略孔喉連通性的非線性影響。若所有入滲衰減都歸因於氣體，也可能漏掉細粒、生物或區域梯度變化造成的同時作用。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Equating blocked pore fraction with proportional conductivity decline ignores nonlinear connectivity. Assigning every infiltration decrease to gas can also overlook particles, biological effects or regional gradient changes acting at the same time. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：Sand Hollow研究把水力和水化學資料並用，提供氣體相關機制的實際研究背景；本課的簡化截面模型只用於辨別幾何量與流量的關係，不把假設的氣體比例套用到該水庫或當作現地診斷公式。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The teaching area model isolates geometry and flux without assigning its hypothetical gas fraction to that reservoir or treating it as a field diagnostic law.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「孔隙氣體占比降低多少，水力傳導係數就必定以完全相同的百分比提高。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Reducing gas-filled pore fraction always increases conductivity by exactly the same percentage." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把阻斷孔隙比例直接當成水力傳導係數下降比例，會忽略孔喉連通性的非線性影響。若所有入滲衰減都歸因於氣體，也可能漏掉細粒、生物或區域梯度變化造成的同時作用。
knowledge.textEn: Equating blocked pore fraction with proportional conductivity decline ignores nonlinear connectivity. Assigning every infiltration decrease to gas can also overlook particles, biological effects or regional gradient changes acting at the same time.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「氣體困陷與有效導水截面」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Gas entrapment and effective flow area" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
指數曲線擬合良好，就足以證明入滲衰減只有一種已知堵塞機制。
把阻斷孔隙比例直接當成水力傳導係數下降比例，會忽略孔喉連通性的非線性影響。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
A good exponential fit proves that infiltration decline has one uniquely identified clogging mechanism.
Equating blocked pore fraction with proportional conductivity decline ignores nonlinear connectivity.
quiz.explanation: 把阻斷孔隙比例直接當成水力傳導係數下降比例，會忽略孔喉連通性的非線性影響。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Equating blocked pore fraction with proportional conductivity decline ignores nonlinear connectivity. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 入滲衰減與觀測期間：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Declining infiltration and observation windows: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「入滲衰減與觀測期間」如何影響地下水人工補注設施的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Declining infiltration and observation windows” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Managed aquifer-recharge facilities”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 補注池入滲率常隨時間改變，可能同時反映土壤濕潤、池底沉積、氣體效應與地下水位隆起。把整段紀錄擬合成指數衰減，只是資料摘要，不代表每個因素都遵循相同機制。短期試驗若在最初高入滲率時就結束，可能高估持續供水能力；反之，單一低值也可能只是暫時水頭變化。教學上使用明列的經驗曲線計算累積水量，並要求將曲線參數與可獨立觀測的現象對照，而非把擬合參數直接命名為某種堵塞常數。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「入滲衰減與觀測期間」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Basin infiltration can vary with wetting, surface deposition, gas effects and groundwater mounding. An exponential fit summarizes observations but does not prove a shared physical mechanism. Ending a trial during initially high infiltration can overstate sustained capacity, while one low value may reflect temporary head conditions. Use a declared empirical curve to calculate cumulative volume and compare its parameters with independently observed processes rather than labeling a fitted coefficient as a definitive clogging constant. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Declining infiltration and observation windows” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For the hypothetical empirical curve f(t)=0.05+0.15 exp(−0.5t) m/day with t in days, four-day infiltration depth is 0.4594 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「指數曲線擬合良好，就足以證明入滲衰減只有一種已知堵塞機制。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A good exponential fit proves that infiltration decline has one uniquely identified clogging mechanism." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「入滲衰減與觀測期間」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Declining infiltration and observation windows”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 入滲衰減與觀測期間
knowledge.text: 補注池入滲率常隨時間改變，可能同時反映土壤濕潤、池底沉積、氣體效應與地下水位隆起。把整段紀錄擬合成指數衰減，只是資料摘要，不代表每個因素都遵循相同機制。
knowledge.textEn: Basin infiltration can vary with wetting, surface deposition, gas effects and groundwater mounding. An exponential fit summarizes observations but does not prove a shared physical mechanism.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：指數曲線擬合良好，就足以證明入滲衰減只有一種已知堵塞機制。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A good exponential fit proves that infiltration decline has one uniquely identified clogging mechanism. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「入滲衰減與觀測期間」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Declining infiltration and observation windows" is correct?
options: 補注池入滲率常隨時間改變，可能同時反映土壤濕潤、池底沉積、氣體效應與地下水位隆起。
指數曲線擬合良好，就足以證明入滲衰減只有一種已知堵塞機制。
混合後濃度降低，就表示污染物總質量一定已經被去除。
optionsEn: Basin infiltration can vary with wetting, surface deposition, gas effects and groundwater mounding.
A good exponential fit proves that infiltration decline has one uniquely identified clogging mechanism.
A lower concentration after mixing necessarily means pollutant mass has been removed.
quiz.explanation: 補注池入滲率常隨時間改變，可能同時反映土壤濕潤、池底沉積、氣體效應與地下水位隆起。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Basin infiltration can vary with wetting, surface deposition, gas effects and groundwater mounding. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.titleEn: Declining infiltration and observation windows: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「入滲衰減與觀測期間」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Declining infiltration and observation windows” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學經驗曲線f(t)=0.05+0.15e^(−0.5t) m/day，t以日計；四日累積入滲深度為0.05×4+0.15/0.5×(1−e^−2)=0.4594 m。固定池面面積1000 m²時，體積459.4 m³。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For the hypothetical empirical curve f(t)=0.05+0.15 exp(−0.5t) m/day with t in days, four-day infiltration depth is 0.4594 m. At constant basin area 1000 m², volume is 459.4 m³. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用細時間步長數值加總與解析積分互相核對，確認衰減係數單位為每日而非無量綱。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Cross-check numerical integration against the analytic integral and confirm inverse-day units for the decay coefficient.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: For the hypothetical empirical curve f(t)=0.05+0.15 exp(−0.5t) m/day with t in days, four-day infiltration depth is 0.4594 m. At constant basin area 1000 m², volume is 459.4 m³.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「入滲衰減與觀測期間」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Declining infiltration and observation windows", which statement holds?
options: 總抽回量占注入量百分之八十，就代表有百分之八十的注入水已符合所有使用條件。
教學經驗曲線f(t)=0.05+0.15e^(−0.5t) m/day，t以日計。
補注池水位下降的全部水量，都等於同一天已經抵達區域含水層的補注量。
optionsEn: Pumping eighty percent of injected volume proves eighty percent of injected water meets every use condition.
For the hypothetical empirical curve f(t)=0.05+0.15 exp(−0.5t) m/day with t in days, four-day infiltration depth is 0.4594 m.
Every basin-level loss equals aquifer recharge completed on the same day.
quiz.explanation: 教學經驗曲線f(t)=0.05+0.15e^(−0.5t) m/day，t以日計；四日累積入滲深度為0.05×4+0.15/0.5×(1−e^−2)=0.4594 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: For the hypothetical empirical curve f(t)=0.05+0.15 exp(−0.5t) m/day with t in days, four-day infiltration depth is 0.4594 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 入滲衰減與觀測期間：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Declining infiltration and observation windows: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「入滲衰減與觀測期間」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Declining infiltration and observation windows” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用細時間步長數值加總與解析積分互相核對，確認衰減係數單位為每日而非無量綱。把池水深、地下水位與供水中斷一起標在紀錄中，並保留未參與擬合的時段檢驗外推誤差，不能只看訓練資料的擬合優度。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Cross-check numerical integration against the analytic integral and confirm inverse-day units for the decay coefficient. Record basin depth, groundwater levels and supply interruptions, reserving an unused period to assess extrapolation rather than relying only on fit quality within the calibration window. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以一天為步長用左端點法估算四日入滲量，再縮短步長與解析值比較。將衰減係數減半，說明累積量如何改變，並指出要判斷這是材料變化還是水頭變化，還缺少哪些獨立觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Estimate four-day infiltration using daily left endpoints, refine the timestep and compare with the analytic result. Halve the decay coefficient, assess cumulative volume and identify additional observations needed to distinguish material changes from changing hydraulic head.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：將初始入滲率乘上整個運轉期間，會忽略後續衰減而高估體積。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Multiplying the initial rate by the full operating period overestimates volume when rates decline. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用細時間步長數值加總與解析積分互相核對，確認衰減係數單位為每日而非無量綱。把池水深、地下水位與供水中斷一起標在紀錄中，並保留未參與擬合的時段檢驗外推誤差，不能只看訓練資料的擬合優度。
knowledge.textEn: Cross-check numerical integration against the analytic integral and confirm inverse-day units for the decay coefficient. Record basin depth, groundwater levels and supply interruptions, reserving an unused period to assess extrapolation rather than relying only on fit quality within the calibration window.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以一天為步長用左端點法估算四日入滲量，再縮短步長與解析值比較。將衰減係數減半，說明累積量如何改變，並指出要判斷這是材料變化還是水頭變化，還缺少哪些獨立觀測。
knowledge.textEn: Estimate four-day infiltration using daily left endpoints, refine the timestep and compare with the analytic result. Halve the decay coefficient, assess cumulative volume and identify additional observations needed to distinguish material changes from changing hydraulic head.

quiz.question: 要驗證「入滲衰減與觀測期間」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Declining infiltration and observation windows"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
限制層只要很薄，就不可能控制整個地層剖面的垂直入滲通量。
用細時間步長數值加總與解析積分互相核對，確認衰減係數單位為每日而非無量綱。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
A thin restrictive layer can never control vertical flux through the full profile.
Cross-check numerical integration against the analytic integral and confirm inverse-day units for the decay coefficient.
quiz.explanation: 用細時間步長數值加總與解析積分互相核對，確認衰減係數單位為每日而非無量綱。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Cross-check numerical integration against the analytic integral and confirm inverse-day units for the decay coefficient. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 入滲衰減與觀測期間：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Declining infiltration and observation windows: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「入滲衰減與觀測期間」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Declining infiltration and observation windows” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 將初始入滲率乘上整個運轉期間，會忽略後續衰減而高估體積。把經驗曲線延伸到遠超過觀測期間，也可能誤把暫時趨勢當成長期穩定行為，產生缺乏證據的容量承諾。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Multiplying the initial rate by the full operating period overestimates volume when rates decline. Extrapolating far beyond observations can also mistake a temporary trend for stable long-term behavior, producing unsupported claims about sustained recharge capacity. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：教學上使用明列的經驗曲線計算累積水量，並要求將曲線參數與可獨立觀測的現象對照，而非把擬合參數直接命名為某種堵塞常數。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Use a declared empirical curve to calculate cumulative volume and compare its parameters with independently observed processes rather than labeling a fitted coefficient as a definitive clogging constant.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「指數曲線擬合良好，就足以證明入滲衰減只有一種已知堵塞機制。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A good exponential fit proves that infiltration decline has one uniquely identified clogging mechanism." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 將初始入滲率乘上整個運轉期間，會忽略後續衰減而高估體積。把經驗曲線延伸到遠超過觀測期間，也可能誤把暫時趨勢當成長期穩定行為，產生缺乏證據的容量承諾。
knowledge.textEn: Multiplying the initial rate by the full operating period overestimates volume when rates decline. Extrapolating far beyond observations can also mistake a temporary trend for stable long-term behavior, producing unsupported claims about sustained recharge capacity.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「入滲衰減與觀測期間」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Declining infiltration and observation windows" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 將初始入滲率乘上整個運轉期間，會忽略後續衰減而高估體積。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
混合後濃度降低，就表示污染物總質量一定已經被去除。
optionsEn: Multiplying the initial rate by the full operating period overestimates volume when rates decline.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
A lower concentration after mixing necessarily means pollutant mass has been removed.
quiz.explanation: 將初始入滲率乘上整個運轉期間，會忽略後續衰減而高估體積。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Multiplying the initial rate by the full operating period overestimates volume when rates decline. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「水質混合與質量負荷」與「熱訊號與水流示蹤」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Water-quality mixing and mass loading" and "Thermal signals and water-flow tracing": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 水質混合與質量負荷：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Water-quality mixing and mass loading: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「水質混合與質量負荷」如何影響地下水人工補注設施的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Water-quality mixing and mass loading” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Managed aquifer-recharge facilities”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 補注水的水質評估不能只看濃度變低，因為總污染物負荷取決於水量與濃度的乘積。兩股水混合的理想濃度可由質量守恆得到，但這並不代表反應性物質、病原體或微量污染物都能用同一公式判斷風險。地下地球化學還可能使原本存在的物質釋出，因此進水合格與含水層反應需要分別檢驗。課程只使用假想保守溶質說明混合與負荷，明確排除把稀釋計算當作水質處理或用途核准的替代方式。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「水質混合與質量負荷」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Quality assessment must distinguish concentration from mass load, which depends on both volume and concentration. Ideal mixing follows mass balance, but reactive substances, pathogens and trace contaminants do not share one universal risk relation. Aquifer geochemistry may mobilize pre-existing constituents, requiring separate evaluation of incoming water and subsurface response. The teaching example uses a hypothetical conservative solute to explain mixing and loading, explicitly separating dilution arithmetic from treatment performance and acceptance for any particular use. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Water-quality mixing and mass loading” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設保守溶質及體積可加，100 m³水濃度10 mg/L與200 m³水濃度40 mg/L混合；總質量9 kg，混合濃度30 mg/L。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Assume a conservative solute and additive volumes: 100 m³ at 10 mg/L mixes with 200 m³ at 40 mg/L.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「混合後濃度降低，就表示污染物總質量一定已經被去除。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A lower concentration after mixing necessarily means pollutant mass has been removed." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「水質混合與質量負荷」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Water-quality mixing and mass loading”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 水質混合與質量負荷
knowledge.text: 補注水的水質評估不能只看濃度變低，因為總污染物負荷取決於水量與濃度的乘積。兩股水混合的理想濃度可由質量守恆得到，但這並不代表反應性物質、病原體或微量污染物都能用同一公式判斷風險。
