knowledge.textEn: Quality assessment must distinguish concentration from mass load, which depends on both volume and concentration. Ideal mixing follows mass balance, but reactive substances, pathogens and trace contaminants do not share one universal risk relation.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：混合後濃度降低，就表示污染物總質量一定已經被去除。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A lower concentration after mixing necessarily means pollutant mass has been removed. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「水質混合與質量負荷」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Water-quality mixing and mass loading" is correct?
options: 混合後濃度降低，就表示污染物總質量一定已經被去除。
補注水的水質評估不能只看濃度變低，因為總污染物負荷取決於水量與濃度的乘積。
熱前緣一定與保守溶質以完全相同速度移動，不受土壤固體熱容量影響。
optionsEn: A lower concentration after mixing necessarily means pollutant mass has been removed.
Quality assessment must distinguish concentration from mass load, which depends on both volume and concentration.
Thermal fronts always move at conservative-solute speed, unaffected by solid heat capacity.
quiz.explanation: 補注水的水質評估不能只看濃度變低，因為總污染物負荷取決於水量與濃度的乘積。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Quality assessment must distinguish concentration from mass load, which depends on both volume and concentration. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 水質混合與質量負荷：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Water-quality mixing and mass loading: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「水質混合與質量負荷」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Water-quality mixing and mass loading” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設保守溶質及體積可加，100 m³水濃度10 mg/L與200 m³水濃度40 mg/L混合；總質量9 kg，混合濃度30 mg/L。此計算沒有去除任何溶質。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Assume a conservative solute and additive volumes: 100 m³ at 10 mg/L mixes with 200 m³ at 40 mg/L. Total mass is 9 kg and mixture concentration 30 mg/L; no solute is removed. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將每股水量先換成公升再計算質量，反代混合濃度檢查守恆。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Convert volumes consistently before calculating mass and back-check the mixed concentration.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設保守溶質及體積可加，100 m³水濃度10 mg/L與200 m³水濃度40 mg/L混合；總質量9 kg，混合濃度30 mg/L。此計算沒有去除任何溶質。
knowledge.textEn: Assume a conservative solute and additive volumes: 100 m³ at 10 mg/L mixes with 200 m³ at 40 mg/L. Total mass is 9 kg and mixture concentration 30 mg/L; no solute is removed.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「水質混合與質量負荷」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Water-quality mixing and mass loading", which statement holds?
options: 設備額定日容量乘以三百六十五，就一定等於每年實際完成的地下水補注量。
相同入滲水量在任何初始含水量下，都會產生完全相同的濕潤前緣深度。
教學假設保守溶質及體積可加，100 m³水濃度10 mg/L與200 m³水濃度40 mg/L混合；總質量9 kg，混合濃度30 mg/L。
optionsEn: Rated daily capacity multiplied by 365 always equals actual annual aquifer recharge.
Equal infiltrated volume produces the same wetting-front depth regardless of initial moisture.
Assume a conservative solute and additive volumes: 100 m³ at 10 mg/L mixes with 200 m³ at 40 mg/L.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設保守溶質及體積可加，100 m³水濃度10 mg/L與200 m³水濃度40 mg/L混合；總質量9 kg，混合濃度30 mg/L。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Assume a conservative solute and additive volumes: 100 m³ at 10 mg/L mixes with 200 m³ at 40 mg/L. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 水質混合與質量負荷：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Water-quality mixing and mass loading: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「水質混合與質量負荷」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Water-quality mixing and mass loading” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將每股水量先換成公升再計算質量，反代混合濃度檢查守恆。確認採樣與水量期間一致，並為反應性指標另列需要的化學與水文資料，不能因保守示蹤物符合混合式，就推論所有水質項目都受同樣控制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Convert volumes consistently before calculating mass and back-check the mixed concentration. Align sampling with volume intervals and identify additional chemical and hydrologic evidence for reactive constituents, avoiding the inference that agreement for one conservative tracer validates every other water-quality parameter. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：保持兩股水的濃度不變，將低濃度水量加倍，重算混合濃度與總質量。用兩張圖分別呈現濃度和負荷，說明為何兩者可往不同方向變化，並列出不能由這個保守混合模型回答的水質問題。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Double the lower-concentration volume while keeping both concentrations fixed, then recompute concentration and total load. Plot the two measures separately, explain why they may change differently, and identify quality questions that the conservative mixing model cannot answer.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：看到濃度降低就宣稱污染物已被去除，會混淆稀釋與處理。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Interpreting a lower concentration as removal confuses dilution with treatment. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將每股水量先換成公升再計算質量，反代混合濃度檢查守恆。確認採樣與水量期間一致，並為反應性指標另列需要的化學與水文資料，不能因保守示蹤物符合混合式，就推論所有水質項目都受同樣控制。
knowledge.textEn: Convert volumes consistently before calculating mass and back-check the mixed concentration. Align sampling with volume intervals and identify additional chemical and hydrologic evidence for reactive constituents, avoiding the inference that agreement for one conservative tracer validates every other water-quality parameter.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 保持兩股水的濃度不變，將低濃度水量加倍，重算混合濃度與總質量。用兩張圖分別呈現濃度和負荷，說明為何兩者可往不同方向變化，並列出不能由這個保守混合模型回答的水質問題。
knowledge.textEn: Double the lower-concentration volume while keeping both concentrations fixed, then recompute concentration and total load. Plot the two measures separately, explain why they may change differently, and identify quality questions that the conservative mixing model cannot answer.

quiz.question: 要驗證「水質混合與質量負荷」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Water-quality mixing and mass loading"?
options: 將每股水量先換成公升再計算質量，反代混合濃度檢查守恆。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
任何一口井測到的水位隆起，都可以直接代表整個補注區域的平均水位變化。
optionsEn: Convert volumes consistently before calculating mass and back-check the mixed concentration.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
The rise measured at any single well automatically represents the mean rise across the recharge area.
quiz.explanation: 將每股水量先換成公升再計算質量，反代混合濃度檢查守恆。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Convert volumes consistently before calculating mass and back-check the mixed concentration. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 水質混合與質量負荷：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Water-quality mixing and mass loading: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「水質混合與質量負荷」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Water-quality mixing and mass loading” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 看到濃度降低就宣稱污染物已被去除，會混淆稀釋與處理。若低濃度水量大幅增加，總質量仍可能上升；忽略地下反應則可能讓只檢查入口的監測方案漏掉後續變化。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Interpreting a lower concentration as removal confuses dilution with treatment. A larger volume can increase total load despite lower concentration, and ignoring subsurface reactions can leave an inlet-only monitoring program unable to detect subsequent changes. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：課程只使用假想保守溶質說明混合與負荷，明確排除把稀釋計算當作水質處理或用途核准的替代方式。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The teaching example uses a hypothetical conservative solute to explain mixing and loading, explicitly separating dilution arithmetic from treatment performance and acceptance for any particular use.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「混合後濃度降低，就表示污染物總質量一定已經被去除。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A lower concentration after mixing necessarily means pollutant mass has been removed." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 看到濃度降低就宣稱污染物已被去除，會混淆稀釋與處理。若低濃度水量大幅增加，總質量仍可能上升；忽略地下反應則可能讓只檢查入口的監測方案漏掉後續變化。
knowledge.textEn: Interpreting a lower concentration as removal confuses dilution with treatment. A larger volume can increase total load despite lower concentration, and ignoring subsurface reactions can leave an inlet-only monitoring program unable to detect subsequent changes.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「水質混合與質量負荷」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Water-quality mixing and mass loading" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
看到濃度降低就宣稱污染物已被去除，會混淆稀釋與處理。
熱前緣一定與保守溶質以完全相同速度移動，不受土壤固體熱容量影響。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Interpreting a lower concentration as removal confuses dilution with treatment.
Thermal fronts always move at conservative-solute speed, unaffected by solid heat capacity.
quiz.explanation: 看到濃度降低就宣稱污染物已被去除，會混淆稀釋與處理。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Interpreting a lower concentration as removal confuses dilution with treatment. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 熱訊號與水流示蹤：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Thermal signals and water-flow tracing: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「熱訊號與水流示蹤」如何影響地下水人工補注設施的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Thermal signals and water-flow tracing” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Managed aquifer-recharge facilities”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 補注水與原地下水溫度不同時，可以利用熱訊號協助辨識流動，但熱量同時由水攜帶並與固體骨架交換，也會因導熱擴散。熱前緣通常不能直接當成同速度移動的保守溶質前緣。簡化局部熱平衡模型以總體積熱容量比較水所攜帶的熱容量，得到熱傳輸相對水流的延遲因子；這仍忽略非均質、非平衡與邊界熱通量。監測時應與水位和其他示蹤物一起判讀，不因溫度先變或後變就單獨推定整批水的來源比例。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「熱訊號與水流示蹤」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Temperature contrasts can help trace recharge, but heat is advected by water, exchanged with solids and spread by conduction. A thermal front cannot simply be treated as a conservative-solute front moving at pore-water speed. A local-equilibrium approximation compares bulk heat capacity with the moving-water contribution to estimate thermal retardation, while omitting heterogeneity, nonequilibrium and boundary heat fluxes. Interpret temperature alongside heads and other tracers rather than inferring complete source-water proportions from the timing of temperature change alone. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Thermal signals and water-flow tracing” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For porosity 0.25 and water and solid volumetric heat capacities 4.18 and 2.0 MJ/(m³·K), local-equilibrium retardation is 2.435.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「熱前緣一定與保守溶質以完全相同速度移動，不受土壤固體熱容量影響。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Thermal fronts always move at conservative-solute speed, unaffected by solid heat capacity." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「熱訊號與水流示蹤」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Thermal signals and water-flow tracing”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 熱訊號與水流示蹤
knowledge.text: 補注水與原地下水溫度不同時，可以利用熱訊號協助辨識流動，但熱量同時由水攜帶並與固體骨架交換，也會因導熱擴散。熱前緣通常不能直接當成同速度移動的保守溶質前緣。
knowledge.textEn: Temperature contrasts can help trace recharge, but heat is advected by water, exchanged with solids and spread by conduction. A thermal front cannot simply be treated as a conservative-solute front moving at pore-water speed.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：熱前緣一定與保守溶質以完全相同速度移動，不受土壤固體熱容量影響。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Thermal fronts always move at conservative-solute speed, unaffected by solid heat capacity. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「熱訊號與水流示蹤」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Thermal signals and water-flow tracing" is correct?
options: 熱前緣一定與保守溶質以完全相同速度移動，不受土壤固體熱容量影響。
總抽回量占注入量百分之八十，就代表有百分之八十的注入水已符合所有使用條件。
補注水與原地下水溫度不同時，可以利用熱訊號協助辨識流動，但熱量同時由水攜帶並與固體骨架交換，也會因導熱擴散。
optionsEn: Thermal fronts always move at conservative-solute speed, unaffected by solid heat capacity.
Pumping eighty percent of injected volume proves eighty percent of injected water meets every use condition.
Temperature contrasts can help trace recharge, but heat is advected by water, exchanged with solids and spread by conduction.
quiz.explanation: 補注水與原地下水溫度不同時，可以利用熱訊號協助辨識流動，但熱量同時由水攜帶並與固體骨架交換，也會因導熱擴散。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Temperature contrasts can help trace recharge, but heat is advected by water, exchanged with solids and spread by conduction. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 熱訊號與水流示蹤：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Thermal signals and water-flow tracing: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「熱訊號與水流示蹤」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Thermal signals and water-flow tracing” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設孔隙率0.25、水與固體體積熱容量分別4.18與2.0 MJ/(m³·K)，局部熱平衡；R=[0.25×4.18+0.75×2.0]/(0.25×4.18)=2.435。孔隙水速0.20 m/day時，理想熱前緣速約0.0821 m/day。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For porosity 0.25 and water and solid volumetric heat capacities 4.18 and 2.0 MJ/(m³·K), local-equilibrium retardation is 2.435. Pore-water velocity 0.20 m/day gives ideal thermal-front velocity about 0.0821 m/day. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對熱容量是每單位水體、固體或總體積的定義，避免重複乘孔隙率。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check whether heat capacities refer to water, solid or bulk volume to avoid duplicate porosity factors.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設孔隙率0.25、水與固體體積熱容量分別4.18與2.0 MJ/(m³·K)，局部熱平衡；R=[0.25×4.18+0.75×2.0]/(0.25×4.18)=2.435。孔隙水速0.20 m/day時，理想熱前緣速約0.0821 m/day。
knowledge.textEn: For porosity 0.25 and water and solid volumetric heat capacities 4.18 and 2.0 MJ/(m³·K), local-equilibrium retardation is 2.435. Pore-water velocity 0.20 m/day gives ideal thermal-front velocity about 0.0821 m/day.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「熱訊號與水流示蹤」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Thermal signals and water-flow tracing", which statement holds?
options: 教學假設孔隙率0.25、水與固體體積熱容量分別4.18與2.0 MJ/(m³·K)，局部熱平衡。
補注池水位下降的全部水量，都等於同一天已經抵達區域含水層的補注量。
限制層只要很薄，就不可能控制整個地層剖面的垂直入滲通量。
optionsEn: For porosity 0.25 and water and solid volumetric heat capacities 4.18 and 2.0 MJ/(m³·K), local-equilibrium retardation is 2.435.
Every basin-level loss equals aquifer recharge completed on the same day.
A thin restrictive layer can never control vertical flux through the full profile.
quiz.explanationEn: For porosity 0.25 and water and solid volumetric heat capacities 4.18 and 2.0 MJ/(m³·K), local-equilibrium retardation is 2.435. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 熱訊號與水流示蹤：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Thermal signals and water-flow tracing: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「熱訊號與水流示蹤」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Thermal signals and water-flow tracing” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對熱容量是每單位水體、固體或總體積的定義，避免重複乘孔隙率。比較多深度溫度曲線與已知供水溫度，並檢查季節背景和導熱影響；以其他示蹤物確認水體來源，不能只用熱前緣時間反推出唯一流速。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check whether heat capacities refer to water, solid or bulk volume to avoid duplicate porosity factors. Compare depth-dependent temperatures with supply temperature and seasonal conductive effects, using additional tracers to constrain water origin rather than deriving a unique flow velocity solely from thermal arrival. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將固體熱容量加倍，保持孔隙率與水流速度不變，重算熱延遲因子。畫出水流與熱訊號的兩條時間線，再加入季節性邊界變化，說明哪些觀測有助於區分熱交換、傳導和真正的補注水到達。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Double solid heat capacity at fixed porosity and pore velocity and recalculate retardation. Draw separate water and thermal timelines, add a seasonal boundary variation, and explain which observations help distinguish heat exchange, conduction and arrival of recharge water.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把熱前緣延遲全部歸因於水流速度變慢，會忽略固體儲熱與導熱。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Assigning all thermal delay to slow water movement ignores solid heat storage and conduction. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 核對熱容量是每單位水體、固體或總體積的定義，避免重複乘孔隙率。比較多深度溫度曲線與已知供水溫度，並檢查季節背景和導熱影響；以其他示蹤物確認水體來源，不能只用熱前緣時間反推出唯一流速。
knowledge.textEn: Check whether heat capacities refer to water, solid or bulk volume to avoid duplicate porosity factors. Compare depth-dependent temperatures with supply temperature and seasonal conductive effects, using additional tracers to constrain water origin rather than deriving a unique flow velocity solely from thermal arrival.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將固體熱容量加倍，保持孔隙率與水流速度不變，重算熱延遲因子。畫出水流與熱訊號的兩條時間線，再加入季節性邊界變化，說明哪些觀測有助於區分熱交換、傳導和真正的補注水到達。
knowledge.textEn: Double solid heat capacity at fixed porosity and pore velocity and recalculate retardation. Draw separate water and thermal timelines, add a seasonal boundary variation, and explain which observations help distinguish heat exchange, conduction and arrival of recharge water.

quiz.question: 要驗證「熱訊號與水流示蹤」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Thermal signals and water-flow tracing"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
核對熱容量是每單位水體、固體或總體積的定義，避免重複乘孔隙率。
孔隙氣體占比降低多少，水力傳導係數就必定以完全相同的百分比提高。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Check whether heat capacities refer to water, solid or bulk volume to avoid duplicate porosity factors.
Reducing gas-filled pore fraction always increases conductivity by exactly the same percentage.
quiz.explanation: 核對熱容量是每單位水體、固體或總體積的定義，避免重複乘孔隙率。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check whether heat capacities refer to water, solid or bulk volume to avoid duplicate porosity factors. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 熱訊號與水流示蹤：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Thermal signals and water-flow tracing: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「熱訊號與水流示蹤」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Thermal signals and water-flow tracing” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把熱前緣延遲全部歸因於水流速度變慢，會忽略固體儲熱與導熱。若地表季節溫度本來就有相似週期，還可能把自然背景誤認為補注訊號，需要獨立的供水與監測紀錄。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Assigning all thermal delay to slow water movement ignores solid heat storage and conduction. Similar seasonal surface-temperature cycles can also imitate recharge signals, requiring independent supply and background observations before attributing the measured change. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：監測時應與水位和其他示蹤物一起判讀，不因溫度先變或後變就單獨推定整批水的來源比例。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Interpret temperature alongside heads and other tracers rather than inferring complete source-water proportions from the timing of temperature change alone.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「熱前緣一定與保守溶質以完全相同速度移動，不受土壤固體熱容量影響。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Thermal fronts always move at conservative-solute speed, unaffected by solid heat capacity." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把熱前緣延遲全部歸因於水流速度變慢，會忽略固體儲熱與導熱。若地表季節溫度本來就有相似週期，還可能把自然背景誤認為補注訊號，需要獨立的供水與監測紀錄。
knowledge.textEn: Assigning all thermal delay to slow water movement ignores solid heat storage and conduction. Similar seasonal surface-temperature cycles can also imitate recharge signals, requiring independent supply and background observations before attributing the measured change.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「熱訊號與水流示蹤」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Thermal signals and water-flow tracing" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
總抽回量占注入量百分之八十，就代表有百分之八十的注入水已符合所有使用條件。
把熱前緣延遲全部歸因於水流速度變慢，會忽略固體儲熱與導熱。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Pumping eighty percent of injected volume proves eighty percent of injected water meets every use condition.
Assigning all thermal delay to slow water movement ignores solid heat storage and conduction.
quiz.explanation: 把熱前緣延遲全部歸因於水流速度變慢，會忽略固體儲熱與導熱。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Assigning all thermal delay to slow water movement ignores solid heat storage and conduction. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「儲存回收效率與合格水量」與「停供期間、容量與長期水量帳」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Storage-recovery efficiency and acceptable volume" and "Supply interruptions, capacity and long-term accounting": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 儲存回收效率與合格水量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Storage-recovery efficiency and acceptable volume: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「儲存回收效率與合格水量」如何影響地下水人工補注設施的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Storage-recovery efficiency and acceptable volume” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Managed aquifer-recharge facilities”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 含水層儲存回收的效率必須明確定義回收水量的水質條件與觀測期間。抽出總量可能大於符合指定用途條件的水量，而其中也可能混入原地下水，因此單一比例不能同時代表水源回收率、抽水效率和水質效果。教學指標以符合預先定義條件的回收量除以注入量，並保留未回收、水質不符及背景混合等資訊。此課不設定真實水質門檻，而是要求在比較方案前先統一分子、分母和邊界，避免透過改換定義製造較高績效。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「儲存回收效率與合格水量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Aquifer storage-recovery efficiency requires an explicit quality condition and accounting period. Total pumped volume can exceed the portion meeting a predefined use condition and may include native groundwater, so one percentage cannot represent source-water recovery, pumping performance and quality simultaneously. The teaching metric divides acceptable recovered volume by injected volume while recording unrecovered storage and mixing separately. No real acceptance threshold is prescribed; comparisons require consistent numerators, denominators and boundaries rather than improved scores obtained by changing definitions. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Storage-recovery efficiency and acceptable volume” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設注入10000 m³，後續抽回8000 m³，其中6500 m³符合預先假設的教學條件；條件合格回收效率65%，總抽回量比80%，兩者不同，且都不直接識別水分子來源。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Assume injection of 10000 m³, pumping of 8000 m³ and 6500 m³ meeting a predefined hypothetical condition.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「總抽回量占注入量百分之八十，就代表有百分之八十的注入水已符合所有使用條件。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Pumping eighty percent of injected volume proves eighty percent of injected water meets every use condition." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「儲存回收效率與合格水量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Storage-recovery efficiency and acceptable volume”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 儲存回收效率與合格水量
knowledge.text: 含水層儲存回收的效率必須明確定義回收水量的水質條件與觀測期間。抽出總量可能大於符合指定用途條件的水量，而其中也可能混入原地下水，因此單一比例不能同時代表水源回收率、抽水效率和水質效果。
knowledge.textEn: Aquifer storage-recovery efficiency requires an explicit quality condition and accounting period. Total pumped volume can exceed the portion meeting a predefined use condition and may include native groundwater, so one percentage cannot represent source-water recovery, pumping performance and quality simultaneously.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：總抽回量占注入量百分之八十，就代表有百分之八十的注入水已符合所有使用條件。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Pumping eighty percent of injected volume proves eighty percent of injected water meets every use condition. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「儲存回收效率與合格水量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Storage-recovery efficiency and acceptable volume" is correct?
options: 含水層儲存回收的效率必須明確定義回收水量的水質條件與觀測期間。
總抽回量占注入量百分之八十，就代表有百分之八十的注入水已符合所有使用條件。
設備額定日容量乘以三百六十五，就一定等於每年實際完成的地下水補注量。
optionsEn: Aquifer storage-recovery efficiency requires an explicit quality condition and accounting period.
Pumping eighty percent of injected volume proves eighty percent of injected water meets every use condition.
Rated daily capacity multiplied by 365 always equals actual annual aquifer recharge.
quiz.explanation: 含水層儲存回收的效率必須明確定義回收水量的水質條件與觀測期間。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Aquifer storage-recovery efficiency requires an explicit quality condition and accounting period. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 儲存回收效率與合格水量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Storage-recovery efficiency and acceptable volume: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「儲存回收效率與合格水量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Storage-recovery efficiency and acceptable volume” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設注入10000 m³，後續抽回8000 m³，其中6500 m³符合預先假設的教學條件；條件合格回收效率65%，總抽回量比80%，兩者不同，且都不直接識別水分子來源。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Assume injection of 10000 m³, pumping of 8000 m³ and 6500 m³ meeting a predefined hypothetical condition. Acceptable recovery efficiency is 65%, versus a gross pumped-volume ratio of 80%; neither directly identifies molecular source. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將注入、抽回、符合條件與不符合條件的水量分欄，逐項核對期間和量測方法。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Tabulate injected, pumped, acceptable and unacceptable volumes with matching periods and measurement methods.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設注入10000 m³，後續抽回8000 m³，其中6500 m³符合預先假設的教學條件；條件合格回收效率65%，總抽回量比80%，兩者不同，且都不直接識別水分子來源。
knowledge.textEn: Assume injection of 10000 m³, pumping of 8000 m³ and 6500 m³ meeting a predefined hypothetical condition. Acceptable recovery efficiency is 65%, versus a gross pumped-volume ratio of 80%; neither directly identifies molecular source.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「儲存回收效率與合格水量」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Storage-recovery efficiency and acceptable volume", which statement holds?
options: 相同入滲水量在任何初始含水量下，都會產生完全相同的濕潤前緣深度。
教學假設注入10000 m³，後續抽回8000 m³，其中6500 m³符合預先假設的教學條件。
任何一口井測到的水位隆起，都可以直接代表整個補注區域的平均水位變化。
optionsEn: Equal infiltrated volume produces the same wetting-front depth regardless of initial moisture.
Assume injection of 10000 m³, pumping of 8000 m³ and 6500 m³ meeting a predefined hypothetical condition.
The rise measured at any single well automatically represents the mean rise across the recharge area.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設注入10000 m³，後續抽回8000 m³，其中6500 m³符合預先假設的教學條件；條件合格回收效率65%，總抽回量比80%，兩者不同，且都不直接識別水分子來源。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Assume injection of 10000 m³, pumping of 8000 m³ and 6500 m³ meeting a predefined hypothetical condition. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 儲存回收效率與合格水量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Storage-recovery efficiency and acceptable volume: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「儲存回收效率與合格水量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Storage-recovery efficiency and acceptable volume” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將注入、抽回、符合條件與不符合條件的水量分欄，逐項核對期間和量測方法。檢查比較情境是否使用相同教學條件及儲存時間，若要分辨原地下水比例，另需示蹤或混合分析，不以水量表本身宣稱完成來源辨識。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Tabulate injected, pumped, acceptable and unacceptable volumes with matching periods and measurement methods. Compare scenarios only under consistent hypothetical criteria and storage durations; determining native-water contribution additionally requires tracers or mixing analysis rather than source attribution from volume meters alone. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：保持注入與總抽回量不變，改變符合教學條件的水量並比較兩種指標。再加入原地下水混合情境，指出哪些結論只能由水量帳得到，哪些需要額外示蹤證據，最後寫出可供他人重現的指標定義。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Keep injection and gross pumping fixed while changing acceptable volume and compare both metrics. Add native-water mixing, distinguish conclusions supported by balances from those requiring tracers, and write a reproducible definition of each reported performance measure.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只報告總抽回量比，可能掩蓋部分水未符合預先設定條件。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Reporting only gross pumped volume can conceal water failing the predefined condition. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將注入、抽回、符合條件與不符合條件的水量分欄，逐項核對期間和量測方法。檢查比較情境是否使用相同教學條件及儲存時間，若要分辨原地下水比例，另需示蹤或混合分析，不以水量表本身宣稱完成來源辨識。
knowledge.textEn: Tabulate injected, pumped, acceptable and unacceptable volumes with matching periods and measurement methods. Compare scenarios only under consistent hypothetical criteria and storage durations; determining native-water contribution additionally requires tracers or mixing analysis rather than source attribution from volume meters alone.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 保持注入與總抽回量不變，改變符合教學條件的水量並比較兩種指標。再加入原地下水混合情境，指出哪些結論只能由水量帳得到，哪些需要額外示蹤證據，最後寫出可供他人重現的指標定義。
knowledge.textEn: Keep injection and gross pumping fixed while changing acceptable volume and compare both metrics. Add native-water mixing, distinguish conclusions supported by balances from those requiring tracers, and write a reproducible definition of each reported performance measure.

quiz.question: 要驗證「儲存回收效率與合格水量」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Storage-recovery efficiency and acceptable volume"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
指數曲線擬合良好，就足以證明入滲衰減只有一種已知堵塞機制。
將注入、抽回、符合條件與不符合條件的水量分欄，逐項核對期間和量測方法。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
A good exponential fit proves that infiltration decline has one uniquely identified clogging mechanism.
Tabulate injected, pumped, acceptable and unacceptable volumes with matching periods and measurement methods.
quiz.explanation: 將注入、抽回、符合條件與不符合條件的水量分欄，逐項核對期間和量測方法。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Tabulate injected, pumped, acceptable and unacceptable volumes with matching periods and measurement methods. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 儲存回收效率與合格水量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Storage-recovery efficiency and acceptable volume: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「儲存回收效率與合格水量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Storage-recovery efficiency and acceptable volume” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只報告總抽回量比，可能掩蓋部分水未符合預先設定條件。改變條件或延長抽水期間後直接與舊值比較，也可能造成績效似乎提升，實際卻只是統計邊界改變。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Reporting only gross pumped volume can conceal water failing the predefined condition. Changing criteria or extending the pumping period before comparison can create apparent improvement that actually results from different accounting boundaries rather than better storage performance. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：此課不設定真實水質門檻，而是要求在比較方案前先統一分子、分母和邊界，避免透過改換定義製造較高績效。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: No real acceptance threshold is prescribed; comparisons require consistent numerators, denominators and boundaries rather than improved scores obtained by changing definitions.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「總抽回量占注入量百分之八十，就代表有百分之八十的注入水已符合所有使用條件。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Pumping eighty percent of injected volume proves eighty percent of injected water meets every use condition." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只報告總抽回量比，可能掩蓋部分水未符合預先設定條件。改變條件或延長抽水期間後直接與舊值比較，也可能造成績效似乎提升，實際卻只是統計邊界改變。
knowledge.textEn: Reporting only gross pumped volume can conceal water failing the predefined condition. Changing criteria or extending the pumping period before comparison can create apparent improvement that actually results from different accounting boundaries rather than better storage performance.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「儲存回收效率與合格水量」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Storage-recovery efficiency and acceptable volume" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 只報告總抽回量比，可能掩蓋部分水未符合預先設定條件。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
設備額定日容量乘以三百六十五，就一定等於每年實際完成的地下水補注量。
optionsEn: Reporting only gross pumped volume can conceal water failing the predefined condition.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Rated daily capacity multiplied by 365 always equals actual annual aquifer recharge.
quiz.explanation: 只報告總抽回量比，可能掩蓋部分水未符合預先設定條件。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Reporting only gross pumped volume can conceal water failing the predefined condition. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 停供期間、容量與長期水量帳：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Supply interruptions, capacity and long-term accounting: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「停供期間、容量與長期水量帳」如何影響地下水人工補注設施的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Supply interruptions, capacity and long-term accounting” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Managed aquifer-recharge facilities”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 人工補注設施的年水量不只取決於瞬時入滲能力，也受水源可用時間、維護停運、池體輪替和下游含水層容納條件限制。把最大能力乘上一整年會隱含全年滿載且沒有任何限制，通常需要證據才能成立。簡單可用率模型可以拆開容量與運轉時間，但不同停運原因可能相互重疊，不能直接把比例相加扣除。課程以清楚的時間分類練習計算，並要求將入池量、入滲量和最終補注量保持獨立，避免同一個年度數字跨越不同邊界。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「停供期間、容量與長期水量帳」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Annual managed recharge depends on source-water availability, maintenance, basin rotation and aquifer acceptance as well as instantaneous infiltration capacity. Multiplying maximum capacity by a full year assumes continuous unrestricted operation. A simple availability model separates capacity from operating time, but overlapping outages cannot be subtracted twice. Use explicit time categories and maintain distinctions among basin delivery, infiltration and eventual aquifer recharge so one annual number is not silently transferred between different physical accounting boundaries. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Supply interruptions, capacity and long-term accounting” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設容量1000 m³/day，365日中水源可用300日，其中另有不重疊維護停運20日，運轉日均達容量80%；入池量1000×(300−20)×0.80=224000 m³/year，尚非地下水補注量。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Assume capacity 1000 m³/day, source availability on 300 days, 20 additional nonoverlapping maintenance days within them and operation at 80% capacity.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「設備額定日容量乘以三百六十五，就一定等於每年實際完成的地下水補注量。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Rated daily capacity multiplied by 365 always equals actual annual aquifer recharge." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「停供期間、容量與長期水量帳」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Supply interruptions, capacity and long-term accounting”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 停供期間、容量與長期水量帳
knowledge.titleEn: Supply interruptions, capacity and long-term accounting
knowledge.text: 人工補注設施的年水量不只取決於瞬時入滲能力，也受水源可用時間、維護停運、池體輪替和下游含水層容納條件限制。把最大能力乘上一整年會隱含全年滿載且沒有任何限制，通常需要證據才能成立。
knowledge.textEn: Annual managed recharge depends on source-water availability, maintenance, basin rotation and aquifer acceptance as well as instantaneous infiltration capacity. Multiplying maximum capacity by a full year assumes continuous unrestricted operation.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：設備額定日容量乘以三百六十五，就一定等於每年實際完成的地下水補注量。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Rated daily capacity multiplied by 365 always equals actual annual aquifer recharge. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「停供期間、容量與長期水量帳」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Supply interruptions, capacity and long-term accounting" is correct?
options: 設備額定日容量乘以三百六十五，就一定等於每年實際完成的地下水補注量。
人工補注設施的年水量不只取決於瞬時入滲能力，也受水源可用時間、維護停運、池體輪替和下游含水層容納條件限制。
補注池水位下降的全部水量，都等於同一天已經抵達區域含水層的補注量。
optionsEn: Rated daily capacity multiplied by 365 always equals actual annual aquifer recharge.
Annual managed recharge depends on source-water availability, maintenance, basin rotation and aquifer acceptance as well as instantaneous infiltration capacity.
Every basin-level loss equals aquifer recharge completed on the same day.
quiz.explanation: 人工補注設施的年水量不只取決於瞬時入滲能力，也受水源可用時間、維護停運、池體輪替和下游含水層容納條件限制。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Annual managed recharge depends on source-water availability, maintenance, basin rotation and aquifer acceptance as well as instantaneous infiltration capacity. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 停供期間、容量與長期水量帳：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Supply interruptions, capacity and long-term accounting: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「停供期間、容量與長期水量帳」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Supply interruptions, capacity and long-term accounting” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設容量1000 m³/day，365日中水源可用300日，其中另有不重疊維護停運20日，運轉日均達容量80%；入池量1000×(300−20)×0.80=224000 m³/year，尚非地下水補注量。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Assume capacity 1000 m³/day, source availability on 300 days, 20 additional nonoverlapping maintenance days within them and operation at 80% capacity. Annual basin delivery is 224000 m³, not yet aquifer recharge. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用日曆逐日分類水源缺乏、維護與可運轉時間，確認重疊停運只計一次。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Classify source outages, maintenance and available operation on a daily calendar, counting overlapping interruptions only once.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設容量1000 m³/day，365日中水源可用300日，其中另有不重疊維護停運20日，運轉日均達容量80%；入池量1000×(300−20)×0.80=224000 m³/year，尚非地下水補注量。
knowledge.textEn: Assume capacity 1000 m³/day, source availability on 300 days, 20 additional nonoverlapping maintenance days within them and operation at 80% capacity. Annual basin delivery is 224000 m³, not yet aquifer recharge.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「停供期間、容量與長期水量帳」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Supply interruptions, capacity and long-term accounting", which statement holds?
options: 限制層只要很薄，就不可能控制整個地層剖面的垂直入滲通量。
孔隙氣體占比降低多少，水力傳導係數就必定以完全相同的百分比提高。
教學假設容量1000 m³/day，365日中水源可用300日，其中另有不重疊維護停運20日，運轉日均達容量80%。
optionsEn: A thin restrictive layer can never control vertical flux through the full profile.
Reducing gas-filled pore fraction always increases conductivity by exactly the same percentage.
Assume capacity 1000 m³/day, source availability on 300 days, 20 additional nonoverlapping maintenance days within them and operation at 80% capacity.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設容量1000 m³/day，365日中水源可用300日，其中另有不重疊維護停運20日，運轉日均達容量80%；入池量1000×(300−20)×0.80=224000 m³/year，尚非地下水補注量。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Assume capacity 1000 m³/day, source availability on 300 days, 20 additional nonoverlapping maintenance days within them and operation at 80% capacity. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 停供期間、容量與長期水量帳：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Supply interruptions, capacity and long-term accounting: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「停供期間、容量與長期水量帳」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Supply interruptions, capacity and long-term accounting” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用日曆逐日分類水源缺乏、維護與可運轉時間，確認重疊停運只計一次。將實際每日流量加總與簡化可用率結果比較，再另核對池面損失及包氣帶儲存，不能把供水表總量直接填入最終含水層補注欄。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Classify source outages, maintenance and available operation on a daily calendar, counting overlapping interruptions only once. Compare summed daily flows with the availability approximation, then account separately for basin losses and vadose storage instead of copying delivery-meter totals into the aquifer-recharge column. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將十日維護安排改到原本無水源的日期，重算年度入池量並說明重疊時間的效果。再加入年底包氣帶存量增加，建立跨年度水量帳，區分設施利用率提升與含水層實際補注增加是否為同一件事。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Move ten maintenance days into existing source outages and recalculate annual delivery. Add increased year-end vadose storage, prepare a cross-year balance, and distinguish improved facility utilization from an actual increase in recharge reaching the aquifer during that year.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：將兩種重疊停運比例相加，會低估可運轉時間；用額定容量乘全年則可能高估入池量。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Adding overlapping outage fractions understates available time, while multiplying nameplate capacity by a full year can overstate delivery. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用日曆逐日分類水源缺乏、維護與可運轉時間，確認重疊停運只計一次。將實際每日流量加總與簡化可用率結果比較，再另核對池面損失及包氣帶儲存，不能把供水表總量直接填入最終含水層補注欄。
knowledge.textEn: Classify source outages, maintenance and available operation on a daily calendar, counting overlapping interruptions only once. Compare summed daily flows with the availability approximation, then account separately for basin losses and vadose storage instead of copying delivery-meter totals into the aquifer-recharge column.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將十日維護安排改到原本無水源的日期，重算年度入池量並說明重疊時間的效果。再加入年底包氣帶存量增加，建立跨年度水量帳，區分設施利用率提升與含水層實際補注增加是否為同一件事。
knowledge.textEn: Move ten maintenance days into existing source outages and recalculate annual delivery. Add increased year-end vadose storage, prepare a cross-year balance, and distinguish improved facility utilization from an actual increase in recharge reaching the aquifer during that year.

quiz.question: 要驗證「停供期間、容量與長期水量帳」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Supply interruptions, capacity and long-term accounting"?
options: 用日曆逐日分類水源缺乏、維護與可運轉時間，確認重疊停運只計一次。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
混合後濃度降低，就表示污染物總質量一定已經被去除。
optionsEn: Classify source outages, maintenance and available operation on a daily calendar, counting overlapping interruptions only once.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
A lower concentration after mixing necessarily means pollutant mass has been removed.
quiz.explanation: 用日曆逐日分類水源缺乏、維護與可運轉時間，確認重疊停運只計一次。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Classify source outages, maintenance and available operation on a daily calendar, counting overlapping interruptions only once. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 停供期間、容量與長期水量帳：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Supply interruptions, capacity and long-term accounting: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「停供期間、容量與長期水量帳」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Supply interruptions, capacity and long-term accounting” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 將兩種重疊停運比例相加，會低估可運轉時間；用額定容量乘全年則可能高估入池量。即使年度入池量計算正確，忽略儲存延遲仍可能把當年供水錯列成當年已完成補注。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Adding overlapping outage fractions understates available time, while multiplying nameplate capacity by a full year can overstate delivery. Even correct annual basin inflow can be misclassified as same-year recharge when subsurface storage delays are ignored. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：課程以清楚的時間分類練習計算，並要求將入池量、入滲量和最終補注量保持獨立，避免同一個年度數字跨越不同邊界。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Use explicit time categories and maintain distinctions among basin delivery, infiltration and eventual aquifer recharge so one annual number is not silently transferred between different physical accounting boundaries.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「設備額定日容量乘以三百六十五，就一定等於每年實際完成的地下水補注量。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Rated daily capacity multiplied by 365 always equals actual annual aquifer recharge." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 將兩種重疊停運比例相加，會低估可運轉時間；用額定容量乘全年則可能高估入池量。即使年度入池量計算正確，忽略儲存延遲仍可能把當年供水錯列成當年已完成補注。
knowledge.textEn: Adding overlapping outage fractions understates available time, while multiplying nameplate capacity by a full year can overstate delivery. Even correct annual basin inflow can be misclassified as same-year recharge when subsurface storage delays are ignored.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「停供期間、容量與長期水量帳」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Supply interruptions, capacity and long-term accounting" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
將兩種重疊停運比例相加，會低估可運轉時間；用額定容量乘全年則可能高估入池量。
補注池水位下降的全部水量，都等於同一天已經抵達區域含水層的補注量。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Adding overlapping outage fractions understates available time, while multiplying nameplate capacity by a full year can overstate delivery.
Every basin-level loss equals aquifer recharge completed on the same day.
quiz.explanation: 將兩種重疊停運比例相加，會低估可運轉時間；用額定容量乘全年則可能高估入池量。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Adding overlapping outage fractions understates available time, while multiplying nameplate capacity by a full year can overstate delivery. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 地下水屏障防止海水入侵
summary: 以洛杉磯與橘郡海水屏障為背景，逐步區分壓力防護、淡鹹水混合與物質旅行時間。十個原創單元從尖銳界面近似、等效淡水水頭和達西流，深入徑向注入、線性疊加、注入能力與潮汐反應，所有算例均明列理想條件，並用分層觀測檢查解釋是否成立。
summaryEn: Using Los Angeles and Orange County barriers as context, distinguish hydraulic protection, fresh-saline mixing and material travel time. Ten original units progress from ideal interfaces and equivalent heads through radial injection, superposition, injectivity and tidal response, stating model assumptions and checking interpretations against depth-resolved observations.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
subcategoryTitle: 海岸、港灣與水資源韌性

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 教學假設淡水與鹹水密度分別1000與1025 kg/m³，靜水尖銳界面模型將海面以上0.80 m水頭換算為海面以下32 m界面深度。這不是觀測到的鹽水前緣。另一個獨立算例把100 m路徑除以0.20 m/day孔隙速度，得到500日平流時間；同距離若水力擴散率100000 m²/day，特徵壓力尺度僅0.10日。兩者不能互換，快速水位反應不證明補注水已抵達。請改變密度差與儲水係數，分別重算各自影響的模型，並列出能否證實壓力、混合或水質改善的獨立觀測。
workedExample.textEn: Assume fresh and saline densities of 1000 and 1025 kg/m³. An ideal hydrostatic sharp interface converts 0.80 m freshwater elevation above sea level into 32 m interface depth below it; this is not an observed salt front. In a separate calculation, a 100 m path and 0.20 m/day pore velocity imply 500 days of advective travel. Hydraulic diffusivity of 100000 m²/day gives a characteristic pressure scale of only 0.10 day at the same distance. These quantities are not interchangeable, and rapid head response does not prove recharge-water arrival. Vary density contrast and storativity separately, then identify independent evidence for pressure, mixing and quality improvement.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「密度差與理想淡鹹水界面」與「等效淡水水頭與壓力基準」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Density contrast and an ideal fresh-saline interface" and "Equivalent freshwater head and pressure datum": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 密度差與理想淡鹹水界面：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Density contrast and an ideal fresh-saline interface: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「密度差與理想淡鹹水界面」如何影響地下水屏障防止海水入侵的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Density contrast and an ideal fresh-saline interface” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Groundwater barriers against seawater intrusion”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 淡地下水與海水密度不同，在理想靜水平衡下會形成淡水位高出海面的高度與界面深度之間的關係。這個尖銳界面模型把混合帶壓縮成一條線，並忽略地下水流動、分層和抽水引起的局部上升，因此適合理解密度效應，不能直接定位現地鹽水前緣。地下水屏障利用補注改變水頭與流向，不是一道實體不透水牆。實際評估需要同時觀察不同深度的壓力、鹽度和時間變化，不能只在單一水井量到高水位就認定所有含水層已受到保護。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「密度差與理想淡鹹水界面」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Fresh groundwater and seawater have different densities. Ideal hydrostatic equilibrium relates freshwater elevation above sea level to interface depth below it. The sharp-interface approximation compresses a mixing zone into a line and omits flow, layering and local pumping-induced upconing, making it useful for understanding density effects rather than locating a field salt front. Recharge barriers alter heads and flow paths rather than forming impermeable walls. Assess pressure, salinity and temporal behavior at multiple depths instead of inferring protection from one high well level. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Density contrast and an ideal fresh-saline interface” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設靜水、均質非受壓含水層及尖銳界面，淡水密度1000、鹹水1025 kg/m³，淡水位高出海面0.80 m；z=1000×0.80/(1025−1000)=32 m，為海面以下的理想界面深度。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Assume hydrostatic equilibrium, a homogeneous unconfined aquifer and sharp interface, with densities 1000 and 1025 kg/m³ and freshwater head 0.80 m above sea level.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「任何海岸含水層只要水位高出海面一公尺，實際鹽水界面就必定精確位於四十公尺深。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Every coastal aquifer with one metre of freshwater head has an actual interface exactly forty metres deep." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「密度差與理想淡鹹水界面」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Density contrast and an ideal fresh-saline interface”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 密度差與理想淡鹹水界面
knowledge.titleEn: Density contrast and an ideal fresh-saline interface
knowledge.text: 淡地下水與海水密度不同，在理想靜水平衡下會形成淡水位高出海面的高度與界面深度之間的關係。這個尖銳界面模型把混合帶壓縮成一條線，並忽略地下水流動、分層和抽水引起的局部上升，因此適合理解密度效應，不能直接定位現地鹽水前緣。
knowledge.textEn: Fresh groundwater and seawater have different densities. Ideal hydrostatic equilibrium relates freshwater elevation above sea level to interface depth below it.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：任何海岸含水層只要水位高出海面一公尺，實際鹽水界面就必定精確位於四十公尺深。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Every coastal aquifer with one metre of freshwater head has an actual interface exactly forty metres deep. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「密度差與理想淡鹹水界面」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Density contrast and an ideal fresh-saline interface" is correct?
options: 任何海岸含水層只要水位高出海面一公尺，實際鹽水界面就必定精確位於四十公尺深。
淡地下水與海水密度不同，在理想靜水平衡下會形成淡水位高出海面的高度與界面深度之間的關係。
只要兩口井的水面高程相同，不論井內水的密度如何，壓力狀態就完全相同。
optionsEn: Every coastal aquifer with one metre of freshwater head has an actual interface exactly forty metres deep.
Fresh groundwater and seawater have different densities.
Equal water-surface elevations imply identical pressure conditions regardless of fluid density.
quiz.explanation: 淡地下水與海水密度不同，在理想靜水平衡下會形成淡水位高出海面的高度與界面深度之間的關係。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Fresh groundwater and seawater have different densities. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 密度差與理想淡鹹水界面：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Density contrast and an ideal fresh-saline interface: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「密度差與理想淡鹹水界面」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Density contrast and an ideal fresh-saline interface” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設靜水、均質非受壓含水層及尖銳界面，淡水密度1000、鹹水1025 kg/m³，淡水位高出海面0.80 m；z=1000×0.80/(1025−1000)=32 m，為海面以下的理想界面深度。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Assume hydrostatic equilibrium, a homogeneous unconfined aquifer and sharp interface, with densities 1000 and 1025 kg/m³ and freshwater head 0.80 m above sea level. Interface depth below sea level is 32 m. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：先以相同海面基準畫出兩側壓力柱，確認界面兩側壓力相等，再檢查密度和深度單位。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Draw pressure columns using one sea-level datum and verify pressure continuity before checking density and depth units.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設靜水、均質非受壓含水層及尖銳界面，淡水密度1000、鹹水1025 kg/m³，淡水位高出海面0.80 m；z=1000×0.80/(1025−1000)=32 m，為海面以下的理想界面深度。
knowledge.textEn: Assume hydrostatic equilibrium, a homogeneous unconfined aquifer and sharp interface, with densities 1000 and 1025 kg/m³ and freshwater head 0.80 m above sea level. Interface depth below sea level is 32 m.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「密度差與理想淡鹹水界面」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Density contrast and an ideal fresh-saline interface", which statement holds?
options: 注入井內壓力升高多少，周圍所有觀測井的含水層水頭就必然同步升高多少。
只要樣本氯離子升高，就能單獨證明海水入侵，且不需要檢查其他來源。
教學假設靜水、均質非受壓含水層及尖銳界面，淡水密度1000、鹹水1025 kg/m³，淡水位高出海面0.80 m。
optionsEn: An injection-well pressure increase must appear unchanged at every surrounding observation well.
An increase in chloride alone proves seawater intrusion without checking any alternative source.
Assume hydrostatic equilibrium, a homogeneous unconfined aquifer and sharp interface, with densities 1000 and 1025 kg/m³ and freshwater head 0.80 m above sea level.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設靜水、均質非受壓含水層及尖銳界面，淡水密度1000、鹹水1025 kg/m³，淡水位高出海面0.80 m；z=1000×0.80/(1025−1000)=32 m，為海面以下的理想界面深度。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Assume hydrostatic equilibrium, a homogeneous unconfined aquifer and sharp interface, with densities 1000 and 1025 kg/m³ and freshwater head 0.80 m above sea level. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 密度差與理想淡鹹水界面：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Density contrast and an ideal fresh-saline interface: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「密度差與理想淡鹹水界面」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Density contrast and an ideal fresh-saline interface” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 先以相同海面基準畫出兩側壓力柱，確認界面兩側壓力相等，再檢查密度和深度單位。比較分層鹽度剖面時，記錄混合帶厚度及採樣深度，將理想界面與實測過渡區分開呈現，不把一條計算線包裝成精確地質邊界。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Draw pressure columns using one sea-level datum and verify pressure continuity before checking density and depth units. Compare depth-resolved salinity observations, recording mixing-zone thickness and sampling depth, and distinguish the ideal interface from the observed transition zone rather than presenting a calculated line as an exact geological boundary. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：保持淡水位不變，將鹹水密度改為1020 kg/m³並重算深度，再畫出有厚混合帶的剖面。說明哪個結果只是尖銳界面模型的預測，另列出需要補充的壓力與鹽度量測，避免把簡式直接當作場址設計。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Hold freshwater head fixed, change saline density to 1020 kg/m³ and recalculate depth. Sketch a finite mixing zone, identify what the sharp-interface approximation predicts, and list additional pressure and salinity observations needed before any site-specific interpretation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把四十倍比例當成任何海岸都固定成立的法則，會忽略密度、地層與流動的差異。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Treating a forty-to-one ratio as universal ignores density, stratigraphy and flow. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 先以相同海面基準畫出兩側壓力柱，確認界面兩側壓力相等，再檢查密度和深度單位。比較分層鹽度剖面時，記錄混合帶厚度及採樣深度，將理想界面與實測過渡區分開呈現，不把一條計算線包裝成精確地質邊界。
knowledge.textEn: Draw pressure columns using one sea-level datum and verify pressure continuity before checking density and depth units. Compare depth-resolved salinity observations, recording mixing-zone thickness and sampling depth, and distinguish the ideal interface from the observed transition zone rather than presenting a calculated line as an exact geological boundary.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 保持淡水位不變，將鹹水密度改為1020 kg/m³並重算深度，再畫出有厚混合帶的剖面。說明哪個結果只是尖銳界面模型的預測，另列出需要補充的壓力與鹽度量測，避免把簡式直接當作場址設計。
knowledge.textEn: Hold freshwater head fixed, change saline density to 1020 kg/m³ and recalculate depth. Sketch a finite mixing zone, identify what the sharp-interface approximation predicts, and list additional pressure and salinity observations needed before any site-specific interpretation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「密度差與理想淡鹹水界面」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Density contrast and an ideal fresh-saline interface"?
options: 先以相同海面基準畫出兩側壓力柱，確認界面兩側壓力相等，再檢查密度和深度單位。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
觀測井一出現水位上升，就表示新注入水已經抵達該井，無需其他示蹤資料。
optionsEn: Draw pressure columns using one sea-level datum and verify pressure continuity before checking density and depth units.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A water-level rise proves newly injected water has reached the well without any tracer evidence.
quiz.explanation: 先以相同海面基準畫出兩側壓力柱，確認界面兩側壓力相等，再檢查密度和深度單位。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Draw pressure columns using one sea-level datum and verify pressure continuity before checking density and depth units. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 密度差與理想淡鹹水界面：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Density contrast and an ideal fresh-saline interface: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「密度差與理想淡鹹水界面」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Density contrast and an ideal fresh-saline interface” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把四十倍比例當成任何海岸都固定成立的法則，會忽略密度、地層與流動的差異。抽水井附近可能出現局部鹽水上升，遠處水位看似足夠仍不能證明井口水質穩定。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Treating a forty-to-one ratio as universal ignores density, stratigraphy and flow. Local saltwater upconing near pumping wells may occur even when distant heads appear adequate, so a regional head measurement does not demonstrate stable production-water quality. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：實際評估需要同時觀察不同深度的壓力、鹽度和時間變化，不能只在單一水井量到高水位就認定所有含水層已受到保護。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Assess pressure, salinity and temporal behavior at multiple depths instead of inferring protection from one high well level.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「任何海岸含水層只要水位高出海面一公尺，實際鹽水界面就必定精確位於四十公尺深。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Every coastal aquifer with one metre of freshwater head has an actual interface exactly forty metres deep." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把四十倍比例當成任何海岸都固定成立的法則，會忽略密度、地層與流動的差異。抽水井附近可能出現局部鹽水上升，遠處水位看似足夠仍不能證明井口水質穩定。
knowledge.textEn: Treating a forty-to-one ratio as universal ignores density, stratigraphy and flow. Local saltwater upconing near pumping wells may occur even when distant heads appear adequate, so a regional head measurement does not demonstrate stable production-water quality.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「密度差與理想淡鹹水界面」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Density contrast and an ideal fresh-saline interface" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
把四十倍比例當成任何海岸都固定成立的法則，會忽略密度、地層與流動的差異。
只要兩口井的水面高程相同，不論井內水的密度如何，壓力狀態就完全相同。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Treating a forty-to-one ratio as universal ignores density, stratigraphy and flow.
Equal water-surface elevations imply identical pressure conditions regardless of fluid density.
quiz.explanation: 把四十倍比例當成任何海岸都固定成立的法則，會忽略密度、地層與流動的差異。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Treating a forty-to-one ratio as universal ignores density, stratigraphy and flow. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 等效淡水水頭與壓力基準：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Equivalent freshwater head and pressure datum: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「等效淡水水頭與壓力基準」如何影響地下水屏障防止海水入侵的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Equivalent freshwater head and pressure datum” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Groundwater barriers against seawater intrusion”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 井內水柱的密度會影響水位與壓力的換算，相同水面高程不一定表示相同的等效淡水水頭。使用壓力感測器時，必須清楚定義量測點高程、表壓或絕對壓以及參考密度，再把不同井的資料轉成一致表示方式。等效淡水水頭有助於比較壓力，但在密度隨位置改變時，不能把其梯度直接當成所有方向上的流速，尤其垂直方向還包含密度驅動項。海岸監測因此需要溫度和鹽度資料配合，讓壓力變化與密度變化能被分辨。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「等效淡水水頭與壓力基準」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Water-column density affects conversion between pressure and level, so equal surface elevations need not imply equal equivalent freshwater heads. Define sensor elevation, gauge versus absolute pressure and reference density before comparing wells. Equivalent freshwater head provides a common pressure representation, but with spatially variable density its gradient alone does not describe flow in every direction; vertical flow includes an additional density effect. Coastal monitoring therefore needs temperature and salinity observations to distinguish pressure changes from changes in fluid density. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Equivalent freshwater head and pressure datum” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學量測點高程z=−20 m，表壓p=201105 Pa，參考淡水密度1000 kg/m³；h_f=z+p/(1000×9.81)=0.50 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For sensor elevation −20 m and gauge pressure 201105 Pa, freshwater-equivalent head is −20+201105/(1000×9.81)=0.50 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要兩口井的水面高程相同，不論井內水的密度如何，壓力狀態就完全相同。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equal water-surface elevations imply identical pressure conditions regardless of fluid density." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「等效淡水水頭與壓力基準」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Equivalent freshwater head and pressure datum”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 等效淡水水頭與壓力基準
knowledge.titleEn: Equivalent freshwater head and pressure datum
knowledge.text: 井內水柱的密度會影響水位與壓力的換算，相同水面高程不一定表示相同的等效淡水水頭。使用壓力感測器時，必須清楚定義量測點高程、表壓或絕對壓以及參考密度，再把不同井的資料轉成一致表示方式。
knowledge.textEn: Water-column density affects conversion between pressure and level, so equal surface elevations need not imply equal equivalent freshwater heads. Define sensor elevation, gauge versus absolute pressure and reference density before comparing wells.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要兩口井的水面高程相同，不論井內水的密度如何，壓力狀態就完全相同。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Equal water-surface elevations imply identical pressure conditions regardless of fluid density. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「等效淡水水頭與壓力基準」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Equivalent freshwater head and pressure datum" is correct?
options: 只要兩口井的水面高程相同，不論井內水的密度如何，壓力狀態就完全相同。
達西通量與孔隙中的平均水流速度永遠相同，不需要知道有效孔隙率。
井內水柱的密度會影響水位與壓力的換算，相同水面高程不一定表示相同的等效淡水水頭。
optionsEn: Equal water-surface elevations imply identical pressure conditions regardless of fluid density.
Darcy flux always equals average pore-water velocity without any need for effective porosity.
Water-column density affects conversion between pressure and level, so equal surface elevations need not imply equal equivalent freshwater heads.
quiz.explanation: 井內水柱的密度會影響水位與壓力的換算，相同水面高程不一定表示相同的等效淡水水頭。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Water-column density affects conversion between pressure and level, so equal surface elevations need not imply equal equivalent freshwater heads. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 等效淡水水頭與壓力基準：定量估算
