steps.titleEn: Equivalent freshwater head and pressure datum: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「等效淡水水頭與壓力基準」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Equivalent freshwater head and pressure datum” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學量測點高程z=−20 m，表壓p=201105 Pa，參考淡水密度1000 kg/m³；h_f=z+p/(1000×9.81)=0.50 m。此壓力也等於密度1025 kg/m³、20 m鹹水柱的壓力。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For sensor elevation −20 m and gauge pressure 201105 Pa, freshwater-equivalent head is −20+201105/(1000×9.81)=0.50 m. The pressure also equals that of a 20 m saline column at 1025 kg/m³. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：為每支感測器列出高程基準、壓力類型與密度來源，先扣除適當大氣壓再進行換算。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record elevation datum, pressure type and density provenance for each instrument, applying the appropriate atmospheric correction.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學量測點高程z=−20 m，表壓p=201105 Pa，參考淡水密度1000 kg/m³；h_f=z+p/(1000×9.81)=0.50 m。此壓力也等於密度1025 kg/m³、20 m鹹水柱的壓力。
knowledge.textEn: For sensor elevation −20 m and gauge pressure 201105 Pa, freshwater-equivalent head is −20+201105/(1000×9.81)=0.50 m. The pressure also equals that of a 20 m saline column at 1025 kg/m³.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「等效淡水水頭與壓力基準」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Equivalent freshwater head and pressure datum", which statement holds?
options: 教學量測點高程z=−20 m，表壓p=201105 Pa，參考淡水密度1000 kg/m³；h_f=z+p/(1000×9.81)=0.50 m。
兩個注入源各自造成的絕對水頭可以直接相加，不必扣除重複的背景水頭。
注入能力下降一定只代表細砂堵塞，因此不必檢查區域水位、密度或儀器校正。
optionsEn: For sensor elevation −20 m and gauge pressure 201105 Pa, freshwater-equivalent head is −20+201105/(1000×9.81)=0.50 m.
Absolute heads from two injection sources can be added directly without removing duplicated background head.
Declining injectivity always means sand clogging, so regional head, density and calibration need no review.
quiz.explanation: 教學量測點高程z=−20 m，表壓p=201105 Pa，參考淡水密度1000 kg/m³；h_f=z+p/(1000×9.81)=0.50 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: For sensor elevation −20 m and gauge pressure 201105 Pa, freshwater-equivalent head is −20+201105/(1000×9.81)=0.50 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 等效淡水水頭與壓力基準：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Equivalent freshwater head and pressure datum: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「等效淡水水頭與壓力基準」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Equivalent freshwater head and pressure datum” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 為每支感測器列出高程基準、壓力類型與密度來源，先扣除適當大氣壓再進行換算。用同一支儀器的人工水位與鹽度紀錄交叉檢查，對密度未知的時段標示不確定度，不能把資料缺口當成淡水條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record elevation datum, pressure type and density provenance for each instrument, applying the appropriate atmospheric correction. Cross-check against manual levels and salinity records, and flag uncertainty when density is unknown rather than silently assuming freshwater throughout a missing-data interval. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：建立淡水與鹹水兩根相同高度的虛擬水柱，分別計算底部表壓與等效淡水水頭。再加入一個不同高程的感測點，說明為何比較之前必須統一基準、壓力類型與密度，而非只比較畫面上的水位數字。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Create equal-height virtual fresh and saline water columns and calculate bottom gauge pressure and equivalent freshwater head. Add a sensor at another elevation and explain why datum, pressure type and density must be reconciled before comparing displayed levels.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：將絕對壓直接當表壓，會加入一整個大氣壓的偏差；將不同鹽度井的水面高程直接相減，則可能把密度差誤認為補注形成的梯度。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using absolute pressure as gauge pressure adds an atmospheric offset. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 為每支感測器列出高程基準、壓力類型與密度來源，先扣除適當大氣壓再進行換算。用同一支儀器的人工水位與鹽度紀錄交叉檢查，對密度未知的時段標示不確定度，不能把資料缺口當成淡水條件。
knowledge.textEn: Record elevation datum, pressure type and density provenance for each instrument, applying the appropriate atmospheric correction. Cross-check against manual levels and salinity records, and flag uncertainty when density is unknown rather than silently assuming freshwater throughout a missing-data interval.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 建立淡水與鹹水兩根相同高度的虛擬水柱，分別計算底部表壓與等效淡水水頭。再加入一個不同高程的感測點，說明為何比較之前必須統一基準、壓力類型與密度，而非只比較畫面上的水位數字。
knowledge.textEn: Create equal-height virtual fresh and saline water columns and calculate bottom gauge pressure and equivalent freshwater head. Add a sensor at another elevation and explain why datum, pressure type and density must be reconciled before comparing displayed levels.

quiz.question: 要驗證「等效淡水水頭與壓力基準」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Equivalent freshwater head and pressure datum"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
為每支感測器列出高程基準、壓力類型與密度來源，先扣除適當大氣壓再進行換算。
只要總注入量足夠，每個含水層就一定會自動獲得相同流量與相同保護。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Record elevation datum, pressure type and density provenance for each instrument, applying the appropriate atmospheric correction.
Adequate total injection automatically gives every aquifer equal flow and equal protection.
quiz.explanation: 為每支感測器列出高程基準、壓力類型與密度來源，先扣除適當大氣壓再進行換算。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Record elevation datum, pressure type and density provenance for each instrument, applying the appropriate atmospheric correction. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 等效淡水水頭與壓力基準：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Equivalent freshwater head and pressure datum: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「等效淡水水頭與壓力基準」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Equivalent freshwater head and pressure datum” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 將絕對壓直接當表壓，會加入一整個大氣壓的偏差；將不同鹽度井的水面高程直接相減，則可能把密度差誤認為補注形成的梯度。兩種錯誤都可能改變對屏障成效的判斷。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using absolute pressure as gauge pressure adds an atmospheric offset. Directly subtracting levels from wells with different salinities can mistake density effects for recharge gradients; either error can distort conclusions about barrier performance. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：海岸監測因此需要溫度和鹽度資料配合，讓壓力變化與密度變化能被分辨。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Coastal monitoring therefore needs temperature and salinity observations to distinguish pressure changes from changes in fluid density.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要兩口井的水面高程相同，不論井內水的密度如何，壓力狀態就完全相同。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Equal water-surface elevations imply identical pressure conditions regardless of fluid density." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 將絕對壓直接當表壓，會加入一整個大氣壓的偏差；將不同鹽度井的水面高程直接相減，則可能把密度差誤認為補注形成的梯度。兩種錯誤都可能改變對屏障成效的判斷。
knowledge.textEn: Using absolute pressure as gauge pressure adds an atmospheric offset. Directly subtracting levels from wells with different salinities can mistake density effects for recharge gradients; either error can distort conclusions about barrier performance.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「等效淡水水頭與壓力基準」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Equivalent freshwater head and pressure datum" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
達西通量與孔隙中的平均水流速度永遠相同，不需要知道有效孔隙率。
將絕對壓直接當表壓，會加入一整個大氣壓的偏差；將不同鹽度井的水面高程直接相減，則可能把密度差誤認為補注形成的梯度。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Darcy flux always equals average pore-water velocity without any need for effective porosity.
Using absolute pressure as gauge pressure adds an atmospheric offset.
quiz.explanation: 將絕對壓直接當表壓，會加入一整個大氣壓的偏差；將不同鹽度井的水面高程直接相減，則可能把密度差誤認為補注形成的梯度。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using absolute pressure as gauge pressure adds an atmospheric offset. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 水力機制、材料與定量模型
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「達西通量與孔隙流速」與「理想徑向注入與水頭隆起」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Darcy flux and pore-water velocity" and "Ideal radial injection and head buildup": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 達西通量與孔隙流速：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Darcy flux and pore-water velocity: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「達西通量與孔隙流速」如何影響地下水屏障防止海水入侵的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Darcy flux and pore-water velocity” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Groundwater barriers against seawater intrusion”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 屏障改變水力梯度後，穿越含水層截面的流量可先用達西定律估算，但這個流量除以總截面積得到的是達西通量，不是水在孔隙中的平均前進速度。連通有效孔隙率決定可供流動的面積比例，使用總孔隙率或岩心小樣本值時都要注意代表性。此簡式假設單相、近似定密度、層流和可代表的水力傳導係數；若含水層有高導水通道，平均速度無法描述最快污染路徑。教學上應先分清流量、通量及速度，再討論旅行時間。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「達西通量與孔隙流速」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A changed hydraulic gradient can be translated into section flow using Darcy law, but discharge divided by total section area is Darcy flux rather than average pore-water velocity. Connected effective porosity determines the flowing fraction, and total porosity or a small core measurement may not represent it. The approximation assumes single-phase, approximately constant-density laminar flow and representative conductivity. Preferential pathways can move solute faster than the average, so distinguish discharge, flux and velocity before interpreting travel time. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Darcy flux and pore-water velocity” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設K=20 m/day、梯度i=0.002、截面積A=500 m²及有效孔隙率0.25；Q=KiA=20 m³/day，達西通量0.04 m/day，平均孔隙流速0.04/0.25=0.16 m/day。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Assume conductivity 20 m/day, gradient 0.002, section area 500 m² and effective porosity 0.25.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「達西通量與孔隙中的平均水流速度永遠相同，不需要知道有效孔隙率。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Darcy flux always equals average pore-water velocity without any need for effective porosity." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「達西通量與孔隙流速」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Darcy flux and pore-water velocity”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 達西通量與孔隙流速
knowledge.text: 屏障改變水力梯度後，穿越含水層截面的流量可先用達西定律估算，但這個流量除以總截面積得到的是達西通量，不是水在孔隙中的平均前進速度。連通有效孔隙率決定可供流動的面積比例，使用總孔隙率或岩心小樣本值時都要注意代表性。
knowledge.textEn: A changed hydraulic gradient can be translated into section flow using Darcy law, but discharge divided by total section area is Darcy flux rather than average pore-water velocity. Connected effective porosity determines the flowing fraction, and total porosity or a small core measurement may not represent it.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：達西通量與孔隙中的平均水流速度永遠相同，不需要知道有效孔隙率。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Darcy flux always equals average pore-water velocity without any need for effective porosity. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「達西通量與孔隙流速」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Darcy flux and pore-water velocity" is correct?
options: 屏障改變水力梯度後，穿越含水層截面的流量可先用達西定律估算，但這個流量除以總截面積得到的是達西通量，不是水在孔隙中的平均前進速度。
達西通量與孔隙中的平均水流速度永遠相同，不需要知道有效孔隙率。
注入井內壓力升高多少，周圍所有觀測井的含水層水頭就必然同步升高多少。
optionsEn: A changed hydraulic gradient can be translated into section flow using Darcy law, but discharge divided by total section area is Darcy flux rather than average pore-water velocity.
Darcy flux always equals average pore-water velocity without any need for effective porosity.
An injection-well pressure increase must appear unchanged at every surrounding observation well.
quiz.explanation: 屏障改變水力梯度後，穿越含水層截面的流量可先用達西定律估算，但這個流量除以總截面積得到的是達西通量，不是水在孔隙中的平均前進速度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A changed hydraulic gradient can be translated into section flow using Darcy law, but discharge divided by total section area is Darcy flux rather than average pore-water velocity. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 達西通量與孔隙流速：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Darcy flux and pore-water velocity: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「達西通量與孔隙流速」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Darcy flux and pore-water velocity” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設K=20 m/day、梯度i=0.002、截面積A=500 m²及有效孔隙率0.25；Q=KiA=20 m³/day，達西通量0.04 m/day，平均孔隙流速0.04/0.25=0.16 m/day。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Assume conductivity 20 m/day, gradient 0.002, section area 500 m² and effective porosity 0.25. Discharge is 20 m³/day, Darcy flux 0.04 m/day and average pore-water velocity 0.16 m/day. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：逐項標註量綱，檢查梯度是同基準水頭差除以距離，且截面方向與主要流向一致。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Label dimensions and confirm that gradient uses consistent head datums and distance, with area normal to flow.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設K=20 m/day、梯度i=0.002、截面積A=500 m²及有效孔隙率0.25；Q=KiA=20 m³/day，達西通量0.04 m/day，平均孔隙流速0.04/0.25=0.16 m/day。
knowledge.textEn: Assume conductivity 20 m/day, gradient 0.002, section area 500 m² and effective porosity 0.25. Discharge is 20 m³/day, Darcy flux 0.04 m/day and average pore-water velocity 0.16 m/day.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「達西通量與孔隙流速」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Darcy flux and pore-water velocity", which statement holds?
options: 只要樣本氯離子升高，就能單獨證明海水入侵，且不需要檢查其他來源。
教學假設K=20 m/day、梯度i=0.002、截面積A=500 m²及有效孔隙率0.25。
觀測井一出現水位上升，就表示新注入水已經抵達該井，無需其他示蹤資料。
optionsEn: An increase in chloride alone proves seawater intrusion without checking any alternative source.
Assume conductivity 20 m/day, gradient 0.002, section area 500 m² and effective porosity 0.25.
A water-level rise proves newly injected water has reached the well without any tracer evidence.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設K=20 m/day、梯度i=0.002、截面積A=500 m²及有效孔隙率0.25；Q=KiA=20 m³/day，達西通量0.04 m/day，平均孔隙流速0.04/0.25=0.16 m/day。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Assume conductivity 20 m/day, gradient 0.002, section area 500 m² and effective porosity 0.25. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 達西通量與孔隙流速：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Darcy flux and pore-water velocity: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「達西通量與孔隙流速」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Darcy flux and pore-water velocity” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 逐項標註量綱，檢查梯度是同基準水頭差除以距離，且截面方向與主要流向一致。以不同尺度的水力試驗和示蹤觀察比較有效參數，對只由單一岩心推估的速度另列限制，不把計算精度誤當現地參數精度。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Label dimensions and confirm that gradient uses consistent head datums and distance, with area normal to flow. Compare hydraulic tests and tracer observations across scales, documenting limitations of core-derived parameters rather than confusing numerical precision with confidence in field conductivity or effective porosity. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：保持流量與截面不變，將有效孔隙率從0.25改為0.20，重算平均速度。再畫出一條高導水狹窄通道，解釋為何相同總流量可能產生不同的到達時間分布，並列出可辨識這種差異的觀測方式。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Keep discharge and section fixed while lowering effective porosity from 0.25 to 0.20. Recalculate velocity, sketch a narrow preferential pathway and explain why equal total discharge can produce different arrival-time distributions and require additional observations.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把流量除以總面積得到的值直接當成孔隙速度，會低估理想平均前進速度。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Treating discharge per total area as pore velocity understates ideal average movement. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 逐項標註量綱，檢查梯度是同基準水頭差除以距離，且截面方向與主要流向一致。以不同尺度的水力試驗和示蹤觀察比較有效參數，對只由單一岩心推估的速度另列限制，不把計算精度誤當現地參數精度。
knowledge.textEn: Label dimensions and confirm that gradient uses consistent head datums and distance, with area normal to flow. Compare hydraulic tests and tracer observations across scales, documenting limitations of core-derived parameters rather than confusing numerical precision with confidence in field conductivity or effective porosity.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 保持流量與截面不變，將有效孔隙率從0.25改為0.20，重算平均速度。再畫出一條高導水狹窄通道，解釋為何相同總流量可能產生不同的到達時間分布，並列出可辨識這種差異的觀測方式。
knowledge.textEn: Keep discharge and section fixed while lowering effective porosity from 0.25 to 0.20. Recalculate velocity, sketch a narrow preferential pathway and explain why equal total discharge can produce different arrival-time distributions and require additional observations.

quiz.question: 要驗證「達西通量與孔隙流速」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Darcy flux and pore-water velocity"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
地下水壓力呈現潮汐週期，就表示海水前緣每個週期都移動到相同的觀測位置。
逐項標註量綱，檢查梯度是同基準水頭差除以距離，且截面方向與主要流向一致。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
A tidal pressure cycle proves that the seawater front reaches the observation location during every cycle.
Label dimensions and confirm that gradient uses consistent head datums and distance, with area normal to flow.
quiz.explanation: 逐項標註量綱，檢查梯度是同基準水頭差除以距離，且截面方向與主要流向一致。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Label dimensions and confirm that gradient uses consistent head datums and distance, with area normal to flow. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 達西通量與孔隙流速：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Darcy flux and pore-water velocity: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「達西通量與孔隙流速」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Darcy flux and pore-water velocity” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把流量除以總面積得到的值直接當成孔隙速度，會低估理想平均前進速度。相反地，把有效孔隙率用得過小也會高估速度；通道效應則可能使兩種平均估算都無法描述最早到達。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Treating discharge per total area as pore velocity understates ideal average movement. An unrealistically small effective porosity overstates it, while preferential pathways can make either average insufficient for predicting earliest arrival at a monitoring point. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：教學上應先分清流量、通量及速度，再討論旅行時間。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Preferential pathways can move solute faster than the average, so distinguish discharge, flux and velocity before interpreting travel time.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「達西通量與孔隙中的平均水流速度永遠相同，不需要知道有效孔隙率。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Darcy flux always equals average pore-water velocity without any need for effective porosity." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把流量除以總面積得到的值直接當成孔隙速度，會低估理想平均前進速度。相反地，把有效孔隙率用得過小也會高估速度；通道效應則可能使兩種平均估算都無法描述最早到達。
knowledge.textEn: Treating discharge per total area as pore velocity understates ideal average movement. An unrealistically small effective porosity overstates it, while preferential pathways can make either average insufficient for predicting earliest arrival at a monitoring point.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「達西通量與孔隙流速」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Darcy flux and pore-water velocity" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 把流量除以總面積得到的值直接當成孔隙速度，會低估理想平均前進速度。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
注入井內壓力升高多少，周圍所有觀測井的含水層水頭就必然同步升高多少。
optionsEn: Treating discharge per total area as pore velocity understates ideal average movement.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
An injection-well pressure increase must appear unchanged at every surrounding observation well.
quiz.explanation: 把流量除以總面積得到的值直接當成孔隙速度，會低估理想平均前進速度。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Treating discharge per total area as pore velocity understates ideal average movement. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 理想徑向注入與水頭隆起：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Ideal radial injection and head buildup: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「理想徑向注入與水頭隆起」如何影響地下水屏障防止海水入侵的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Ideal radial injection and head buildup” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Groundwater barriers against seawater intrusion”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 在均質受壓含水層中，定常注入的水頭增量可由徑向流動近似理解，離注入位置越近，理想增量通常越大。公式中的外邊界不是任意選來配合答案的半徑，而是明確設定的定水頭邊界。穿透不完全、井皮效應、分層與密度差都會使現地反應偏離簡式；注入井內的壓力也不等於遠處含水層的水頭。因此本課僅用理想模型理解參數敏感度，不推導現場注入壓力設定或以單一井的反應取代監測網。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「理想徑向注入與水頭隆起」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: In a homogeneous confined aquifer, steady radial flow explains how head buildup varies with distance from injection. The outer radius represents a specified constant-head boundary, not an arbitrary tuning distance. Partial penetration, well skin, layering and density contrast can invalidate the approximation, and pressure inside an injection well differs from aquifer head away from it. Use this ideal model for parameter sensitivity rather than prescribing operating pressure or substituting one well response for a distributed monitoring network. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Ideal radial injection and head buildup” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設完全穿透、定常徑向流、T=100 m²/day、Q=500 m³/day，外定水頭半徑R=200 m；在r=10 m處Δh=Q ln(R/r)/(2πT)=2.384 m，忽略井損與密度差。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Assume fully penetrating steady radial injection, transmissivity 100 m²/day and discharge 500 m³/day, with constant-head radius 200 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「注入井內壓力升高多少，周圍所有觀測井的含水層水頭就必然同步升高多少。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "An injection-well pressure increase must appear unchanged at every surrounding observation well." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「理想徑向注入與水頭隆起」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Ideal radial injection and head buildup”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 理想徑向注入與水頭隆起
knowledge.titleEn: Ideal radial injection and head buildup
knowledge.text: 在均質受壓含水層中，定常注入的水頭增量可由徑向流動近似理解，離注入位置越近，理想增量通常越大。公式中的外邊界不是任意選來配合答案的半徑，而是明確設定的定水頭邊界。
knowledge.textEn: In a homogeneous confined aquifer, steady radial flow explains how head buildup varies with distance from injection. The outer radius represents a specified constant-head boundary, not an arbitrary tuning distance.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：注入井內壓力升高多少，周圍所有觀測井的含水層水頭就必然同步升高多少。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: An injection-well pressure increase must appear unchanged at every surrounding observation well. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「理想徑向注入與水頭隆起」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Ideal radial injection and head buildup" is correct?
options: 注入井內壓力升高多少，周圍所有觀測井的含水層水頭就必然同步升高多少。
在均質受壓含水層中，定常注入的水頭增量可由徑向流動近似理解，離注入位置越近，理想增量通常越大。
兩個注入源各自造成的絕對水頭可以直接相加，不必扣除重複的背景水頭。
optionsEn: An injection-well pressure increase must appear unchanged at every surrounding observation well.
In a homogeneous confined aquifer, steady radial flow explains how head buildup varies with distance from injection.
Absolute heads from two injection sources can be added directly without removing duplicated background head.
quiz.explanation: 在均質受壓含水層中，定常注入的水頭增量可由徑向流動近似理解，離注入位置越近，理想增量通常越大。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: In a homogeneous confined aquifer, steady radial flow explains how head buildup varies with distance from injection. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 理想徑向注入與水頭隆起：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Ideal radial injection and head buildup: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「理想徑向注入與水頭隆起」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Ideal radial injection and head buildup” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設完全穿透、定常徑向流、T=100 m²/day、Q=500 m³/day，外定水頭半徑R=200 m；在r=10 m處Δh=Q ln(R/r)/(2πT)=2.384 m，忽略井損與密度差。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Assume fully penetrating steady radial injection, transmissivity 100 m²/day and discharge 500 m³/day, with constant-head radius 200 m. At radius 10 m, buildup is 500 ln(20)/(2π×100)=2.384 m, excluding well losses and density effects. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：先在圖上標出外邊界和計算點，確認使用自然對數且半徑比無量綱。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Mark the outer boundary and evaluation point, checking natural logarithms and a dimensionless radius ratio.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設完全穿透、定常徑向流、T=100 m²/day、Q=500 m³/day，外定水頭半徑R=200 m；在r=10 m處Δh=Q ln(R/r)/(2πT)=2.384 m，忽略井損與密度差。
knowledge.textEn: Assume fully penetrating steady radial injection, transmissivity 100 m²/day and discharge 500 m³/day, with constant-head radius 200 m. At radius 10 m, buildup is 500 ln(20)/(2π×100)=2.384 m, excluding well losses and density effects.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「理想徑向注入與水頭隆起」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Ideal radial injection and head buildup", which statement holds?
options: 注入能力下降一定只代表細砂堵塞，因此不必檢查區域水位、密度或儀器校正。
只要總注入量足夠，每個含水層就一定會自動獲得相同流量與相同保護。
教學假設完全穿透、定常徑向流、T=100 m²/day、Q=500 m³/day，外定水頭半徑R=200 m。
optionsEn: Declining injectivity always means sand clogging, so regional head, density and calibration need no review.
Adequate total injection automatically gives every aquifer equal flow and equal protection.
Assume fully penetrating steady radial injection, transmissivity 100 m²/day and discharge 500 m³/day, with constant-head radius 200 m.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設完全穿透、定常徑向流、T=100 m²/day、Q=500 m³/day，外定水頭半徑R=200 m；在r=10 m處Δh=Q ln(R/r)/(2πT)=2.384 m，忽略井損與密度差。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Assume fully penetrating steady radial injection, transmissivity 100 m²/day and discharge 500 m³/day, with constant-head radius 200 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 理想徑向注入與水頭隆起：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Ideal radial injection and head buildup: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「理想徑向注入與水頭隆起」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Ideal radial injection and head buildup” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 先在圖上標出外邊界和計算點，確認使用自然對數且半徑比無量綱。將不同距離的增量畫成對數距離圖，再與觀測井而非注入井內壓力比較，若斜率或邊界反應不符，應重新檢查含水層與時間假設。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Mark the outer boundary and evaluation point, checking natural logarithms and a dimensionless radius ratio. Plot buildup against logarithmic distance and compare observation-well responses, not just injection-well pressure, revisiting aquifer and steady-state assumptions when the slope or boundary response differs. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將傳導係數加倍而保持注入量及邊界不變，重算水頭增量並畫出兩條理想剖面。接著加入一個只影響井內的假設井損，說明為何井壓上升不一定代表遠處屏障變強，並指出需要比較的量測位置。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Double transmissivity while keeping injection and boundaries fixed, then compare ideal profiles. Add a hypothetical loss affecting only the injection well and explain why rising well pressure need not strengthen the distant barrier, identifying the observation locations required to distinguish both effects.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：忽略井損而把注入井壓力全算成含水層水頭，會高估屏障向外延伸的效果。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Assigning all injection-well pressure to aquifer buildup overstates the barrier effect away from the well. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 先在圖上標出外邊界和計算點，確認使用自然對數且半徑比無量綱。將不同距離的增量畫成對數距離圖，再與觀測井而非注入井內壓力比較，若斜率或邊界反應不符，應重新檢查含水層與時間假設。
knowledge.textEn: Mark the outer boundary and evaluation point, checking natural logarithms and a dimensionless radius ratio. Plot buildup against logarithmic distance and compare observation-well responses, not just injection-well pressure, revisiting aquifer and steady-state assumptions when the slope or boundary response differs.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將傳導係數加倍而保持注入量及邊界不變，重算水頭增量並畫出兩條理想剖面。接著加入一個只影響井內的假設井損，說明為何井壓上升不一定代表遠處屏障變強，並指出需要比較的量測位置。
knowledge.textEn: Double transmissivity while keeping injection and boundaries fixed, then compare ideal profiles. Add a hypothetical loss affecting only the injection well and explain why rising well pressure need not strengthen the distant barrier, identifying the observation locations required to distinguish both effects.

quiz.question: 要驗證「理想徑向注入與水頭隆起」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Ideal radial injection and head buildup"?
options: 先在圖上標出外邊界和計算點，確認使用自然對數且半徑比無量綱。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
任何海岸含水層只要水位高出海面一公尺，實際鹽水界面就必定精確位於四十公尺深。
optionsEn: Mark the outer boundary and evaluation point, checking natural logarithms and a dimensionless radius ratio.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Every coastal aquifer with one metre of freshwater head has an actual interface exactly forty metres deep.
quiz.explanation: 先在圖上標出外邊界和計算點，確認使用自然對數且半徑比無量綱。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Mark the outer boundary and evaluation point, checking natural logarithms and a dimensionless radius ratio. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 理想徑向注入與水頭隆起：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Ideal radial injection and head buildup: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「理想徑向注入與水頭隆起」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Ideal radial injection and head buildup” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 忽略井損而把注入井壓力全算成含水層水頭，會高估屏障向外延伸的效果。尚未達定常時套用固定外邊界，也可能把時間造成的差異錯誤解讀成傳導係數改變。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Assigning all injection-well pressure to aquifer buildup overstates the barrier effect away from the well. Applying a fixed steady boundary before stabilization can likewise mistake time-dependent behavior for a change in aquifer transmissivity. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：因此本課僅用理想模型理解參數敏感度，不推導現場注入壓力設定或以單一井的反應取代監測網。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Use this ideal model for parameter sensitivity rather than prescribing operating pressure or substituting one well response for a distributed monitoring network.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「注入井內壓力升高多少，周圍所有觀測井的含水層水頭就必然同步升高多少。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "An injection-well pressure increase must appear unchanged at every surrounding observation well." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 忽略井損而把注入井壓力全算成含水層水頭，會高估屏障向外延伸的效果。尚未達定常時套用固定外邊界，也可能把時間造成的差異錯誤解讀成傳導係數改變。
knowledge.textEn: Assigning all injection-well pressure to aquifer buildup overstates the barrier effect away from the well. Applying a fixed steady boundary before stabilization can likewise mistake time-dependent behavior for a change in aquifer transmissivity.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「理想徑向注入與水頭隆起」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Ideal radial injection and head buildup" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
忽略井損而把注入井壓力全算成含水層水頭，會高估屏障向外延伸的效果。
兩個注入源各自造成的絕對水頭可以直接相加，不必扣除重複的背景水頭。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Assigning all injection-well pressure to aquifer buildup overstates the barrier effect away from the well.
Absolute heads from two injection sources can be added directly without removing duplicated background head.
quiz.explanation: 忽略井損而把注入井壓力全算成含水層水頭，會高估屏障向外延伸的效果。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Assigning all injection-well pressure to aquifer buildup overstates the barrier effect away from the well. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「線性疊加與井間薄弱區」與「保守離子與兩端元混合」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Linear superposition and gaps between wells" and "Conservative ions and two-endmember mixing": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 線性疊加與井間薄弱區：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Linear superposition and gaps between wells: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「線性疊加與井間薄弱區」如何影響地下水屏障防止海水入侵的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Linear superposition and gaps between wells” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Groundwater barriers against seawater intrusion”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 在參數固定且控制方程線性的模型中，各注入源造成的水頭增量可以相加，但疊加的是同一基準下的增量，不是絕對水頭重複相加。井間位置可能比井邊的水頭低，因此屏障是否連續需要沿線剖面和深度分層來判讀。若飽和厚度顯著改變、密度耦合或井損非線性，簡單疊加便可能不適用。教學上應把背景水頭、各源增量與總水頭分開，讓學徒看出局部高值不能取代整條防護線的證據。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「線性疊加與井間薄弱區」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: When parameters are fixed and governing equations are linear, head increments from individual sources may be added. Add increments on one datum rather than repeatedly adding absolute heads. Interwell locations can have lower heads than locations near wells, so barrier continuity requires along-line and depth-resolved assessment. Changing saturated thickness, density coupling or nonlinear well losses may invalidate simple superposition. Separate background head, source increments and total head to show why a local maximum cannot establish protection along the entire barrier. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Linear superposition and gaps between wells” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設同一受壓線性模型、相同外邊界及固定參數，某點由兩注入源各產生1.5 m與1.0 m增量；合成增量2.5 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For one linear confined model with fixed properties and common boundaries, two sources add 1.5 and 1.0 m at a point.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兩個注入源各自造成的絕對水頭可以直接相加，不必扣除重複的背景水頭。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Absolute heads from two injection sources can be added directly without removing duplicated background head." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「線性疊加與井間薄弱區」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Linear superposition and gaps between wells”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 線性疊加與井間薄弱區
knowledge.titleEn: Linear superposition and gaps between wells
knowledge.text: 在參數固定且控制方程線性的模型中，各注入源造成的水頭增量可以相加，但疊加的是同一基準下的增量，不是絕對水頭重複相加。井間位置可能比井邊的水頭低，因此屏障是否連續需要沿線剖面和深度分層來判讀。
knowledge.textEn: When parameters are fixed and governing equations are linear, head increments from individual sources may be added. Add increments on one datum rather than repeatedly adding absolute heads.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：兩個注入源各自造成的絕對水頭可以直接相加，不必扣除重複的背景水頭。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Absolute heads from two injection sources can be added directly without removing duplicated background head. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「線性疊加與井間薄弱區」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Linear superposition and gaps between wells" is correct?
options: 兩個注入源各自造成的絕對水頭可以直接相加，不必扣除重複的背景水頭。
只要樣本氯離子升高，就能單獨證明海水入侵，且不需要檢查其他來源。
在參數固定且控制方程線性的模型中，各注入源造成的水頭增量可以相加，但疊加的是同一基準下的增量，不是絕對水頭重複相加。
optionsEn: Absolute heads from two injection sources can be added directly without removing duplicated background head.
An increase in chloride alone proves seawater intrusion without checking any alternative source.
When parameters are fixed and governing equations are linear, head increments from individual sources may be added.
quiz.explanation: 在參數固定且控制方程線性的模型中，各注入源造成的水頭增量可以相加，但疊加的是同一基準下的增量，不是絕對水頭重複相加。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: When parameters are fixed and governing equations are linear, head increments from individual sources may be added. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 線性疊加與井間薄弱區：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Linear superposition and gaps between wells: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「線性疊加與井間薄弱區」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Linear superposition and gaps between wells” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設同一受壓線性模型、相同外邊界及固定參數，某點由兩注入源各產生1.5 m與1.0 m增量；合成增量2.5 m。背景水頭0.4 m時，總水頭2.9 m，而非把背景算兩次。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For one linear confined model with fixed properties and common boundaries, two sources add 1.5 and 1.0 m at a point. Total buildup is 2.5 m; adding background head 0.4 m once gives total head 2.9 m. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用單源與雙源模型在相同網格上比較水頭增量，檢查差值是否符合線性疊加。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare single-source and combined increments on the same grid to test linearity.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設同一受壓線性模型、相同外邊界及固定參數，某點由兩注入源各產生1.5 m與1.0 m增量；合成增量2.5 m。背景水頭0.4 m時，總水頭2.9 m，而非把背景算兩次。
knowledge.textEn: For one linear confined model with fixed properties and common boundaries, two sources add 1.5 and 1.0 m at a point. Total buildup is 2.5 m; adding background head 0.4 m once gives total head 2.9 m.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「線性疊加與井間薄弱區」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Linear superposition and gaps between wells", which statement holds?
options: 教學假設同一受壓線性模型、相同外邊界及固定參數，某點由兩注入源各產生1.5 m與1.0 m增量；合成增量2.5 m。
觀測井一出現水位上升，就表示新注入水已經抵達該井，無需其他示蹤資料。
地下水壓力呈現潮汐週期，就表示海水前緣每個週期都移動到相同的觀測位置。
optionsEn: For one linear confined model with fixed properties and common boundaries, two sources add 1.5 and 1.0 m at a point.
A water-level rise proves newly injected water has reached the well without any tracer evidence.
A tidal pressure cycle proves that the seawater front reaches the observation location during every cycle.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設同一受壓線性模型、相同外邊界及固定參數，某點由兩注入源各產生1.5 m與1.0 m增量；合成增量2.5 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: For one linear confined model with fixed properties and common boundaries, two sources add 1.5 and 1.0 m at a point. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 線性疊加與井間薄弱區：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Linear superposition and gaps between wells: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「線性疊加與井間薄弱區」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Linear superposition and gaps between wells” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用單源與雙源模型在相同網格上比較水頭增量，檢查差值是否符合線性疊加。沿井間中線及不同深度列出最低值，並核對背景水頭是否只加入一次；對參數隨水頭改變的模型，另做完整聯合運算而非強行相加。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare single-source and combined increments on the same grid to test linearity. Examine interwell minima at multiple depths and verify that background head is added only once. When properties vary with head, use a combined calculation rather than forcing a linear sum onto a nonlinear system. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：建立五個沿線節點，分別給定兩源增量和同一背景水頭，算出總水頭並找最小值。將其中一源的流量降低一半，在線性假設下重算，再說明若含水層厚度同時改變，為何需要重新檢驗疊加條件。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Create five along-line nodes with increments from two sources and one background head. Find the minimum total head, halve one source under linear assumptions, and explain why a simultaneous change in saturated thickness requires checking the superposition assumptions again.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只查看每口注入井旁的高水頭，可能漏掉井間或較深層的薄弱位置。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Checking only high heads beside injection wells can miss weaker interwell or deeper locations. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用單源與雙源模型在相同網格上比較水頭增量，檢查差值是否符合線性疊加。沿井間中線及不同深度列出最低值，並核對背景水頭是否只加入一次；對參數隨水頭改變的模型，另做完整聯合運算而非強行相加。
knowledge.textEn: Compare single-source and combined increments on the same grid to test linearity. Examine interwell minima at multiple depths and verify that background head is added only once. When properties vary with head, use a combined calculation rather than forcing a linear sum onto a nonlinear system.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 建立五個沿線節點，分別給定兩源增量和同一背景水頭，算出總水頭並找最小值。將其中一源的流量降低一半，在線性假設下重算，再說明若含水層厚度同時改變，為何需要重新檢驗疊加條件。
knowledge.textEn: Create five along-line nodes with increments from two sources and one background head. Find the minimum total head, halve one source under linear assumptions, and explain why a simultaneous change in saturated thickness requires checking the superposition assumptions again.

quiz.question: 要驗證「線性疊加與井間薄弱區」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Linear superposition and gaps between wells"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
用單源與雙源模型在相同網格上比較水頭增量，檢查差值是否符合線性疊加。
只要兩口井的水面高程相同，不論井內水的密度如何，壓力狀態就完全相同。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Compare single-source and combined increments on the same grid to test linearity.
Equal water-surface elevations imply identical pressure conditions regardless of fluid density.
quiz.explanation: 用單源與雙源模型在相同網格上比較水頭增量，檢查差值是否符合線性疊加。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare single-source and combined increments on the same grid to test linearity. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 線性疊加與井間薄弱區：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Linear superposition and gaps between wells: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「線性疊加與井間薄弱區」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Linear superposition and gaps between wells” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只查看每口注入井旁的高水頭，可能漏掉井間或較深層的薄弱位置。將絕對水頭相加又會重複背景值，造成整條屏障似乎比實際更高，進一步掩蓋監測配置不足。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Checking only high heads beside injection wells can miss weaker interwell or deeper locations. Adding absolute heads double-counts the background and exaggerates apparent protection, potentially concealing the need for a better distributed monitoring network. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：教學上應把背景水頭、各源增量與總水頭分開，讓學徒看出局部高值不能取代整條防護線的證據。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Separate background head, source increments and total head to show why a local maximum cannot establish protection along the entire barrier.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「兩個注入源各自造成的絕對水頭可以直接相加，不必扣除重複的背景水頭。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Absolute heads from two injection sources can be added directly without removing duplicated background head." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只查看每口注入井旁的高水頭，可能漏掉井間或較深層的薄弱位置。將絕對水頭相加又會重複背景值，造成整條屏障似乎比實際更高，進一步掩蓋監測配置不足。
knowledge.textEn: Checking only high heads beside injection wells can miss weaker interwell or deeper locations. Adding absolute heads double-counts the background and exaggerates apparent protection, potentially concealing the need for a better distributed monitoring network.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「線性疊加與井間薄弱區」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Linear superposition and gaps between wells" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
只要樣本氯離子升高，就能單獨證明海水入侵，且不需要檢查其他來源。
只查看每口注入井旁的高水頭，可能漏掉井間或較深層的薄弱位置。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
An increase in chloride alone proves seawater intrusion without checking any alternative source.
Checking only high heads beside injection wells can miss weaker interwell or deeper locations.
quiz.explanation: 只查看每口注入井旁的高水頭，可能漏掉井間或較深層的薄弱位置。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Checking only high heads beside injection wells can miss weaker interwell or deeper locations. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 保守離子與兩端元混合：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Conservative ions and two-endmember mixing: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「保守離子與兩端元混合」如何影響地下水屏障防止海水入侵的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Conservative ions and two-endmember mixing” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Groundwater barriers against seawater intrusion”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 鹽度變化可以用保守溶質的兩端元混合先作概念估算，但必須確定淡水與海水端元濃度具有代表性，且沒有其他溶質來源、反應或顯著體積非加成。氯離子常被用來追蹤鹹水影響，卻也可能來自其他來源；一個濃度值不能獨自證明海水入侵。監測應結合離子比例、地層、時間序列與水力資訊，並明確區分混合比例、海水前緣位置和水質用途判斷，三者不是同一個計算問題。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「保守離子與兩端元混合」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Two-endmember conservative-solute mixing provides a conceptual estimate of saline contribution when freshwater and seawater concentrations are representative and other sources, reactions and volume nonadditivity are negligible. Chloride can trace saline influence but may have other origins, so one concentration does not independently demonstrate seawater intrusion. Combine ion ratios, stratigraphy, time series and hydraulic evidence. Distinguish mixing fraction from salt-front location and end-use water quality, because these are separate questions requiring different evidence. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Conservative ions and two-endmember mixing” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設保守氯離子、體積可加，淡水50、海水19000、混合樣本240 mg/L；海水體積比例f=(240−50)/(19000−50)=0.010026，約1.003%。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Assume conservative chloride and additive volumes, with fresh, sea and mixed concentrations of 50, 19000 and 240 mg/L.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要樣本氯離子升高，就能單獨證明海水入侵，且不需要檢查其他來源。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "An increase in chloride alone proves seawater intrusion without checking any alternative source." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「保守離子與兩端元混合」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Conservative ions and two-endmember mixing”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 保守離子與兩端元混合
knowledge.text: 鹽度變化可以用保守溶質的兩端元混合先作概念估算，但必須確定淡水與海水端元濃度具有代表性，且沒有其他溶質來源、反應或顯著體積非加成。氯離子常被用來追蹤鹹水影響，卻也可能來自其他來源；一個濃度值不能獨自證明海水入侵。
knowledge.textEn: Two-endmember conservative-solute mixing provides a conceptual estimate of saline contribution when freshwater and seawater concentrations are representative and other sources, reactions and volume nonadditivity are negligible. Chloride can trace saline influence but may have other origins, so one concentration does not independently demonstrate seawater intrusion.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要樣本氯離子升高，就能單獨證明海水入侵，且不需要檢查其他來源。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: An increase in chloride alone proves seawater intrusion without checking any alternative source. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「保守離子與兩端元混合」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Conservative ions and two-endmember mixing" is correct?
options: 鹽度變化可以用保守溶質的兩端元混合先作概念估算，但必須確定淡水與海水端元濃度具有代表性，且沒有其他溶質來源、反應或顯著體積非加成。
只要樣本氯離子升高，就能單獨證明海水入侵，且不需要檢查其他來源。
注入能力下降一定只代表細砂堵塞，因此不必檢查區域水位、密度或儀器校正。
optionsEn: Two-endmember conservative-solute mixing provides a conceptual estimate of saline contribution when freshwater and seawater concentrations are representative and other sources, reactions and volume nonadditivity are negligible.
An increase in chloride alone proves seawater intrusion without checking any alternative source.
Declining injectivity always means sand clogging, so regional head, density and calibration need no review.
quiz.explanation: 鹽度變化可以用保守溶質的兩端元混合先作概念估算，但必須確定淡水與海水端元濃度具有代表性，且沒有其他溶質來源、反應或顯著體積非加成。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Two-endmember conservative-solute mixing provides a conceptual estimate of saline contribution when freshwater and seawater concentrations are representative and other sources, reactions and volume nonadditivity are negligible. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 保守離子與兩端元混合：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Conservative ions and two-endmember mixing: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「保守離子與兩端元混合」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Conservative ions and two-endmember mixing” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設保守氯離子、體積可加，淡水50、海水19000、混合樣本240 mg/L；海水體積比例f=(240−50)/(19000−50)=0.010026，約1.003%。此值不代表用途合格或前緣位置。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Assume conservative chloride and additive volumes, with fresh, sea and mixed concentrations of 50, 19000 and 240 mg/L. Seawater volume fraction is (240−50)/(19000−50)=0.010026, about 1.003%, not a water-quality acceptance result or front location. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用質量守恆反代混合比例，檢查結果介於零與一之間，並將端元取樣日期和位置列入紀錄。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Substitute the fraction into mass balance, check that it lies between zero and one, and record endmember sampling dates and locations.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設保守氯離子、體積可加，淡水50、海水19000、混合樣本240 mg/L；海水體積比例f=(240−50)/(19000−50)=0.010026，約1.003%。此值不代表用途合格或前緣位置。
knowledge.textEn: Assume conservative chloride and additive volumes, with fresh, sea and mixed concentrations of 50, 19000 and 240 mg/L. Seawater volume fraction is (240−50)/(19000−50)=0.010026, about 1.003%, not a water-quality acceptance result or front location.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「保守離子與兩端元混合」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Conservative ions and two-endmember mixing", which statement holds?
options: 只要總注入量足夠，每個含水層就一定會自動獲得相同流量與相同保護。
教學假設保守氯離子、體積可加，淡水50、海水19000、混合樣本240 mg/L。
任何海岸含水層只要水位高出海面一公尺，實際鹽水界面就必定精確位於四十公尺深。
optionsEn: Adequate total injection automatically gives every aquifer equal flow and equal protection.
Assume conservative chloride and additive volumes, with fresh, sea and mixed concentrations of 50, 19000 and 240 mg/L.
Every coastal aquifer with one metre of freshwater head has an actual interface exactly forty metres deep.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設保守氯離子、體積可加，淡水50、海水19000、混合樣本240 mg/L；海水體積比例f=(240−50)/(19000−50)=0.010026，約1.003%。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Assume conservative chloride and additive volumes, with fresh, sea and mixed concentrations of 50, 19000 and 240 mg/L. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 保守離子與兩端元混合：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Conservative ions and two-endmember mixing: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「保守離子與兩端元混合」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Conservative ions and two-endmember mixing” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用質量守恆反代混合比例，檢查結果介於零與一之間，並將端元取樣日期和位置列入紀錄。再比較其他保守指標及水頭變化，若不同指標不能支持相同混合解釋，應調查額外來源或反應，而非只保留最符合預期的濃度。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Substitute the fraction into mass balance, check that it lies between zero and one, and record endmember sampling dates and locations. Compare other conservative indicators and head changes; disagreement should prompt investigation of additional sources or reactions rather than selective retention of the preferred concentration. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將淡水端元濃度提高到100 mg/L，保持樣本與海水端元不變，重算比例。再加入第三個高氯來源的概念圖，說明單一濃度為何無法唯一分解三個來源，並提出至少一項額外觀測以改善辨識。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Raise the freshwater endmember to 100 mg/L while retaining the other concentrations and recalculate the fraction. Add a third chloride source conceptually, explain why one concentration cannot uniquely separate three sources, and propose an additional observation that improves identification.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：使用固定海水端元而忽略季節或河口淡化，會改變估算比例；若氯離子另有工業或地表來源，兩端元模型也可能把非海水污染誤認成海水混入，造成錯誤的成因判斷。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A fixed seawater endmember can misrepresent seasonal or estuarine dilution. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用質量守恆反代混合比例，檢查結果介於零與一之間，並將端元取樣日期和位置列入紀錄。再比較其他保守指標及水頭變化，若不同指標不能支持相同混合解釋，應調查額外來源或反應，而非只保留最符合預期的濃度。
knowledge.textEn: Substitute the fraction into mass balance, check that it lies between zero and one, and record endmember sampling dates and locations. Compare other conservative indicators and head changes; disagreement should prompt investigation of additional sources or reactions rather than selective retention of the preferred concentration.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將淡水端元濃度提高到100 mg/L，保持樣本與海水端元不變，重算比例。再加入第三個高氯來源的概念圖，說明單一濃度為何無法唯一分解三個來源，並提出至少一項額外觀測以改善辨識。
knowledge.textEn: Raise the freshwater endmember to 100 mg/L while retaining the other concentrations and recalculate the fraction. Add a third chloride source conceptually, explain why one concentration cannot uniquely separate three sources, and propose an additional observation that improves identification.

quiz.question: 要驗證「保守離子與兩端元混合」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Conservative ions and two-endmember mixing"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
達西通量與孔隙中的平均水流速度永遠相同，不需要知道有效孔隙率。
用質量守恆反代混合比例，檢查結果介於零與一之間，並將端元取樣日期和位置列入紀錄。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
Darcy flux always equals average pore-water velocity without any need for effective porosity.
Substitute the fraction into mass balance, check that it lies between zero and one, and record endmember sampling dates and locations.
quiz.explanation: 用質量守恆反代混合比例，檢查結果介於零與一之間，並將端元取樣日期和位置列入紀錄。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Substitute the fraction into mass balance, check that it lies between zero and one, and record endmember sampling dates and locations. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 保守離子與兩端元混合：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Conservative ions and two-endmember mixing: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「保守離子與兩端元混合」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Conservative ions and two-endmember mixing” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 使用固定海水端元而忽略季節或河口淡化，會改變估算比例；若氯離子另有工業或地表來源，兩端元模型也可能把非海水污染誤認成海水混入，造成錯誤的成因判斷。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A fixed seawater endmember can misrepresent seasonal or estuarine dilution. Additional industrial or surface sources of chloride can be falsely assigned to seawater by a two-endmember model, producing an incorrect explanation of the observed concentration increase. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：監測應結合離子比例、地層、時間序列與水力資訊，並明確區分混合比例、海水前緣位置和水質用途判斷，三者不是同一個計算問題。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Distinguish mixing fraction from salt-front location and end-use water quality, because these are separate questions requiring different evidence.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要樣本氯離子升高，就能單獨證明海水入侵，且不需要檢查其他來源。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "An increase in chloride alone proves seawater intrusion without checking any alternative source." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 使用固定海水端元而忽略季節或河口淡化，會改變估算比例；若氯離子另有工業或地表來源，兩端元模型也可能把非海水污染誤認成海水混入，造成錯誤的成因判斷。
knowledge.textEn: A fixed seawater endmember can misrepresent seasonal or estuarine dilution. Additional industrial or surface sources of chloride can be falsely assigned to seawater by a two-endmember model, producing an incorrect explanation of the observed concentration increase.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「保守離子與兩端元混合」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Conservative ions and two-endmember mixing" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 使用固定海水端元而忽略季節或河口淡化，會改變估算比例；若氯離子另有工業或地表來源，兩端元模型也可能把非海水污染誤認成海水混入，造成錯誤的成因判斷。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
注入能力下降一定只代表細砂堵塞，因此不必檢查區域水位、密度或儀器校正。
optionsEn: A fixed seawater endmember can misrepresent seasonal or estuarine dilution.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Declining injectivity always means sand clogging, so regional head, density and calibration need no review.
quiz.explanation: 使用固定海水端元而忽略季節或河口淡化，會改變估算比例；若氯離子另有工業或地表來源，兩端元模型也可能把非海水污染誤認成海水混入，造成錯誤的成因判斷。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A fixed seawater endmember can misrepresent seasonal or estuarine dilution. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「注入能力衰減與成因辨識」與「壓力傳播與溶質旅行時間」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Declining injectivity and causal diagnosis" and "Pressure propagation versus solute travel time": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 注入能力衰減與成因辨識：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Declining injectivity and causal diagnosis: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「注入能力衰減與成因辨識」如何影響地下水屏障防止海水入侵的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Declining injectivity and causal diagnosis” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Groundwater barriers against seawater intrusion”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 注入能力常以流量除以相對背景的水頭增量描述，但指標下降不一定只有井周堵塞一種原因。區域水位升高、密度改變、量測位置差異或設備損失都可能改變分母，因此比較不同時間前應統一基準、流量區間與資料校正。堵塞也可能包含細粒、化學沉澱、生物膜與氣體效應，不能只用一個比值決定處理方式。課程以趨勢辨識為目的，要求先區分含水層反應和井內損失，再由具場址資料的人員評估原因。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「注入能力衰減與成因辨識」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Injectivity is commonly expressed as discharge divided by head buildup relative to background, but a decline does not uniquely diagnose clogging. Regional head changes, density, measurement location and equipment losses can alter the denominator, requiring consistent baselines, flow ranges and corrections. Clogging may involve particles, precipitation, biofilms or gas, and one ratio cannot select a remedy. Use the metric for trend detection, separating aquifer response from well losses before interpreting causes with site-specific evidence. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Declining injectivity and causal diagnosis” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設同一流量100 m³/day，經背景與密度校正後的增量由2 m升至10 m；注入能力由50降至10 m²/day，降低80%。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: At the same 100 m³/day flow, corrected buildup increases from 2 to 10 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「注入能力下降一定只代表細砂堵塞，因此不必檢查區域水位、密度或儀器校正。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Declining injectivity always means sand clogging, so regional head, density and calibration need no review." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「注入能力衰減與成因辨識」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Declining injectivity and causal diagnosis”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 注入能力衰減與成因辨識
knowledge.text: 注入能力常以流量除以相對背景的水頭增量描述，但指標下降不一定只有井周堵塞一種原因。區域水位升高、密度改變、量測位置差異或設備損失都可能改變分母，因此比較不同時間前應統一基準、流量區間與資料校正。
knowledge.textEn: Injectivity is commonly expressed as discharge divided by head buildup relative to background, but a decline does not uniquely diagnose clogging. Regional head changes, density, measurement location and equipment losses can alter the denominator, requiring consistent baselines, flow ranges and corrections.

knowledge.text: 誤解：注入能力下降一定只代表細砂堵塞，因此不必檢查區域水位、密度或儀器校正。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Declining injectivity always means sand clogging, so regional head, density and calibration need no review. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「注入能力衰減與成因辨識」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Declining injectivity and causal diagnosis" is correct?
options: 注入能力下降一定只代表細砂堵塞，因此不必檢查區域水位、密度或儀器校正。
注入能力常以流量除以相對背景的水頭增量描述，但指標下降不一定只有井周堵塞一種原因。
觀測井一出現水位上升，就表示新注入水已經抵達該井，無需其他示蹤資料。
optionsEn: Declining injectivity always means sand clogging, so regional head, density and calibration need no review.
Injectivity is commonly expressed as discharge divided by head buildup relative to background, but a decline does not uniquely diagnose clogging.
A water-level rise proves newly injected water has reached the well without any tracer evidence.
quiz.explanation: 注入能力常以流量除以相對背景的水頭增量描述，但指標下降不一定只有井周堵塞一種原因。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Injectivity is commonly expressed as discharge divided by head buildup relative to background, but a decline does not uniquely diagnose clogging. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 注入能力衰減與成因辨識：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Declining injectivity and causal diagnosis: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「注入能力衰減與成因辨識」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Declining injectivity and causal diagnosis” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設同一流量100 m³/day，經背景與密度校正後的增量由2 m升至10 m；注入能力由50降至10 m²/day，降低80%。這只是性能指標，不能據此直接提高現場注入壓力。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: At the same 100 m³/day flow, corrected buildup increases from 2 to 10 m. Injectivity falls from 50 to 10 m²/day, an 80% decrease. This performance indicator does not justify increasing field injection pressure. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：對比同一流量區間、相同感測位置及一致背景基準的歷史資料，同時查看鄰近觀測井與注入井內的反應。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare matching flow ranges, sensor locations and background datums while examining both injection and nearby observation wells.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設同一流量100 m³/day，經背景與密度校正後的增量由2 m升至10 m；注入能力由50降至10 m²/day，降低80%。這只是性能指標，不能據此直接提高現場注入壓力。
knowledge.textEn: At the same 100 m³/day flow, corrected buildup increases from 2 to 10 m. Injectivity falls from 50 to 10 m²/day, an 80% decrease. This performance indicator does not justify increasing field injection pressure.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「注入能力衰減與成因辨識」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Declining injectivity and causal diagnosis", which statement holds?
options: 地下水壓力呈現潮汐週期，就表示海水前緣每個週期都移動到相同的觀測位置。
只要兩口井的水面高程相同，不論井內水的密度如何，壓力狀態就完全相同。
教學假設同一流量100 m³/day，經背景與密度校正後的增量由2 m升至10 m；注入能力由50降至10 m²/day，降低80%。
optionsEn: A tidal pressure cycle proves that the seawater front reaches the observation location during every cycle.
Equal water-surface elevations imply identical pressure conditions regardless of fluid density.
At the same 100 m³/day flow, corrected buildup increases from 2 to 10 m.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設同一流量100 m³/day，經背景與密度校正後的增量由2 m升至10 m；注入能力由50降至10 m²/day，降低80%。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: At the same 100 m³/day flow, corrected buildup increases from 2 to 10 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 注入能力衰減與成因辨識：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Declining injectivity and causal diagnosis: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「注入能力衰減與成因辨識」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Declining injectivity and causal diagnosis” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
