steps.instruction: 對比同一流量區間、相同感測位置及一致背景基準的歷史資料，同時查看鄰近觀測井與注入井內的反應。把儀器校正、停運期間和水質變化標在時間軸上，區分量測偏差、區域變化與局部性能衰減的可能證據。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare matching flow ranges, sensor locations and background datums while examining both injection and nearby observation wells. Mark calibration, shutdowns and source-water changes on the timeline to distinguish measurement bias, regional behavior and local performance deterioration using separate lines of evidence. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：建立兩份相同表面指標下降的合成紀錄，一份由背景水位變化造成，另一份由局部水頭損失增加造成。加入鄰近觀測井資料後重新計算，說明哪一項證據能區分兩種情境，以及哪些原因仍無法唯一確認。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Construct two synthetic records with equal apparent injectivity decline, one caused by background head change and the other by local loss. Add nearby observation data, recalculate the corrected metric and identify which evidence distinguishes the scenarios and which causes remain unresolved.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：直接比較未校正的井內壓力，可能把區域水位升高誤認成堵塞。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Comparing uncorrected well pressures can mistake regional head rise for clogging. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 對比同一流量區間、相同感測位置及一致背景基準的歷史資料，同時查看鄰近觀測井與注入井內的反應。把儀器校正、停運期間和水質變化標在時間軸上，區分量測偏差、區域變化與局部性能衰減的可能證據。
knowledge.textEn: Compare matching flow ranges, sensor locations and background datums while examining both injection and nearby observation wells. Mark calibration, shutdowns and source-water changes on the timeline to distinguish measurement bias, regional behavior and local performance deterioration using separate lines of evidence.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 建立兩份相同表面指標下降的合成紀錄，一份由背景水位變化造成，另一份由局部水頭損失增加造成。加入鄰近觀測井資料後重新計算，說明哪一項證據能區分兩種情境，以及哪些原因仍無法唯一確認。
knowledge.textEn: Construct two synthetic records with equal apparent injectivity decline, one caused by background head change and the other by local loss. Add nearby observation data, recalculate the corrected metric and identify which evidence distinguishes the scenarios and which causes remain unresolved.

quiz.question: 要驗證「注入能力衰減與成因辨識」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Declining injectivity and causal diagnosis"?
options: 對比同一流量區間、相同感測位置及一致背景基準的歷史資料，同時查看鄰近觀測井與注入井內的反應。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
注入井內壓力升高多少，周圍所有觀測井的含水層水頭就必然同步升高多少。
optionsEn: Compare matching flow ranges, sensor locations and background datums while examining both injection and nearby observation wells.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
An injection-well pressure increase must appear unchanged at every surrounding observation well.
quiz.explanation: 對比同一流量區間、相同感測位置及一致背景基準的歷史資料，同時查看鄰近觀測井與注入井內的反應。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare matching flow ranges, sensor locations and background datums while examining both injection and nearby observation wells. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 注入能力衰減與成因辨識：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Declining injectivity and causal diagnosis: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「注入能力衰減與成因辨識」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Declining injectivity and causal diagnosis” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 直接比較未校正的井內壓力，可能把區域水位升高誤認成堵塞。反過來，若只看流量仍達標而忽略所需水頭增加，可能錯失性能衰減的早期訊號，讓後續判讀更加困難。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Comparing uncorrected well pressures can mistake regional head rise for clogging. Conversely, observing unchanged discharge while ignoring increasing required head can miss early deterioration and leave later diagnosis dependent on incomplete historical records. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：課程以趨勢辨識為目的，要求先區分含水層反應和井內損失，再由具場址資料的人員評估原因。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Use the metric for trend detection, separating aquifer response from well losses before interpreting causes with site-specific evidence.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「注入能力下降一定只代表細砂堵塞，因此不必檢查區域水位、密度或儀器校正。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Declining injectivity always means sand clogging, so regional head, density and calibration need no review." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 直接比較未校正的井內壓力，可能把區域水位升高誤認成堵塞。反過來，若只看流量仍達標而忽略所需水頭增加，可能錯失性能衰減的早期訊號，讓後續判讀更加困難。
knowledge.textEn: Comparing uncorrected well pressures can mistake regional head rise for clogging. Conversely, observing unchanged discharge while ignoring increasing required head can miss early deterioration and leave later diagnosis dependent on incomplete historical records.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「注入能力衰減與成因辨識」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Declining injectivity and causal diagnosis" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
直接比較未校正的井內壓力，可能把區域水位升高誤認成堵塞。
觀測井一出現水位上升，就表示新注入水已經抵達該井，無需其他示蹤資料。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Comparing uncorrected well pressures can mistake regional head rise for clogging.
A water-level rise proves newly injected water has reached the well without any tracer evidence.
quiz.explanation: 直接比較未校正的井內壓力，可能把區域水位升高誤認成堵塞。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Comparing uncorrected well pressures can mistake regional head rise for clogging. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 壓力傳播與溶質旅行時間：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Pressure propagation versus solute travel time: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「壓力傳播與溶質旅行時間」如何影響地下水屏障防止海水入侵的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Pressure propagation versus solute travel time” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Groundwater barriers against seawater intrusion”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 水頭訊號可以透過含水層的壓力擴散快速傳遞，而新注入水或溶質需要隨流動路徑前進，兩者的時間尺度常不同。觀測井很快出現水位反應，不代表補注水已到達或鹽水已被置換。壓力擴散的特徵時間取決於傳導係數與儲水係數，平流旅行時間則取決於孔隙速度和路徑長度；實際濃度曲線還受彌散和混合影響。解釋屏障監測時應把壓力、示蹤物與水質的證據分列，避免用快速訊號取代較慢的物質傳輸驗證。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「壓力傳播與溶質旅行時間」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Hydraulic signals can propagate through pressure diffusion much faster than injected water or solute moves along flow paths. A rapid well-level response does not demonstrate arrival of recharge water or displacement of salinity. Pressure timescales depend on transmissivity and storativity, whereas advective travel depends on pore velocity and path length; dispersion and mixing further shape concentration curves. Keep hydraulic, tracer and quality evidence separate so a fast pressure response is not substituted for slower verification of material transport. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Pressure propagation versus solute travel time” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設距離100 m、孔隙速度0.20 m/day，平流時間500日。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For distance 100 m and pore velocity 0.20 m/day, advective travel is 500 days.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「觀測井一出現水位上升，就表示新注入水已經抵達該井，無需其他示蹤資料。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A water-level rise proves newly injected water has reached the well without any tracer evidence." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「壓力傳播與溶質旅行時間」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Pressure propagation versus solute travel time”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 壓力傳播與溶質旅行時間
knowledge.titleEn: Pressure propagation versus solute travel time
knowledge.text: 水頭訊號可以透過含水層的壓力擴散快速傳遞，而新注入水或溶質需要隨流動路徑前進，兩者的時間尺度常不同。觀測井很快出現水位反應，不代表補注水已到達或鹽水已被置換。
knowledge.textEn: Hydraulic signals can propagate through pressure diffusion much faster than injected water or solute moves along flow paths. A rapid well-level response does not demonstrate arrival of recharge water or displacement of salinity.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：觀測井一出現水位上升，就表示新注入水已經抵達該井，無需其他示蹤資料。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A water-level rise proves newly injected water has reached the well without any tracer evidence. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「壓力傳播與溶質旅行時間」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Pressure propagation versus solute travel time" is correct?
options: 觀測井一出現水位上升，就表示新注入水已經抵達該井，無需其他示蹤資料。
只要總注入量足夠，每個含水層就一定會自動獲得相同流量與相同保護。
水頭訊號可以透過含水層的壓力擴散快速傳遞，而新注入水或溶質需要隨流動路徑前進，兩者的時間尺度常不同。
optionsEn: A water-level rise proves newly injected water has reached the well without any tracer evidence.
Adequate total injection automatically gives every aquifer equal flow and equal protection.
Hydraulic signals can propagate through pressure diffusion much faster than injected water or solute moves along flow paths.
quiz.explanation: 水頭訊號可以透過含水層的壓力擴散快速傳遞，而新注入水或溶質需要隨流動路徑前進，兩者的時間尺度常不同。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Hydraulic signals can propagate through pressure diffusion much faster than injected water or solute moves along flow paths. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 壓力傳播與溶質旅行時間：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Pressure propagation versus solute travel time: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「壓力傳播與溶質旅行時間」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Pressure propagation versus solute travel time” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設距離100 m、孔隙速度0.20 m/day，平流時間500日。若T=100 m²/day、S=0.001，水力擴散率D=T/S=100000 m²/day，尺度L²/D=0.10日；後者不是精確到達時間。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For distance 100 m and pore velocity 0.20 m/day, advective travel is 500 days. With transmissivity 100 m²/day and storativity 0.001, hydraulic diffusivity is 100000 m²/day and L²/D is 0.10 day, a characteristic scale rather than exact arrival time. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：分別繪製水頭與保守示蹤濃度的時間序列，統一時間基準但保留各自的採樣解析度。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Plot head and conservative-tracer series on a common time basis while retaining their sampling resolutions.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設距離100 m、孔隙速度0.20 m/day，平流時間500日。若T=100 m²/day、S=0.001，水力擴散率D=T/S=100000 m²/day，尺度L²/D=0.10日；後者不是精確到達時間。
knowledge.textEn: For distance 100 m and pore velocity 0.20 m/day, advective travel is 500 days. With transmissivity 100 m²/day and storativity 0.001, hydraulic diffusivity is 100000 m²/day and L²/D is 0.10 day, a characteristic scale rather than exact arrival time.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「壓力傳播與溶質旅行時間」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Pressure propagation versus solute travel time", which statement holds?
options: 教學假設距離100 m、孔隙速度0.20 m/day，平流時間500日。
任何海岸含水層只要水位高出海面一公尺，實際鹽水界面就必定精確位於四十公尺深。
達西通量與孔隙中的平均水流速度永遠相同，不需要知道有效孔隙率。
optionsEn: For distance 100 m and pore velocity 0.20 m/day, advective travel is 500 days.
Every coastal aquifer with one metre of freshwater head has an actual interface exactly forty metres deep.
Darcy flux always equals average pore-water velocity without any need for effective porosity.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設距離100 m、孔隙速度0.20 m/day，平流時間500日。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: For distance 100 m and pore velocity 0.20 m/day, advective travel is 500 days. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 壓力傳播與溶質旅行時間：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Pressure propagation versus solute travel time: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「壓力傳播與溶質旅行時間」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Pressure propagation versus solute travel time” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 分別繪製水頭與保守示蹤濃度的時間序列，統一時間基準但保留各自的採樣解析度。檢查壓力反應是否也可能由潮汐或抽水造成，再以濃度和其他水化學證據辨識水體到達，不把第一個水位變化點當成示蹤物到達點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Plot head and conservative-tracer series on a common time basis while retaining their sampling resolutions. Check whether tides or pumping could explain the pressure response, then use concentration and supporting chemistry to assess water arrival instead of labeling the first head change as tracer breakthrough. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：在同一張時間軸上標示兩種理想時間尺度，將孔隙速度降低一半再重算平流時間。另把儲水係數增加十倍，觀察壓力尺度如何改變，說明不同參數影響不同過程，不能用一個延遲係數同時校正所有資料。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Place both ideal timescales on one timeline, halve pore velocity and recalculate transport time. Increase storativity tenfold separately and compare the pressure scale, explaining why distinct processes respond to different parameters and cannot share one universal delay correction.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把快速水頭上升視為補注水已經到達，可能高估水質改善的速度。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Equating rapid head rise with recharge-water arrival can overstate the speed of quality improvement. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 分別繪製水頭與保守示蹤濃度的時間序列，統一時間基準但保留各自的採樣解析度。檢查壓力反應是否也可能由潮汐或抽水造成，再以濃度和其他水化學證據辨識水體到達，不把第一個水位變化點當成示蹤物到達點。
knowledge.textEn: Plot head and conservative-tracer series on a common time basis while retaining their sampling resolutions. Check whether tides or pumping could explain the pressure response, then use concentration and supporting chemistry to assess water arrival instead of labeling the first head change as tracer breakthrough.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 在同一張時間軸上標示兩種理想時間尺度，將孔隙速度降低一半再重算平流時間。另把儲水係數增加十倍，觀察壓力尺度如何改變，說明不同參數影響不同過程，不能用一個延遲係數同時校正所有資料。
knowledge.textEn: Place both ideal timescales on one timeline, halve pore velocity and recalculate transport time. Increase storativity tenfold separately and compare the pressure scale, explaining why distinct processes respond to different parameters and cannot share one universal delay correction.

quiz.question: 要驗證「壓力傳播與溶質旅行時間」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Pressure propagation versus solute travel time"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
分別繪製水頭與保守示蹤濃度的時間序列，統一時間基準但保留各自的採樣解析度。
兩個注入源各自造成的絕對水頭可以直接相加，不必扣除重複的背景水頭。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Plot head and conservative-tracer series on a common time basis while retaining their sampling resolutions.
Absolute heads from two injection sources can be added directly without removing duplicated background head.
quiz.explanation: 分別繪製水頭與保守示蹤濃度的時間序列，統一時間基準但保留各自的採樣解析度。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Plot head and conservative-tracer series on a common time basis while retaining their sampling resolutions. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 壓力傳播與溶質旅行時間：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Pressure propagation versus solute travel time: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「壓力傳播與溶質旅行時間」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Pressure propagation versus solute travel time” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把快速水頭上升視為補注水已經到達，可能高估水質改善的速度。若示蹤物尚未量到就判定工程失效，也可能忽略較長旅行時間；兩種誤判都源於把壓力與物質傳輸混成同一過程。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Equating rapid head rise with recharge-water arrival can overstate the speed of quality improvement. Declaring failure before tracer arrival can instead ignore a longer travel time; both errors confuse pressure transmission with movement of water and solute. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋屏障監測時應把壓力、示蹤物與水質的證據分列，避免用快速訊號取代較慢的物質傳輸驗證。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Keep hydraulic, tracer and quality evidence separate so a fast pressure response is not substituted for slower verification of material transport.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「觀測井一出現水位上升，就表示新注入水已經抵達該井，無需其他示蹤資料。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A water-level rise proves newly injected water has reached the well without any tracer evidence." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把快速水頭上升視為補注水已經到達，可能高估水質改善的速度。若示蹤物尚未量到就判定工程失效，也可能忽略較長旅行時間；兩種誤判都源於把壓力與物質傳輸混成同一過程。
knowledge.textEn: Equating rapid head rise with recharge-water arrival can overstate the speed of quality improvement. Declaring failure before tracer arrival can instead ignore a longer travel time; both errors confuse pressure transmission with movement of water and solute.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「壓力傳播與溶質旅行時間」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Pressure propagation versus solute travel time" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
只要總注入量足夠，每個含水層就一定會自動獲得相同流量與相同保護。
把快速水頭上升視為補注水已經到達，可能高估水質改善的速度。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Adequate total injection automatically gives every aquifer equal flow and equal protection.
Equating rapid head rise with recharge-water arrival can overstate the speed of quality improvement.
quiz.explanation: 把快速水頭上升視為補注水已經到達，可能高估水質改善的速度。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Equating rapid head rise with recharge-water arrival can overstate the speed of quality improvement. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「分層分配與獨立含水層」與「潮汐水頭衰減與相位延遲」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Layer allocation and independent aquifers" and "Tidal-head attenuation and phase lag": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 分層分配與獨立含水層：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Layer allocation and independent aquifers: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「分層分配與獨立含水層」如何影響地下水屏障防止海水入侵的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Layer allocation and independent aquifers” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Groundwater barriers against seawater intrusion”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 多層含水層的補注分配取決於各層傳導能力、背景水頭與施加增量。即使總流量足夠，也可能主要進入較高傳導性的層位，讓其他層的防護不足。教學模型可把兩個彼此隔離、相同幾何的線性支路放在紙上比較，但不能據此設計跨層連通井，因為實際層間混流會改變水質與壓力邊界。分析應保留每層獨立的水量帳和監測資料，避免把全井平均反應當成各層反應一致的證據。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「分層分配與獨立含水層」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Recharge allocation across layers depends on transmissivity, background head and imposed buildup. Sufficient total flow may preferentially enter a conductive layer while another remains weakly supported. A teaching model can compare hydraulically isolated linear branches with equal geometry, but it does not justify cross-aquifer connections, which alter quality and pressure boundaries. Keep separate layer balances and monitoring evidence instead of treating an average well response as proof that every aquifer receives equal hydraulic protection. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Layer allocation and independent aquifers” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設兩個水力隔離支路，幾何、外邊界和施加增量相同，T分別100與50 m²/day；總Q=300 m³/day依傳導係數比例分為200與100 m³/day。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For two hydraulically isolated branches with equal geometry, outer heads and applied buildup, transmissivities are 100 and 50 m²/day.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要總注入量足夠，每個含水層就一定會自動獲得相同流量與相同保護。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Adequate total injection automatically gives every aquifer equal flow and equal protection." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「分層分配與獨立含水層」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Layer allocation and independent aquifers”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 分層分配與獨立含水層
knowledge.text: 多層含水層的補注分配取決於各層傳導能力、背景水頭與施加增量。即使總流量足夠，也可能主要進入較高傳導性的層位，讓其他層的防護不足。
knowledge.textEn: Recharge allocation across layers depends on transmissivity, background head and imposed buildup. Sufficient total flow may preferentially enter a conductive layer while another remains weakly supported.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要總注入量足夠，每個含水層就一定會自動獲得相同流量與相同保護。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Adequate total injection automatically gives every aquifer equal flow and equal protection. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「分層分配與獨立含水層」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Layer allocation and independent aquifers" is correct?
options: 多層含水層的補注分配取決於各層傳導能力、背景水頭與施加增量。
只要總注入量足夠，每個含水層就一定會自動獲得相同流量與相同保護。
地下水壓力呈現潮汐週期，就表示海水前緣每個週期都移動到相同的觀測位置。
optionsEn: Recharge allocation across layers depends on transmissivity, background head and imposed buildup.
Adequate total injection automatically gives every aquifer equal flow and equal protection.
A tidal pressure cycle proves that the seawater front reaches the observation location during every cycle.
quiz.explanation: 多層含水層的補注分配取決於各層傳導能力、背景水頭與施加增量。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Recharge allocation across layers depends on transmissivity, background head and imposed buildup. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 分層分配與獨立含水層：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Layer allocation and independent aquifers: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「分層分配與獨立含水層」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Layer allocation and independent aquifers” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設兩個水力隔離支路，幾何、外邊界和施加增量相同，T分別100與50 m²/day；總Q=300 m³/day依傳導係數比例分為200與100 m³/day。僅為獨立支路線性模型。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For two hydraulically isolated branches with equal geometry, outer heads and applied buildup, transmissivities are 100 and 50 m²/day. A total 300 m³/day splits proportionally into 200 and 100 m³/day in this linear teaching model. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：先檢查兩支路是否確實採相同邊界與幾何，再分別核對流量和水頭資料。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Verify common geometry and boundary assumptions before comparing branch flows and heads.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設兩個水力隔離支路，幾何、外邊界和施加增量相同，T分別100與50 m²/day；總Q=300 m³/day依傳導係數比例分為200與100 m³/day。僅為獨立支路線性模型。
knowledge.textEn: For two hydraulically isolated branches with equal geometry, outer heads and applied buildup, transmissivities are 100 and 50 m²/day. A total 300 m³/day splits proportionally into 200 and 100 m³/day in this linear teaching model.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「分層分配與獨立含水層」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Layer allocation and independent aquifers", which statement holds?
options: 只要兩口井的水面高程相同，不論井內水的密度如何，壓力狀態就完全相同。
教學假設兩個水力隔離支路，幾何、外邊界和施加增量相同，T分別100與50 m²/day。
注入井內壓力升高多少，周圍所有觀測井的含水層水頭就必然同步升高多少。
optionsEn: Equal water-surface elevations imply identical pressure conditions regardless of fluid density.
For two hydraulically isolated branches with equal geometry, outer heads and applied buildup, transmissivities are 100 and 50 m²/day.
An injection-well pressure increase must appear unchanged at every surrounding observation well.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設兩個水力隔離支路，幾何、外邊界和施加增量相同，T分別100與50 m²/day；總Q=300 m³/day依傳導係數比例分為200與100 m³/day。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: For two hydraulically isolated branches with equal geometry, outer heads and applied buildup, transmissivities are 100 and 50 m²/day. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 分層分配與獨立含水層：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Layer allocation and independent aquifers: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「分層分配與獨立含水層」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Layer allocation and independent aquifers” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 先檢查兩支路是否確實採相同邊界與幾何，再分別核對流量和水頭資料。以分層觀測而非全井平均濃度判讀防護效果，若背景水頭不同，需重新解各支路方程，不可仍用傳導係數比例硬分總流量。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Verify common geometry and boundary assumptions before comparing branch flows and heads. Assess protection with layer-specific observations rather than whole-well average concentration. If background heads differ, solve the branches separately instead of retaining a proportional split based only on transmissivity. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將第二支路的傳導係數降為25 m²/day，在相同線性邊界下重算分配。再只改其背景水頭，指出原本比例式哪個假設不再成立，並畫出應分層記錄的流量、水頭和鹽度欄位，不提出實體跨層接通方案。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Reduce the second branch transmissivity to 25 m²/day and recalculate the split under unchanged linear boundaries. Then change only its background head, identify the failed assumption and design separate flow, head and salinity records without proposing physical cross-aquifer connections.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把總注入量平均除以層數，會忽略各層傳導能力不同。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Dividing total injection equally among layers ignores differing transmissivity. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 先檢查兩支路是否確實採相同邊界與幾何，再分別核對流量和水頭資料。以分層觀測而非全井平均濃度判讀防護效果，若背景水頭不同，需重新解各支路方程，不可仍用傳導係數比例硬分總流量。
knowledge.textEn: Verify common geometry and boundary assumptions before comparing branch flows and heads. Assess protection with layer-specific observations rather than whole-well average concentration. If background heads differ, solve the branches separately instead of retaining a proportional split based only on transmissivity.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將第二支路的傳導係數降為25 m²/day，在相同線性邊界下重算分配。再只改其背景水頭，指出原本比例式哪個假設不再成立，並畫出應分層記錄的流量、水頭和鹽度欄位，不提出實體跨層接通方案。
knowledge.textEn: Reduce the second branch transmissivity to 25 m²/day and recalculate the split under unchanged linear boundaries. Then change only its background head, identify the failed assumption and design separate flow, head and salinity records without proposing physical cross-aquifer connections.

quiz.question: 要驗證「分層分配與獨立含水層」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Layer allocation and independent aquifers"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
只要樣本氯離子升高，就能單獨證明海水入侵，且不需要檢查其他來源。
先檢查兩支路是否確實採相同邊界與幾何，再分別核對流量和水頭資料。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
An increase in chloride alone proves seawater intrusion without checking any alternative source.
Verify common geometry and boundary assumptions before comparing branch flows and heads.
quiz.explanation: 先檢查兩支路是否確實採相同邊界與幾何，再分別核對流量和水頭資料。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Verify common geometry and boundary assumptions before comparing branch flows and heads. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 分層分配與獨立含水層：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Layer allocation and independent aquifers: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「分層分配與獨立含水層」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Layer allocation and independent aquifers” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把總注入量平均除以層數，會忽略各層傳導能力不同。若高流量層的淡水掩蓋另一層鹽度升高，全井混合樣本可能看似穩定，卻無法揭示較弱層位的變化。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Dividing total injection equally among layers ignores differing transmissivity. Fresh water from a high-flow layer can mask rising salinity in another, so a stable mixed well sample may conceal important changes within a weaker layer. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：分析應保留每層獨立的水量帳和監測資料，避免把全井平均反應當成各層反應一致的證據。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Keep separate layer balances and monitoring evidence instead of treating an average well response as proof that every aquifer receives equal hydraulic protection.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要總注入量足夠，每個含水層就一定會自動獲得相同流量與相同保護。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Adequate total injection automatically gives every aquifer equal flow and equal protection." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把總注入量平均除以層數，會忽略各層傳導能力不同。若高流量層的淡水掩蓋另一層鹽度升高，全井混合樣本可能看似穩定，卻無法揭示較弱層位的變化。
knowledge.textEn: Dividing total injection equally among layers ignores differing transmissivity. Fresh water from a high-flow layer can mask rising salinity in another, so a stable mixed well sample may conceal important changes within a weaker layer.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「分層分配與獨立含水層」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Layer allocation and independent aquifers" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 把總注入量平均除以層數，會忽略各層傳導能力不同。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
地下水壓力呈現潮汐週期，就表示海水前緣每個週期都移動到相同的觀測位置。
optionsEn: Dividing total injection equally among layers ignores differing transmissivity.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
A tidal pressure cycle proves that the seawater front reaches the observation location during every cycle.
quiz.explanation: 把總注入量平均除以層數，會忽略各層傳導能力不同。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Dividing total injection equally among layers ignores differing transmissivity. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 潮汐水頭衰減與相位延遲：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Tidal-head attenuation and phase lag: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「潮汐水頭衰減與相位延遲」如何影響地下水屏障防止海水入侵的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Tidal-head attenuation and phase lag” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Groundwater barriers against seawater intrusion”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 海岸潮汐可使地下水壓力週期變化，離岸距離增加時振幅可能衰減並產生相位延遲。這種訊號提供水力參數的線索，但壓力潮汐並不等於鹽水隨每個週期同距離進退。理想一維受壓半無限含水層可以用擴散方程的週期解描述，實際上地層邊界、河道、抽水與大氣壓都可能疊加其他訊號。學徒應先理解振幅比和相位的量綱，再以多點資料檢查模型是否合理，而不是只用一口井擬合出漂亮曲線就宣稱掌握入侵範圍。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「潮汐水頭衰減與相位延遲」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Coastal tides can drive periodic groundwater pressure with attenuation and phase delay inland. These signals inform hydraulic behavior but do not mean saltwater moves the same distance each cycle. A one-dimensional semi-infinite confined aquifer has an ideal periodic diffusion solution; boundaries, channels, pumping and atmospheric pressure introduce additional signals in practice. Understand amplitude ratios and phase dimensions, then compare multiple observations rather than treating a good fit at one well as proof of the saltwater-intrusion extent. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Tidal-head attenuation and phase lag” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設一維受壓半無限含水層，D=10000 m²/day、潮週期0.50 day；ω=2π/0.50，衰減長度δ=√(2D/ω)=39.894 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For an ideal one-dimensional semi-infinite confined aquifer, diffusivity 10000 m²/day and period 0.50 day give angular frequency 2π/0.50 and attenuation length 39.894 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「地下水壓力呈現潮汐週期，就表示海水前緣每個週期都移動到相同的觀測位置。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A tidal pressure cycle proves that the seawater front reaches the observation location during every cycle." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「潮汐水頭衰減與相位延遲」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Tidal-head attenuation and phase lag”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 潮汐水頭衰減與相位延遲
knowledge.text: 海岸潮汐可使地下水壓力週期變化，離岸距離增加時振幅可能衰減並產生相位延遲。這種訊號提供水力參數的線索，但壓力潮汐並不等於鹽水隨每個週期同距離進退。
knowledge.textEn: Coastal tides can drive periodic groundwater pressure with attenuation and phase delay inland. These signals inform hydraulic behavior but do not mean saltwater moves the same distance each cycle.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：地下水壓力呈現潮汐週期，就表示海水前緣每個週期都移動到相同的觀測位置。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A tidal pressure cycle proves that the seawater front reaches the observation location during every cycle. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「潮汐水頭衰減與相位延遲」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Tidal-head attenuation and phase lag" is correct?
options: 地下水壓力呈現潮汐週期，就表示海水前緣每個週期都移動到相同的觀測位置。
海岸潮汐可使地下水壓力週期變化，離岸距離增加時振幅可能衰減並產生相位延遲。
任何海岸含水層只要水位高出海面一公尺，實際鹽水界面就必定精確位於四十公尺深。
optionsEn: A tidal pressure cycle proves that the seawater front reaches the observation location during every cycle.
Coastal tides can drive periodic groundwater pressure with attenuation and phase delay inland.
Every coastal aquifer with one metre of freshwater head has an actual interface exactly forty metres deep.
quiz.explanation: 海岸潮汐可使地下水壓力週期變化，離岸距離增加時振幅可能衰減並產生相位延遲。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Coastal tides can drive periodic groundwater pressure with attenuation and phase delay inland. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 潮汐水頭衰減與相位延遲：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Tidal-head attenuation and phase lag: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「潮汐水頭衰減與相位延遲」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Tidal-head attenuation and phase lag” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設一維受壓半無限含水層，D=10000 m²/day、潮週期0.50 day；ω=2π/0.50，衰減長度δ=√(2D/ω)=39.894 m。在x=40 m，振幅比exp(−x/δ)=0.3669，相位延遲1.0027 rad。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For an ideal one-dimensional semi-infinite confined aquifer, diffusivity 10000 m²/day and period 0.50 day give angular frequency 2π/0.50 and attenuation length 39.894 m. At 40 m, amplitude ratio is 0.3669 and phase lag 1.0027 radians. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對潮位與井壓時間戳及取樣頻率，以相同週期分量比較振幅和相位，避免把日平均資料拿來解半日潮。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check tide and well-pressure timestamps and sampling frequency, comparing the same periodic component rather than applying daily averages to semidiurnal tides.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設一維受壓半無限含水層，D=10000 m²/day、潮週期0.50 day；ω=2π/0.50，衰減長度δ=√(2D/ω)=39.894 m。在x=40 m，振幅比exp(−x/δ)=0.3669，相位延遲1.0027 rad。
knowledge.textEn: For an ideal one-dimensional semi-infinite confined aquifer, diffusivity 10000 m²/day and period 0.50 day give angular frequency 2π/0.50 and attenuation length 39.894 m. At 40 m, amplitude ratio is 0.3669 and phase lag 1.0027 radians.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「潮汐水頭衰減與相位延遲」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Tidal-head attenuation and phase lag", which statement holds?
options: 達西通量與孔隙中的平均水流速度永遠相同，不需要知道有效孔隙率。
兩個注入源各自造成的絕對水頭可以直接相加，不必扣除重複的背景水頭。
教學假設一維受壓半無限含水層，D=10000 m²/day、潮週期0.50 day；ω=2π/0.50，衰減長度δ=√(2D/ω)=39.894 m。
optionsEn: Darcy flux always equals average pore-water velocity without any need for effective porosity.
Absolute heads from two injection sources can be added directly without removing duplicated background head.
For an ideal one-dimensional semi-infinite confined aquifer, diffusivity 10000 m²/day and period 0.50 day give angular frequency 2π/0.50 and attenuation length 39.894 m.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設一維受壓半無限含水層，D=10000 m²/day、潮週期0.50 day；ω=2π/0.50，衰減長度δ=√(2D/ω)=39.894 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: For an ideal one-dimensional semi-infinite confined aquifer, diffusivity 10000 m²/day and period 0.50 day give angular frequency 2π/0.50 and attenuation length 39.894 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 潮汐水頭衰減與相位延遲：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Tidal-head attenuation and phase lag: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「潮汐水頭衰減與相位延遲」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Tidal-head attenuation and phase lag” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對潮位與井壓時間戳及取樣頻率，以相同週期分量比較振幅和相位，避免把日平均資料拿來解半日潮。再檢查多個距離的衰減是否一致，並將抽水及大氣壓紀錄列為競爭解釋，確認擬合不是時間錯位造成。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check tide and well-pressure timestamps and sampling frequency, comparing the same periodic component rather than applying daily averages to semidiurnal tides. Examine attenuation across multiple distances and consider pumping and atmospheric pressure as alternative explanations, verifying that apparent phase lag is not merely clock error. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把潮週期加倍，保持擴散率和距離不變，重算衰減長度、振幅比與相位。另加入十分鐘時鐘偏差，換算造成的相位誤差，說明資料同步與物理參數估計之間的關係，並區分壓力模型與鹽度驗證。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Double tidal period with diffusivity and distance fixed, recalculating attenuation length, amplitude ratio and phase. Add a ten-minute clock offset and convert it to phase error, explaining how synchronization affects inference while keeping hydraulic modeling distinct from salinity verification.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：不同儀器時鐘未同步，會產生假的相位延遲，進而扭曲推估的擴散率。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Unsynchronized clocks create artificial phase lag and distort inferred diffusivity. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 核對潮位與井壓時間戳及取樣頻率，以相同週期分量比較振幅和相位，避免把日平均資料拿來解半日潮。再檢查多個距離的衰減是否一致，並將抽水及大氣壓紀錄列為競爭解釋，確認擬合不是時間錯位造成。
knowledge.textEn: Check tide and well-pressure timestamps and sampling frequency, comparing the same periodic component rather than applying daily averages to semidiurnal tides. Examine attenuation across multiple distances and consider pumping and atmospheric pressure as alternative explanations, verifying that apparent phase lag is not merely clock error.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 把潮週期加倍，保持擴散率和距離不變，重算衰減長度、振幅比與相位。另加入十分鐘時鐘偏差，換算造成的相位誤差，說明資料同步與物理參數估計之間的關係，並區分壓力模型與鹽度驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Double tidal period with diffusivity and distance fixed, recalculating attenuation length, amplitude ratio and phase. Add a ten-minute clock offset and convert it to phase error, explaining how synchronization affects inference while keeping hydraulic modeling distinct from salinity verification.

quiz.question: 要驗證「潮汐水頭衰減與相位延遲」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Tidal-head attenuation and phase lag"?
options: 核對潮位與井壓時間戳及取樣頻率，以相同週期分量比較振幅和相位，避免把日平均資料拿來解半日潮。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
注入能力下降一定只代表細砂堵塞，因此不必檢查區域水位、密度或儀器校正。
optionsEn: Check tide and well-pressure timestamps and sampling frequency, comparing the same periodic component rather than applying daily averages to semidiurnal tides.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Declining injectivity always means sand clogging, so regional head, density and calibration need no review.
quiz.explanation: 核對潮位與井壓時間戳及取樣頻率，以相同週期分量比較振幅和相位，避免把日平均資料拿來解半日潮。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check tide and well-pressure timestamps and sampling frequency, comparing the same periodic component rather than applying daily averages to semidiurnal tides. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 潮汐水頭衰減與相位延遲：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Tidal-head attenuation and phase lag: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「潮汐水頭衰減與相位延遲」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Tidal-head attenuation and phase lag” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 不同儀器時鐘未同步，會產生假的相位延遲，進而扭曲推估的擴散率。即使壓力週期擬合良好，也不能省略鹽度監測，因為壓力訊號與溶質前緣屬於不同的物理過程。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Unsynchronized clocks create artificial phase lag and distort inferred diffusivity. Even a strong pressure-cycle fit cannot replace salinity monitoring, because hydraulic signals and solute fronts describe different physical processes and require distinct supporting observations. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：學徒應先理解振幅比和相位的量綱，再以多點資料檢查模型是否合理，而不是只用一口井擬合出漂亮曲線就宣稱掌握入侵範圍。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Understand amplitude ratios and phase dimensions, then compare multiple observations rather than treating a good fit at one well as proof of the saltwater-intrusion extent.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「地下水壓力呈現潮汐週期，就表示海水前緣每個週期都移動到相同的觀測位置。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A tidal pressure cycle proves that the seawater front reaches the observation location during every cycle." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 不同儀器時鐘未同步，會產生假的相位延遲，進而扭曲推估的擴散率。即使壓力週期擬合良好，也不能省略鹽度監測，因為壓力訊號與溶質前緣屬於不同的物理過程。
knowledge.textEn: Unsynchronized clocks create artificial phase lag and distort inferred diffusivity. Even a strong pressure-cycle fit cannot replace salinity monitoring, because hydraulic signals and solute fronts describe different physical processes and require distinct supporting observations.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「潮汐水頭衰減與相位延遲」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Tidal-head attenuation and phase lag" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
不同儀器時鐘未同步，會產生假的相位延遲，進而扭曲推估的擴散率。
任何海岸含水層只要水位高出海面一公尺，實際鹽水界面就必定精確位於四十公尺深。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Unsynchronized clocks create artificial phase lag and distort inferred diffusivity.
Every coastal aquifer with one metre of freshwater head has an actual interface exactly forty metres deep.
quiz.explanation: 不同儀器時鐘未同步，會產生假的相位延遲，進而扭曲推估的擴散率。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Unsynchronized clocks create artificial phase lag and distort inferred diffusivity. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 雨水貯留與非飲用供水
summary: 從屋頂降雨到使用端水量帳，逐步檢查雨水貯留系統的容量、時序與服務可靠度。十個原創單元包含初期分流、儲槽溢流、乾旱自主時間、抽水能耗與感測不確定度，並明確分開水力估算及水質用途驗證。以舊金山公用事業總部與Fort Buchanan官方案例作比較，不把不同設施的處理配置混為一談。
summaryEn: Follow roof rainfall through storage to end-use accounting, checking capacity, timing and service reliability. Ten original units cover diversion, overflow, dry-period autonomy, pumping energy and measurement uncertainty while separating hydraulic estimates from water-quality suitability. Official SFPUC headquarters and Fort Buchanan cases support comparison without treating their distinct treatment arrangements as interchangeable.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
subcategoryTitle: 海岸、港灣與水資源韌性

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 教學假設五百平方公尺屋頂接受二十毫米降雨，體積逕流係數0.80得到8.0 m³。再從這個已算出的逕流量另扣0.5 m³分流，剩7.5 m³進槽；不能把同一初損再扣一次。若只改係數為0.60，扣分流前變成6.0 m³，比原先少25%。另取容量10 m³、初始4 m³的儲槽，先進水8 m³後用水3 m³，溢流2 m³而期末7 m³。這是另一個時序算例，不與前一個分流事件混帳。請逐一列出邊界、時段和所有去向，讓第三人能以守恆式重算。
workedExample.textEn: Assume a five-hundred-square-metre roof receives twenty millimetres of rain with volumetric coefficient 0.80, yielding 8.0 m³. Separately divert 0.5 m³ from that calculated runoff, leaving 7.5 m³ for storage without subtracting the same initial loss twice. Changing only the coefficient to 0.60 gives 6.0 m³ before diversion, twenty-five percent lower. In a separate sequencing example, a 10 m³ tank initially holds 4 m³, receives 8 m³ and then supplies 3 m³, overflowing 2 m³ and ending at 7 m³. Do not merge these distinct event assumptions. List boundaries, intervals and every destination so another reader can independently reproduce all the conservation equations.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「屋頂集水與逕流體積」與「初期分流與可利用水量」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Roof catchment and runoff volume" and "Initial diversion and usable yield": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 屋頂集水與逕流體積：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Roof catchment and runoff volume: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「屋頂集水與逕流體積」如何影響雨水貯留與非飲用供水的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Roof catchment and runoff volume” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Rainwater storage and nonpotable supply”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 屋頂雨水量的第一個估算是水平投影集水面積乘以降雨深度，再以逕流係數表示濕潤、附著與其他初期損失的綜合影響。斜屋面的實際鋪面面積不能直接代替水平受雨面積，雨量站的位置也可能無法代表整片屋頂。單一係數是指定事件或期間的近似，不能同時當作峰值流量、污染去除率與設備效率。建立集水區邊界時應將不接入水槽的屋面另列，並區分屋頂雨水與地面暴雨逕流，因為它們的污染來源和輸送路徑不相同。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「屋頂集水與逕流體積」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A first roof-yield estimate multiplies horizontal catchment area by rainfall depth and a runoff coefficient representing combined wetting and other losses. Sloping roof surface area is not the same as horizontal receiving area, and a distant gauge may not represent local rain. One coefficient approximates a specified event or period; it is not simultaneously a peak-flow factor, pollutant-removal efficiency and equipment efficiency. Delineate disconnected roof areas and distinguish rooftop rain from ground-level storm runoff with different contaminant pathways. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Roof catchment and runoff volume” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設水平屋頂面積500 m²、事件降雨20 mm與體積逕流係數0.80；收集前逕流體積V=500×0.020×0.80=8.0 m³，尚未扣除後續分流與水槽溢流。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Assume a horizontal roof area of 500 m², event rainfall 20 mm and volumetric runoff coefficient 0.80.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要知道屋頂鋪面總面積，就能把它全部當作有效水平集水面積。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The total sloping roof surface area always equals effective horizontal catchment area." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「屋頂集水與逕流體積」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Roof catchment and runoff volume”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 屋頂集水與逕流體積
knowledge.text: 屋頂雨水量的第一個估算是水平投影集水面積乘以降雨深度，再以逕流係數表示濕潤、附著與其他初期損失的綜合影響。斜屋面的實際鋪面面積不能直接代替水平受雨面積，雨量站的位置也可能無法代表整片屋頂。
knowledge.textEn: A first roof-yield estimate multiplies horizontal catchment area by rainfall depth and a runoff coefficient representing combined wetting and other losses. Sloping roof surface area is not the same as horizontal receiving area, and a distant gauge may not represent local rain.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要知道屋頂鋪面總面積，就能把它全部當作有效水平集水面積。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The total sloping roof surface area always equals effective horizontal catchment area. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「屋頂集水與逕流體積」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Roof catchment and runoff volume" is correct?
options: 只要知道屋頂鋪面總面積，就能把它全部當作有效水平集水面積。
屋頂雨水量的第一個估算是水平投影集水面積乘以降雨深度，再以逕流係數表示濕潤、附著與其他初期損失的綜合影響。
初期分流達到某個固定體積後，剩餘雨水就一定符合所有非飲用用途要求。
optionsEn: The total sloping roof surface area always equals effective horizontal catchment area.
A first roof-yield estimate multiplies horizontal catchment area by rainfall depth and a runoff coefficient representing combined wetting and other losses.
After a fixed initial diversion, remaining rainwater automatically meets every nonpotable-use requirement.
quiz.explanation: 屋頂雨水量的第一個估算是水平投影集水面積乘以降雨深度，再以逕流係數表示濕潤、附著與其他初期損失的綜合影響。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A first roof-yield estimate multiplies horizontal catchment area by rainfall depth and a runoff coefficient representing combined wetting and other losses. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 屋頂集水與逕流體積：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Roof catchment and runoff volume: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「屋頂集水與逕流體積」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Roof catchment and runoff volume” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設水平屋頂面積500 m²、事件降雨20 mm與體積逕流係數0.80；收集前逕流體積V=500×0.020×0.80=8.0 m³，尚未扣除後續分流與水槽溢流。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Assume a horizontal roof area of 500 m², event rainfall 20 mm and volumetric runoff coefficient 0.80. Runoff is V=500×0.020×0.80=8.0 m³ before diversion and tank overflow. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：沿排水分區核對屋頂水平面積與實際接管，將雨量站累積值與量測時段對齊。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check horizontal areas and connected downpipes by drainage zone, aligning rainfall totals with meter intervals.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設水平屋頂面積500 m²、事件降雨20 mm與體積逕流係數0.80；收集前逕流體積V=500×0.020×0.80=8.0 m³，尚未扣除後續分流與水槽溢流。
knowledge.textEn: Assume a horizontal roof area of 500 m², event rainfall 20 mm and volumetric runoff coefficient 0.80. Runoff is V=500×0.020×0.80=8.0 m³ before diversion and tank overflow.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「屋頂集水與逕流體積」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Roof catchment and runoff volume", which statement holds?
options: 供水日數可靠度是百分之七十五，就代表全年需求水量也一定滿足百分之七十五。
雨水是免費降下來的，所以抽水和處理過程必定不會消耗能源。
教學假設水平屋頂面積500 m²、事件降雨20 mm與體積逕流係數0.80。
optionsEn: Seventy-five-percent daily reliability always means seventy-five percent of demand volume is supplied.
Because rainfall is free, pumping and treating collected rainwater necessarily require no energy.
Assume a horizontal roof area of 500 m², event rainfall 20 mm and volumetric runoff coefficient 0.80.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設水平屋頂面積500 m²、事件降雨20 mm與體積逕流係數0.80；收集前逕流體積V=500×0.020×0.80=8.0 m³，尚未扣除後續分流與水槽溢流。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Assume a horizontal roof area of 500 m², event rainfall 20 mm and volumetric runoff coefficient 0.80. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 屋頂集水與逕流體積：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Roof catchment and runoff volume: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「屋頂集水與逕流體積」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Roof catchment and runoff volume” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 沿排水分區核對屋頂水平面積與實際接管，將雨量站累積值與量測時段對齊。以多場事件比較入口水量計和計算值，分別觀察短小降雨與長時間降雨的偏差，並保留屋頂維修或新增遮蔽物的日期以解釋係數變化。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check horizontal areas and connected downpipes by drainage zone, aligning rainfall totals with meter intervals. Compare measured inlet volumes across short and prolonged events, recording roof maintenance and new obstructions so that changing collection performance can be traced to physical changes. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：畫出四個屋頂排水分區，分別標示水平面積與接管去向。把其中一區改為排入一般雨水管後重算集水量，再將逕流係數從零點八降到零點六，說明面積與係數的不確定度如何分別影響估算。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Draw four roof drainage zones with horizontal areas and outlet destinations. Disconnect one zone and recalculate yield, then lower the runoff coefficient from 0.8 to 0.6 to distinguish the effects of catchment definition and coefficient uncertainty.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把傾斜屋面的鋪面面積當成受雨投影面積，會高估可收水量。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using sloping surface area overstates rainfall capture. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 沿排水分區核對屋頂水平面積與實際接管，將雨量站累積值與量測時段對齊。以多場事件比較入口水量計和計算值，分別觀察短小降雨與長時間降雨的偏差，並保留屋頂維修或新增遮蔽物的日期以解釋係數變化。
knowledge.textEn: Check horizontal areas and connected downpipes by drainage zone, aligning rainfall totals with meter intervals. Compare measured inlet volumes across short and prolonged events, recording roof maintenance and new obstructions so that changing collection performance can be traced to physical changes.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 畫出四個屋頂排水分區，分別標示水平面積與接管去向。把其中一區改為排入一般雨水管後重算集水量，再將逕流係數從零點八降到零點六，說明面積與係數的不確定度如何分別影響估算。
knowledge.textEn: Draw four roof drainage zones with horizontal areas and outlet destinations. Disconnect one zone and recalculate yield, then lower the runoff coefficient from 0.8 to 0.6 to distinguish the effects of catchment definition and coefficient uncertainty.

quiz.question: 要驗證「屋頂集水與逕流體積」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Roof catchment and runoff volume"?
options: 沿排水分區核對屋頂水平面積與實際接管，將雨量站累積值與量測時段對齊。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
當累積出水量等於水槽容積時，槽內每一滴舊水就必定已經排出。
optionsEn: Check horizontal areas and connected downpipes by drainage zone, aligning rainfall totals with meter intervals.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Once cumulative outflow equals tank volume, every original water parcel has necessarily left.
quiz.explanation: 沿排水分區核對屋頂水平面積與實際接管，將雨量站累積值與量測時段對齊。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check horizontal areas and connected downpipes by drainage zone, aligning rainfall totals with meter intervals. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 屋頂集水與逕流體積：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Roof catchment and runoff volume: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「屋頂集水與逕流體積」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Roof catchment and runoff volume” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把傾斜屋面的鋪面面積當成受雨投影面積，會高估可收水量。若再忽略未接管區域及入口溢流，帳面水源可能足夠，水槽卻經常無法補滿；這不是單靠放大儲水槽就能修正的問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using sloping surface area overstates rainfall capture. Ignoring disconnected areas and inlet bypasses can make theoretical supply appear adequate while tanks remain underfilled; increasing tank size does not repair an incorrectly defined catchment. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：建立集水區邊界時應將不接入水槽的屋面另列，並區分屋頂雨水與地面暴雨逕流，因為它們的污染來源和輸送路徑不相同。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Delineate disconnected roof areas and distinguish rooftop rain from ground-level storm runoff with different contaminant pathways.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要知道屋頂鋪面總面積，就能把它全部當作有效水平集水面積。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The total sloping roof surface area always equals effective horizontal catchment area." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把傾斜屋面的鋪面面積當成受雨投影面積，會高估可收水量。若再忽略未接管區域及入口溢流，帳面水源可能足夠，水槽卻經常無法補滿；這不是單靠放大儲水槽就能修正的問題。
knowledge.textEn: Using sloping surface area overstates rainfall capture. Ignoring disconnected areas and inlet bypasses can make theoretical supply appear adequate while tanks remain underfilled; increasing tank size does not repair an incorrectly defined catchment.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「屋頂集水與逕流體積」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Roof catchment and runoff volume" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
把傾斜屋面的鋪面面積當成受雨投影面積，會高估可收水量。
初期分流達到某個固定體積後，剩餘雨水就一定符合所有非飲用用途要求。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Using sloping surface area overstates rainfall capture.
After a fixed initial diversion, remaining rainwater automatically meets every nonpotable-use requirement.
quiz.explanation: 把傾斜屋面的鋪面面積當成受雨投影面積，會高估可收水量。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using sloping surface area overstates rainfall capture. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 初期分流與可利用水量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Initial diversion and usable yield: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「初期分流與可利用水量」如何影響雨水貯留與非飲用供水的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Initial diversion and usable yield” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Rainwater storage and nonpotable supply”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 初期雨水分流會犧牲部分收集量，以改變進入儲槽的污染負荷，但固定體積分流不能證明所有污染已被移除。乾旱間隔、落塵、鳥類活動與屋面材料都會改變污染在事件中的分布。計算可利用水量時，應明確說明分流量是在逕流係數計算之前還是之後扣除，避免把同一損失算兩次。分流裝置的復位和剩餘水也會影響下一場事件，因此不能只檢查名目容積，還需知道每次事件實際進入與離開裝置的水量。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「初期分流與可利用水量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Initial diversion sacrifices some collected water and changes the contaminant load entering storage, but a fixed diverted volume does not prove complete contaminant removal. Dry intervals, deposition, wildlife and roof materials alter within-event loading. State whether diversion is subtracted before or after the runoff coefficient to avoid double-counting losses. Reset behavior and retained water affect the next event, so nominal vessel capacity alone is insufficient; record actual diversion and discharge for each event instead. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Initial diversion and usable yield” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設從已計得8.0 m³屋頂逕流中，另分流0.5 m³；進槽量為7.5 m³。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Assume 0.5 m³ is diverted from an already calculated 8.0 m³ runoff volume, leaving 7.5 m³.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「初期分流達到某個固定體積後，剩餘雨水就一定符合所有非飲用用途要求。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "After a fixed initial diversion, remaining rainwater automatically meets every nonpotable-use requirement." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「初期分流與可利用水量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Initial diversion and usable yield”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 初期分流與可利用水量
knowledge.text: 初期雨水分流會犧牲部分收集量，以改變進入儲槽的污染負荷，但固定體積分流不能證明所有污染已被移除。乾旱間隔、落塵、鳥類活動與屋面材料都會改變污染在事件中的分布。
knowledge.textEn: Initial diversion sacrifices some collected water and changes the contaminant load entering storage, but a fixed diverted volume does not prove complete contaminant removal. Dry intervals, deposition, wildlife and roof materials alter within-event loading.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：初期分流達到某個固定體積後，剩餘雨水就一定符合所有非飲用用途要求。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: After a fixed initial diversion, remaining rainwater automatically meets every nonpotable-use requirement. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「初期分流與可利用水量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Initial diversion and usable yield" is correct?
options: 初期分流達到某個固定體積後，剩餘雨水就一定符合所有非飲用用途要求。
每日雨量和用水總量相同時，入流與需求的時間順序完全不會影響溢流。
初期雨水分流會犧牲部分收集量，以改變進入儲槽的污染負荷，但固定體積分流不能證明所有污染已被移除。
optionsEn: After a fixed initial diversion, remaining rainwater automatically meets every nonpotable-use requirement.
With equal daily rainfall and demand totals, event ordering never affects overflow.
Initial diversion sacrifices some collected water and changes the contaminant load entering storage, but a fixed diverted volume does not prove complete contaminant removal.
quiz.explanation: 初期雨水分流會犧牲部分收集量，以改變進入儲槽的污染負荷，但固定體積分流不能證明所有污染已被移除。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Initial diversion sacrifices some collected water and changes the contaminant load entering storage, but a fixed diverted volume does not prove complete contaminant removal. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 初期分流與可利用水量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Initial diversion and usable yield: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「初期分流與可利用水量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Initial diversion and usable yield” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設從已計得8.0 m³屋頂逕流中，另分流0.5 m³；進槽量為7.5 m³。對500 m²集水面積，0.5 m³相當於1 mm逕流深度，僅為算例而非建議設定。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Assume 0.5 m³ is diverted from an already calculated 8.0 m³ runoff volume, leaving 7.5 m³. Over 500 m², diversion equals 1 mm of runoff depth; this is not a recommended setting. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以事件水量表分開記錄屋頂逕流、初期分流、入口旁通及真正進槽量。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Keep separate event records for runoff, initial diversion, bypass and tank inflow.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設從已計得8.0 m³屋頂逕流中，另分流0.5 m³；進槽量為7.5 m³。對500 m²集水面積，0.5 m³相當於1 mm逕流深度，僅為算例而非建議設定。
knowledge.textEn: Assume 0.5 m³ is diverted from an already calculated 8.0 m³ runoff volume, leaving 7.5 m³. Over 500 m², diversion equals 1 mm of runoff depth; this is not a recommended setting.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「初期分流與可利用水量」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Initial diversion and usable yield", which statement holds?
options: 教學假設從已計得8.0 m³屋頂逕流中，另分流0.5 m³；進槽量為7.5 m³。
儲槽名目容量除以全年平均需求，就一定是任何乾旱期間都能保證的自主天數。
濾網前後水頭損失越小，就能證明它的污染物去除能力越好。
optionsEn: Assume 0.5 m³ is diverted from an already calculated 8.0 m³ runoff volume, leaving 7.5 m³.
Nominal tank capacity divided by annual average demand guarantees autonomy during every drought.
A smaller pressure loss across a screen proves better pollutant-removal performance.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設從已計得8.0 m³屋頂逕流中，另分流0.5 m³；進槽量為7.5 m³。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Assume 0.5 m³ is diverted from an already calculated 8.0 m³ runoff volume, leaving 7.5 m³. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 初期分流與可利用水量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Initial diversion and usable yield: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「初期分流與可利用水量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Initial diversion and usable yield” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以事件水量表分開記錄屋頂逕流、初期分流、入口旁通及真正進槽量。檢查裝置在前後兩場雨之間是否完成預定復位，並用適合用途的獨立水質採樣比較分流前後，不能以顏色變清或水量公式代替處理效果證據。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Keep separate event records for runoff, initial diversion, bypass and tank inflow. Check intended reset behavior between storms and compare appropriate independent water-quality samples before and after diversion; clearer appearance or a volume calculation does not establish treatment performance. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：為兩場相隔不同乾旱天數的合成降雨建立水量表，保持相同分流體積但改變污染負荷分布。說明相同可利用水量為何不代表相同水質，並提出一項能檢查裝置是否復位的紀錄欄位。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Build water balances for two synthetic storms with different dry intervals. Keep diversion volume constant while changing contaminant loading, explain why equal usable volumes need not have equal quality, and define a record that checks device reset.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若把分流體積與已包含相同初損的逕流係數重複扣除，會低估供水量；若裝置未復位卻仍假設每場雨都分流，則可能高估水質控制效果。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Double-counting diversion within an already loss-adjusted coefficient underestimates supply. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以事件水量表分開記錄屋頂逕流、初期分流、入口旁通及真正進槽量。檢查裝置在前後兩場雨之間是否完成預定復位，並用適合用途的獨立水質採樣比較分流前後，不能以顏色變清或水量公式代替處理效果證據。
knowledge.textEn: Keep separate event records for runoff, initial diversion, bypass and tank inflow. Check intended reset behavior between storms and compare appropriate independent water-quality samples before and after diversion; clearer appearance or a volume calculation does not establish treatment performance.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 為兩場相隔不同乾旱天數的合成降雨建立水量表，保持相同分流體積但改變污染負荷分布。說明相同可利用水量為何不代表相同水質，並提出一項能檢查裝置是否復位的紀錄欄位。
knowledge.textEn: Build water balances for two synthetic storms with different dry intervals. Keep diversion volume constant while changing contaminant loading, explain why equal usable volumes need not have equal quality, and define a record that checks device reset.

quiz.question: 要驗證「初期分流與可利用水量」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Initial diversion and usable yield"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以事件水量表分開記錄屋頂逕流、初期分流、入口旁通及真正進槽量。
只要正常時飲用側壓力較高，就永遠不需要考慮非飲用水回流。
