optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Keep separate event records for runoff, initial diversion, bypass and tank inflow.
Higher potable-side pressure during normal operation permanently eliminates reverse-flow concerns.
quiz.explanation: 以事件水量表分開記錄屋頂逕流、初期分流、入口旁通及真正進槽量。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Keep separate event records for runoff, initial diversion, bypass and tank inflow. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 初期分流與可利用水量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Initial diversion and usable yield: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「初期分流與可利用水量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Initial diversion and usable yield” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若把分流體積與已包含相同初損的逕流係數重複扣除，會低估供水量；若裝置未復位卻仍假設每場雨都分流，則可能高估水質控制效果。水量估算和水質驗證應各有證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Double-counting diversion within an already loss-adjusted coefficient underestimates supply. Assuming diversion occurs when the device has not reset can overstate quality control, so water balance and treatment performance require separate supporting evidence. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：分流裝置的復位和剩餘水也會影響下一場事件，因此不能只檢查名目容積，還需知道每次事件實際進入與離開裝置的水量。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Reset behavior and retained water affect the next event, so nominal vessel capacity alone is insufficient; record actual diversion and discharge for each event instead.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「初期分流達到某個固定體積後，剩餘雨水就一定符合所有非飲用用途要求。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "After a fixed initial diversion, remaining rainwater automatically meets every nonpotable-use requirement." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若把分流體積與已包含相同初損的逕流係數重複扣除，會低估供水量；若裝置未復位卻仍假設每場雨都分流，則可能高估水質控制效果。水量估算和水質驗證應各有證據。
knowledge.textEn: Double-counting diversion within an already loss-adjusted coefficient underestimates supply. Assuming diversion occurs when the device has not reset can overstate quality control, so water balance and treatment performance require separate supporting evidence.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「初期分流與可利用水量」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Initial diversion and usable yield" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
每日雨量和用水總量相同時，入流與需求的時間順序完全不會影響溢流。
若把分流體積與已包含相同初損的逕流係數重複扣除，會低估供水量；若裝置未復位卻仍假設每場雨都分流，則可能高估水質控制效果。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
With equal daily rainfall and demand totals, event ordering never affects overflow.
Double-counting diversion within an already loss-adjusted coefficient underestimates supply.
quiz.explanation: 若把分流體積與已包含相同初損的逕流係數重複扣除，會低估供水量；若裝置未復位卻仍假設每場雨都分流，則可能高估水質控制效果。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Double-counting diversion within an already loss-adjusted coefficient underestimates supply. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 水力機制、材料與定量模型
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「有限儲槽與事件時序」與「供水日數與供水量可靠度」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Finite storage and event ordering" and "Time-based and volumetric reliability": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 有限儲槽與事件時序：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Finite storage and event ordering: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「有限儲槽與事件時序」如何影響雨水貯留與非飲用供水的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Finite storage and event ordering” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Rainwater storage and nonpotable supply”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 儲水槽容量有限，入流、溢流與需求發生的先後會影響最後可利用的水量。每日總雨量和總需求相同，仍可能因下雨與用水時間不同而得到不同溢流。計算時應選擇足以辨識重要事件的時間步長，並明確列出先進水後用水或逐時同步計算的假設。容量限制只能截住儲量，超出的水必須作為溢流保留在水量帳中，不能直接消失；同樣地，需求超過存水時應記錄未滿足需求，而不是容許儲量變成負值。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「有限儲槽與事件時序」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Finite tank capacity makes the order of inflow, overflow and demand consequential. Equal daily rainfall and demand totals can yield different overflow when their timing changes. Choose a time step resolving important events and state whether inflow precedes demand or is integrated concurrently. Capacity limits constrain storage but do not erase excess water: overflow remains in the balance. When demand exceeds available water, record unmet demand instead of allowing negative storage or silently inventing additional supply. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Finite storage and event ordering” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設容量10 m³、初始4 m³，先一次進水8 m³再用水3 m³；進水後溢流2 m³，期末存水7 m³。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Assume capacity 10 m³ and initial storage 4 m³, with 8 m³ inflow before 3 m³ demand.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「每日雨量和用水總量相同時，入流與需求的時間順序完全不會影響溢流。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "With equal daily rainfall and demand totals, event ordering never affects overflow." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「有限儲槽與事件時序」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Finite storage and event ordering”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 有限儲槽與事件時序
knowledge.text: 儲水槽容量有限，入流、溢流與需求發生的先後會影響最後可利用的水量。每日總雨量和總需求相同，仍可能因下雨與用水時間不同而得到不同溢流。
knowledge.textEn: Finite tank capacity makes the order of inflow, overflow and demand consequential. Equal daily rainfall and demand totals can yield different overflow when their timing changes.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：每日雨量和用水總量相同時，入流與需求的時間順序完全不會影響溢流。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: With equal daily rainfall and demand totals, event ordering never affects overflow. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「有限儲槽與事件時序」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Finite storage and event ordering" is correct?
options: 儲水槽容量有限，入流、溢流與需求發生的先後會影響最後可利用的水量。
每日雨量和用水總量相同時，入流與需求的時間順序完全不會影響溢流。
供水日數可靠度是百分之七十五，就代表全年需求水量也一定滿足百分之七十五。
optionsEn: Finite tank capacity makes the order of inflow, overflow and demand consequential.
With equal daily rainfall and demand totals, event ordering never affects overflow.
Seventy-five-percent daily reliability always means seventy-five percent of demand volume is supplied.
quiz.explanation: 儲水槽容量有限，入流、溢流與需求發生的先後會影響最後可利用的水量。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Finite tank capacity makes the order of inflow, overflow and demand consequential. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 有限儲槽與事件時序：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Finite storage and event ordering: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「有限儲槽與事件時序」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Finite storage and event ordering” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設容量10 m³、初始4 m³，先一次進水8 m³再用水3 m³；進水後溢流2 m³，期末存水7 m³。守恆為4+8=2+3+7，僅適用明列的事件順序。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Assume capacity 10 m³ and initial storage 4 m³, with 8 m³ inflow before 3 m³ demand. Overflow is 2 m³ and final storage 7 m³; 4+8=2+3+7 for this stated order. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：逐步列出期初存水、入流、溢流、實際供水、未滿足需求與期末存水，對每一步檢查守恆。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Tabulate initial storage, inflow, overflow, delivered demand, unmet demand and final storage, checking each balance.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設容量10 m³、初始4 m³，先一次進水8 m³再用水3 m³；進水後溢流2 m³，期末存水7 m³。守恆為4+8=2+3+7，僅適用明列的事件順序。
knowledge.textEn: Assume capacity 10 m³ and initial storage 4 m³, with 8 m³ inflow before 3 m³ demand. Overflow is 2 m³ and final storage 7 m³; 4+8=2+3+7 for this stated order.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「有限儲槽與事件時序」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Finite storage and event ordering", which statement holds?
options: 雨水是免費降下來的，所以抽水和處理過程必定不會消耗能源。
教學假設容量10 m³、初始4 m³，先一次進水8 m³再用水3 m³；進水後溢流2 m³，期末存水7 m³。
當累積出水量等於水槽容積時，槽內每一滴舊水就必定已經排出。
optionsEn: Because rainfall is free, pumping and treating collected rainwater necessarily require no energy.
Assume capacity 10 m³ and initial storage 4 m³, with 8 m³ inflow before 3 m³ demand.
Once cumulative outflow equals tank volume, every original water parcel has necessarily left.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設容量10 m³、初始4 m³，先一次進水8 m³再用水3 m³；進水後溢流2 m³，期末存水7 m³。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Assume capacity 10 m³ and initial storage 4 m³, with 8 m³ inflow before 3 m³ demand. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 有限儲槽與事件時序：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Finite storage and event ordering: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「有限儲槽與事件時序」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Finite storage and event ordering” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 逐步列出期初存水、入流、溢流、實際供水、未滿足需求與期末存水，對每一步檢查守恆。用較短時間步長重算同一事件，確認溢流差異來自時序而非程式錯誤，並以水位容量曲線檢查感測水位轉換成體積的方式。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Tabulate initial storage, inflow, overflow, delivered demand, unmet demand and final storage, checking each balance. Repeat with finer timing to distinguish sequence effects from coding errors, and verify the level-to-volume conversion against the tank geometry rather than assuming constant area. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把算例改成先用水三立方公尺再進水八立方公尺，重算期末存水與溢流。接著改為每小時交錯進出水，說明哪一種時間解析度才能保留關鍵事件，並列出兩種順序都必須滿足的水量等式。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Reverse the example by using three cubic metres before receiving eight, then recalculate storage and overflow. Introduce alternating hourly inflow and demand, explaining the required temporal resolution and writing the balance equation that both event orders must satisfy.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：直接把一天總入流減總需求後再限制容量，可能把先前已溢出的水留在帳面上，造成虛假的供水能力。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Subtracting daily demand before imposing capacity can retain water that overflowed earlier, creating fictitious supply. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 逐步列出期初存水、入流、溢流、實際供水、未滿足需求與期末存水，對每一步檢查守恆。用較短時間步長重算同一事件，確認溢流差異來自時序而非程式錯誤，並以水位容量曲線檢查感測水位轉換成體積的方式。
knowledge.textEn: Tabulate initial storage, inflow, overflow, delivered demand, unmet demand and final storage, checking each balance. Repeat with finer timing to distinguish sequence effects from coding errors, and verify the level-to-volume conversion against the tank geometry rather than assuming constant area.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 把算例改成先用水三立方公尺再進水八立方公尺，重算期末存水與溢流。接著改為每小時交錯進出水，說明哪一種時間解析度才能保留關鍵事件，並列出兩種順序都必須滿足的水量等式。
knowledge.textEn: Reverse the example by using three cubic metres before receiving eight, then recalculate storage and overflow. Introduce alternating hourly inflow and demand, explaining the required temporal resolution and writing the balance equation that both event orders must satisfy.

quiz.question: 要驗證「有限儲槽與事件時序」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Finite storage and event ordering"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
儲槽出水表顯示的所有水量，都可以直接當作雨水替代自來水的節省量。
逐步列出期初存水、入流、溢流、實際供水、未滿足需求與期末存水，對每一步檢查守恆。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Every volume recorded at the tank outlet can be credited directly as rainwater substitution.
Tabulate initial storage, inflow, overflow, delivered demand, unmet demand and final storage, checking each balance.
quiz.explanation: 逐步列出期初存水、入流、溢流、實際供水、未滿足需求與期末存水，對每一步檢查守恆。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Tabulate initial storage, inflow, overflow, delivered demand, unmet demand and final storage, checking each balance. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 有限儲槽與事件時序：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Finite storage and event ordering: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「有限儲槽與事件時序」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Finite storage and event ordering” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 直接把一天總入流減總需求後再限制容量，可能把先前已溢出的水留在帳面上，造成虛假的供水能力。若水位計零點改變，期初期末存水差也可能看起來不守恆，需要另查幾何與校正。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Subtracting daily demand before imposing capacity can retain water that overflowed earlier, creating fictitious supply. A changed level-sensor zero can also mimic imbalance, requiring separate checks of tank geometry and instrument calibration. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：容量限制只能截住儲量，超出的水必須作為溢流保留在水量帳中，不能直接消失；同樣地，需求超過存水時應記錄未滿足需求，而不是容許儲量變成負值。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: When demand exceeds available water, record unmet demand instead of allowing negative storage or silently inventing additional supply.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「每日雨量和用水總量相同時，入流與需求的時間順序完全不會影響溢流。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "With equal daily rainfall and demand totals, event ordering never affects overflow." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.title: 供水日數與供水量可靠度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Time-based and volumetric reliability: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「供水日數與供水量可靠度」如何影響雨水貯留與非飲用供水的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Time-based and volumetric reliability” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Rainwater storage and nonpotable supply”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 雨水系統的可靠度必須先定義分母，否則不同指標可能被誤當成同一件事。完全滿足需求的天數比例描述使用者有多少天不需補充水源；總供水量占總需求量的比例則描述替代水量，兩者對高需求日的權重不同。研究期間若刻意避開乾季，任何可靠度都可能偏高。分析應使用對應用途的需求時序與降雨紀錄，並同時報告未滿足需求的頻率、總量及最長連續期間，讓短暫小缺水與長時間大缺水的差異清楚呈現。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「供水日數與供水量可靠度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Reliability requires an explicit denominator. The fraction of days with fully met demand describes service continuity, whereas delivered volume divided by total demand describes water substitution; high-demand days receive different weights. Excluding dry seasons can inflate either measure. Use rainfall and demand sequences matching the intended use and report shortage frequency, total shortage and the longest consecutive shortage period, distinguishing brief small deficits from prolonged large ones instead of presenting one unlabeled percentage. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Time-based and volumetric reliability” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設四日需求依序1、1、1、17 m³，實際供水1、1、1、7 m³；完全滿足日數比例3/4=75%，總量可靠度10/20=50%，兩者分母不同。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Assume four daily demands of 1, 1, 1 and 17 m³, with deliveries of 1, 1, 1 and 7 m³.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「供水日數可靠度是百分之七十五，就代表全年需求水量也一定滿足百分之七十五。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Seventy-five-percent daily reliability always means seventy-five percent of demand volume is supplied." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「供水日數與供水量可靠度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：供水日數可靠度是百分之七十五，就代表全年需求水量也一定滿足百分之七十五。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

steps.title: 供水日數與供水量可靠度：定量估算

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Time-based and volumetric reliability” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設四日需求依序1、1、1、17 m³，實際供水1、1、1、7 m³；完全滿足日數比例3/4=75%，總量可靠度10/20=50%，兩者分母不同。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Assume four daily demands of 1, 1, 1 and 17 m³, with deliveries of 1, 1, 1 and 7 m³. Fully served days are 75%, while volumetric reliability is 50%; denominators differ. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在報告中為每個百分比列出分子、分母、期間與需求定義，將乾季和雨季分開檢查。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: List numerator, denominator, period and demand definition for each percentage, examining wet and dry seasons separately.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: Assume four daily demands of 1, 1, 1 and 17 m³, with deliveries of 1, 1, 1 and 7 m³. Fully served days are 75%, while volumetric reliability is 50%; denominators differ.

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

optionsEn: A smaller pressure loss across a screen proves better pollutant-removal performance.
Higher potable-side pressure during normal operation permanently eliminates reverse-flow concerns.
Assume four daily demands of 1, 1, 1 and 17 m³, with deliveries of 1, 1, 1 and 7 m³.

steps.title: 供水日數與供水量可靠度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Time-based and volumetric reliability: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「供水日數與供水量可靠度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Time-based and volumetric reliability” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在報告中為每個百分比列出分子、分母、期間與需求定義，將乾季和雨季分開檢查。利用完整日序列尋找連續缺水天數，再核對備援水源實際供水是否被錯算成雨水替代量，避免把總服務可靠度與雨水自身貢獻混淆。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: List numerator, denominator, period and demand definition for each percentage, examining wet and dry seasons separately. Identify consecutive shortage days from the full sequence and check whether backup supply has been incorrectly credited to rainwater rather than overall service continuity. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.observationEn: Site practice: Split the largest demand into two smaller days while preserving total volume and compare reliability measures. Arrange identical shortage days consecutively and separately, explaining why equal aggregate scores can impose different backup requirements and proposing a supplementary metric.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只報告滿足日數比例，可能忽略少數高需求日的大量缺水；只報告年度替代量，也可能掩蓋連續乾旱時使用者完全依賴備援。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A high fraction of served days can conceal major deficits on a few demanding days. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

Arrange identical shortage days consecutively and separately, explaining why equal aggregate scores can impose different backup requirements and proposing a supplementary metric.

quiz.question: 在「供水日數與供水量可靠度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Time-based and volumetric reliability" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
只報告滿足日數比例，可能忽略少數高需求日的大量缺水；只報告年度替代量，也可能掩蓋連續乾旱時使用者完全依賴備援。
儲槽名目容量除以全年平均需求，就一定是任何乾旱期間都能保證的自主天數。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
A high fraction of served days can conceal major deficits on a few demanding days.
Nominal tank capacity divided by annual average demand guarantees autonomy during every drought.
quiz.explanation: 只報告滿足日數比例，可能忽略少數高需求日的大量缺水；只報告年度替代量，也可能掩蓋連續乾旱時使用者完全依賴備援。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A high fraction of served days can conceal major deficits on a few demanding days. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「乾旱自主時間與可用容積」與「抽水能耗與系統總揚程」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Dry-period autonomy and usable volume" and "Pumping energy and total dynamic head": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 乾旱自主時間與可用容積：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Dry-period autonomy and usable volume: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「乾旱自主時間與可用容積」如何影響雨水貯留與非飲用供水的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Dry-period autonomy and usable volume” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Rainwater storage and nonpotable supply”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 無雨期間可以支持多久，取決於真正可抽取容積與需求，而不只是水槽的外觀容量。底部沉積保留區、最低抽水水位與預留容量會減少可用水量；需求又可能隨氣候、使用人數或灌溉時段變動。用固定需求相除得到的自主天數，是特定假設下的簡化指標，不能當作乾旱發生機率或全年可靠度。若需求具有尖峰，還需確認輸送設備的瞬時能力，因此足夠的總容積也不保證每個使用時段都能供應。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「乾旱自主時間與可用容積」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Dry-period autonomy depends on extractable storage and demand, not merely the visible tank capacity. Sediment zones, minimum pumping levels and reserved volume reduce availability, while weather, occupancy and irrigation scheduling change consumption. Dividing by constant demand gives a conditional autonomy estimate, not a drought probability or annual reliability. Peak use also requires adequate delivery capacity, so sufficient total volume does not guarantee that every short demand interval can be served at the required rate. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Dry-period autonomy and usable volume” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設名目容量8 m³，其中2 m³不可抽取，固定需求0.75 m³/day且無入流；可用6 m³可支持6/0.75=8日。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Assume an 8 m³ tank with 2 m³ unavailable, no inflow and constant demand 0.75 m³/day.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「儲槽名目容量除以全年平均需求，就一定是任何乾旱期間都能保證的自主天數。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Nominal tank capacity divided by annual average demand guarantees autonomy during every drought." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「乾旱自主時間與可用容積」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Dry-period autonomy and usable volume”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 乾旱自主時間與可用容積
knowledge.text: 無雨期間可以支持多久，取決於真正可抽取容積與需求，而不只是水槽的外觀容量。底部沉積保留區、最低抽水水位與預留容量會減少可用水量；需求又可能隨氣候、使用人數或灌溉時段變動。
knowledge.textEn: Dry-period autonomy depends on extractable storage and demand, not merely the visible tank capacity. Sediment zones, minimum pumping levels and reserved volume reduce availability, while weather, occupancy and irrigation scheduling change consumption.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：儲槽名目容量除以全年平均需求，就一定是任何乾旱期間都能保證的自主天數。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Nominal tank capacity divided by annual average demand guarantees autonomy during every drought. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「乾旱自主時間與可用容積」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Dry-period autonomy and usable volume" is correct?
options: 儲槽名目容量除以全年平均需求，就一定是任何乾旱期間都能保證的自主天數。
雨水是免費降下來的，所以抽水和處理過程必定不會消耗能源。
無雨期間可以支持多久，取決於真正可抽取容積與需求，而不只是水槽的外觀容量。
optionsEn: Nominal tank capacity divided by annual average demand guarantees autonomy during every drought.
Because rainfall is free, pumping and treating collected rainwater necessarily require no energy.
Dry-period autonomy depends on extractable storage and demand, not merely the visible tank capacity.
quiz.explanation: 無雨期間可以支持多久，取決於真正可抽取容積與需求，而不只是水槽的外觀容量。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Dry-period autonomy depends on extractable storage and demand, not merely the visible tank capacity. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 乾旱自主時間與可用容積：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Dry-period autonomy and usable volume: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「乾旱自主時間與可用容積」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Dry-period autonomy and usable volume” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設名目容量8 m³，其中2 m³不可抽取，固定需求0.75 m³/day且無入流；可用6 m³可支持6/0.75=8日。若需求增至1 m³/day，自主時間降為6日。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Assume an 8 m³ tank with 2 m³ unavailable, no inflow and constant demand 0.75 m³/day. Usable volume supports eight days; increasing demand to 1 m³/day reduces autonomy to six days. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用實際水位容量曲線確認最低可用水位和沉積區，將名目容量、可抽取容量及保留量分列。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use the actual level-volume curve to separate nominal, extractable and reserved capacity.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設名目容量8 m³，其中2 m³不可抽取，固定需求0.75 m³/day且無入流；可用6 m³可支持6/0.75=8日。若需求增至1 m³/day，自主時間降為6日。
knowledge.textEn: Assume an 8 m³ tank with 2 m³ unavailable, no inflow and constant demand 0.75 m³/day. Usable volume supports eight days; increasing demand to 1 m³/day reduces autonomy to six days.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「乾旱自主時間與可用容積」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Dry-period autonomy and usable volume", which statement holds?
options: 教學假設名目容量8 m³，其中2 m³不可抽取，固定需求0.75 m³/day且無入流；可用6 m³可支持6/0.75=8日。
當累積出水量等於水槽容積時，槽內每一滴舊水就必定已經排出。
儲槽出水表顯示的所有水量，都可以直接當作雨水替代自來水的節省量。
optionsEn: Assume an 8 m³ tank with 2 m³ unavailable, no inflow and constant demand 0.75 m³/day.
Once cumulative outflow equals tank volume, every original water parcel has necessarily left.
Every volume recorded at the tank outlet can be credited directly as rainwater substitution.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設名目容量8 m³，其中2 m³不可抽取，固定需求0.75 m³/day且無入流；可用6 m³可支持6/0.75=8日。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Assume an 8 m³ tank with 2 m³ unavailable, no inflow and constant demand 0.75 m³/day. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 乾旱自主時間與可用容積：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Dry-period autonomy and usable volume: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「乾旱自主時間與可用容積」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Dry-period autonomy and usable volume” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用實際水位容量曲線確認最低可用水位和沉積區，將名目容量、可抽取容量及保留量分列。以多段乾旱期間的需求紀錄重算，而非只採全年平均需求，並核對備援啟動條件是否與分析假設一致，避免高估無雨期間可持續的服務。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use the actual level-volume curve to separate nominal, extractable and reserved capacity. Recalculate with demand records from multiple dry spells instead of annual averages, and verify that backup activation assumptions match the intended service arrangement before interpreting calculated autonomy. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：建立名目容量不變但沉積區逐年增加的三個情境，重算可用容積與自主天數。再加入乾季需求增加的情境，區分維護造成的容量變化與使用方式造成的需求變化，提出需要監測的兩個獨立量。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Compare three scenarios with unchanged nominal capacity but increasing sediment storage, recalculating usable volume and autonomy. Add higher dry-season demand, distinguish maintenance-related capacity loss from demand change, and identify two independent quantities that require monitoring.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：如果把不能抽取的底部存水算入自主容量，模型會在現場已經無水可用時仍顯示剩餘天數。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Including inaccessible bottom water predicts remaining service after usable storage is exhausted. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用實際水位容量曲線確認最低可用水位和沉積區，將名目容量、可抽取容量及保留量分列。以多段乾旱期間的需求紀錄重算，而非只採全年平均需求，並核對備援啟動條件是否與分析假設一致，避免高估無雨期間可持續的服務。
knowledge.textEn: Use the actual level-volume curve to separate nominal, extractable and reserved capacity. Recalculate with demand records from multiple dry spells instead of annual averages, and verify that backup activation assumptions match the intended service arrangement before interpreting calculated autonomy.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 建立名目容量不變但沉積區逐年增加的三個情境，重算可用容積與自主天數。再加入乾季需求增加的情境，區分維護造成的容量變化與使用方式造成的需求變化，提出需要監測的兩個獨立量。
knowledge.textEn: Compare three scenarios with unchanged nominal capacity but increasing sediment storage, recalculating usable volume and autonomy. Add higher dry-season demand, distinguish maintenance-related capacity loss from demand change, and identify two independent quantities that require monitoring.

quiz.question: 要驗證「乾旱自主時間與可用容積」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Dry-period autonomy and usable volume"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
用實際水位容量曲線確認最低可用水位和沉積區，將名目容量、可抽取容量及保留量分列。
初期分流達到某個固定體積後，剩餘雨水就一定符合所有非飲用用途要求。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Use the actual level-volume curve to separate nominal, extractable and reserved capacity.
After a fixed initial diversion, remaining rainwater automatically meets every nonpotable-use requirement.
quiz.explanation: 用實際水位容量曲線確認最低可用水位和沉積區，將名目容量、可抽取容量及保留量分列。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Use the actual level-volume curve to separate nominal, extractable and reserved capacity. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 乾旱自主時間與可用容積：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Dry-period autonomy and usable volume: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「乾旱自主時間與可用容積」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Dry-period autonomy and usable volume” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 如果把不能抽取的底部存水算入自主容量，模型會在現場已經無水可用時仍顯示剩餘天數。用雨季平均需求估計乾季灌溉，也可能同時高估供應與低估需求，使誤差向同一方向累積。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Including inaccessible bottom water predicts remaining service after usable storage is exhausted. Applying wet-season demand to dry-season irrigation can simultaneously overstate supply and understate consumption, compounding the error in the same direction. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若需求具有尖峰，還需確認輸送設備的瞬時能力，因此足夠的總容積也不保證每個使用時段都能供應。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Peak use also requires adequate delivery capacity, so sufficient total volume does not guarantee that every short demand interval can be served at the required rate.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「儲槽名目容量除以全年平均需求，就一定是任何乾旱期間都能保證的自主天數。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Nominal tank capacity divided by annual average demand guarantees autonomy during every drought." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 如果把不能抽取的底部存水算入自主容量，模型會在現場已經無水可用時仍顯示剩餘天數。用雨季平均需求估計乾季灌溉，也可能同時高估供應與低估需求，使誤差向同一方向累積。
knowledge.textEn: Including inaccessible bottom water predicts remaining service after usable storage is exhausted. Applying wet-season demand to dry-season irrigation can simultaneously overstate supply and understate consumption, compounding the error in the same direction.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「乾旱自主時間與可用容積」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Dry-period autonomy and usable volume" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
雨水是免費降下來的，所以抽水和處理過程必定不會消耗能源。
如果把不能抽取的底部存水算入自主容量，模型會在現場已經無水可用時仍顯示剩餘天數。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Because rainfall is free, pumping and treating collected rainwater necessarily require no energy.
Including inaccessible bottom water predicts remaining service after usable storage is exhausted.
quiz.explanation: 如果把不能抽取的底部存水算入自主容量，模型會在現場已經無水可用時仍顯示剩餘天數。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Including inaccessible bottom water predicts remaining service after usable storage is exhausted. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 抽水能耗與系統總揚程：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Pumping energy and total dynamic head: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「抽水能耗與系統總揚程」如何影響雨水貯留與非飲用供水的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Pumping energy and total dynamic head” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Rainwater storage and nonpotable supply”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 將儲存雨水送到使用點需要克服高差、管路摩擦與設備局部損失，這些共同形成泵浦所需的總揚程。液壓功率與流量及揚程成正比，電力輸入還需除以整體效率；只用馬達銘牌功率乘時間，未必能反映實際輸送的水量。設備在不同工作點的效率會改變，小流量頻繁啟停也可能增加每立方公尺的能耗。比較節水方案時應保持供水服務相同，同時記錄輔助耗電與運轉時間，才能判斷替代水源帶來的水與能源取捨。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「抽水能耗與系統總揚程」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Delivering stored rainwater requires elevation, pipe-friction and local-loss head. Hydraulic power scales with flow and total head, while electrical input also depends on overall efficiency. Nameplate power multiplied by time need not represent actual delivered volume. Efficiency varies with operating point, and frequent starts at small demand can increase specific energy. Compare alternatives at equivalent service and include auxiliary electricity and operating duration to assess the relationship between freshwater substitution and energy use. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Pumping energy and total dynamic head” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設淡水流量2 m³/h、總揚程15 m、整體效率0.50；輸入功率P=1000×9.81×(2/3600)×15/0.50=163.5 W，單位水量能耗0.08175 kWh/m³，未含待機。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Assume freshwater flow 2 m³/h, total head 15 m and overall efficiency 0.50.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「雨水是免費降下來的，所以抽水和處理過程必定不會消耗能源。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Because rainfall is free, pumping and treating collected rainwater necessarily require no energy." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「抽水能耗與系統總揚程」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Pumping energy and total dynamic head”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 抽水能耗與系統總揚程
knowledge.titleEn: Pumping energy and total dynamic head
knowledge.text: 將儲存雨水送到使用點需要克服高差、管路摩擦與設備局部損失，這些共同形成泵浦所需的總揚程。液壓功率與流量及揚程成正比，電力輸入還需除以整體效率；只用馬達銘牌功率乘時間，未必能反映實際輸送的水量。
knowledge.textEn: Delivering stored rainwater requires elevation, pipe-friction and local-loss head. Hydraulic power scales with flow and total head, while electrical input also depends on overall efficiency.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：雨水是免費降下來的，所以抽水和處理過程必定不會消耗能源。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Because rainfall is free, pumping and treating collected rainwater necessarily require no energy. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「抽水能耗與系統總揚程」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Pumping energy and total dynamic head" is correct?
options: 將儲存雨水送到使用點需要克服高差、管路摩擦與設備局部損失，這些共同形成泵浦所需的總揚程。
雨水是免費降下來的，所以抽水和處理過程必定不會消耗能源。
濾網前後水頭損失越小，就能證明它的污染物去除能力越好。
optionsEn: Delivering stored rainwater requires elevation, pipe-friction and local-loss head.
Because rainfall is free, pumping and treating collected rainwater necessarily require no energy.
A smaller pressure loss across a screen proves better pollutant-removal performance.
quiz.explanation: 將儲存雨水送到使用點需要克服高差、管路摩擦與設備局部損失，這些共同形成泵浦所需的總揚程。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Delivering stored rainwater requires elevation, pipe-friction and local-loss head. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 抽水能耗與系統總揚程：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Pumping energy and total dynamic head: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「抽水能耗與系統總揚程」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Pumping energy and total dynamic head” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設淡水流量2 m³/h、總揚程15 m、整體效率0.50；輸入功率P=1000×9.81×(2/3600)×15/0.50=163.5 W，單位水量能耗0.08175 kWh/m³，未含待機。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Assume freshwater flow 2 m³/h, total head 15 m and overall efficiency 0.50. Electrical input is 163.5 W, equivalent to 0.08175 kWh/m³, excluding standby and auxiliary energy. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用同一時段的電表與水量計計算實測單位能耗，並記錄吸入口、出水口壓力及高程以核對總揚程。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Calculate measured specific energy from synchronized electricity and water meters, checking total head with inlet and outlet pressures and elevations.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設淡水流量2 m³/h、總揚程15 m、整體效率0.50；輸入功率P=1000×9.81×(2/3600)×15/0.50=163.5 W，單位水量能耗0.08175 kWh/m³，未含待機。
knowledge.textEn: Assume freshwater flow 2 m³/h, total head 15 m and overall efficiency 0.50. Electrical input is 163.5 W, equivalent to 0.08175 kWh/m³, excluding standby and auxiliary energy.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「抽水能耗與系統總揚程」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Pumping energy and total dynamic head", which statement holds?
options: 只要正常時飲用側壓力較高，就永遠不需要考慮非飲用水回流。
教學假設淡水流量2 m³/h、總揚程15 m、整體效率0.50。
只要知道屋頂鋪面總面積，就能把它全部當作有效水平集水面積。
optionsEn: Higher potable-side pressure during normal operation permanently eliminates reverse-flow concerns.
Assume freshwater flow 2 m³/h, total head 15 m and overall efficiency 0.50.
The total sloping roof surface area always equals effective horizontal catchment area.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設淡水流量2 m³/h、總揚程15 m、整體效率0.50；輸入功率P=1000×9.81×(2/3600)×15/0.50=163.5 W，單位水量能耗0.08175 kWh/m³，未含待機。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Assume freshwater flow 2 m³/h, total head 15 m and overall efficiency 0.50. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 抽水能耗與系統總揚程：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Pumping energy and total dynamic head: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「抽水能耗與系統總揚程」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Pumping energy and total dynamic head” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用同一時段的電表與水量計計算實測單位能耗，並記錄吸入口、出水口壓力及高程以核對總揚程。把運轉、啟停與待機時段分開，再比較不同流量下的工作點，不以單一效率假設套用整個年度。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Calculate measured specific energy from synchronized electricity and water meters, checking total head with inlet and outlet pressures and elevations. Separate running, starting and standby periods, and compare operating points across flows rather than extending one efficiency assumption over an entire year. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將總揚程增加五公尺但保持流量與效率不變，重算功率和單位能耗。再加入每天固定的待機電量，分析用水量降低時每立方公尺能耗為何可能上升，並列出應與節水量一起報告的能源資料。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Increase total head by five metres while holding flow and efficiency fixed. Add fixed daily standby electricity and explain why lower water use can increase energy per cubic metre, listing energy measurements to report alongside freshwater savings.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：忽略濾網堵塞造成的額外水頭損失，可能把能耗上升誤認成馬達效率降低。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Unmodeled screen losses can make rising energy use appear to be motor degradation. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用同一時段的電表與水量計計算實測單位能耗，並記錄吸入口、出水口壓力及高程以核對總揚程。把運轉、啟停與待機時段分開，再比較不同流量下的工作點，不以單一效率假設套用整個年度。
knowledge.textEn: Calculate measured specific energy from synchronized electricity and water meters, checking total head with inlet and outlet pressures and elevations. Separate running, starting and standby periods, and compare operating points across flows rather than extending one efficiency assumption over an entire year.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將總揚程增加五公尺但保持流量與效率不變，重算功率和單位能耗。再加入每天固定的待機電量，分析用水量降低時每立方公尺能耗為何可能上升，並列出應與節水量一起報告的能源資料。
knowledge.textEn: Increase total head by five metres while holding flow and efficiency fixed. Add fixed daily standby electricity and explain why lower water use can increase energy per cubic metre, listing energy measurements to report alongside freshwater savings.

quiz.question: 要驗證「抽水能耗與系統總揚程」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Pumping energy and total dynamic head"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
每日雨量和用水總量相同時，入流與需求的時間順序完全不會影響溢流。
用同一時段的電表與水量計計算實測單位能耗，並記錄吸入口、出水口壓力及高程以核對總揚程。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
With equal daily rainfall and demand totals, event ordering never affects overflow.
Calculate measured specific energy from synchronized electricity and water meters, checking total head with inlet and outlet pressures and elevations.
quiz.explanation: 用同一時段的電表與水量計計算實測單位能耗，並記錄吸入口、出水口壓力及高程以核對總揚程。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Calculate measured specific energy from synchronized electricity and water meters, checking total head with inlet and outlet pressures and elevations. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 抽水能耗與系統總揚程：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Pumping energy and total dynamic head: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「抽水能耗與系統總揚程」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Pumping energy and total dynamic head” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 忽略濾網堵塞造成的額外水頭損失，可能把能耗上升誤認成馬達效率降低。若水量計和電表期間不同，也可能出現虛假的節能效果，因此應先核對服務量與量測邊界，再判斷設備性能。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Unmodeled screen losses can make rising energy use appear to be motor degradation. Mismatched electricity and water-meter intervals can also create false savings, so verify delivered service and measurement boundaries before diagnosing equipment performance. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：比較節水方案時應保持供水服務相同，同時記錄輔助耗電與運轉時間，才能判斷替代水源帶來的水與能源取捨。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Compare alternatives at equivalent service and include auxiliary electricity and operating duration to assess the relationship between freshwater substitution and energy use.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「雨水是免費降下來的，所以抽水和處理過程必定不會消耗能源。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Because rainfall is free, pumping and treating collected rainwater necessarily require no energy." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 忽略濾網堵塞造成的額外水頭損失，可能把能耗上升誤認成馬達效率降低。若水量計和電表期間不同，也可能出現虛假的節能效果，因此應先核對服務量與量測邊界，再判斷設備性能。
knowledge.textEn: Unmodeled screen losses can make rising energy use appear to be motor degradation. Mismatched electricity and water-meter intervals can also create false savings, so verify delivered service and measurement boundaries before diagnosing equipment performance.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「抽水能耗與系統總揚程」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Pumping energy and total dynamic head" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 忽略濾網堵塞造成的額外水頭損失，可能把能耗上升誤認成馬達效率降低。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
濾網前後水頭損失越小，就能證明它的污染物去除能力越好。
optionsEn: Unmodeled screen losses can make rising energy use appear to be motor degradation.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
A smaller pressure loss across a screen proves better pollutant-removal performance.
quiz.explanation: 忽略濾網堵塞造成的額外水頭損失，可能把能耗上升誤認成馬達效率降低。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Unmodeled screen losses can make rising energy use appear to be motor degradation. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「濾網損失與入口輸送能力」與「完全混合與舊水殘留」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Screen losses and inlet conveyance" and "Complete mixing and retained old water": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 濾網損失與入口輸送能力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Screen losses and inlet conveyance: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「濾網損失與入口輸送能力」如何影響雨水貯留與非飲用供水的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Screen losses and inlet conveyance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Rainwater storage and nonpotable supply”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 入口濾網攔截粗大雜物時，也會改變通水面積與局部水頭損失。流速提高通常使慣性損失增加，但損失係數必須與使用的流速基準一致，不能同時縮小有效面積又重複加入代表相同堵塞的修正。濾網孔徑與水力通量也不是微生物去除能力的替代指標。研究暴雨進槽能力時，要連同屋簷溝、落水管和旁通溢流的控制位置一起判讀，因為最先受限的部位可能在濾網上游，僅更換較大的儲槽無法改變入口瓶頸。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「濾網損失與入口輸送能力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An inlet screen changes open area and local head loss while intercepting coarse debris. Increasing velocity generally increases inertial loss, but the loss coefficient must match its reference velocity; reducing area and adding an equivalent blockage correction can double-count the same effect. Aperture and hydraulic throughput do not establish microbial removal. Evaluate gutters, downpipes and bypass controls together because the limiting section may lie upstream of the screen, where a larger storage tank cannot remove the inlet bottleneck. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Screen losses and inlet conveyance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設以指定參考截面速度v=0.8 m/s及相應損失係數K=5估算，hL=Kv²/(2g)=0.1631 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Assume reference-section velocity 0.8 m/s and a corresponding loss coefficient K=5.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「濾網前後水頭損失越小，就能證明它的污染物去除能力越好。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A smaller pressure loss across a screen proves better pollutant-removal performance." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「濾網損失與入口輸送能力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Screen losses and inlet conveyance”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 濾網損失與入口輸送能力
knowledge.text: 入口濾網攔截粗大雜物時，也會改變通水面積與局部水頭損失。流速提高通常使慣性損失增加，但損失係數必須與使用的流速基準一致，不能同時縮小有效面積又重複加入代表相同堵塞的修正。
knowledge.textEn: An inlet screen changes open area and local head loss while intercepting coarse debris. Increasing velocity generally increases inertial loss, but the loss coefficient must match its reference velocity; reducing area and adding an equivalent blockage correction can double-count the same effect.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：濾網前後水頭損失越小，就能證明它的污染物去除能力越好。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A smaller pressure loss across a screen proves better pollutant-removal performance. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「濾網損失與入口輸送能力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Screen losses and inlet conveyance" is correct?
options: 濾網前後水頭損失越小，就能證明它的污染物去除能力越好。
入口濾網攔截粗大雜物時，也會改變通水面積與局部水頭損失。
當累積出水量等於水槽容積時，槽內每一滴舊水就必定已經排出。
optionsEn: A smaller pressure loss across a screen proves better pollutant-removal performance.
An inlet screen changes open area and local head loss while intercepting coarse debris.
Once cumulative outflow equals tank volume, every original water parcel has necessarily left.
quiz.explanation: 入口濾網攔截粗大雜物時，也會改變通水面積與局部水頭損失。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: An inlet screen changes open area and local head loss while intercepting coarse debris. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 濾網損失與入口輸送能力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Screen losses and inlet conveyance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「濾網損失與入口輸送能力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Screen losses and inlet conveyance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設以指定參考截面速度v=0.8 m/s及相應損失係數K=5估算，hL=Kv²/(2g)=0.1631 m。此為局部水力損失，不能換算成污染物去除率。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Assume reference-section velocity 0.8 m/s and a corresponding loss coefficient K=5. Local loss hL=Kv²/(2g)=0.1631 m; this hydraulic quantity does not specify pollutant-removal efficiency. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在相同流量下記錄濾網前後水位差，核對係數所使用的參考截面並保留清潔前後狀態。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure the differential level at matched flow and verify the coefficient reference section, recording clean and fouled conditions.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設以指定參考截面速度v=0.8 m/s及相應損失係數K=5估算，hL=Kv²/(2g)=0.1631 m。此為局部水力損失，不能換算成污染物去除率。
knowledge.textEn: Assume reference-section velocity 0.8 m/s and a corresponding loss coefficient K=5. Local loss hL=Kv²/(2g)=0.1631 m; this hydraulic quantity does not specify pollutant-removal efficiency.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「濾網損失與入口輸送能力」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Screen losses and inlet conveyance", which statement holds?
options: 儲槽出水表顯示的所有水量，都可以直接當作雨水替代自來水的節省量。
初期分流達到某個固定體積後，剩餘雨水就一定符合所有非飲用用途要求。
教學假設以指定參考截面速度v=0.8 m/s及相應損失係數K=5估算，hL=Kv²/(2g)=0.1631 m。
optionsEn: Every volume recorded at the tank outlet can be credited directly as rainwater substitution.
After a fixed initial diversion, remaining rainwater automatically meets every nonpotable-use requirement.
Assume reference-section velocity 0.8 m/s and a corresponding loss coefficient K=5.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設以指定參考截面速度v=0.8 m/s及相應損失係數K=5估算，hL=Kv²/(2g)=0.1631 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Assume reference-section velocity 0.8 m/s and a corresponding loss coefficient K=5. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 濾網損失與入口輸送能力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Screen losses and inlet conveyance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「濾網損失與入口輸送能力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Screen losses and inlet conveyance” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在相同流量下記錄濾網前後水位差，核對係數所使用的參考截面並保留清潔前後狀態。同步觀察旁通溢流是否開始，以判斷實際進槽受哪個位置控制；水質處理效果則使用另一套採樣與驗證紀錄，不能從水頭損失直接推算。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure the differential level at matched flow and verify the coefficient reference section, recording clean and fouled conditions. Observe bypass onset to identify the controlling inlet component. Maintain separate sampling evidence for treatment performance rather than deriving removal from hydraulic loss. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：在固定參考截面下把流量增加一倍，先用不變係數估計損失變化，再指出係數也可能改變的原因。建立清潔、堵塞與破損三種狀態的診斷表，說明各自需要哪些水力與外觀證據。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Double flow at a fixed reference section and estimate loss using unchanged coefficient, then discuss why that coefficient may vary. Compare clean, blocked and damaged states, identifying the hydraulic and inspection evidence needed to distinguish them.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：同時使用縮小的開孔流速與已含堵塞效應的係數，可能重複放大損失。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using an increased opening velocity with a coefficient already corrected for the same blockage may overpredict loss. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在相同流量下記錄濾網前後水位差，核對係數所使用的參考截面並保留清潔前後狀態。同步觀察旁通溢流是否開始，以判斷實際進槽受哪個位置控制；水質處理效果則使用另一套採樣與驗證紀錄，不能從水頭損失直接推算。
knowledge.textEn: Measure the differential level at matched flow and verify the coefficient reference section, recording clean and fouled conditions. Observe bypass onset to identify the controlling inlet component. Maintain separate sampling evidence for treatment performance rather than deriving removal from hydraulic loss.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 在固定參考截面下把流量增加一倍，先用不變係數估計損失變化，再指出係數也可能改變的原因。建立清潔、堵塞與破損三種狀態的診斷表，說明各自需要哪些水力與外觀證據。
knowledge.textEn: Double flow at a fixed reference section and estimate loss using unchanged coefficient, then discuss why that coefficient may vary. Compare clean, blocked and damaged states, identifying the hydraulic and inspection evidence needed to distinguish them.

quiz.question: 要驗證「濾網損失與入口輸送能力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Screen losses and inlet conveyance"?
options: 在相同流量下記錄濾網前後水位差，核對係數所使用的參考截面並保留清潔前後狀態。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
供水日數可靠度是百分之七十五，就代表全年需求水量也一定滿足百分之七十五。
optionsEn: Measure the differential level at matched flow and verify the coefficient reference section, recording clean and fouled conditions.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Seventy-five-percent daily reliability always means seventy-five percent of demand volume is supplied.
quiz.explanation: 在相同流量下記錄濾網前後水位差，核對係數所使用的參考截面並保留清潔前後狀態。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure the differential level at matched flow and verify the coefficient reference section, recording clean and fouled conditions. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 濾網損失與入口輸送能力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Screen losses and inlet conveyance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「濾網損失與入口輸送能力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Screen losses and inlet conveyance” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 同時使用縮小的開孔流速與已含堵塞效應的係數，可能重複放大損失。反過來，僅看到水能通過就忽略濾網破損，則會把較低水頭差誤判成更好的過濾性能，水力和完整性應分別確認。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using an increased opening velocity with a coefficient already corrected for the same blockage may overpredict loss. A damaged screen can instead show lower differential head, so easy passage is not evidence of improved filtration or intact barriers. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：研究暴雨進槽能力時，要連同屋簷溝、落水管和旁通溢流的控制位置一起判讀，因為最先受限的部位可能在濾網上游，僅更換較大的儲槽無法改變入口瓶頸。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Evaluate gutters, downpipes and bypass controls together because the limiting section may lie upstream of the screen, where a larger storage tank cannot remove the inlet bottleneck.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「濾網前後水頭損失越小，就能證明它的污染物去除能力越好。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A smaller pressure loss across a screen proves better pollutant-removal performance." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 同時使用縮小的開孔流速與已含堵塞效應的係數，可能重複放大損失。反過來，僅看到水能通過就忽略濾網破損，則會把較低水頭差誤判成更好的過濾性能，水力和完整性應分別確認。
knowledge.textEn: Using an increased opening velocity with a coefficient already corrected for the same blockage may overpredict loss. A damaged screen can instead show lower differential head, so easy passage is not evidence of improved filtration or intact barriers.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「濾網損失與入口輸送能力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Screen losses and inlet conveyance" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
同時使用縮小的開孔流速與已含堵塞效應的係數，可能重複放大損失。
當累積出水量等於水槽容積時，槽內每一滴舊水就必定已經排出。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Using an increased opening velocity with a coefficient already corrected for the same blockage may overpredict loss.
Once cumulative outflow equals tank volume, every original water parcel has necessarily left.
quiz.explanation: 同時使用縮小的開孔流速與已含堵塞效應的係數，可能重複放大損失。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using an increased opening velocity with a coefficient already corrected for the same blockage may overpredict loss. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 完全混合與舊水殘留：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Complete mixing and retained old water: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「完全混合與舊水殘留」如何影響雨水貯留與非飲用供水的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Complete mixing and retained old water” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Rainwater storage and nonpotable supply”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 水槽的平均停留時間是體積除以交換流量，但不是每個水團停留完全相同的時間。若水槽保持定容積並完全混合，持續進入的新水會稀釋舊水，舊水比例以指數衰減；短路流與死水區則會偏離這個理想模型。單純把一天用水量乘以天數，不能推斷整槽已被百分之百換新。水齡也不是水質的單一判準，因為溫度、污染來源與處理狀態仍會影響用途適合性，應把水力更新與水質驗證作為互相補充的證據。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「完全混合與舊水殘留」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Mean residence time is volume divided by exchange flow, not an identical age for every parcel. In a constant-volume, completely mixed tank, fresh inflow dilutes old water exponentially; short circuits and stagnant zones depart from this idealization. Multiplying demand by elapsed days does not show that every part has been replaced. Water age alone also does not establish quality because temperature, source loading and treatment condition matter, so hydraulic turnover and quality verification provide complementary evidence. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Complete mixing and retained old water” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設定容積10 m³、等量進出流1 m³/h、完全混合且新水不含舊水示蹤；六小時後舊水比例exp(−Qt/V)=exp(−0.6)=0.5488，不是已全部更新。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Assume a constant 10 m³ completely mixed tank with equal inflow and outflow of 1 m³/h and fresh inlet tracer concentration zero.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「當累積出水量等於水槽容積時，槽內每一滴舊水就必定已經排出。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Once cumulative outflow equals tank volume, every original water parcel has necessarily left." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「完全混合與舊水殘留」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Complete mixing and retained old water”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 完全混合與舊水殘留
knowledge.titleEn: Complete mixing and retained old water

knowledge.textEn: Mean residence time is volume divided by exchange flow, not an identical age for every parcel. In a constant-volume, completely mixed tank, fresh inflow dilutes old water exponentially; short circuits and stagnant zones depart from this idealization.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：當累積出水量等於水槽容積時，槽內每一滴舊水就必定已經排出。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Once cumulative outflow equals tank volume, every original water parcel has necessarily left. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「完全混合與舊水殘留」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Complete mixing and retained old water" is correct?
options: 當累積出水量等於水槽容積時，槽內每一滴舊水就必定已經排出。
只要正常時飲用側壓力較高，就永遠不需要考慮非飲用水回流。
水槽的平均停留時間是體積除以交換流量，但不是每個水團停留完全相同的時間。
optionsEn: Once cumulative outflow equals tank volume, every original water parcel has necessarily left.
Higher potable-side pressure during normal operation permanently eliminates reverse-flow concerns.
Mean residence time is volume divided by exchange flow, not an identical age for every parcel.
quiz.explanation: 水槽的平均停留時間是體積除以交換流量，但不是每個水團停留完全相同的時間。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Mean residence time is volume divided by exchange flow, not an identical age for every parcel. The other options are common misconceptions.
