steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare an outlet tracer curve with ideal mixing using synthetic data or an approved professional tracer study, examining early arrival and late tails.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設定容積10 m³、等量進出流1 m³/h、完全混合且新水不含舊水示蹤；六小時後舊水比例exp(−Qt/V)=exp(−0.6)=0.5488，不是已全部更新。
knowledge.textEn: Assume a constant 10 m³ completely mixed tank with equal inflow and outflow of 1 m³/h and fresh inlet tracer concentration zero. After six hours, the old-water fraction is exp(−0.6)=0.5488.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「完全混合與舊水殘留」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Complete mixing and retained old water", which statement holds?
options: 教學假設定容積10 m³、等量進出流1 m³/h、完全混合且新水不含舊水示蹤。
只要知道屋頂鋪面總面積，就能把它全部當作有效水平集水面積。
每日雨量和用水總量相同時，入流與需求的時間順序完全不會影響溢流。
optionsEn: Assume a constant 10 m³ completely mixed tank with equal inflow and outflow of 1 m³/h and fresh inlet tracer concentration zero.
The total sloping roof surface area always equals effective horizontal catchment area.
With equal daily rainfall and demand totals, event ordering never affects overflow.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設定容積10 m³、等量進出流1 m³/h、完全混合且新水不含舊水示蹤；六小時後舊水比例exp(−Qt/V)=exp(−0.6)=0.5488，不是已全部更新。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Assume a constant 10 m³ completely mixed tank with equal inflow and outflow of 1 m³/h and fresh inlet tracer concentration zero. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 完全混合與舊水殘留：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Complete mixing and retained old water: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「完全混合與舊水殘留」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Complete mixing and retained old water” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在合成資料或經核准的專業示蹤研究中比較出口濃度與理想混合曲線，檢查初期快速到達及後期長尾。以不同水位與進出水配置分別評估，並記錄模型把哪一部分容積視為有效混合區，避免用單次平均停留時間掩蓋死水區。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare an outlet tracer curve with ideal mixing using synthetic data or an approved professional tracer study, examining early arrival and late tails. Evaluate different levels and inlet arrangements, documenting which volume participates in mixing rather than hiding stagnant zones behind one mean residence time. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：計算經過一個與兩個名目停留時間後的舊水比例，與理想活塞流比較。再假設只有部分容積參與快速混合，畫出可能出現的長尾形狀，說明為何需要多時間點而不是單一出口樣本。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Calculate old-water fractions after one and two nominal residence times and compare ideal plug flow. Introduce a slowly exchanging region, sketch the expected tail and explain why multiple observation times are needed instead of one outlet sample.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：將平均停留時間誤解為最長水齡，會低估死水區或混合槽中的長尾。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Treating mean residence time as the maximum age understates long tails in mixed or stagnant regions. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在合成資料或經核准的專業示蹤研究中比較出口濃度與理想混合曲線，檢查初期快速到達及後期長尾。以不同水位與進出水配置分別評估，並記錄模型把哪一部分容積視為有效混合區，避免用單次平均停留時間掩蓋死水區。
knowledge.textEn: Compare an outlet tracer curve with ideal mixing using synthetic data or an approved professional tracer study, examining early arrival and late tails. Evaluate different levels and inlet arrangements, documenting which volume participates in mixing rather than hiding stagnant zones behind one mean residence time.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 計算經過一個與兩個名目停留時間後的舊水比例，與理想活塞流比較。再假設只有部分容積參與快速混合，畫出可能出現的長尾形狀，說明為何需要多時間點而不是單一出口樣本。
knowledge.textEn: Calculate old-water fractions after one and two nominal residence times and compare ideal plug flow. Introduce a slowly exchanging region, sketch the expected tail and explain why multiple observation times are needed instead of one outlet sample.

quiz.question: 要驗證「完全混合與舊水殘留」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Complete mixing and retained old water"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
在合成資料或經核准的專業示蹤研究中比較出口濃度與理想混合曲線，檢查初期快速到達及後期長尾。
儲槽名目容量除以全年平均需求，就一定是任何乾旱期間都能保證的自主天數。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Compare an outlet tracer curve with ideal mixing using synthetic data or an approved professional tracer study, examining early arrival and late tails.
Nominal tank capacity divided by annual average demand guarantees autonomy during every drought.
quiz.explanation: 在合成資料或經核准的專業示蹤研究中比較出口濃度與理想混合曲線，檢查初期快速到達及後期長尾。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare an outlet tracer curve with ideal mixing using synthetic data or an approved professional tracer study, examining early arrival and late tails. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 完全混合與舊水殘留：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Complete mixing and retained old water: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「完全混合與舊水殘留」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Complete mixing and retained old water” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 將平均停留時間誤解為最長水齡，會低估死水區或混合槽中的長尾。若只在出口量測單一時間點，可能錯過早期短路與後期殘留，因此一次良好濃度值不能證明整個流場均勻。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Treating mean residence time as the maximum age understates long tails in mixed or stagnant regions. A single outlet observation can miss early bypass and late retention, so one satisfactory concentration does not demonstrate a uniform internal flow field. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：水齡也不是水質的單一判準，因為溫度、污染來源與處理狀態仍會影響用途適合性，應把水力更新與水質驗證作為互相補充的證據。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Water age alone also does not establish quality because temperature, source loading and treatment condition matter, so hydraulic turnover and quality verification provide complementary evidence.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「當累積出水量等於水槽容積時，槽內每一滴舊水就必定已經排出。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Once cumulative outflow equals tank volume, every original water parcel has necessarily left." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 將平均停留時間誤解為最長水齡，會低估死水區或混合槽中的長尾。若只在出口量測單一時間點，可能錯過早期短路與後期殘留，因此一次良好濃度值不能證明整個流場均勻。
knowledge.textEn: Treating mean residence time as the maximum age understates long tails in mixed or stagnant regions. A single outlet observation can miss early bypass and late retention, so one satisfactory concentration does not demonstrate a uniform internal flow field.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「完全混合與舊水殘留」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Complete mixing and retained old water" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
只要正常時飲用側壓力較高，就永遠不需要考慮非飲用水回流。
將平均停留時間誤解為最長水齡，會低估死水區或混合槽中的長尾。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Higher potable-side pressure during normal operation permanently eliminates reverse-flow concerns.
Treating mean residence time as the maximum age understates long tails in mixed or stagnant regions.
quiz.explanation: 將平均停留時間誤解為最長水齡，會低估死水區或混合槽中的長尾。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Treating mean residence time as the maximum age understates long tails in mixed or stagnant regions. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「分離供水與回流水力判讀」與「替代水量帳與量測不確定度」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Separated supplies and reverse-flow interpretation" and "Substitution accounting and measurement uncertainty": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 分離供水與回流水力判讀：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Separated supplies and reverse-flow interpretation: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「分離供水與回流水力判讀」如何影響雨水貯留與非飲用供水的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Separated supplies and reverse-flow interpretation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Rainwater storage and nonpotable supply”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 非飲用供水與飲用供水之間的隔離是系統邊界，不能因為正常時壓力方向看似有利就視為永遠安全。停電、泵浦狀態改變或供水壓力下降，可能反轉壓差；單一止回元件的存在也不能代替按用途和地區要求驗證完整防護。課堂可用互不連接的示意壓力節點分析驅動方向，但不應建立實際交叉接管實驗。資料圖、管線標示、補水介面與獨立檢驗紀錄需一致，才能證明設計意圖沒有在後續維修或改裝中被改變。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「分離供水與回流水力判讀」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Separation between nonpotable and potable supplies is a system boundary, not a conclusion drawn from a favorable normal pressure direction. Power loss, pump changes or lower supply pressure can reverse a gradient. One check component does not replace verification of complete protection appropriate to use and jurisdiction. Analyze disconnected schematic pressure nodes in class without constructing cross-connections. Drawings, identification, makeup interfaces and independent inspection records must remain consistent through later maintenance and modification. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Separated supplies and reverse-flow interpretation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：純示意教學假設同高程兩個未相連節點，非飲用側200 kPa、另一側100 kPa；壓差100 kPa相當於100000/(1000×9.81)=10.19 m淡水水頭。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For disconnected teaching nodes at equal elevation, assume nonpotable-side pressure 200 kPa and the other side 100 kPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要正常時飲用側壓力較高，就永遠不需要考慮非飲用水回流。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Higher potable-side pressure during normal operation permanently eliminates reverse-flow concerns." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「分離供水與回流水力判讀」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Separated supplies and reverse-flow interpretation”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 分離供水與回流水力判讀
knowledge.text: 非飲用供水與飲用供水之間的隔離是系統邊界，不能因為正常時壓力方向看似有利就視為永遠安全。停電、泵浦狀態改變或供水壓力下降，可能反轉壓差；單一止回元件的存在也不能代替按用途和地區要求驗證完整防護。
knowledge.textEn: Separation between nonpotable and potable supplies is a system boundary, not a conclusion drawn from a favorable normal pressure direction. Power loss, pump changes or lower supply pressure can reverse a gradient.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要正常時飲用側壓力較高，就永遠不需要考慮非飲用水回流。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Higher potable-side pressure during normal operation permanently eliminates reverse-flow concerns. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「分離供水與回流水力判讀」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Separated supplies and reverse-flow interpretation" is correct?
options: 非飲用供水與飲用供水之間的隔離是系統邊界，不能因為正常時壓力方向看似有利就視為永遠安全。
只要正常時飲用側壓力較高，就永遠不需要考慮非飲用水回流。
儲槽出水表顯示的所有水量，都可以直接當作雨水替代自來水的節省量。
optionsEn: Separation between nonpotable and potable supplies is a system boundary, not a conclusion drawn from a favorable normal pressure direction.
Higher potable-side pressure during normal operation permanently eliminates reverse-flow concerns.
Every volume recorded at the tank outlet can be credited directly as rainwater substitution.
quiz.explanation: 非飲用供水與飲用供水之間的隔離是系統邊界，不能因為正常時壓力方向看似有利就視為永遠安全。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Separation between nonpotable and potable supplies is a system boundary, not a conclusion drawn from a favorable normal pressure direction. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 分離供水與回流水力判讀：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Separated supplies and reverse-flow interpretation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「分離供水與回流水力判讀」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Separated supplies and reverse-flow interpretation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：純示意教學假設同高程兩個未相連節點，非飲用側200 kPa、另一側100 kPa；壓差100 kPa相當於100000/(1000×9.81)=10.19 m淡水水頭。若錯誤相連即有反向驅動可能，絕不可據此建立接管。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For disconnected teaching nodes at equal elevation, assume nonpotable-side pressure 200 kPa and the other side 100 kPa. The difference equals 10.19 m freshwater head and illustrates a reverse-driving potential if improperly connected, not permission to connect systems. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：僅在紙上或隔離的數值模型中比較正常、停電與壓力下降情境，確認不能靠壓差方向作永久防護。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare normal, outage and reduced-pressure cases only on paper or in an isolated numerical model.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 純示意教學假設同高程兩個未相連節點，非飲用側200 kPa、另一側100 kPa；壓差100 kPa相當於100000/(1000×9.81)=10.19 m淡水水頭。若錯誤相連即有反向驅動可能，絕不可據此建立接管。
knowledge.textEn: For disconnected teaching nodes at equal elevation, assume nonpotable-side pressure 200 kPa and the other side 100 kPa. The difference equals 10.19 m freshwater head and illustrates a reverse-driving potential if improperly connected, not permission to connect systems.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「分離供水與回流水力判讀」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Separated supplies and reverse-flow interpretation", which statement holds?
options: 初期分流達到某個固定體積後，剩餘雨水就一定符合所有非飲用用途要求。
純示意教學假設同高程兩個未相連節點，非飲用側200 kPa、另一側100 kPa。
供水日數可靠度是百分之七十五，就代表全年需求水量也一定滿足百分之七十五。
optionsEn: After a fixed initial diversion, remaining rainwater automatically meets every nonpotable-use requirement.
For disconnected teaching nodes at equal elevation, assume nonpotable-side pressure 200 kPa and the other side 100 kPa.
Seventy-five-percent daily reliability always means seventy-five percent of demand volume is supplied.
quiz.explanation: 純示意教學假設同高程兩個未相連節點，非飲用側200 kPa、另一側100 kPa；壓差100 kPa相當於100000/(1000×9.81)=10.19 m淡水水頭。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: For disconnected teaching nodes at equal elevation, assume nonpotable-side pressure 200 kPa and the other side 100 kPa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 分離供水與回流水力判讀：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Separated supplies and reverse-flow interpretation: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「分離供水與回流水力判讀」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Separated supplies and reverse-flow interpretation” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 僅在紙上或隔離的數值模型中比較正常、停電與壓力下降情境，確認不能靠壓差方向作永久防護。審查時核對最新版管線圖、標示與具資格人員的檢驗紀錄，將未知介面列為待查事項，不以未曾發生回流作為系統隔離已證實的理由。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare normal, outage and reduced-pressure cases only on paper or in an isolated numerical model. Review current drawings, labels and qualified inspection records, documenting unknown interfaces rather than treating the absence of an observed reverse-flow event as proof of separation. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：用兩個互不連接的壓力節點製作三種數值情境，標出壓差改變方向的條件。最後列出需要由合格專業人員確認的介面證據，不設計實體交叉接管、不提出替代法規防護的臨時操作方式。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Create three numerical scenarios using two disconnected pressure nodes and identify conditions reversing the gradient. List interface evidence requiring qualified review without designing a physical cross-connection or proposing temporary procedures that substitute for required protection.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：用正常運轉壓力推論任何時候都不會回流，忽略了短暫低壓與維修配置。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Inferring permanent flow direction from normal pressure overlooks transients and maintenance configurations. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 僅在紙上或隔離的數值模型中比較正常、停電與壓力下降情境，確認不能靠壓差方向作永久防護。審查時核對最新版管線圖、標示與具資格人員的檢驗紀錄，將未知介面列為待查事項，不以未曾發生回流作為系統隔離已證實的理由。
knowledge.textEn: Compare normal, outage and reduced-pressure cases only on paper or in an isolated numerical model. Review current drawings, labels and qualified inspection records, documenting unknown interfaces rather than treating the absence of an observed reverse-flow event as proof of separation.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 用兩個互不連接的壓力節點製作三種數值情境，標出壓差改變方向的條件。最後列出需要由合格專業人員確認的介面證據，不設計實體交叉接管、不提出替代法規防護的臨時操作方式。
knowledge.textEn: Create three numerical scenarios using two disconnected pressure nodes and identify conditions reversing the gradient. List interface evidence requiring qualified review without designing a physical cross-connection or proposing temporary procedures that substitute for required protection.

quiz.question: 要驗證「分離供水與回流水力判讀」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Separated supplies and reverse-flow interpretation"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
雨水是免費降下來的，所以抽水和處理過程必定不會消耗能源。
僅在紙上或隔離的數值模型中比較正常、停電與壓力下降情境，確認不能靠壓差方向作永久防護。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Because rainfall is free, pumping and treating collected rainwater necessarily require no energy.
Compare normal, outage and reduced-pressure cases only on paper or in an isolated numerical model.
quiz.explanation: 僅在紙上或隔離的數值模型中比較正常、停電與壓力下降情境，確認不能靠壓差方向作永久防護。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare normal, outage and reduced-pressure cases only on paper or in an isolated numerical model. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 分離供水與回流水力判讀：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Separated supplies and reverse-flow interpretation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「分離供水與回流水力判讀」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Separated supplies and reverse-flow interpretation” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 用正常運轉壓力推論任何時候都不會回流，忽略了短暫低壓與維修配置。若後續加裝一條未記錄的補水管，原先正確的分析也不再描述現況，因此介面變更必須觸發重新查核。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Inferring permanent flow direction from normal pressure overlooks transients and maintenance configurations. An undocumented makeup connection can invalidate a previously correct assessment, so interface changes must trigger renewed review instead of inheriting an old conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：資料圖、管線標示、補水介面與獨立檢驗紀錄需一致，才能證明設計意圖沒有在後續維修或改裝中被改變。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Drawings, identification, makeup interfaces and independent inspection records must remain consistent through later maintenance and modification.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要正常時飲用側壓力較高，就永遠不需要考慮非飲用水回流。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Higher potable-side pressure during normal operation permanently eliminates reverse-flow concerns." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 用正常運轉壓力推論任何時候都不會回流，忽略了短暫低壓與維修配置。若後續加裝一條未記錄的補水管，原先正確的分析也不再描述現況，因此介面變更必須觸發重新查核。
knowledge.textEn: Inferring permanent flow direction from normal pressure overlooks transients and maintenance configurations. An undocumented makeup connection can invalidate a previously correct assessment, so interface changes must trigger renewed review instead of inheriting an old conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「分離供水與回流水力判讀」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Separated supplies and reverse-flow interpretation" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 用正常運轉壓力推論任何時候都不會回流，忽略了短暫低壓與維修配置。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
儲槽出水表顯示的所有水量，都可以直接當作雨水替代自來水的節省量。
optionsEn: Inferring permanent flow direction from normal pressure overlooks transients and maintenance configurations.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Every volume recorded at the tank outlet can be credited directly as rainwater substitution.
quiz.explanation: 用正常運轉壓力推論任何時候都不會回流，忽略了短暫低壓與維修配置。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Inferring permanent flow direction from normal pressure overlooks transients and maintenance configurations. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 替代水量帳與量測不確定度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Substitution accounting and measurement uncertainty: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「替代水量帳與量測不確定度」如何影響雨水貯留與非飲用供水的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Substitution accounting and measurement uncertainty” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Rainwater storage and nonpotable supply”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 宣稱雨水替代了多少自來水，需要先界定水量帳的邊界，包括入槽雨水、備援補水、實際使用、溢流與期末存量。只看儲槽出水表可能把補入的自來水一併當成雨水貢獻。各儀表的不確定度若獨立，可由平方和開根號合併；共同校正偏差或相同演算法造成的誤差則可能相關，不能直接套用獨立公式。分析期間也需一致，否則季末大量存水會被錯誤算成已節省的用水量，讓年度績效看起來比真正服務量更高。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「替代水量帳與量測不確定度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Rainwater substitution claims need a balance boundary including rainfall inflow, backup makeup, actual use, overflow and closing inventory. A tank outlet meter alone may count municipal makeup as harvested supply. Independent measurement uncertainties combine through a root-sum-square relation, whereas common calibration or processing errors can be correlated. Match accounting periods as well: water stored at year-end is not yet delivered service, and crediting it as consumption savings can overstate the achieved substitution. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Substitution accounting and measurement uncertainty” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設兩項水量差值的獨立標準不確定度分別20與10 m³；合併標準不確定度u=√(20²+10²)=22.36 m³。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Assume independent standard uncertainties of 20 and 10 m³ for two volumes used in a difference.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「儲槽出水表顯示的所有水量，都可以直接當作雨水替代自來水的節省量。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Every volume recorded at the tank outlet can be credited directly as rainwater substitution." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「替代水量帳與量測不確定度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Substitution accounting and measurement uncertainty”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 替代水量帳與量測不確定度
knowledge.text: 宣稱雨水替代了多少自來水，需要先界定水量帳的邊界，包括入槽雨水、備援補水、實際使用、溢流與期末存量。只看儲槽出水表可能把補入的自來水一併當成雨水貢獻。
knowledge.textEn: Rainwater substitution claims need a balance boundary including rainfall inflow, backup makeup, actual use, overflow and closing inventory. A tank outlet meter alone may count municipal makeup as harvested supply.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：儲槽出水表顯示的所有水量，都可以直接當作雨水替代自來水的節省量。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Every volume recorded at the tank outlet can be credited directly as rainwater substitution. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「替代水量帳與量測不確定度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Substitution accounting and measurement uncertainty" is correct?
options: 儲槽出水表顯示的所有水量，都可以直接當作雨水替代自來水的節省量。
宣稱雨水替代了多少自來水，需要先界定水量帳的邊界，包括入槽雨水、備援補水、實際使用、溢流與期末存量。
只要知道屋頂鋪面總面積，就能把它全部當作有效水平集水面積。
optionsEn: Every volume recorded at the tank outlet can be credited directly as rainwater substitution.
Rainwater substitution claims need a balance boundary including rainfall inflow, backup makeup, actual use, overflow and closing inventory.
The total sloping roof surface area always equals effective horizontal catchment area.
quiz.explanation: 宣稱雨水替代了多少自來水，需要先界定水量帳的邊界，包括入槽雨水、備援補水、實際使用、溢流與期末存量。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Rainwater substitution claims need a balance boundary including rainfall inflow, backup makeup, actual use, overflow and closing inventory. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 替代水量帳與量測不確定度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Substitution accounting and measurement uncertainty: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「替代水量帳與量測不確定度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Substitution accounting and measurement uncertainty” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設兩項水量差值的獨立標準不確定度分別20與10 m³；合併標準不確定度u=√(20²+10²)=22.36 m³。若誤差相關，需加入協方差，不能沿用此值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Assume independent standard uncertainties of 20 and 10 m³ for two volumes used in a difference. Combined standard uncertainty is √(20²+10²)=22.36 m³; correlated errors require a covariance term. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將所有水量表讀值對齊同一開始與結束時間，獨立列出備援補水及存量變化。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Align all meter readings to common endpoints and separate backup supply from inventory change.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設兩項水量差值的獨立標準不確定度分別20與10 m³；合併標準不確定度u=√(20²+10²)=22.36 m³。若誤差相關，需加入協方差，不能沿用此值。
knowledge.textEn: Assume independent standard uncertainties of 20 and 10 m³ for two volumes used in a difference. Combined standard uncertainty is √(20²+10²)=22.36 m³; correlated errors require a covariance term.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「替代水量帳與量測不確定度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Substitution accounting and measurement uncertainty", which statement holds?
options: 每日雨量和用水總量相同時，入流與需求的時間順序完全不會影響溢流。
儲槽名目容量除以全年平均需求，就一定是任何乾旱期間都能保證的自主天數。
教學假設兩項水量差值的獨立標準不確定度分別20與10 m³；合併標準不確定度u=√(20²+10²)=22.36 m³。
optionsEn: With equal daily rainfall and demand totals, event ordering never affects overflow.
Nominal tank capacity divided by annual average demand guarantees autonomy during every drought.
Assume independent standard uncertainties of 20 and 10 m³ for two volumes used in a difference.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設兩項水量差值的獨立標準不確定度分別20與10 m³；合併標準不確定度u=√(20²+10²)=22.36 m³。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Assume independent standard uncertainties of 20 and 10 m³ for two volumes used in a difference. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 替代水量帳與量測不確定度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Substitution accounting and measurement uncertainty: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「替代水量帳與量測不確定度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Substitution accounting and measurement uncertainty” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將所有水量表讀值對齊同一開始與結束時間，獨立列出備援補水及存量變化。檢查儀表校正來源與誤差相關性，再用水量閉合差尋找漏列項；報告節省量時同時列出不確定度與資料缺漏，不能把估算值顯示更多小數位就視為較準確。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Align all meter readings to common endpoints and separate backup supply from inventory change. Check calibration provenance and error correlation, then use balance closure to locate omissions. Report uncertainty and missing data alongside savings rather than implying accuracy through additional displayed decimals. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：建立包含備援補水、雨水、溢流與存量變化的年度水量帳，先核對守恆再計算替代量。比較獨立誤差與完全同向共同偏差的兩種假設，說明為何不確定度的合併方式需要儀表來源證據。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Build an annual balance including makeup, rain, overflow and inventory change, verifying conservation before calculating substitution. Compare independent errors with perfectly shared bias and explain why the uncertainty combination requires evidence about calibration and measurement provenance.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若一邊採用月初表讀值、另一邊採月中表讀值，水量帳可能出現不存在的損失或節省。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Mismatched meter endpoints can create apparent losses or savings that never occurred. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將所有水量表讀值對齊同一開始與結束時間，獨立列出備援補水及存量變化。檢查儀表校正來源與誤差相關性，再用水量閉合差尋找漏列項；報告節省量時同時列出不確定度與資料缺漏，不能把估算值顯示更多小數位就視為較準確。
knowledge.textEn: Align all meter readings to common endpoints and separate backup supply from inventory change. Check calibration provenance and error correlation, then use balance closure to locate omissions. Report uncertainty and missing data alongside savings rather than implying accuracy through additional displayed decimals.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 建立包含備援補水、雨水、溢流與存量變化的年度水量帳，先核對守恆再計算替代量。比較獨立誤差與完全同向共同偏差的兩種假設，說明為何不確定度的合併方式需要儀表來源證據。
knowledge.textEn: Build an annual balance including makeup, rain, overflow and inventory change, verifying conservation before calculating substitution. Compare independent errors with perfectly shared bias and explain why the uncertainty combination requires evidence about calibration and measurement provenance.

quiz.question: 要驗證「替代水量帳與量測不確定度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Substitution accounting and measurement uncertainty"?
options: 將所有水量表讀值對齊同一開始與結束時間，獨立列出備援補水及存量變化。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
濾網前後水頭損失越小，就能證明它的污染物去除能力越好。
optionsEn: Align all meter readings to common endpoints and separate backup supply from inventory change.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
A smaller pressure loss across a screen proves better pollutant-removal performance.
quiz.explanation: 將所有水量表讀值對齊同一開始與結束時間，獨立列出備援補水及存量變化。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Align all meter readings to common endpoints and separate backup supply from inventory change. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 替代水量帳與量測不確定度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Substitution accounting and measurement uncertainty: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「替代水量帳與量測不確定度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Substitution accounting and measurement uncertainty” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若一邊採用月初表讀值、另一邊採月中表讀值，水量帳可能出現不存在的損失或節省。將共用偏差當作獨立隨機誤差，也會低估合併不確定度，使績效差異看似顯著但實際證據不足。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Mismatched meter endpoints can create apparent losses or savings that never occurred. Treating common bias as independent random error may understate combined uncertainty, making a performance difference appear significant without sufficient supporting evidence. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：分析期間也需一致，否則季末大量存水會被錯誤算成已節省的用水量，讓年度績效看起來比真正服務量更高。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Match accounting periods as well: water stored at year-end is not yet delivered service, and crediting it as consumption savings can overstate the achieved substitution.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「儲槽出水表顯示的所有水量，都可以直接當作雨水替代自來水的節省量。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Every volume recorded at the tank outlet can be credited directly as rainwater substitution." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若一邊採用月初表讀值、另一邊採月中表讀值，水量帳可能出現不存在的損失或節省。將共用偏差當作獨立隨機誤差，也會低估合併不確定度，使績效差異看似顯著但實際證據不足。
knowledge.textEn: Mismatched meter endpoints can create apparent losses or savings that never occurred. Treating common bias as independent random error may understate combined uncertainty, making a performance difference appear significant without sufficient supporting evidence.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「替代水量帳與量測不確定度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Substitution accounting and measurement uncertainty" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
若一邊採用月初表讀值、另一邊採月中表讀值，水量帳可能出現不存在的損失或節省。
只要知道屋頂鋪面總面積，就能把它全部當作有效水平集水面積。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Mismatched meter endpoints can create apparent losses or savings that never occurred.
The total sloping roof surface area always equals effective horizontal catchment area.
quiz.explanation: 若一邊採用月初表讀值、另一邊採月中表讀值，水量帳可能出現不存在的損失或節省。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Mismatched meter endpoints can create apparent losses or savings that never occurred. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 水利設施數位孿生
summary: 以樟宜水再生廠數位孿生為真實入口，逐步建立從感測資料到決策證據的完整鏈結。十個單元分辨拓樸、時鐘、單位、校正與異常判讀的錯誤來源，並以原創小型算例驗證每項假設。課程把模型驗證與真實設備確認分開，讓學徒能指出預測可信的條件及仍需量測的疑問。
summaryEn: Starting from the real Changi Water Reclamation Plant digital twin, build a chain from sensor records to decision evidence. Ten units distinguish topology, timing, units, calibration and anomaly interpretation through original numerical examples. Separate equation verification from physical validation and identify both the conditions supporting a prediction and questions requiring additional observations.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
subcategoryTitle: 海岸、港灣與水資源韌性

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 教學比較採用兩個不同的資料品質問題。首先，兩支獨立無偏水頭感測器分別為40±2 m與46±1 m，反變異數加權得到44.8 m；若兩者共同偏高3 m，融合結果也偏高3 m，原本較小的不確定度不能揭露共同偏差。其次，取壓點高程25 m與表壓水頭40 m相加得到65 m測壓管水頭。這兩個案例不互相交換數字，因為前者討論同一狀態的統計融合，後者討論單位和垂直基準。請分別保存原始讀值、假設與計算式，再說明增加哪一項獨立量測才能區分儀器偏差與模型誤差。
workedExample.textEn: Compare two distinct data-quality problems. Independent unbiased head measurements of 40±2 m and 46±1 m combine to 44.8 m by inverse-variance weighting. Adding a shared three-metre bias shifts that result by three metres; the nominal reduction in uncertainty does not expose common bias. Separately, a tap elevation of 25 m plus gauge pressure head 40 m yields piezometric head 65 m. Do not exchange numbers between these examples: one concerns statistical fusion of the same state, the other concerns units and vertical datum. Preserve raw values, assumptions and equations, then identify additional independent evidence needed to separate instrument bias from model error.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「網路拓樸與守恆殘差」與「時間同步與相位誤差」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Network topology and balance residuals" and "Time alignment and phase error": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 網路拓樸與守恆殘差：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Network topology and balance residuals: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「網路拓樸與守恆殘差」如何影響水利設施數位孿生的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Network topology and balance residuals” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Digital twins for water infrastructure”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 數位孿生必須先知道每支感測器、管段與水池代表哪個物理物件，才能比較預測與觀測。節點流量依統一方向列入守恆式，蓄水變化另作一項，而不是把所有正值直接相加。水量殘差可能來自漏列支管、時間錯位、儀表偏移或真正漏水，因此單一殘差不能唯一辨識原因。建立穩定的資產識別碼與版本化連線表，能讓一次閥門改接與一次感測器更換在資料中保持可追溯，也能避免外觀相同的圖示遮蔽實際已改變的水路。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「網路拓樸與守恆殘差」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A digital twin needs a physical identity for every sensor, pipe and tank before predictions can be compared with observations. Signed node flows enter a conservation equation, while changing storage remains a separate term. A residual can arise from an omitted branch, timing error, instrument bias or leakage and therefore does not identify its cause uniquely. Stable asset identifiers and versioned connections preserve the distinction between a changed water route and a replaced sensor, even when the displayed diagram looks unchanged. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Network topology and balance residuals” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設一個無蓄水節點，兩股入流為1.8及0.6 m³/s，量得出流2.3 m³/s；殘差r=1.8+0.6−2.3=0.1 m³/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Assume a storage-free teaching node with inflows 1.8 and 0.6 m³/s and measured outflow 2.3 m³/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「節點出現正水量殘差，就一定代表同等流量的管線漏水。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A positive node balance residual always equals the physical leakage flow." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「網路拓樸與守恆殘差」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Network topology and balance residuals”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 網路拓樸與守恆殘差
knowledge.text: 數位孿生必須先知道每支感測器、管段與水池代表哪個物理物件，才能比較預測與觀測。節點流量依統一方向列入守恆式，蓄水變化另作一項，而不是把所有正值直接相加。
knowledge.textEn: A digital twin needs a physical identity for every sensor, pipe and tank before predictions can be compared with observations. Signed node flows enter a conservation equation, while changing storage remains a separate term.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：節點出現正水量殘差，就一定代表同等流量的管線漏水。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A positive node balance residual always equals the physical leakage flow. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「網路拓樸與守恆殘差」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Network topology and balance residuals" is correct?
options: 節點出現正水量殘差，就一定代表同等流量的管線漏水。
數位孿生必須先知道每支感測器、管段與水池代表哪個物理物件，才能比較預測與觀測。
只要兩條曲線的相關係數最高，就證明兩個感測器已正確同步。
optionsEn: A positive node balance residual always equals the physical leakage flow.
A digital twin needs a physical identity for every sensor, pipe and tank before predictions can be compared with observations.
Maximum correlation between two curves proves that their sensors are correctly synchronized.
quiz.explanation: 數位孿生必須先知道每支感測器、管段與水池代表哪個物理物件，才能比較預測與觀測。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A digital twin needs a physical identity for every sensor, pipe and tank before predictions can be compared with observations. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 網路拓樸與守恆殘差：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Network topology and balance residuals: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「網路拓樸與守恆殘差」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Network topology and balance residuals” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設一個無蓄水節點，兩股入流為1.8及0.6 m³/s，量得出流2.3 m³/s；殘差r=1.8+0.6−2.3=0.1 m³/s。此數值尚不能直接當作漏水量。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Assume a storage-free teaching node with inflows 1.8 and 0.6 m³/s and measured outflow 2.3 m³/s. Residual r=1.8+0.6−2.3=0.1 m³/s is not automatically a leakage estimate. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：逐一核對資產編號、流向符號、旁通管與量測時間，再以獨立水量計或水池水位變化驗算。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check asset identifiers, signs, bypasses and timestamps before using an independent meter or tank-level change to test balance.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設一個無蓄水節點，兩股入流為1.8及0.6 m³/s，量得出流2.3 m³/s；殘差r=1.8+0.6−2.3=0.1 m³/s。此數值尚不能直接當作漏水量。
knowledge.textEn: Assume a storage-free teaching node with inflows 1.8 and 0.6 m³/s and measured outflow 2.3 m³/s. Residual r=1.8+0.6−2.3=0.1 m³/s is not automatically a leakage estimate.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「網路拓樸與守恆殘差」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Network topology and balance residuals", which statement holds?
options: 把同一支感測器的資料複製十份再平均，就能得到十支獨立儀器的準確度。
把水力參數重新校正到量測曲線，就一定能消除任何時間步長造成的數值誤差。
教學假設一個無蓄水節點，兩股入流為1.8及0.6 m³/s，量得出流2.3 m³/s；殘差r=1.8+0.6−2.3=0.1 m³/s。
optionsEn: Copying one sensor record ten times provides the accuracy of ten independent instruments.
Recalibrating hydraulic parameters always eliminates numerical error caused by the chosen time step.
Assume a storage-free teaching node with inflows 1.8 and 0.6 m³/s and measured outflow 2.3 m³/s.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設一個無蓄水節點，兩股入流為1.8及0.6 m³/s，量得出流2.3 m³/s；殘差r=1.8+0.6−2.3=0.1 m³/s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Assume a storage-free teaching node with inflows 1.8 and 0.6 m³/s and measured outflow 2.3 m³/s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 網路拓樸與守恆殘差：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Network topology and balance residuals: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「網路拓樸與守恆殘差」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Network topology and balance residuals” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 逐一核對資產編號、流向符號、旁通管與量測時間，再以獨立水量計或水池水位變化驗算。把改接前後的拓樸版本分開重播，觀察殘差是持續偏移還是只在切換期間出現，並保留校正紀錄以區分資料錯誤與真實水量缺口。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check asset identifiers, signs, bypasses and timestamps before using an independent meter or tank-level change to test balance. Replay topology versions separately and distinguish a persistent residual from a switching transient, retaining calibration records as evidence for competing explanations. steps.failure: 注意干擾：若旁通支管未納入模型，校正程序可能錯把少算的流量吸收到需求係數中。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An omitted bypass may be absorbed into calibrated demand coefficients. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.title: 網路拓樸與守恆殘差：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Network topology and balance residuals: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「網路拓樸與守恆殘差」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Network topology and balance residuals” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若旁通支管未納入模型，校正程序可能錯把少算的流量吸收到需求係數中。這會使平時殘差看似降低，卻在閥門切換後產生更大的偏差，不能用較小的訓練誤差證明拓樸正確。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An omitted bypass may be absorbed into calibrated demand coefficients. Training residuals then decrease while errors grow after valve changes, so a better fitted baseline does not demonstrate correct network connectivity. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：建立穩定的資產識別碼與版本化連線表，能讓一次閥門改接與一次感測器更換在資料中保持可追溯，也能避免外觀相同的圖示遮蔽實際已改變的水路。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Stable asset identifiers and versioned connections preserve the distinction between a changed water route and a replaced sensor, even when the displayed diagram looks unchanged.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「節點出現正水量殘差，就一定代表同等流量的管線漏水。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A positive node balance residual always equals the physical leakage flow." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若旁通支管未納入模型，校正程序可能錯把少算的流量吸收到需求係數中。這會使平時殘差看似降低，卻在閥門切換後產生更大的偏差，不能用較小的訓練誤差證明拓樸正確。
knowledge.textEn: An omitted bypass may be absorbed into calibrated demand coefficients. Training residuals then decrease while errors grow after valve changes, so a better fitted baseline does not demonstrate correct network connectivity.

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「網路拓樸與守恆殘差」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Network topology and balance residuals" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若旁通支管未納入模型，校正程序可能錯把少算的流量吸收到需求係數中。
只要兩條曲線的相關係數最高，就證明兩個感測器已正確同步。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
An omitted bypass may be absorbed into calibrated demand coefficients.
Maximum correlation between two curves proves that their sensors are correctly synchronized.

quiz.explanationEn: An omitted bypass may be absorbed into calibrated demand coefficients. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 時間同步與相位誤差：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Time alignment and phase error: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「時間同步與相位誤差」如何影響水利設施數位孿生的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Time alignment and phase error” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Digital twins for water infrastructure”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 水位與流量紀錄常來自不同時鐘，資料到達伺服器的時間也可能晚於實際取樣。若直接以接收時間配對，正常的水力傳播便可能被誤認為設備故障。週期性訊號的固定時間差可換算成相位差，但只有在週期穩定時才有這種簡單關係；泵浦啟停的非週期事件要用事件時間和因果順序判讀。重採樣之前應保留原始時間戳、時區、品質旗標與取樣間隔，不能先把缺值平滑後再假設兩條曲線已同步。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「時間同步與相位誤差」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Water levels and flows often come from different clocks, and arrival at a server can lag physical sampling. Pairing records by reception time may turn normal propagation into an apparent fault. A fixed delay maps to phase for a stable periodic signal, whereas irregular pump events require explicit event times and causal ordering. Preserve original timestamps, time zones, quality flags and sampling intervals before resampling; smoothing missing values does not establish synchronization between two records. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Time alignment and phase error” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設穩定週期T=900 s的水位振盪，一個通道晚記60 s；相位誤差φ=360×60/900=24°。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Assume a steady water-level period T=900 s and a channel timestamp delayed 60 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要兩條曲線的相關係數最高，就證明兩個感測器已正確同步。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Maximum correlation between two curves proves that their sensors are correctly synchronized." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「時間同步與相位誤差」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Time alignment and phase error”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 時間同步與相位誤差
knowledge.text: 水位與流量紀錄常來自不同時鐘，資料到達伺服器的時間也可能晚於實際取樣。若直接以接收時間配對，正常的水力傳播便可能被誤認為設備故障。
knowledge.textEn: Water levels and flows often come from different clocks, and arrival at a server can lag physical sampling. Pairing records by reception time may turn normal propagation into an apparent fault.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要兩條曲線的相關係數最高，就證明兩個感測器已正確同步。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Maximum correlation between two curves proves that their sensors are correctly synchronized. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「時間同步與相位誤差」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Time alignment and phase error" is correct?
options: 只要兩條曲線的相關係數最高，就證明兩個感測器已正確同步。
兩支壓力計讀值相同，就表示它們所在位置的總水頭必定相同。
水位與流量紀錄常來自不同時鐘，資料到達伺服器的時間也可能晚於實際取樣。
optionsEn: Maximum correlation between two curves proves that their sensors are correctly synchronized.
Equal pressure readings always imply equal total hydraulic head at both locations.
Water levels and flows often come from different clocks, and arrival at a server can lag physical sampling.
quiz.explanation: 水位與流量紀錄常來自不同時鐘，資料到達伺服器的時間也可能晚於實際取樣。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Water levels and flows often come from different clocks, and arrival at a server can lag physical sampling. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 時間同步與相位誤差：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Time alignment and phase error: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「時間同步與相位誤差」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Time alignment and phase error” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設穩定週期T=900 s的水位振盪，一個通道晚記60 s；相位誤差φ=360×60/900=24°。此值不代表水在兩測站間真的旅行60 s。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Assume a steady water-level period T=900 s and a channel timestamp delayed 60 s. Phase error φ=360×60/900=24°. This does not establish a physical travel time between stations. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以共同事件或獨立時鐘記錄檢查相對延遲，將取樣時間與接收時間分開繪圖。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check relative delay against a common event or independent clock, plotting sample and reception times separately.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設穩定週期T=900 s的水位振盪，一個通道晚記60 s；相位誤差φ=360×60/900=24°。此值不代表水在兩測站間真的旅行60 s。
knowledge.textEn: Assume a steady water-level period T=900 s and a channel timestamp delayed 60 s. Phase error φ=360×60/900=24°. This does not establish a physical travel time between stations.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「時間同步與相位誤差」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Time alignment and phase error", which statement holds?
options: 教學假設穩定週期T=900 s的水位振盪，一個通道晚記60 s；相位誤差φ=360×60/900=24°。
最佳化程式只回傳一組參數，就證明這組參數已被資料唯一辨識。
驗證殘差的平均值是零，就表示模型的每一個預測值都完全準確。
optionsEn: Assume a steady water-level period T=900 s and a channel timestamp delayed 60 s.
A single parameter vector returned by an optimizer proves unique identification by the data.
A zero mean validation residual means every individual model prediction is exact.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設穩定週期T=900 s的水位振盪，一個通道晚記60 s；相位誤差φ=360×60/900=24°。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Assume a steady water-level period T=900 s and a channel timestamp delayed 60 s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 時間同步與相位誤差：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Time alignment and phase error: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「時間同步與相位誤差」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Time alignment and phase error” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以共同事件或獨立時鐘記錄檢查相對延遲，將取樣時間與接收時間分開繪圖。再測試延遲是否隨通訊負載變動；只有在時間校正可重現且不會倒置事件順序時，才比較模型的水力相位，並記錄重採樣所使用的方法。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check relative delay against a common event or independent clock, plotting sample and reception times separately. Test variation with communication load. Compare hydraulic phase only after reproducible time correction, preserving event order and documenting the resampling method used. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：建立一條十五分鐘週期的合成曲線與一條延後一分鐘的副本，再加入一次真正的水力延遲。分別標記時鐘偏移與傳播時間，說明僅靠相關係數為何無法辨認兩者，並寫出必要的獨立時間證據。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Create a fifteen-minute synthetic cycle and a copy delayed one minute, then add genuine propagation delay. Label clock offset separately and explain why correlation alone cannot distinguish the causes, specifying the independent timing evidence required.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：自動移動曲線以追求最高相關係數，可能把真實水力延遲一併消掉。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Shifting curves to maximize correlation can remove genuine hydraulic delay. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Check relative delay against a common event or independent clock, plotting sample and reception times separately. Test variation with communication load. Compare hydraulic phase only after reproducible time correction, preserving event order and documenting the resampling method used.
