knowledge.text: 建立一條十五分鐘週期的合成曲線與一條延後一分鐘的副本，再加入一次真正的水力延遲。分別標記時鐘偏移與傳播時間，說明僅靠相關係數為何無法辨認兩者，並寫出必要的獨立時間證據。
knowledge.textEn: Create a fifteen-minute synthetic cycle and a copy delayed one minute, then add genuine propagation delay. Label clock offset separately and explain why correlation alone cannot distinguish the causes, specifying the independent timing evidence required.

quiz.question: 要驗證「時間同步與相位誤差」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Time alignment and phase error"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以共同事件或獨立時鐘記錄檢查相對延遲，將取樣時間與接收時間分開繪圖。
偵測器的真陽性率是百分之九十五，就表示每次警報都有百分之九十五機率是真的。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Check relative delay against a common event or independent clock, plotting sample and reception times separately.
A ninety-five-percent true-positive rate means every alert has a ninety-five-percent chance of being genuine.
quiz.explanation: 以共同事件或獨立時鐘記錄檢查相對延遲，將取樣時間與接收時間分開繪圖。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check relative delay against a common event or independent clock, plotting sample and reception times separately. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 時間同步與相位誤差：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Time alignment and phase error: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「時間同步與相位誤差」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Time alignment and phase error” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 自動移動曲線以追求最高相關係數，可能把真實水力延遲一併消掉。若對所有通道套用同一補值規則，還可能製造本來不存在的同步尖峰，使異常分類器學到資料處理的痕跡。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Shifting curves to maximize correlation can remove genuine hydraulic delay. Applying one filling rule to every channel can also manufacture synchronized peaks, allowing an anomaly classifier to learn processing artifacts instead of physical behavior. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：重採樣之前應保留原始時間戳、時區、品質旗標與取樣間隔，不能先把缺值平滑後再假設兩條曲線已同步。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Preserve original timestamps, time zones, quality flags and sampling intervals before resampling; smoothing missing values does not establish synchronization between two records.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要兩條曲線的相關係數最高，就證明兩個感測器已正確同步。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Maximum correlation between two curves proves that their sensors are correctly synchronized." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 自動移動曲線以追求最高相關係數，可能把真實水力延遲一併消掉。若對所有通道套用同一補值規則，還可能製造本來不存在的同步尖峰，使異常分類器學到資料處理的痕跡。
knowledge.textEn: Shifting curves to maximize correlation can remove genuine hydraulic delay. Applying one filling rule to every channel can also manufacture synchronized peaks, allowing an anomaly classifier to learn processing artifacts instead of physical behavior.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「時間同步與相位誤差」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Time alignment and phase error" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
兩支壓力計讀值相同，就表示它們所在位置的總水頭必定相同。
自動移動曲線以追求最高相關係數，可能把真實水力延遲一併消掉。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Equal pressure readings always imply equal total hydraulic head at both locations.
Shifting curves to maximize correlation can remove genuine hydraulic delay.
quiz.explanation: 自動移動曲線以追求最高相關係數，可能把真實水力延遲一併消掉。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Shifting curves to maximize correlation can remove genuine hydraulic delay. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 水力機制、材料與定量模型
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「單位、基準面與壓力水頭」與「獨立感測器的加權融合」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Units, datums and pressure head" and "Weighted fusion of independent sensors": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 單位、基準面與壓力水頭：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Units, datums and pressure head: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「單位、基準面與壓力水頭」如何影響水利設施數位孿生的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Units, datums and pressure head” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Digital twins for water infrastructure”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 數位孿生交換資料時，壓力、壓力水頭與總水頭必須明確區分。相同壓力讀值裝在不同高程，代表的測壓管水頭並不相同；若使用總能量水頭，還要說明速度水頭是否納入。感測器可能回報表壓或絕對壓力，地形資料也可能使用不同垂直基準面，因此欄位名稱相同仍不足以證明可以相減。將量綱、密度假設、垂直基準與感測器取壓位置一起版本化，才有可能在設備更換後重現同一個物理判讀。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「單位、基準面與壓力水頭」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Data exchange must distinguish pressure, pressure head and total head. Equal pressure readings at different elevations do not imply equal piezometric head; total energy head also requires a stated velocity contribution. Instruments may report gauge or absolute pressure, while terrain records may use different vertical datums. Matching column names are therefore insufficient. Version the units, assumed density, elevation datum and pressure-tap position together so that replacing an instrument does not silently change the physical interpretation. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Units, datums and pressure head” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設淡水ρ=1000 kg/m³、g=9.81 m/s²，表壓水頭40 m與取壓點高程25 m；表壓p=392.4 kPa，測壓管水頭H=25+40=65 m，未含速度水頭。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Assume freshwater density 1000 kg/m³, g=9.81 m/s², gauge pressure head 40 m and tap elevation 25 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兩支壓力計讀值相同，就表示它們所在位置的總水頭必定相同。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equal pressure readings always imply equal total hydraulic head at both locations." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「單位、基準面與壓力水頭」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Units, datums and pressure head”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 單位、基準面與壓力水頭
knowledge.text: 數位孿生交換資料時，壓力、壓力水頭與總水頭必須明確區分。相同壓力讀值裝在不同高程，代表的測壓管水頭並不相同；若使用總能量水頭，還要說明速度水頭是否納入。
knowledge.textEn: Data exchange must distinguish pressure, pressure head and total head. Equal pressure readings at different elevations do not imply equal piezometric head; total energy head also requires a stated velocity contribution.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：兩支壓力計讀值相同，就表示它們所在位置的總水頭必定相同。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Equal pressure readings always imply equal total hydraulic head at both locations. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「單位、基準面與壓力水頭」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Units, datums and pressure head" is correct?
options: 數位孿生交換資料時，壓力、壓力水頭與總水頭必須明確區分。
兩支壓力計讀值相同，就表示它們所在位置的總水頭必定相同。
把同一支感測器的資料複製十份再平均，就能得到十支獨立儀器的準確度。
optionsEn: Data exchange must distinguish pressure, pressure head and total head.
Equal pressure readings always imply equal total hydraulic head at both locations.
Copying one sensor record ten times provides the accuracy of ten independent instruments.
quiz.explanation: 數位孿生交換資料時，壓力、壓力水頭與總水頭必須明確區分。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Data exchange must distinguish pressure, pressure head and total head. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 單位、基準面與壓力水頭：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Units, datums and pressure head: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「單位、基準面與壓力水頭」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Units, datums and pressure head” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設淡水ρ=1000 kg/m³、g=9.81 m/s²，表壓水頭40 m與取壓點高程25 m；表壓p=392.4 kPa，測壓管水頭H=25+40=65 m，未含速度水頭。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Assume freshwater density 1000 kg/m³, g=9.81 m/s², gauge pressure head 40 m and tap elevation 25 m. Gauge pressure is 392.4 kPa and piezometric head H=65 m, excluding velocity head. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：先用一筆可手算的固定數值逐層通過資料介面，確認公斤帕與帕的倍率以及公尺的垂直基準。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Pass one hand-checkable value through every interface to verify pressure scaling and elevation datum.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設淡水ρ=1000 kg/m³、g=9.81 m/s²，表壓水頭40 m與取壓點高程25 m；表壓p=392.4 kPa，測壓管水頭H=25+40=65 m，未含速度水頭。
knowledge.textEn: Assume freshwater density 1000 kg/m³, g=9.81 m/s², gauge pressure head 40 m and tap elevation 25 m. Gauge pressure is 392.4 kPa and piezometric head H=65 m, excluding velocity head.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「單位、基準面與壓力水頭」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Units, datums and pressure head", which statement holds?
options: 把水力參數重新校正到量測曲線，就一定能消除任何時間步長造成的數值誤差。
教學假設淡水ρ=1000 kg/m³、g=9.81 m/s²，表壓水頭40 m與取壓點高程25 m。
資料同化後的不確定度下降，就能證明原本的物理模型完全正確。
optionsEn: Recalibrating hydraulic parameters always eliminates numerical error caused by the chosen time step.
Assume freshwater density 1000 kg/m³, g=9.81 m/s², gauge pressure head 40 m and tap elevation 25 m.
Reduced uncertainty after assimilation proves that the underlying physical model is completely correct.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設淡水ρ=1000 kg/m³、g=9.81 m/s²，表壓水頭40 m與取壓點高程25 m；表壓p=392.4 kPa，測壓管水頭H=25+40=65 m，未含速度水頭。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Assume freshwater density 1000 kg/m³, g=9.81 m/s², gauge pressure head 40 m and tap elevation 25 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 單位、基準面與壓力水頭：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Units, datums and pressure head: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「單位、基準面與壓力水頭」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Units, datums and pressure head” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 先用一筆可手算的固定數值逐層通過資料介面，確認公斤帕與帕的倍率以及公尺的垂直基準。將感測器零點、取壓口高程和大氣壓處理方式列入資料字典，再對照獨立水準測量，不以圖上的數字相近作為基準一致的證據。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Pass one hand-checkable value through every interface to verify pressure scaling and elevation datum. Document instrument zero, tap elevation and atmospheric-pressure treatment, then compare an independent level survey instead of treating similar displayed numbers as evidence of datum consistency. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：建立表壓、絕對壓力、壓力水頭與測壓管水頭四欄對照表，逐欄標出單位與基準。故意將其中一欄改成千帕，設計一個能在資料進入模型前即拒絕錯誤倍率的檢核條件。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Build a table separating gauge pressure, absolute pressure, pressure head and piezometric head with units and datums. Change one column to kilopascals and design a validation rule that rejects incorrect scaling before model ingestion.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若模型把絕對壓力當成表壓，會加入一個近似大氣壓的假水頭；若又用需求校正抵消此差，模型可能在另一海拔或天氣條件下失準。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Treating absolute pressure as gauge pressure introduces a spurious atmospheric head. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 先用一筆可手算的固定數值逐層通過資料介面，確認公斤帕與帕的倍率以及公尺的垂直基準。將感測器零點、取壓口高程和大氣壓處理方式列入資料字典，再對照獨立水準測量，不以圖上的數字相近作為基準一致的證據。
knowledge.textEn: Pass one hand-checkable value through every interface to verify pressure scaling and elevation datum. Document instrument zero, tap elevation and atmospheric-pressure treatment, then compare an independent level survey instead of treating similar displayed numbers as evidence of datum consistency.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 建立表壓、絕對壓力、壓力水頭與測壓管水頭四欄對照表，逐欄標出單位與基準。故意將其中一欄改成千帕，設計一個能在資料進入模型前即拒絕錯誤倍率的檢核條件。
knowledge.textEn: Build a table separating gauge pressure, absolute pressure, pressure head and piezometric head with units and datums. Change one column to kilopascals and design a validation rule that rejects incorrect scaling before model ingestion.

quiz.question: 要驗證「單位、基準面與壓力水頭」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Units, datums and pressure head"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
只要數位孿生預測某方案耗能較低，就可以忽略供水限制直接執行。
先用一筆可手算的固定數值逐層通過資料介面，確認公斤帕與帕的倍率以及公尺的垂直基準。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Any strategy predicted to use less energy can be implemented without checking water-service constraints.
Pass one hand-checkable value through every interface to verify pressure scaling and elevation datum.
quiz.explanation: 先用一筆可手算的固定數值逐層通過資料介面，確認公斤帕與帕的倍率以及公尺的垂直基準。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Pass one hand-checkable value through every interface to verify pressure scaling and elevation datum. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 單位、基準面與壓力水頭：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Units, datums and pressure head: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「單位、基準面與壓力水頭」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Units, datums and pressure head” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若模型把絕對壓力當成表壓，會加入一個近似大氣壓的假水頭；若又用需求校正抵消此差，模型可能在另一海拔或天氣條件下失準。單位錯誤不應交給參數最佳化掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Treating absolute pressure as gauge pressure introduces a spurious atmospheric head. Calibration may conceal it temporarily, then fail at another elevation or atmospheric condition; parameter optimization should not mask unit or datum errors. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若模型把絕對壓力當成表壓，會加入一個近似大氣壓的假水頭；若又用需求校正抵消此差，模型可能在另一海拔或天氣條件下失準。單位錯誤不應交給參數最佳化掩蓋。
knowledge.textEn: Treating absolute pressure as gauge pressure introduces a spurious atmospheric head. Calibration may conceal it temporarily, then fail at another elevation or atmospheric condition; parameter optimization should not mask unit or datum errors.

knowledge.title: 根因確認

steps.title: 獨立感測器的加權融合：機制與系統路徑

steps.instruction: 兩支感測器估計同一個量時，若誤差無偏、互相獨立而且變異數已知，可使用反變異數加權得到較小的不確定度。權重不是儀器價格、顯示小數位數或資料筆數的替代說法，而是對誤差模型的明確假設。兩支儀器若共用取壓管、供電或校正來源，可能具有共同偏差，此時獨立公式會過度樂觀。融合之前要確認兩者真的觀察同一物理狀態，同時保留各自原始值，才能在融合結果看似平穩時發現單一通道漂移。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「獨立感測器的加權融合」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: For two estimates of the same quantity, inverse-variance weighting reduces uncertainty when errors are unbiased, independent and have known variances. Confirm that both instruments observe the same physical state and preserve their separate records so that a stable fused estimate does not conceal one drifting channel. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Weighted fusion of independent sensors” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設兩個獨立無偏水頭估計40±2 m與46±1 m，其中±為標準不確定度；融合值=(40/4+46/1)/(1/4+1)=44.8 m，標準不確定度√(1/1.25)=0.8944 m。

兩支感測器估計同一個量時，若誤差無偏、互相獨立而且變異數已知，可使用反變異數加權得到較小的不確定度。

steps.title: 獨立感測器的加權融合：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Weighted fusion of independent sensors: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「獨立感測器的加權融合」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設兩個獨立無偏水頭估計40±2 m與46±1 m，其中±為標準不確定度；融合值=(40/4+46/1)/(1/4+1)=44.8 m，標準不確定度√(1/1.25)=0.8944 m。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Assume independent unbiased head estimates 40±2 m and 46±1 m, with standard uncertainties. The fused estimate is (40/4+46)/(1/4+1)=44.8 m, with standard uncertainty √(1/1.25)=0.8944 m. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：先檢查校正與安裝是否提供獨立性證據，再用並行資料估計殘差相關性。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check calibration and installation evidence for independence, then estimate residual correlation.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 教學假設兩個獨立無偏水頭估計40±2 m與46±1 m，其中±為標準不確定度；融合值=(40/4+46/1)/(1/4+1)=44.8 m，標準不確定度√(1/1.25)=0.8944 m。
knowledge.textEn: Assume independent unbiased head estimates 40±2 m and 46±1 m, with standard uncertainties. The fused estimate is (40/4+46)/(1/4+1)=44.8 m, with standard uncertainty √(1/1.25)=0.8944 m.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。

quiz.question: 依「獨立感測器的加權融合」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Weighted fusion of independent sensors", which statement holds?
options: 驗證殘差的平均值是零，就表示模型的每一個預測值都完全準確。
偵測器的真陽性率是百分之九十五，就表示每次警報都有百分之九十五機率是真的。
教學假設兩個獨立無偏水頭估計40±2 m與46±1 m，其中±為標準不確定度。
optionsEn: A zero mean validation residual means every individual model prediction is exact.
A ninety-five-percent true-positive rate means every alert has a ninety-five-percent chance of being genuine.
Assume independent unbiased head estimates 40±2 m and 46±1 m, with standard uncertainties.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設兩個獨立無偏水頭估計40±2 m與46±1 m，其中±為標準不確定度；融合值=(40/4+46/1)/(1/4+1)=44.8 m，標準不確定度√(1/1.25)=0.8944 m。 重算時請保留單位。

steps.title: 獨立感測器的加權融合：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Weighted fusion of independent sensors: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「獨立感測器的加權融合」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Weighted fusion of independent sensors” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 先檢查校正與安裝是否提供獨立性證據，再用並行資料估計殘差相關性。以已知參考值分別評估兩支感測器的偏差，並比較融合前後的區間涵蓋率；若共同誤差存在，應在協方差中明列，而非再加入第三支相同來源儀器就宣稱問題解決。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check calibration and installation evidence for independence, then estimate residual correlation. Compare each sensor with an external reference and evaluate interval coverage before and after fusion. Represent shared error in covariance instead of assuming another similarly sourced sensor eliminates the problem. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算兩支感測器等權平均與反變異數平均，說明結果為何偏向較小變異數者。再替兩者加入相同的三公尺偏移，觀察融合值與原公式不確定度的變化，指出原先獨立無偏假設何處失效。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Compare equal-weight and inverse-variance estimates, then add the same three-metre bias to both sensors. Recompute the fused value and nominal uncertainty, explaining which independence or unbiasedness assumptions no longer describe the changed data.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若把重複上傳的同一筆量測視為多支獨立感測器，計算會顯示不確定度不斷下降，實際資訊卻沒有增加。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Counting repeated uploads as independent sensors artificially reduces calculated uncertainty without adding information. quiz.explanationEn: Counting repeated uploads as independent sensors artificially reduces calculated uncertainty without adding information. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「參數可辨識性與校正實驗」與「時間步長與數值守恆」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Parameter identifiability and calibration experiments" and "Time steps and numerical conservation": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 參數可辨識性與校正實驗：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Parameter identifiability and calibration experiments: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「參數可辨識性與校正實驗」如何影響水利設施數位孿生的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Parameter identifiability and calibration experiments” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Digital twins for water infrastructure”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 模型參數能被最佳化程式找到一組數值，不代表資料足以唯一辨識它們。不同粗糙度、需求分配或感測器偏差可能形成相似的壓力殘差，讓多組參數都看似符合觀測。局部敏感度矩陣的獨立欄位代表不同參數會留下可分辨的影響；若欄位近乎平行，量測噪音就會造成巨大的參數變動。校正實驗應改變可控制的工況或增加不同位置量測，並保留參數合理範圍，不能只靠增加同一工況的重複資料期待問題自動消失。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「參數可辨識性與校正實驗」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Finding a parameter vector does not mean observations identify it uniquely. Roughness, demand distribution and sensor bias can produce similar pressure residuals, allowing many apparently successful fits. Independent columns of a local sensitivity matrix indicate distinguishable parameter effects; nearly parallel columns amplify observation noise into large parameter changes. Calibration should introduce different operating conditions or observation locations and retain plausible parameter ranges, rather than expecting repeated measurements under one unchanged condition to resolve the ambiguity. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Parameter identifiability and calibration experiments” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學線性模型以無因次參數r與d表示，只有r+d=8時，(3,5)與(4,4)都符合。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: In a dimensionless teaching model, r+d=8 admits both (3,5) and (4,4).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「最佳化程式只回傳一組參數，就證明這組參數已被資料唯一辨識。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A single parameter vector returned by an optimizer proves unique identification by the data." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「參數可辨識性與校正實驗」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Parameter identifiability and calibration experiments”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 參數可辨識性與校正實驗
knowledge.text: 模型參數能被最佳化程式找到一組數值，不代表資料足以唯一辨識它們。不同粗糙度、需求分配或感測器偏差可能形成相似的壓力殘差，讓多組參數都看似符合觀測。
knowledge.textEn: Finding a parameter vector does not mean observations identify it uniquely. Roughness, demand distribution and sensor bias can produce similar pressure residuals, allowing many apparently successful fits.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：最佳化程式只回傳一組參數，就證明這組參數已被資料唯一辨識。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A single parameter vector returned by an optimizer proves unique identification by the data. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「參數可辨識性與校正實驗」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Parameter identifiability and calibration experiments" is correct?
options: 最佳化程式只回傳一組參數，就證明這組參數已被資料唯一辨識。
把水力參數重新校正到量測曲線，就一定能消除任何時間步長造成的數值誤差。
模型參數能被最佳化程式找到一組數值，不代表資料足以唯一辨識它們。
optionsEn: A single parameter vector returned by an optimizer proves unique identification by the data.
Recalibrating hydraulic parameters always eliminates numerical error caused by the chosen time step.
Finding a parameter vector does not mean observations identify it uniquely.
quiz.explanation: 模型參數能被最佳化程式找到一組數值，不代表資料足以唯一辨識它們。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Finding a parameter vector does not mean observations identify it uniquely. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 參數可辨識性與校正實驗：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Parameter identifiability and calibration experiments: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「參數可辨識性與校正實驗」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Parameter identifiability and calibration experiments” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學線性模型以無因次參數r與d表示，只有r+d=8時，(3,5)與(4,4)都符合。增加獨立觀測r+2d=13後，矩陣行列式為1，解得r=3、d=5；此僅為可辨識性示例。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: In a dimensionless teaching model, r+d=8 admits both (3,5) and (4,4). Adding r+2d=13 gives matrix determinant 1 and identifies r=3, d=5; this is an identifiability example, not a field calibration. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以多組起始參數重跑校正，檢查是否得到相似誤差卻不同的參數。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Repeat calibration from several initial values and look for similar residuals with different parameters.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學線性模型以無因次參數r與d表示，只有r+d=8時，(3,5)與(4,4)都符合。增加獨立觀測r+2d=13後，矩陣行列式為1，解得r=3、d=5；此僅為可辨識性示例。
knowledge.textEn: In a dimensionless teaching model, r+d=8 admits both (3,5) and (4,4). Adding r+2d=13 gives matrix determinant 1 and identifies r=3, d=5; this is an identifiability example, not a field calibration.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「參數可辨識性與校正實驗」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Parameter identifiability and calibration experiments", which statement holds?
options: 教學線性模型以無因次參數r與d表示，只有r+d=8時，(3,5)與(4,4)都符合。
資料同化後的不確定度下降，就能證明原本的物理模型完全正確。
只要數位孿生預測某方案耗能較低，就可以忽略供水限制直接執行。
optionsEn: In a dimensionless teaching model, r+d=8 admits both (3,5) and (4,4).
Reduced uncertainty after assimilation proves that the underlying physical model is completely correct.
Any strategy predicted to use less energy can be implemented without checking water-service constraints.
quiz.explanation: 教學線性模型以無因次參數r與d表示，只有r+d=8時，(3,5)與(4,4)都符合。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: In a dimensionless teaching model, r+d=8 admits both (3,5) and (4,4). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 參數可辨識性與校正實驗：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Parameter identifiability and calibration experiments: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「參數可辨識性與校正實驗」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Parameter identifiability and calibration experiments” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以多組起始參數重跑校正，檢查是否得到相似誤差卻不同的參數。列出敏感度矩陣及其尺度，測試新增量測能否提供不同方向的資訊，再用未參與校正的工況驗證；即使矩陣可逆，也應分析量測噪音對解的放大程度。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Repeat calibration from several initial values and look for similar residuals with different parameters. Inspect scaled sensitivities, test whether added measurements provide independent information, and validate under held-out conditions. Invertibility alone does not establish acceptable sensitivity to measurement noise. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：畫出兩條教學線性觀測方程的交點，再把第二條改為2r+2d=16。比較新增資料前後的解集合，說明多一條方程為何不一定多一項獨立資訊，並提出不同工況下的第三個觀測構想。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Plot the two teaching equations, then replace the second with 2r+2d=16. Compare solution sets and explain why another equation may add no independent information, proposing a third observation under a genuinely different condition.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：強制最佳化器輸出唯一結果，可能只是演算法選了眾多等價解之一。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A unique optimizer output may merely select one of many equivalent solutions. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以多組起始參數重跑校正，檢查是否得到相似誤差卻不同的參數。列出敏感度矩陣及其尺度，測試新增量測能否提供不同方向的資訊，再用未參與校正的工況驗證；即使矩陣可逆，也應分析量測噪音對解的放大程度。
knowledge.textEn: Repeat calibration from several initial values and look for similar residuals with different parameters. Inspect scaled sensitivities, test whether added measurements provide independent information, and validate under held-out conditions. Invertibility alone does not establish acceptable sensitivity to measurement noise.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 畫出兩條教學線性觀測方程的交點，再把第二條改為2r+2d=16。比較新增資料前後的解集合，說明多一條方程為何不一定多一項獨立資訊，並提出不同工況下的第三個觀測構想。
knowledge.textEn: Plot the two teaching equations, then replace the second with 2r+2d=16. Compare solution sets and explain why another equation may add no independent information, proposing a third observation under a genuinely different condition.

quiz.question: 要驗證「參數可辨識性與校正實驗」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Parameter identifiability and calibration experiments"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
以多組起始參數重跑校正，檢查是否得到相似誤差卻不同的參數。
只要兩條曲線的相關係數最高，就證明兩個感測器已正確同步。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Repeat calibration from several initial values and look for similar residuals with different parameters.
Maximum correlation between two curves proves that their sensors are correctly synchronized.
quiz.explanation: 以多組起始參數重跑校正，檢查是否得到相似誤差卻不同的參數。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Repeat calibration from several initial values and look for similar residuals with different parameters. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 參數可辨識性與校正實驗：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Parameter identifiability and calibration experiments: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「參數可辨識性與校正實驗」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Parameter identifiability and calibration experiments” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 強制最佳化器輸出唯一結果，可能只是演算法選了眾多等價解之一。若參數走到邊界卻仍有系統殘差，應先檢查模型結構與資料偏差，而非擴大到不合理的物理範圍繼續追求低誤差。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A unique optimizer output may merely select one of many equivalent solutions. Parameters stuck at bounds with systematic residuals should trigger checks of model structure and data bias, rather than unrestricted expansion into physically implausible ranges. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：校正實驗應改變可控制的工況或增加不同位置量測，並保留參數合理範圍，不能只靠增加同一工況的重複資料期待問題自動消失。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Calibration should introduce different operating conditions or observation locations and retain plausible parameter ranges, rather than expecting repeated measurements under one unchanged condition to resolve the ambiguity.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「最佳化程式只回傳一組參數，就證明這組參數已被資料唯一辨識。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A single parameter vector returned by an optimizer proves unique identification by the data." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 強制最佳化器輸出唯一結果，可能只是演算法選了眾多等價解之一。若參數走到邊界卻仍有系統殘差，應先檢查模型結構與資料偏差，而非擴大到不合理的物理範圍繼續追求低誤差。
knowledge.textEn: A unique optimizer output may merely select one of many equivalent solutions. Parameters stuck at bounds with systematic residuals should trigger checks of model structure and data bias, rather than unrestricted expansion into physically implausible ranges.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「參數可辨識性與校正實驗」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Parameter identifiability and calibration experiments" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
把水力參數重新校正到量測曲線，就一定能消除任何時間步長造成的數值誤差。
強制最佳化器輸出唯一結果，可能只是演算法選了眾多等價解之一。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Recalibrating hydraulic parameters always eliminates numerical error caused by the chosen time step.
A unique optimizer output may merely select one of many equivalent solutions.
quiz.explanation: 強制最佳化器輸出唯一結果，可能只是演算法選了眾多等價解之一。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A unique optimizer output may merely select one of many equivalent solutions. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 時間步長與數值守恆：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Time steps and numerical conservation: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「時間步長與數值守恆」如何影響水利設施數位孿生的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Time steps and numerical conservation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Digital twins for water infrastructure”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 動態水量模型將連續的入流與出流積分成蓄水變化，有限時間步長會引入離散誤差。若入流在步內快速增加，使用步首值會低估水量；縮短步長通常有助於比較收斂，但不能修正漏掉的水路或錯誤的邊界。模型驗證需分清楚程式是否解對所選方程，以及方程是否描述真實設備。對已知解析解的合成案例先做數值驗證，再以不同步長比較水量閉合，可避免把演算法誤差當成需要重新校正的水力參數。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「時間步長與數值守恆」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A dynamic balance integrates changing inflow and outflow into storage, and finite time steps introduce discretization error. Using the initial inflow underestimates volume during a rising interval. Smaller steps support convergence checks but cannot repair omitted pathways or wrong boundaries. Distinguish solving the chosen equations correctly from choosing equations that describe the plant. Start with synthetic cases having analytical solutions, then compare balance closure across time steps so that numerical error is not absorbed into calibrated hydraulic parameters. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Time steps and numerical conservation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設60 s內入流Q(t)=10+0.1t m³/s且無出流；解析入流量為10×60+0.5×0.1×60²=780 m³。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Assume Q(t)=10+0.1t m³/s for 60 s with no outflow.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「把水力參數重新校正到量測曲線，就一定能消除任何時間步長造成的數值誤差。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Recalibrating hydraulic parameters always eliminates numerical error caused by the chosen time step." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「時間步長與數值守恆」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Time steps and numerical conservation”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 時間步長與數值守恆
knowledge.text: 動態水量模型將連續的入流與出流積分成蓄水變化，有限時間步長會引入離散誤差。若入流在步內快速增加，使用步首值會低估水量；縮短步長通常有助於比較收斂，但不能修正漏掉的水路或錯誤的邊界。
knowledge.textEn: A dynamic balance integrates changing inflow and outflow into storage, and finite time steps introduce discretization error. Using the initial inflow underestimates volume during a rising interval.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：把水力參數重新校正到量測曲線，就一定能消除任何時間步長造成的數值誤差。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Recalibrating hydraulic parameters always eliminates numerical error caused by the chosen time step. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「時間步長與數值守恆」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Time steps and numerical conservation" is correct?
options: 動態水量模型將連續的入流與出流積分成蓄水變化，有限時間步長會引入離散誤差。
把水力參數重新校正到量測曲線，就一定能消除任何時間步長造成的數值誤差。
驗證殘差的平均值是零，就表示模型的每一個預測值都完全準確。
optionsEn: A dynamic balance integrates changing inflow and outflow into storage, and finite time steps introduce discretization error.
Recalibrating hydraulic parameters always eliminates numerical error caused by the chosen time step.
A zero mean validation residual means every individual model prediction is exact.
quiz.explanation: 動態水量模型將連續的入流與出流積分成蓄水變化，有限時間步長會引入離散誤差。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A dynamic balance integrates changing inflow and outflow into storage, and finite time steps introduce discretization error. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 時間步長與數值守恆：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Time steps and numerical conservation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「時間步長與數值守恆」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Time steps and numerical conservation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設60 s內入流Q(t)=10+0.1t m³/s且無出流；解析入流量為10×60+0.5×0.1×60²=780 m³。單步左矩形法只有600 m³，少算180 m³。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Assume Q(t)=10+0.1t m³/s for 60 s with no outflow. Exact volume is 780 m³. One initial-value rectangular step gives 600 m³, underestimating volume by 180 m³. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：保留相同物理參數，分別用六十秒、三十秒與十五秒步長重算，與解析積分比較而不是只互相比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Keep physical parameters fixed and compare sixty-, thirty- and fifteen-second calculations against the analytical integral.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設60 s內入流Q(t)=10+0.1t m³/s且無出流；解析入流量為10×60+0.5×0.1×60²=780 m³。單步左矩形法只有600 m³，少算180 m³。
knowledge.textEn: Assume Q(t)=10+0.1t m³/s for 60 s with no outflow. Exact volume is 780 m³. One initial-value rectangular step gives 600 m³, underestimating volume by 180 m³.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「時間步長與數值守恆」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Time steps and numerical conservation", which statement holds?
options: 偵測器的真陽性率是百分之九十五，就表示每次警報都有百分之九十五機率是真的。
教學假設60 s內入流Q(t)=10+0.1t m³/s且無出流；解析入流量為10×60+0.5×0.1×60²=780 m³。
節點出現正水量殘差，就一定代表同等流量的管線漏水。
optionsEn: A ninety-five-percent true-positive rate means every alert has a ninety-five-percent chance of being genuine.
Assume Q(t)=10+0.1t m³/s for 60 s with no outflow.
A positive node balance residual always equals the physical leakage flow.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設60 s內入流Q(t)=10+0.1t m³/s且無出流；解析入流量為10×60+0.5×0.1×60²=780 m³。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Assume Q(t)=10+0.1t m³/s for 60 s with no outflow. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 時間步長與數值守恆：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Time steps and numerical conservation: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「時間步長與數值守恆」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Time steps and numerical conservation” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 保留相同物理參數，分別用六十秒、三十秒與十五秒步長重算，與解析積分比較而不是只互相比較。記錄每步蓄水與入出流的守恆差，並檢查事件是否落在步長邊界；對沒有解析解的案例，仍須建立網格或步長收斂證據。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Keep physical parameters fixed and compare sixty-, thirty- and fifteen-second calculations against the analytical integral. Record interval balance residuals and event alignment. When an analytical solution is unavailable, still establish step-size convergence rather than accepting agreement between two coarse simulations. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：手算三十秒與十五秒左矩形法的總入流量，畫出誤差隨步長縮小的變化。再用梯形法處理相同線性入流，說明它為何在此特例得到解析值，但不保證對所有快速變化訊號都無誤差。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Calculate thirty- and fifteen-second left-rectangle totals and plot error against step size. Apply the trapezoidal rule to the same linear inflow, explaining why it is exact here without implying exactness for arbitrary rapidly changing signals.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若直接調整入流係數補償過粗步長，校正值會隨時間解析度改變，失去可轉移性。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Adjusting inflow coefficients to compensate for coarse integration makes calibration depend on time resolution. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 保留相同物理參數，分別用六十秒、三十秒與十五秒步長重算，與解析積分比較而不是只互相比較。記錄每步蓄水與入出流的守恆差，並檢查事件是否落在步長邊界；對沒有解析解的案例，仍須建立網格或步長收斂證據。
knowledge.textEn: Keep physical parameters fixed and compare sixty-, thirty- and fifteen-second calculations against the analytical integral. Record interval balance residuals and event alignment. When an analytical solution is unavailable, still establish step-size convergence rather than accepting agreement between two coarse simulations.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 手算三十秒與十五秒左矩形法的總入流量，畫出誤差隨步長縮小的變化。再用梯形法處理相同線性入流，說明它為何在此特例得到解析值，但不保證對所有快速變化訊號都無誤差。
knowledge.textEn: Calculate thirty- and fifteen-second left-rectangle totals and plot error against step size. Apply the trapezoidal rule to the same linear inflow, explaining why it is exact here without implying exactness for arbitrary rapidly changing signals.

quiz.question: 要驗證「時間步長與數值守恆」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Time steps and numerical conservation"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
兩支壓力計讀值相同，就表示它們所在位置的總水頭必定相同。
保留相同物理參數，分別用六十秒、三十秒與十五秒步長重算，與解析積分比較而不是只互相比較。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
Equal pressure readings always imply equal total hydraulic head at both locations.
Keep physical parameters fixed and compare sixty-, thirty- and fifteen-second calculations against the analytical integral.
quiz.explanation: 保留相同物理參數，分別用六十秒、三十秒與十五秒步長重算，與解析積分比較而不是只互相比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Keep physical parameters fixed and compare sixty-, thirty- and fifteen-second calculations against the analytical integral. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 時間步長與數值守恆：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Time steps and numerical conservation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「時間步長與數值守恆」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Time steps and numerical conservation” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若直接調整入流係數補償過粗步長，校正值會隨時間解析度改變，失去可轉移性。單一時間點的水位吻合也可能掩蓋期間水量誤差，因此驗證應同時檢查軌跡與累積量。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Adjusting inflow coefficients to compensate for coarse integration makes calibration depend on time resolution. Agreement at one water level can conceal interval volume error, so validation should examine both the trajectory and accumulated quantities. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：對已知解析解的合成案例先做數值驗證，再以不同步長比較水量閉合，可避免把演算法誤差當成需要重新校正的水力參數。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Start with synthetic cases having analytical solutions, then compare balance closure across time steps so that numerical error is not absorbed into calibrated hydraulic parameters.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「把水力參數重新校正到量測曲線，就一定能消除任何時間步長造成的數值誤差。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Recalibrating hydraulic parameters always eliminates numerical error caused by the chosen time step." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若直接調整入流係數補償過粗步長，校正值會隨時間解析度改變，失去可轉移性。單一時間點的水位吻合也可能掩蓋期間水量誤差，因此驗證應同時檢查軌跡與累積量。
knowledge.textEn: Adjusting inflow coefficients to compensate for coarse integration makes calibration depend on time resolution. Agreement at one water level can conceal interval volume error, so validation should examine both the trajectory and accumulated quantities.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「時間步長與數值守恆」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Time steps and numerical conservation" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 若直接調整入流係數補償過粗步長，校正值會隨時間解析度改變，失去可轉移性。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
驗證殘差的平均值是零，就表示模型的每一個預測值都完全準確。
optionsEn: Adjusting inflow coefficients to compensate for coarse integration makes calibration depend on time resolution.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
A zero mean validation residual means every individual model prediction is exact.
quiz.explanation: 若直接調整入流係數補償過粗步長，校正值會隨時間解析度改變，失去可轉移性。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Adjusting inflow coefficients to compensate for coarse integration makes calibration depend on time resolution. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「保留驗證資料與殘差指標」與「狀態估計與資料同化」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Held-out validation and residual metrics" and "State estimation and data assimilation": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 保留驗證資料與殘差指標：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Held-out validation and residual metrics: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「保留驗證資料與殘差指標」如何影響水利設施數位孿生的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Held-out validation and residual metrics” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Digital twins for water infrastructure”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 校正資料與驗證資料的分離，是判斷數位孿生能否描述未見工況的重要步驟。平均誤差反映整體偏移，均方根誤差則同時包含偏差與離散程度；正負誤差抵消後的零平均值，不代表預測逐點正確。時間序列若相鄰樣本高度相關，隨機切分會把幾乎相同的事件放進兩邊，使表現過度樂觀。應依完整事件、季節或設備工況分組留出資料，再同時檢查尖峰、低流量與狀態切換的殘差分布，而不只報告一個平均分數。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「保留驗證資料與殘差指標」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Separating calibration and validation data tests whether a twin represents unseen conditions. Mean error describes overall bias, while root-mean-square error includes both bias and scatter; cancelling positive and negative errors does not imply pointwise accuracy. Randomly splitting highly correlated time samples can place nearly identical events in both sets. Hold out complete events, seasons or operating states, and examine peak, low-flow and switching residuals separately instead of reporting only one averaged score. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Held-out validation and residual metrics” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設四個保留樣本的水頭殘差為1、−1、2、−2 m；平均偏差為0 m，但RMSE=√((1²+1²+2²+2²)/4)=1.581 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Assume held-out head residuals of 1, −1, 2 and −2 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「驗證殘差的平均值是零，就表示模型的每一個預測值都完全準確。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A zero mean validation residual means every individual model prediction is exact." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「保留驗證資料與殘差指標」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Held-out validation and residual metrics”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 保留驗證資料與殘差指標
knowledge.text: 校正資料與驗證資料的分離，是判斷數位孿生能否描述未見工況的重要步驟。平均誤差反映整體偏移，均方根誤差則同時包含偏差與離散程度；正負誤差抵消後的零平均值，不代表預測逐點正確。
knowledge.textEn: Separating calibration and validation data tests whether a twin represents unseen conditions. Mean error describes overall bias, while root-mean-square error includes both bias and scatter; cancelling positive and negative errors does not imply pointwise accuracy.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：驗證殘差的平均值是零，就表示模型的每一個預測值都完全準確。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A zero mean validation residual means every individual model prediction is exact. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「保留驗證資料與殘差指標」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Held-out validation and residual metrics" is correct?
options: 驗證殘差的平均值是零，就表示模型的每一個預測值都完全準確。
校正資料與驗證資料的分離，是判斷數位孿生能否描述未見工況的重要步驟。
資料同化後的不確定度下降，就能證明原本的物理模型完全正確。
optionsEn: A zero mean validation residual means every individual model prediction is exact.
Separating calibration and validation data tests whether a twin represents unseen conditions.
Reduced uncertainty after assimilation proves that the underlying physical model is completely correct.
quiz.explanation: 校正資料與驗證資料的分離，是判斷數位孿生能否描述未見工況的重要步驟。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Separating calibration and validation data tests whether a twin represents unseen conditions. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 保留驗證資料與殘差指標：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Held-out validation and residual metrics: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「保留驗證資料與殘差指標」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Held-out validation and residual metrics” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設四個保留樣本的水頭殘差為1、−1、2、−2 m；平均偏差為0 m，但RMSE=√((1²+1²+2²+2²)/4)=1.581 m。此結果僅描述這四筆資料。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Assume held-out head residuals of 1, −1, 2 and −2 m. Mean bias is zero, but RMSE=√((1+1+4+4)/4)=1.581 m. These metrics describe only the four stated samples. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在校正前決定資料分組與驗證指標，避免看過答案才挑選容易的測試區段。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Define data groups and metrics before calibration.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.title: 保留驗證資料與殘差指標：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Held-out validation and residual metrics: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「保留驗證資料與殘差指標」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Held-out validation and residual metrics” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在校正前決定資料分組與驗證指標，避免看過答案才挑選容易的測試區段。對每個保留事件列出偏差、均方根誤差與最大絕對誤差，並檢查品質旗標及缺值比例；將模型不適用的工況明列，不能直接刪去表現差的資料。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Define data groups and metrics before calibration. For each held-out event, report bias, RMSE and maximum absolute error while checking quality flags and missingness. Identify unsupported operating conditions explicitly instead of removing difficult records after inspecting model performance. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：分別計算四筆殘差的平均絕對誤差與最大絕對誤差，與均方根誤差比較。再加入大量零殘差樣本，觀察平均指標如何下降，並說明為何尖峰誤差與原本兩公尺的失準並未因此改善。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Compute mean absolute and maximum absolute error for the four residuals and compare RMSE. Add many zero residuals, observe the averaged metrics decrease, and explain why the original two-metre failures have not improved.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若在驗證資料上反覆選參數，該資料就已參與模型選擇，不再是獨立檢驗。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Repeated parameter selection on validation records makes them part of model development. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「保留驗證資料與殘差指標」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

optionsEn: Define data groups and metrics before calibration.

quiz.explanationEn: Define data groups and metrics before calibration. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 保留驗證資料與殘差指標：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Held-out validation and residual metrics: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「保留驗證資料與殘差指標」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Held-out validation and residual metrics” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若在驗證資料上反覆選參數，該資料就已參與模型選擇，不再是獨立檢驗。將大量平穩時段混入短暫失準事件，也會壓低總體平均誤差，使真正影響決策的少數失敗被稀釋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Repeated parameter selection on validation records makes them part of model development. Large amounts of quiet operation can also dilute short but consequential failures, lowering an overall average while leaving decision-relevant errors unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：應依完整事件、季節或設備工況分組留出資料，再同時檢查尖峰、低流量與狀態切換的殘差分布，而不只報告一個平均分數。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Hold out complete events, seasons or operating states, and examine peak, low-flow and switching residuals separately instead of reporting only one averaged score.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「驗證殘差的平均值是零，就表示模型的每一個預測值都完全準確。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A zero mean validation residual means every individual model prediction is exact." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若在驗證資料上反覆選參數，該資料就已參與模型選擇，不再是獨立檢驗。將大量平穩時段混入短暫失準事件，也會壓低總體平均誤差，使真正影響決策的少數失敗被稀釋。
knowledge.textEn: Repeated parameter selection on validation records makes them part of model development. Large amounts of quiet operation can also dilute short but consequential failures, lowering an overall average while leaving decision-relevant errors unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「保留驗證資料與殘差指標」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Held-out validation and residual metrics" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若在驗證資料上反覆選參數，該資料就已參與模型選擇，不再是獨立檢驗。
資料同化後的不確定度下降，就能證明原本的物理模型完全正確。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Repeated parameter selection on validation records makes them part of model development.
Reduced uncertainty after assimilation proves that the underlying physical model is completely correct.
quiz.explanation: 若在驗證資料上反覆選參數，該資料就已參與模型選擇，不再是獨立檢驗。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Repeated parameter selection on validation records makes them part of model development. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 狀態估計與資料同化：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: State estimation and data assimilation: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「狀態估計與資料同化」如何影響水利設施數位孿生的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “State estimation and data assimilation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Digital twins for water infrastructure”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 資料同化利用新觀測修正模型內部狀態，並依預測與量測不確定度決定修正幅度。最簡單的純量卡爾曼更新假設線性、無偏且誤差獨立；水池高度可以作為狀態，但實際系統還可能需要需求量、流量與感測器偏移等多個狀態。更新後的不確定度變小，只表示在既定統計模型下資訊增加，不保證物理方程正確。若資料被重複使用或誤差相關性未處理，估計器可能顯示非常自信，卻無法預測下一個真實事件。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「狀態估計與資料同化」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Assimilation updates internal model states using new observations, with the correction governed by prediction and measurement uncertainty. A scalar Kalman update assumes linearity, unbiased independent errors and known variances. Tank level can be a state, although real systems may also require demand, flow and sensor-bias states. Reduced variance means added information within that statistical model, not proof of correct physics. Reused observations or ignored correlations can produce an overconfident estimate that fails on the next event. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “State estimation and data assimilation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學純量案例：預測水位10 m、預測變異數4 m²，觀測14 m、量測變異數1 m²；K=4/(4+1)=0.8，更新水位10+0.8×4=13.2 m，更新變異數0.8 m²。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For a scalar teaching case, predicted level is 10 m with variance 4 m²; observation is 14 m with variance 1 m².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「資料同化後的不確定度下降，就能證明原本的物理模型完全正確。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Reduced uncertainty after assimilation proves that the underlying physical model is completely correct." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「狀態估計與資料同化」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “State estimation and data assimilation”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 狀態估計與資料同化
knowledge.text: 資料同化利用新觀測修正模型內部狀態，並依預測與量測不確定度決定修正幅度。最簡單的純量卡爾曼更新假設線性、無偏且誤差獨立；水池高度可以作為狀態，但實際系統還可能需要需求量、流量與感測器偏移等多個狀態。
knowledge.textEn: Assimilation updates internal model states using new observations, with the correction governed by prediction and measurement uncertainty. A scalar Kalman update assumes linearity, unbiased independent errors and known variances.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：資料同化後的不確定度下降，就能證明原本的物理模型完全正確。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Reduced uncertainty after assimilation proves that the underlying physical model is completely correct. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「狀態估計與資料同化」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "State estimation and data assimilation" is correct?
options: 資料同化後的不確定度下降，就能證明原本的物理模型完全正確。
偵測器的真陽性率是百分之九十五，就表示每次警報都有百分之九十五機率是真的。
資料同化利用新觀測修正模型內部狀態，並依預測與量測不確定度決定修正幅度。
optionsEn: Reduced uncertainty after assimilation proves that the underlying physical model is completely correct.
A ninety-five-percent true-positive rate means every alert has a ninety-five-percent chance of being genuine.
Assimilation updates internal model states using new observations, with the correction governed by prediction and measurement uncertainty.
quiz.explanation: 資料同化利用新觀測修正模型內部狀態，並依預測與量測不確定度決定修正幅度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Assimilation updates internal model states using new observations, with the correction governed by prediction and measurement uncertainty. The other options are common misconceptions.
