knowledge.textEn: For a scalar teaching case, predicted level is 10 m with variance 4 m²; observation is 14 m with variance 1 m². Gain K=0.8 gives updated level 13.2 m and variance 0.8 m².

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「狀態估計與資料同化」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "State estimation and data assimilation", which statement holds?
options: 教學純量案例：預測水位10 m、預測變異數4 m²，觀測14 m、量測變異數1 m²。
節點出現正水量殘差，就一定代表同等流量的管線漏水。
兩支壓力計讀值相同，就表示它們所在位置的總水頭必定相同。
optionsEn: For a scalar teaching case, predicted level is 10 m with variance 4 m²; observation is 14 m with variance 1 m².
A positive node balance residual always equals the physical leakage flow.
Equal pressure readings always imply equal total hydraulic head at both locations.
quiz.explanation: 教學純量案例：預測水位10 m、預測變異數4 m²，觀測14 m、量測變異數1 m²；K=4/(4+1)=0.8，更新水位10+0.8×4=13.2 m，更新變異數0.8 m²。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: For a scalar teaching case, predicted level is 10 m with variance 4 m²; observation is 14 m with variance 1 m². Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 狀態估計與資料同化：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: State estimation and data assimilation: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「狀態估計與資料同化」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “State estimation and data assimilation” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 先核對變異數與標準差沒有混用，再以獨立合成訊號測試更新公式。記錄更新前的創新量與其預測變異數，檢查它是否長期偏離零或呈連續相關；若持續出現同方向偏差，應評估模型或感測器偏移，而不是無限制調大增益。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check that variances are not confused with standard deviations, then test the update on independent synthetic signals. Record innovations and predicted innovation variance, examining persistent bias and serial correlation before attributing improvement to a larger gain or more frequent updates. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把量測變異數從一平方公尺改為九平方公尺，重算增益、更新水位與變異數，說明結果為何更靠近模型預測。再分析同一量測被錯誤重複同化時，估計器會出現哪一種虛假的信心。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change measurement variance from one to nine square metres and recompute gain, level and variance. Explain the increased weight on the prediction, then analyze the false confidence caused by assimilating the same measurement repeatedly.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：同一觀測若在一次更新後又當作新資料重複加入，會讓變異數不合理地縮小。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Reusing the same observation as new evidence shrinks variance incorrectly. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 先核對變異數與標準差沒有混用，再以獨立合成訊號測試更新公式。記錄更新前的創新量與其預測變異數，檢查它是否長期偏離零或呈連續相關；若持續出現同方向偏差，應評估模型或感測器偏移，而不是無限制調大增益。
knowledge.textEn: Check that variances are not confused with standard deviations, then test the update on independent synthetic signals. Record innovations and predicted innovation variance, examining persistent bias and serial correlation before attributing improvement to a larger gain or more frequent updates.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 把量測變異數從一平方公尺改為九平方公尺，重算增益、更新水位與變異數，說明結果為何更靠近模型預測。再分析同一量測被錯誤重複同化時，估計器會出現哪一種虛假的信心。
knowledge.textEn: Change measurement variance from one to nine square metres and recompute gain, level and variance. Explain the increased weight on the prediction, then analyze the false confidence caused by assimilating the same measurement repeatedly.

quiz.question: 要驗證「狀態估計與資料同化」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "State estimation and data assimilation"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
先核對變異數與標準差沒有混用，再以獨立合成訊號測試更新公式。
最佳化程式只回傳一組參數，就證明這組參數已被資料唯一辨識。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Check that variances are not confused with standard deviations, then test the update on independent synthetic signals.
A single parameter vector returned by an optimizer proves unique identification by the data.
quiz.explanation: 先核對變異數與標準差沒有混用，再以獨立合成訊號測試更新公式。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check that variances are not confused with standard deviations, then test the update on independent synthetic signals. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 狀態估計與資料同化：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: State estimation and data assimilation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「狀態估計與資料同化」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “State estimation and data assimilation” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 同一觀測若在一次更新後又當作新資料重複加入，會讓變異數不合理地縮小。若更新後水位超出物理幾何範圍，簡單截斷也會改變統計分布，必須明確記錄約束處理方式。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Reusing the same observation as new evidence shrinks variance incorrectly. Clipping updated levels to physical bounds also changes their statistical distribution and must be documented as a constraint treatment, not presented as an unchanged unconstrained update. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若資料被重複使用或誤差相關性未處理，估計器可能顯示非常自信，卻無法預測下一個真實事件。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Reused observations or ignored correlations can produce an overconfident estimate that fails on the next event.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「資料同化後的不確定度下降，就能證明原本的物理模型完全正確。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Reduced uncertainty after assimilation proves that the underlying physical model is completely correct." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 同一觀測若在一次更新後又當作新資料重複加入，會讓變異數不合理地縮小。若更新後水位超出物理幾何範圍，簡單截斷也會改變統計分布，必須明確記錄約束處理方式。
knowledge.textEn: Reusing the same observation as new evidence shrinks variance incorrectly. Clipping updated levels to physical bounds also changes their statistical distribution and must be documented as a constraint treatment, not presented as an unchanged unconstrained update.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「狀態估計與資料同化」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "State estimation and data assimilation" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
偵測器的真陽性率是百分之九十五，就表示每次警報都有百分之九十五機率是真的。
同一觀測若在一次更新後又當作新資料重複加入，會讓變異數不合理地縮小。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A ninety-five-percent true-positive rate means every alert has a ninety-five-percent chance of being genuine.
Reusing the same observation as new evidence shrinks variance incorrectly.
quiz.explanation: 同一觀測若在一次更新後又當作新資料重複加入，會讓變異數不合理地縮小。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Reusing the same observation as new evidence shrinks variance incorrectly. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「異常警報與基準發生率」與「情境比較與可追溯決策」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Anomaly alerts and base rates" and "Scenario comparison and traceable decisions": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 異常警報與基準發生率：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Anomaly alerts and base rates: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「異常警報與基準發生率」如何影響水利設施數位孿生的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Anomaly alerts and base rates” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Digital twins for water infrastructure”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 異常偵測器的真陽性率與偽陽性率描述不同條件下的分類表現，不能直接解讀成一次警報為真的機率。當實際異常很少，正常情況的少量誤報也可能超過真正事件。評估時必須定義事件的時間窗口、持續條件與標記來源，避免把連續一百筆同一事故當成一百次獨立成功。警報應附帶可檢查的殘差、感測品質與相似事件證據，並在資料分布變動時重新評估，不能因為模型輸出一個高分就省略人工判讀。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「異常警報與基準發生率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: True-positive and false-positive rates condition on different underlying states and do not directly give the probability that an alert is genuine. When anomalies are rare, false alerts from normal conditions can outnumber real events. Define event windows, persistence and labeling evidence, avoiding treatment of repeated samples from one incident as independent successes. Alerts should expose inspectable residuals and data quality, and performance should be reevaluated after distribution changes rather than replacing review with a high model score. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Anomaly alerts and base rates” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設事件基準率0.001、真陽性率0.95、偽陽性率0.01；警報為真機率=0.95×0.001/(0.95×0.001+0.01×0.999)=8.68%，假設這些比例適用於同一母體。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Assume event prevalence 0.001, true-positive rate 0.95 and false-positive rate 0.01.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「偵測器的真陽性率是百分之九十五，就表示每次警報都有百分之九十五機率是真的。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A ninety-five-percent true-positive rate means every alert has a ninety-five-percent chance of being genuine." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「異常警報與基準發生率」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Anomaly alerts and base rates”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 異常警報與基準發生率
knowledge.text: 異常偵測器的真陽性率與偽陽性率描述不同條件下的分類表現，不能直接解讀成一次警報為真的機率。當實際異常很少，正常情況的少量誤報也可能超過真正事件。
knowledge.textEn: True-positive and false-positive rates condition on different underlying states and do not directly give the probability that an alert is genuine. When anomalies are rare, false alerts from normal conditions can outnumber real events.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：偵測器的真陽性率是百分之九十五，就表示每次警報都有百分之九十五機率是真的。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A ninety-five-percent true-positive rate means every alert has a ninety-five-percent chance of being genuine. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「異常警報與基準發生率」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Anomaly alerts and base rates" is correct?
options: 異常偵測器的真陽性率與偽陽性率描述不同條件下的分類表現，不能直接解讀成一次警報為真的機率。
偵測器的真陽性率是百分之九十五，就表示每次警報都有百分之九十五機率是真的。
只要數位孿生預測某方案耗能較低，就可以忽略供水限制直接執行。
optionsEn: True-positive and false-positive rates condition on different underlying states and do not directly give the probability that an alert is genuine.
A ninety-five-percent true-positive rate means every alert has a ninety-five-percent chance of being genuine.
Any strategy predicted to use less energy can be implemented without checking water-service constraints.
quiz.explanation: 異常偵測器的真陽性率與偽陽性率描述不同條件下的分類表現，不能直接解讀成一次警報為真的機率。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: True-positive and false-positive rates condition on different underlying states and do not directly give the probability that an alert is genuine. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 異常警報與基準發生率：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Anomaly alerts and base rates: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「異常警報與基準發生率」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Anomaly alerts and base rates” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設事件基準率0.001、真陽性率0.95、偽陽性率0.01；警報為真機率=0.95×0.001/(0.95×0.001+0.01×0.999)=8.68%，假設這些比例適用於同一母體。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Assume event prevalence 0.001, true-positive rate 0.95 and false-positive rate 0.01. Alert precision is 0.00095/(0.00095+0.00999)=8.68%, provided all rates apply to the same population. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：使用包含正常時段的獨立事件集建立混淆矩陣，列出每種工況的事件基準率。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Build confusion matrices from independent event sets including normal operation, with prevalence by operating state.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: Assume event prevalence 0.001, true-positive rate 0.95 and false-positive rate 0.01. Alert precision is 0.00095/(0.00095+0.00999)=8.68%, provided all rates apply to the same population.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「異常警報與基準發生率」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Anomaly alerts and base rates", which statement holds?
options: 只要兩條曲線的相關係數最高，就證明兩個感測器已正確同步。
教學假設事件基準率0.001、真陽性率0.95、偽陽性率0.01。
把同一支感測器的資料複製十份再平均，就能得到十支獨立儀器的準確度。
optionsEn: Maximum correlation between two curves proves that their sensors are correctly synchronized.
Assume event prevalence 0.001, true-positive rate 0.95 and false-positive rate 0.01.
Copying one sensor record ten times provides the accuracy of ten independent instruments.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設事件基準率0.001、真陽性率0.95、偽陽性率0.01；警報為真機率=0.95×0.001/(0.95×0.001+0.01×0.999)=8.68%，假設這些比例適用於同一母體。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Assume event prevalence 0.001, true-positive rate 0.95 and false-positive rate 0.01. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 異常警報與基準發生率：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Anomaly alerts and base rates: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「異常警報與基準發生率」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Anomaly alerts and base rates” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 使用包含正常時段的獨立事件集建立混淆矩陣，列出每種工況的事件基準率。將警報合併規則與人工複核結果保留，分開計算事件層級與樣本層級指標，並追蹤漏報及誤報的後續處置，不能只蒐集成功警報作成績單。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Build confusion matrices from independent event sets including normal operation, with prevalence by operating state. Preserve alert-grouping rules and reviewed outcomes, separating event-level from sample-level metrics and tracking missed incidents as well as false alarms instead of collecting only successful alerts. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以十萬個獨立教學事件建表，計算預期真警報與假警報數量。再把基準率提高十倍而保持兩種分類率不變，重算警報可信度，說明相同分類器為何會在不同母體呈現不同的使用價值。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Tabulate expected true and false alerts across one hundred thousand independent teaching events. Increase prevalence tenfold while holding classification rates fixed, then recompute precision and explain why the same classifier has different practical value in another population.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若只在預先挑選的異常樣本上展示高命中率，就無法知道正常運轉會產生多少誤報。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: High hit rates on preselected abnormal records say nothing about false alerts during normal operation. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Build confusion matrices from independent event sets including normal operation, with prevalence by operating state. Preserve alert-grouping rules and reviewed outcomes, separating event-level from sample-level metrics and tracking missed incidents as well as false alarms instead of collecting only successful alerts.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以十萬個獨立教學事件建表，計算預期真警報與假警報數量。再把基準率提高十倍而保持兩種分類率不變，重算警報可信度，說明相同分類器為何會在不同母體呈現不同的使用價值。
knowledge.textEn: Tabulate expected true and false alerts across one hundred thousand independent teaching events. Increase prevalence tenfold while holding classification rates fixed, then recompute precision and explain why the same classifier has different practical value in another population.

quiz.question: 要驗證「異常警報與基準發生率」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Anomaly alerts and base rates"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
把水力參數重新校正到量測曲線，就一定能消除任何時間步長造成的數值誤差。
使用包含正常時段的獨立事件集建立混淆矩陣，列出每種工況的事件基準率。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Recalibrating hydraulic parameters always eliminates numerical error caused by the chosen time step.
Build confusion matrices from independent event sets including normal operation, with prevalence by operating state.
quiz.explanation: 使用包含正常時段的獨立事件集建立混淆矩陣，列出每種工況的事件基準率。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Build confusion matrices from independent event sets including normal operation, with prevalence by operating state. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 異常警報與基準發生率：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Anomaly alerts and base rates: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「異常警報與基準發生率」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Anomaly alerts and base rates” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若只在預先挑選的異常樣本上展示高命中率，就無法知道正常運轉會產生多少誤報。模型上線後需求型態或儀器更換也可能改變基準率與誤差分布，使過去的警報可信度不再適用。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: High hit rates on preselected abnormal records say nothing about false alerts during normal operation. Changing demand patterns or instruments can alter prevalence and error distributions, invalidating a previously measured alert precision. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：警報應附帶可檢查的殘差、感測品質與相似事件證據，並在資料分布變動時重新評估，不能因為模型輸出一個高分就省略人工判讀。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Alerts should expose inspectable residuals and data quality, and performance should be reevaluated after distribution changes rather than replacing review with a high model score.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「偵測器的真陽性率是百分之九十五，就表示每次警報都有百分之九十五機率是真的。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A ninety-five-percent true-positive rate means every alert has a ninety-five-percent chance of being genuine." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若只在預先挑選的異常樣本上展示高命中率，就無法知道正常運轉會產生多少誤報。模型上線後需求型態或儀器更換也可能改變基準率與誤差分布，使過去的警報可信度不再適用。
knowledge.textEn: High hit rates on preselected abnormal records say nothing about false alerts during normal operation. Changing demand patterns or instruments can alter prevalence and error distributions, invalidating a previously measured alert precision.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「異常警報與基準發生率」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Anomaly alerts and base rates" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 若只在預先挑選的異常樣本上展示高命中率，就無法知道正常運轉會產生多少誤報。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
只要數位孿生預測某方案耗能較低，就可以忽略供水限制直接執行。
optionsEn: High hit rates on preselected abnormal records say nothing about false alerts during normal operation.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Any strategy predicted to use less energy can be implemented without checking water-service constraints.
quiz.explanation: 若只在預先挑選的異常樣本上展示高命中率，就無法知道正常運轉會產生多少誤報。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: High hit rates on preselected abnormal records say nothing about false alerts during normal operation. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 情境比較與可追溯決策：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Scenario comparison and traceable decisions: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「情境比較與可追溯決策」如何影響水利設施數位孿生的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Scenario comparison and traceable decisions” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Digital twins for water infrastructure”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 數位孿生的情境比較應固定需求、邊界及評估期間，才能把節能差異歸因於所比較的策略。單位供水能耗只是其中一項指標，仍需同時滿足水位、水壓、水質與設備限制；較低能耗若伴隨供水不足，不能視為等效服務下的改善。每次分析應保存模型版本、資料時間範圍、參數、假設和人工審查結果，使未來能重播同一情境。生成式助教可協助整理證據與解釋差異，但其文字結論不能代替可執行模型輸出或現場授權程序。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「情境比較與可追溯決策」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Scenario comparison holds demand, boundaries and assessment duration fixed so that energy differences can be attributed to the proposed strategy. Specific energy is only one metric alongside level, pressure, quality and equipment constraints; lower energy with unmet demand is not equivalent service improvement. Preserve model version, data period, parameters, assumptions and reviewed conclusions for reproducible replay. A generative tutor can organize evidence and explain differences, but its prose does not replace executable model results or authorized operating procedures. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Scenario comparison and traceable decisions” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設兩方案均供水1000 m³且均滿足相同限制，耗能分別200與180 kWh；單位能耗0.20與0.18 kWh/m³，節能率(200−180)/200=10%，未含價格差與設備磨耗。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Assume both strategies supply 1000 m³ and satisfy identical constraints, using 200 and 180 kWh.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要數位孿生預測某方案耗能較低，就可以忽略供水限制直接執行。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Any strategy predicted to use less energy can be implemented without checking water-service constraints." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「情境比較與可追溯決策」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Scenario comparison and traceable decisions”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 情境比較與可追溯決策
knowledge.text: 數位孿生的情境比較應固定需求、邊界及評估期間，才能把節能差異歸因於所比較的策略。單位供水能耗只是其中一項指標，仍需同時滿足水位、水壓、水質與設備限制；較低能耗若伴隨供水不足，不能視為等效服務下的改善。
knowledge.textEn: Scenario comparison holds demand, boundaries and assessment duration fixed so that energy differences can be attributed to the proposed strategy. Specific energy is only one metric alongside level, pressure, quality and equipment constraints; lower energy with unmet demand is not equivalent service improvement.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要數位孿生預測某方案耗能較低，就可以忽略供水限制直接執行。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Any strategy predicted to use less energy can be implemented without checking water-service constraints. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「情境比較與可追溯決策」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Scenario comparison and traceable decisions" is correct?
options: 只要數位孿生預測某方案耗能較低，就可以忽略供水限制直接執行。
數位孿生的情境比較應固定需求、邊界及評估期間，才能把節能差異歸因於所比較的策略。
節點出現正水量殘差，就一定代表同等流量的管線漏水。
optionsEn: Any strategy predicted to use less energy can be implemented without checking water-service constraints.
Scenario comparison holds demand, boundaries and assessment duration fixed so that energy differences can be attributed to the proposed strategy.
A positive node balance residual always equals the physical leakage flow.
quiz.explanation: 數位孿生的情境比較應固定需求、邊界及評估期間，才能把節能差異歸因於所比較的策略。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Scenario comparison holds demand, boundaries and assessment duration fixed so that energy differences can be attributed to the proposed strategy. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 情境比較與可追溯決策：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Scenario comparison and traceable decisions: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「情境比較與可追溯決策」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Scenario comparison and traceable decisions” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設兩方案均供水1000 m³且均滿足相同限制，耗能分別200與180 kWh；單位能耗0.20與0.18 kWh/m³，節能率(200−180)/200=10%，未含價格差與設備磨耗。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Assume both strategies supply 1000 m³ and satisfy identical constraints, using 200 and 180 kWh. Specific energy is 0.20 and 0.18 kWh/m³, a 10% reduction excluding tariff differences and equipment wear. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：先對照兩方案的供水量、服務品質與邊界條件，再檢查能耗計算是否包含同一組設備。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare supplied volume, service quality and boundaries before checking that energy includes the same equipment.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設兩方案均供水1000 m³且均滿足相同限制，耗能分別200與180 kWh；單位能耗0.20與0.18 kWh/m³，節能率(200−180)/200=10%，未含價格差與設備磨耗。
knowledge.textEn: Assume both strategies supply 1000 m³ and satisfy identical constraints, using 200 and 180 kWh. Specific energy is 0.20 and 0.18 kWh/m³, a 10% reduction excluding tariff differences and equipment wear.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「情境比較與可追溯決策」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Scenario comparison and traceable decisions", which statement holds?
options: 兩支壓力計讀值相同，就表示它們所在位置的總水頭必定相同。
最佳化程式只回傳一組參數，就證明這組參數已被資料唯一辨識。
教學假設兩方案均供水1000 m³且均滿足相同限制，耗能分別200與180 kWh。
optionsEn: Equal pressure readings always imply equal total hydraulic head at both locations.
A single parameter vector returned by an optimizer proves unique identification by the data.
Assume both strategies supply 1000 m³ and satisfy identical constraints, using 200 and 180 kWh.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設兩方案均供水1000 m³且均滿足相同限制，耗能分別200與180 kWh；單位能耗0.20與0.18 kWh/m³，節能率(200−180)/200=10%，未含價格差與設備磨耗。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Assume both strategies supply 1000 m³ and satisfy identical constraints, using 200 and 180 kWh. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 情境比較與可追溯決策：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Scenario comparison and traceable decisions: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「情境比較與可追溯決策」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Scenario comparison and traceable decisions” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 先對照兩方案的供水量、服務品質與邊界條件，再檢查能耗計算是否包含同一組設備。用資料與模型雜湊記錄可重播版本，另列需求及參數敏感度，最後把待現場驗證的假設與已被量測支持的結論分開，避免把模擬排名直接當成操作命令。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare supplied volume, service quality and boundaries before checking that energy includes the same equipment. Record replayable data and model hashes, evaluate demand sensitivity, and separate assumptions needing field confirmation from supported conclusions before converting a scenario ranking into an operational decision. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：建立兩方案比較表，包含供水量、能耗、單位能耗及限制是否滿足，再把其中一方案供水量減少一成。重算指標並說明為何原先節能結論需要重新判讀，最後列出第三人重播分析所需的最小檔案清單。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Compare volume, energy, specific energy and constraint compliance, then reduce the delivery of one strategy by ten percent. Recalculate and reconsider the claimed improvement, listing the minimum files another reviewer needs to reproduce the analysis.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若兩方案使用不同需求總量或電價期間，較低帳單不必然表示較高能源效率。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Different demands or tariff periods make lower cost an unreliable indicator of greater energy efficiency. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 先對照兩方案的供水量、服務品質與邊界條件，再檢查能耗計算是否包含同一組設備。用資料與模型雜湊記錄可重播版本，另列需求及參數敏感度，最後把待現場驗證的假設與已被量測支持的結論分開，避免把模擬排名直接當成操作命令。
knowledge.textEn: Compare supplied volume, service quality and boundaries before checking that energy includes the same equipment. Record replayable data and model hashes, evaluate demand sensitivity, and separate assumptions needing field confirmation from supported conclusions before converting a scenario ranking into an operational decision.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 建立兩方案比較表，包含供水量、能耗、單位能耗及限制是否滿足，再把其中一方案供水量減少一成。重算指標並說明為何原先節能結論需要重新判讀，最後列出第三人重播分析所需的最小檔案清單。
knowledge.textEn: Compare volume, energy, specific energy and constraint compliance, then reduce the delivery of one strategy by ten percent. Recalculate and reconsider the claimed improvement, listing the minimum files another reviewer needs to reproduce the analysis.

quiz.question: 要驗證「情境比較與可追溯決策」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Scenario comparison and traceable decisions"?
options: 先對照兩方案的供水量、服務品質與邊界條件，再檢查能耗計算是否包含同一組設備。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
驗證殘差的平均值是零，就表示模型的每一個預測值都完全準確。
optionsEn: Compare supplied volume, service quality and boundaries before checking that energy includes the same equipment.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
A zero mean validation residual means every individual model prediction is exact.
quiz.explanation: 先對照兩方案的供水量、服務品質與邊界條件，再檢查能耗計算是否包含同一組設備。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare supplied volume, service quality and boundaries before checking that energy includes the same equipment. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 情境比較與可追溯決策：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Scenario comparison and traceable decisions: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「情境比較與可追溯決策」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Scenario comparison and traceable decisions” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若兩方案使用不同需求總量或電價期間，較低帳單不必然表示較高能源效率。缺少版本與輸入紀錄的漂亮圖表也無法重現，因此不能在條件已改變後沿用舊排名而不重新計算。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Different demands or tariff periods make lower cost an unreliable indicator of greater energy efficiency. Attractive plots without versioned inputs cannot be reproduced, and old rankings should not be reused after conditions change without recalculation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：生成式助教可協助整理證據與解釋差異，但其文字結論不能代替可執行模型輸出或現場授權程序。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A generative tutor can organize evidence and explain differences, but its prose does not replace executable model results or authorized operating procedures.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要數位孿生預測某方案耗能較低，就可以忽略供水限制直接執行。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Any strategy predicted to use less energy can be implemented without checking water-service constraints." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若兩方案使用不同需求總量或電價期間，較低帳單不必然表示較高能源效率。缺少版本與輸入紀錄的漂亮圖表也無法重現，因此不能在條件已改變後沿用舊排名而不重新計算。
knowledge.textEn: Different demands or tariff periods make lower cost an unreliable indicator of greater energy efficiency. Attractive plots without versioned inputs cannot be reproduced, and old rankings should not be reused after conditions change without recalculation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「情境比較與可追溯決策」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Scenario comparison and traceable decisions" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
若兩方案使用不同需求總量或電價期間，較低帳單不必然表示較高能源效率。
節點出現正水量殘差，就一定代表同等流量的管線漏水。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Different demands or tariff periods make lower cost an unreliable indicator of greater energy efficiency.
A positive node balance residual always equals the physical leakage flow.
quiz.explanation: 若兩方案使用不同需求總量或電價期間，較低帳單不必然表示較高能源效率。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Different demands or tariff periods make lower cost an unreliable indicator of greater energy efficiency. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
